reviews.text: If you love gourmet grilled sandwiches and comfort food, this place is a must-visit. They offer a huge variety of flavors, and every sandwich feels unique and made with attention to detail. I especially recommend the French Dip — and definitely add mushrooms, they make it even richer and more flavorful. Pair it with their tomato soup or a side of crispy fries for the full experience. Amazing food, great atmosphere, and one of those places you’ll want to come back to try more from the menu.
Best grilled cheese sandwiches anywhere. It is a must have.
The chesZeesteak was amazing! Great music.
Amazing food and amazing people great little beach spot!
Absolutely Delicious Food and Great Service...Definitely a Great place to stop and eat.
We got the CheeZersteak and the Ruben.. So good!!!! Definitely want to try all their sandwiches.
The nicest people run this place!!! Super impressed with the food, service, and even bought a t shirt which was a great price! Will be coming back here next time were in ormond. Loved every bit!

This place is truly a hidden gem! The Philly cheesesteaks sandwich is absolutely mouthwatering—packed with flavor w au jus and made to perfection. It’s definitely worth the drive to check it out. The homemade chips and coleslaw are the perfect sidekicks, fresh and delicious. Highly recommend giving this spot a try!

Absolutely amazing food! Cooked to perfection, came out quick, and so SO good. The service was amazing too, the minute I walked in I was greeted, all my questions were answered (Sorry😅) and they even let me make my own sandwich! Quick edit: They also allow dogs on the patio. Not inside, though! The atmosphere is perfectly between 3 am diner and 5 pm brunch, where the people are happy but they arent yelling. They even have a TV showing off the food, so you know exactly what youll get!!! I highly recommend!!

This little place is amazing… and whats more amazing than the food, is the owner, Tracy. We ended up here at least daily. They have so many options and the food is fresh. Im not surprised they have a 4.8 on google reviews (which is almost impossible to do with over a 1000 reviews). Keep up the amazing job Absolutely CheeZee!
Delicious sandwiches!
Really good sandwiches as takeout near the beach

This place is absolutely adorable ! Staff - friendly, caring, attentive Management - sweet, caring Food- amazing, great variety, great quality Absolutely best grilled cheese in Volusia County! The kind woman who runs this establishment is the nicest person! She remembers all her regulars and is just a breath of fresh air. I love the idea of a restaurant being super confident in a dish and taking it to the next level ! Niche restaurant for a niche crowd ! Loveeeeeee ! 10/10 would recommend!!

Absolutely my favorite little lunch place! The food is always fresh and incredible. I wouldn't say it's cheap but I also wouldn't say the prices are outrageous, plus the sandwiches are rather large. The staff is always helpful and willing to make adjustments.
The butter that I assume they used to grill the turkey sandwich was burnt! Not a good thing to smell, nor taste! Very disappointed!
Great food, great people, and amazing atmosphere. Price was great!

I've driven past hundreds of times and never stopped. Kicking myself now for that!!! It's a small family own and run business and it had a really nice and relaxed vibe. The food though is soooo good! They no longer have mac n cheese, so we got the macaroni salad. It was so good! I got the French dip and my husband got the Reuben. Both were fantastic! We also got the cinnamon roll dessert grilled cheezee, but I accidentally ate it before we got a picture 🤷🏻‍♀️

Came in on a Saturday afternoon, only 1 other customer ahead of us in line, but we had to wait 20 min in line. Understaffed, but we get it. We’ve worked food service before. The lady behind the counter asked my wife for her order and as she started to order, the lady turned and walked away mid-order. I understand being the only person at the counter but she could’ve waited 30 seconds to finish the order or at least said “Excuse me, I’ll be right back.”
If you like cheese this is the place to be. There are sides that are very good also.
Absolutely delicious! Best home made Mac n cheese in the area hands down. And the milkshakes and desert r great also. A MUST STOP FOR REAL GOOD COMFORT FOOD😋🌴🌊
I am from Philly area. I wasnt sure about Rye bread. It was delicious. My only complaint was I only asked for no peppers and I did not get mushrooms either... FF were good. ..
Cuban sandwich. delicious! Service great!
Delicious! Hubby had the French dip and I had the Philly cheesesteak with spinach and artichoke, so yummy! Thanks Tracy!
Tracy & Pascal make this little gem terrific especially if you need to eat gluten free. All food is excellent 👌 cute inside and fun place to sit and enjoy.

If you find yourself reading the reviews here, I would encourage you to go straight to the one stars and be entertained. Both by the ridiculousness of them and the owners willingness to respond. After that, head over and grab a fantastic grilled Sheree of your choosing. I would imagine every variation is as delicious as the cheezeesteak and veggie that my wife and I had. Both the house made chips and macaroni salad were exceptional. Good price for the amount of food you get. I doubt you’ll be disappointed. Unless of course you are lactose intolerant.
Always friendly great atmosphere, food, everything the quality is just amazing. I love it!!!!
The two of us visited this bar. We decided to watch the sunset and have dinner. The lamb's kare was really delicious, one large portion was enough for two. I really liked the place, I'll come again.
This establishment is superb. come see Loann see us the a beam of light. So sweet and courteous.. Btw she makes amazing drinks.
Had a great experience here! Loann was an amazing bartender with knowledge about the Orlando area. Definitely recommend this rooftop. Will be back!
Big shout out to AUSTIN for helping me get a table reservation for my clients last minute at this amazing restaurant. He's a gem!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An unforgettable experience! This was our first time at AC Sky Bar and it couldn't have been better. Everything was spectacular: the delicious food, the amazing atmosphere, and the impeccable service. We want to give a special shoutout to Valerie, who made sure our evening was truly wonderful; her attention to detail and warmth made all the difference. Without a doubt, a 5-star place and we will definitely be back. Highly recommended!

Went on Sunday and let me tell you..after valeting my ride and taking the elevator up the music up there at Sky bar killed our vibe. Food and service were fine. However when the DJ isn't present, plays for themselves and not for the vibe and ambience of the venue...we suffered & left more quickly than we had liked 🙄

We had Alex as our server he was amazing and helped us so much. He was very patient and kind and offered to change our fries bc it wasn’t fresh enough and change out steak bc it was over cooked. He also got me a little cake for my bday.
Diana is the best server I have ever had at this establishment and she is the best the most attentive. All credit goes out I bet you o make my night wonderful. Credit to your team
Mary es la mejor persona del mundo un 10
Mari was attentive to our needs during a busy time at the lounge

I came her tonight with my sister and the service and drinks were amazing. Luccia was our server and was attentive, professional, and joyful! She added to the great experience. We will be coming back and asking for her again!

Hermoso Luger,una vista espectacular. La semana Pasada visitamos este Lugar antes de ir al concierto. Fue uno de los lugares mas cercanos al Kia center,antes del concierto. Al llegar el Lugar estaba super lleno pero la alfritiona que estaba reciviendo el personal fue un encanto. No hablabamos ingles pero para nuestra solpresa Ella nos ATENDIO en espñol y no solo nos ATENDIO en nuestro idioma tambien hiso todo lo que estuvo en su arcanse para que pudiermos cenar antes de ir al concierto. Tuvimos que esperar un chin pero valio la pena,Mary logro unir unas sillas y darnos una mesa. Todo estuvo muy delicioso. La comida,la vista,la atsmofera,los tragos Y la mesera Valerie fue todo un encanto. Volveremos pronto.. MESERA Y RECIVIMIENTO EN ESPÑOL FUE GENIAL..
Ask for loann on the drinks she’s the best one on the team
Yalll get with loann she’s the goat with the drinks love her downnnnn 💕

Really enjoyed our visit to AC Skybar. The atmosphere was great, the views were beautiful, and the drinks were on point. Service was excellent overall, and Keith did a great job taking care of us. Looking forward to coming back.

For a restaurant to be in this location you would expect top tier service, as well as food. All of theses expectations tend to fall short when you could compare their chicken Alfredo to those in a can, no flavor whatsoever. I believe they should make a change at head chef, doesn’t take Gordon Ramsay to notice the lack of flavor. Overlooking their poor food quality, I waited almost 15 mins for a simple can of soda. Having MULTIPLE servers walk past me, did an awful job catering to myself and my group. Not once was asked if I needed a refill nor was anyone in my party. I might have as well put on an apron and served myself…. Between the service and poor poor food quality. I advise to spend your money else where. DO NO RECOMMEND

Keith took care of me and my friends, and I can’t say enough good things about the experience. His customer service was absolutely amazing and went far beyond our expectations. He was friendly, professional, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed from start to finish. It’s rare to find someone who genuinely cares about providing such outstanding service, and Keith truly made our experience memorable. I highly recommend working with him, and we look forward to seeing him again in the future. Thank you, Keith, for going above and beyond!

Now the View is great! However sadly, that's as good as it gets at AC Sky bar. We were not warmly invited or treated kindly by the welcome staff, our drinks were way too sweet for us and food was average at best. Also for a classy place like this, the young DJ sounded and looked like a Bedroom DJ who had been given his first big gig. Music and even quality of sound was totally off, he had no connection with the crowd but you could tell he was happy with himself regardless. Why don't you try looking at, interacting with and engaging with the crowd instead of your laptop. Then the crowd may stay longer! This is not a nightclub after all, it's your job to keep the patrons engaged. Place really deserves more care, attention to detail and sophistication from its staff that it has right now.

AC is one of my go to places in Orlando. Hailey and Jordan always take care of me and their service is top notch. Bartenders make wonderful cocktails and the brunch DJ that was present for 5/17/2026 and 5/24/2026 made everyone vibe and fill in tables. Make him a regular

went for sunday brunch with my friend and our server hailey was amazing! she was quick and very attentive and gave great menu recommendations! the $22 bottomless mimosas were a great deal as well + the music provided by the live dj was amazing and made it such a fun vibe! will definitely be back again !!
Very nice view. Drinks very good and well made. Servers good and on point. The music kept everyone jumping. Made the four hours fly by. Good atmosphere and would go back.

I went for brunch and had an amazing time! My server Hailey was incredibly attentive and made sure we were comfortable. Our food order was perfect and everything came out really quick. I had the bottomless mimosas, Steak Tips, Fried Calamari, and Tuna Nachos, all of them SO delicious. The vibes were awesome, the DJ had my whole table dancing, his name was BlumerSounds. Thank you SkyBar for the wonderful experience, and thank you again Hailey for the amazing service!

Everything about this place is worth it. The Sunday brunch you cant beat, especially the vibes. They got a new DJ for Sundays and it makes it the best hangout place. For sure will be returning! Hailey was our server she was great!
The Vibes the DJ brought were absolutely immaculate, great food and service provided by Jordyn was excellent. Gonna go back for a Sunday brunch soon!

Wow! What an amazing Sunday brunch! The Dj killed it, the music was at the perfect level not too loud but you were still able to dance. The food was great. The bar manager was so nice as well as Hailey our server! I will definitely be back to Sunday brunch!

Came for a date and first thing i noticed immediately, DJ is absolutely terrible!! Music did not suit the venue or create a high end vibe 🤡 For such a beautiful spot, this should be on point or why would people stay more than 1 drink. Food arrived lukewarm. Service can be improved. When these things improve, it will bring busier so maybe I'll come back nex year.

Raul at Universal Nissan provided outstanding customer service. He was friendly, professional, and attentive from start to finish. He took the time to answer my questions, made me feel welcome, and never made me feel rushed or pressured. His positive attitude and willingness to help made the experience enjoyable. It’s clear that he genuinely cares about providing excellent service and making customers feel valued. I highly recommend working with Raul if you’re looking for someone who is knowledgeable, respectful, and dedicated to great customer care.
i went in looking for an idea of what i wanted for a new car and Raul helped so much , answered my questions and took his time.Will definitely be coming back !
My company was looking to buy a truck. I’m a ford guy. I’ve been driving ford for 3 years. Sterling got me switched to a frontier, I love it… and the life time warranty will help customers a lot.
This is my 4th lease from Sterling. Great personality, positive energy and work very hard for his customers.

Chris Oliva provided outstanding service from start to finish. He was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of my questions. His attention to detail and dedication to making sure everything went smoothly truly stood out. I really appreciated his friendly attitude and willingness to go above and beyond to ensure I had a great experience. I highly recommend Chris Oliva to anyone looking to purchase a car and have a smooth, stress-free buying experience! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’ve been trying to buy a car the last 3 months. I couldn’t make decisions on what I want. After I met with Sterling, I handed up buying the car from him; but for Sterling, it wasn’t about selling. He was just make sure that I make the right decision for myself. Thank you!
Sterling helped my daughter got into a brand new kicks. She truly loves her baby.

This was by far one of the best dealership experiences I’ve ever had. The process was quick, the team was professional, and they truly cared about making sure I left happy. I appreciate everything they did for me.

Excellent customer service! The entire staff treated me like family and never made me feel pressured. They were honest, patient, and helped me drive home in the exact vehicle I wanted. I’ll definitely be coming back for my next car.

Buying a car can be stressful, but Universal Nissan made it easy. The team kept me informed throughout the process, explained everything clearly, and made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. I highly recommend them.

From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed. Everyone was respectful, knowledgeable, and genuinely wanted to help. They worked hard to get me a payment that fit my budget, and I couldn’t be happier with my purchase. Thank you, Universal Nissan!

I had a great experience at Universal Nissan. The staff was friendly, professional, and made the entire buying process simple. They answered all of my questions without any pressure and helped me find the perfect vehicle. I would definitely recommend this dealership to anyone looking for a new car.

Just heard the new ad for Nissan. Calling their customers weekend warriors. That is a term for national guard and army reserve. As an active duty veteran of the united states army how dare you use that. Your are not enlisted and yall dont care

Feedback score of 5 Stars i gave to Universal Nissan Service Department was due to the professional Service Advisor (DANIEL MENDEZ). The insights he provided on recommendations of what was the best for the continuous mechanical operation of my vehicle, was I believe honest and caring. I Like that Mr. Mendez did not try to push unnecessary additional items to service, but provide information on future visits and expectations on additional cost and details on next service visit. I Will definitely Return an recommend Universal Nissan to friends and family, due to the continuous first rate treatment and services. Thank you
I love my new car great service
Julio is the best
i had the easiest and greatest time! Daniel was informative and found what i wanted after listening! he nailed it on the first try. pressure free and hassle free! thank you for your assistance!

Very good service very diligent and fast the best
Great experience very fast and very diligent

Sarfaraz Ahmed did an amazing job helping us get our daughter her first car !! He was very knowledgeable and helped us find the right deal for us !! The whole team at nissan did an amazing job as well !!

We had an amazing experience at this dealership.They had a huge selection of cars and a very friendly staff. Our salesman CJ was a man of his word and a man of God. No pressure and very knowledgeable. My family purchased 2 cars on the same day.
Muy buen servicio.

I went to Universal looking for a Nissan Frontier truck. I took a test drive with the salesman and afterwards he gave me a price with my trade. I wanted more for my trade so he asked a sales manager. The sales manager took over. He responded to my objections with rude comments. I said I don't need to listen to this and I don't need this truck. I informed another employee about his behavior and the sales manager left. I walked out. Universal is not the only dealer in town.
Excelente servicio al cliente y maravilloso equipo de trabajo. Recomendado 200%
Julio Valdez was my salesman. He was insightful and honest with everything
Excellent place to get a new car… mostly o the people there is super kind… My experience with Mr Raul Ruiz was excellent, he came to help me during his day off… I really appreciate it
Great service and very helpful Sarfaraz Ahmed. Muy buen servicio
Awesome experience, Sarfaraz Ahmed was amazing since the first minute. Highly recommended.

Lovely Place, comfortable, clean and well maintained. The owners John & Arthur provide a relaxing environment. The Breakfast are gourmet and the Inn is located so close to everything in Mt Dora. Highly Recommend its special place.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Adora Inn. Arthur and John welcomed us and we felt at home immediately. They are proud of their town and gave us many recommendations for restaurants and places to visit in downtown Mount Dora, just blocks away. We stayed in the Treehouse room on the third floor which was spacious, bright, comfortably cool and immaculate. The highlight of our stay was breakfast! Each morning these engaging gentlemen prepared a gourmet meal served on the enclosed patio. We will definitely be back to stay at this delightful and historical inn.

We can’t say enough in words to capture the beauty, peace and essence of this special place! Quiet, clean, classy 5 star hospitality! John and Art are wonderful hosts! Breakfast was out of this world! We will be back soon to this oasis!!!!

What a phenomenal weekend me and my friend had at the beautiful Adora Inn! Rooms were clean and very cozy! The two hosts were spectacular and so kind and attentive We got to meet Sam and his sister! 🐾. The beautiful breakfast was delicious and accommodated our dietary needs. If I could give more than stars, I would !!! Thank you guys!!!!! Xo

Our stay at Adora Inn was absolutely lovely. The hosts were incredibly kind and welcoming, the atmosphere was cozy and charming, and the breakfasts were delicious every morning. It was such a peaceful, memorable getaway and we would happily stay again!
Me and my Wife enjoyed our stay for a long weekend. Great hospitality and breakfast were great. 4-5 min walking distance from downtown.

Breakfast was great and made to order. French toast croissants were awesome, fresh fruitbowl, and scones. Room was clean and very comfortable with a large tub my wife loved . Nothing negative to say about this place and if we're ever back in this area we'll definitely come back.

The Adora Inn is a quaint B&B with warm and inviting hosts. It is easy walking distance to downtown Mt. Dora and their Music and Town Hall. The beds were comfortable, the inn and rooms were very clean, the parking was on-site, and the Olive room was generously sized and tastefully decorated. ||However, if you are a post, pre, or menopausal woman who is plagued by night sweats or hot flashes, especially at night, this may not be the place for you. There are no individual in-room air conditioning units or individual controls, nor will the hosts set the temperature below 74 degrees, saying other guests will complain that it's too cold or their A/C unit will freeze up. If the A/C unit freezes up when the temperature is set in the lower 70s, the owners should consider upgrading to a new or better A/C unit to ensure guest comfort. They did provide an industrial fan, but it just blew around warm air and had little impact. Needless to say, our two-night stay turned into a one-night stay due to my inability to sleep in warm conditions because of my medical issue. The hosts did not provide a refund for the night we were unable to stay at the inn due to the warm sleeping conditions. Unfortunately, I couldn't go two nights in a row without sleep, so we chose to leave a day early.||If you like to watch TV to wind down before bed or as you get ready in the morning, the inn doesn't have TVs in the common areas or in the individual bedrooms. In addition, if you choose to stay in the Olive…
Cute and quaint B&B with amazing owners. Easy walking distance to restaurants and cultural events. Private parking. Definitely recommend. Note: bathrooms are small for tall men but we survived!
Perfect stay. Hosts were great. Room was great. Food was great! We will return 👍🏼

Everything about Adora Inn was spectacular. The location is a short walk from everything. The house is beautiful and immaculately clean. The hosts were amazing for our entire stay. The breakfasts were our best meals of our entire stay. We will definitely be back and will recommend to everyone we know.

We had the best time at your beautiful Inn sharing many stories and memories of our past 46 years celebrating our friendship!! Your home was warm and inviting and your breakfasts were so delicious. The rooms were clean and comfy and I would highly recommend to anyone to stay there and enjoy your beautiful home!! Thank you for your incredible hospitality!!
Lovely breakfast and I loved their dogs. The atmosphere is inviting and it's clean and close to everything.

If you have the occasion to go to Mt Dora, don’t miss staying at the Adora Inn. Tasteful, immaculate, comfortable. Jon and Arthur are great hosts. Breakfast was terrific with Jon and Arthur having chef skills. A short walk to everything and better to be a few blocks from the center of town. Would absolutely stay again.

My husband and I had a very short but delightful stay at the Adora Inn. It was our first time visiting Mt. Dora so we searched to find a highly rated, convenient, and welcoming place. We were not disappointed. Our hosts, John and Arthur, were very accommodating to our needs, and we gathered helpful tips for our time in Mt. Dora. The breakfasts served were outstanding highlighting their unique culinary skills. Our room was comfortable and clean. We were well taken care of. Thank you John and Arthur!
John and Arthur are wonderful hosts. The Inn is in a perfect location.
Un excelente lugar puedes caminar al centro en 5 minutos. Paz y tranquilidad.

This is the third time that my husband and I have stayed at the Adora Inn, and it never disappoints! John and Arthur are just the nicest people, very pleasant to talk to, always interesting stories to tell, and their hospitality and how they accommodate you is top-notch! The breakfast every morning is so delicious, and always served with a smile along with some good stories , and a visit once in awhile from their beautiful Salukis! The location is perfect for walking around the adorable town and the parks, and John and Arthur are always open to providing suggestions for places to go and eat! Keep up the good job, gentleman, we will definitely be back again!
Great Spot!

I came upon this bed and breakfast by surprise as a I searched for places to stay in Mount Dora.|There is so much I can say (the list is long), but will sum it up to this:|1) The house and rooms are darling, cozy and tastefully decorated with the art of one of the owners. It is very clean and the bed is very comfortable. One has access to the living and dinning room areas, which are beautiful and relaxing. The music was also extraordinary!|2)The treatment I received by the hosts, was just beyond expectations: very kind, accommodating, and I felt at home with dear friends.|3) The breakfast is simply unbelievable: gourmet, delicious beyond words and with an amazing assortment of different things (e.g., fresh juices, fresh fruit, French toasts, sausage and roasted apples, and a variety of beverages).|4) It is a blocks from downtown.|Simply a fantastic experience and just what I needed!|Noteworthy details: There are two older dogs.

I came upon this bed and breakfast by surprise as a I searched for places to stay in Mount Dora. There is so much I can say (the list is long), but will sum it up to this: 1) The house and rooms are darling, cozy and tastefully decorated with the art of one of the owners. It is very clean and the bed is very comfortable. One has access to the living and dinning room areas, which are beautiful and relaxing. The music was also extraordinary! 2)The treatment I received by the hosts, was just beyond expectations: very kind, accommodating, and I felt at home with dear friends. 3) The breakfast is simply unbelievable: gourmet, delicious beyond words and with an amazing assortment of different things (e.g., fresh juices, fresh fruit, French toasts, sausage and roasted apples, and a variety of beverages). 4) It is a blocks from downtown. Simply a fantastic experience and just what I needed!

We had a wonderful stay at Adora Inn. It was exactly what we were hoping for. We stayed in the Periwinkle room and the claw tooth bathtub was amazing. John and Arthur were the most gracious hosts. We appreciated all of the recommendations for dining options etc. And breakfast on the patio was amazing! Mount Dora is such a hidden gem. We will certainly be back!

We were delighted to find this gem in Mt. Dora. The rooms are beautiful and the location, one block from downtown Mt. Dora, is perfect for walking the town. The B&B is situated in a house built in 1916, but which is extremely well maintained. The breakfast was incredible. John and Arthur are the perfect hosts, attending to your needs, but never intrusive. We will definitely be back.

My husband and I just spent 2 nights at the Adora Inn in Mountain Dora and had a wonderful time. We stayed in the Periwinkle Room and found it to be very comfortable. Our stayed included breakfast each morning which was homemade and delicious. The location was perfect within walking distance to restaurants and attractions. The hospitality couldn’t have been better.

It was an absolute pleasure to stay at "Adora Inn". John and Arthur were very pleasant, their daily breakfast was delicious and their help with guiding us as to where to go and what to do made our trip so much more fun. We can't wait to return with some more friends!

This comfortable Bed and Breakfast is steps away from downtown, providing easy access to the shops, restaurants, bars and lakefront of this quaint community. The Inn itself is located on a peacefully quiet street, providing one way access out of town and a bi-directional bike path on the other lane. The hosts, John and Arthur, were delightfully engaging, entertaining and a wealth of knowledge concerning our options for dining, shopping and sight-seeing. They confidently steered us in the right direction to realize the best of Mount Dora. Both the Inn and their recommended options, consistently provided an engaging and entertaining level of gracious service that is rarely found in a friendly bantering manner. On top of all this, the breakfasts were an absolute treat. We loved our stay and highly recommend the Adora Inn.

Our first time and wont be our last! From a personal welcome by Authur to the tremendous hospitality by both owners, its friendly, warm, quant and so convenient to shops, meals and anything near Mt Dora. What a real treat for anyone wanting a B&B authentic experience.

The Adora Inn is a gem! John & Arthur go above & beyond to make your stay unforgettable. The rooms are spotless. The beds are a dream. The Inn is beautifully done and breakfast……exquisite! We will definitely stay with them when we go to town!

A charming bed and breakfast located within walking distance to downtown Mount Dora and its shops and restaurants. John and Arthur are very gracious hosts. Daily gourmet breakfasts were delicious. We stayed in the Periwinkle room. It was clean and comfortable. A great place to stay!
Incredible place! The food , the service , top notch 5/5 stars will definitely be dining here again!

Amazing service as always. Food amazing as always. This place is a gem in all of Orlando. Best Italian restaurant. I want to gatekeep this location because it’s THAT good. If you want real Italian food. Served by amazing servers (THANK YOU SEAN YOU CRUSHED IT). You need to come here. The owner also came by and did a table touch. Will always come back.
Everyone took great care of us. We even had a toddler and they made us feel very welcome. Juan was absolutely amazing and we will be back. Thank you!
Food was excellent and service was perfect. Juan was attentive and friendly.
My son and I flew in from Rhode Island. We went there the second night for a party and the food 🤌🏽 was fantastic. Will definitely recommend it.!

The food was absolutely amazing! This is a cozy, smaller restaurant with a welcoming, homey atmosphere. Don’t let the size fool you—the staff have big hearts, provide a warm welcome, and serve incredibly flavorful dishes. Gonzo took excellent care of me, helping me choose the perfect wine for the evening and offering fantastic recommendations throughout my visit. The service was attentive, the food was delicious, and the overall experience was wonderful. I will definitely be coming back! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Excelente comida y muy buena atención

Delicious! Had the Cesar salad, the meatballs, the filet Mignon w/ tagliatelle & truffle special as well as their veal tortellini in butter & sage sauce — amazing! Everything tasted fresh & light! Service was also friendly & attentive! Will be back to try more of their dishes!
The food was amazing! The waiters were very nice and professional. They also had an alcohol-free tiramisu, and it was delicious. عندهم تيراميسو ما فيه كحول، والأكل لذيذ.
Great food, great service. Perfect for an intimate date night or family dinner.

This was our first time coming to Adriatico, and we plan on going again! If I needed to use just one word to describe our experience I would say it is FANTASTIC! The restaurant is cozy, the service is perfect (enough attention for you to have everything that you need when you need it without feeling overwhelmed), and the food amazing!
Decent bolognese pasta in the Orlando area. Great staff and atmosphere. Great location as well.
Gonzo was such an amazing server and the food was so delicious! Recommended this place 10/10
Genuinely one of the best dining experiences I’ve ever had. So grateful to have come across this gem, my husband and I will be coming back in the years to come!
Best in town!!Bravi👏
Excelente servicio de Juan, muy buenas recomendaciones muy atento y servicial. Sin duda volveremos

Beautiful understated atomsphere with a patina copper bar. The food is authentic upscale Italian and the deserts are exceptional! Our waiter, Juan, was charming and attentive. We had a wonderful dinner!
Amazing food and the staff is exceptional. Don’t let the unassuming exterior dissuade you, it’s fantastic.

This place was absolutely incredible. I was so excited to dive in that I completely forgot to take photos, but that just means we’ll definitely be back! Adriatico is truly a special place in College Park. The food is incredible; some of the best Italian I’ve had in Orlando. The house-made pasta alone is worth the visit, and every meal I’ve had there has been outstanding. You can tell everything is made with care and attention to detail. They also have a great wine list that pairs beautifully with the menu. What really makes Adriatico memorable, though, is the hospitality. It’s a small but mighty team, and you feel that warmth the moment you walk in. Rosetta, one of the owners, runs the front of the restaurant and makes every guest feel genuinely welcome. The first time I met her, it honestly felt like meeting a long-lost family member. She creates an atmosphere that feels less like dining out and more like being invited into someone’s home for an incredible meal. Chef Marco’s cooking brings authentic Italian flavors to the table, and together they’ve created something really special in College Park. If you want to experience the feeling of a cozy Italian trattoria without getting on a plane, take a trip to Adriatico. It’s a gem.

Last weekend, my wife and I decided to check out Aloma Cinema Grill after hearing about it from a coworker, and it honestly turned into a much better experience than the usual crowded movie theater trips we’ve had lately. We went for a late evening showing and arrived expecting long lines and overpriced snacks, but the atmosphere felt surprisingly relaxed. The theater has an older, local feel to it that’s actually refreshing compared to the giant chain theaters that all look the same. The staff at the front counter were friendly and patient even with several groups arriving at once. What really made the experience stand out was being able to order food during the movie without it becoming distracting. I ordered wings and fries while my wife got a burger, and both were honestly better than typical theater food. The fries were hot and crispy, and the portions were bigger than expected. Prices also felt more reasonable than most theaters we’ve visited recently. The seating wasn’t luxury recliner style, but it was still comfortable enough for a full movie, and the theater itself was clean. The sound quality and screen looked great too. One thing I appreciated was that the audience seemed respectful — no constant phone screens lighting up the room or people talking through the movie. Parking was easy, which is a huge plus around busy areas, and getting in and out after the film was simple. Overall, Aloma Cinema Grill gave us a fun, low-stress movie night with good food and a…

Backlot Express is the perfect example of what it's like when dining at Disney's Hollywood Studios. It's mediocre, low quality fast food that's designed to feed the masses. First, the sticker shock is real. Prices here are high, and unlike at Disneyland Park, there's no annual passholder discount for quick service in Florida. If you're used to that easy 10% off out West, it's a rude awakening. (Yes, I have an annual pass at both Disneyland and Disney World). In search of a quick snack and a place to rest our feet, hubby and I shared a kid's meal that cost around $10, and it felt pretty underwhelming. It consisted of two small chicken strips, a tiny portion of fries, a small bag of sliced apples, and a mini bottle of Dasani. For what you get, it's hard not to feel like Disney is pushing things too far with the pricing. There are a few redeeming qualities. The fried food itself was actually really good. The tenders and fries were crispy, hot, and satisfying, and the apples have always been a favorite of mine. But the reason we always stop here, and one of THE best perks in the park, is the self-serve soda fountain. Being able to refill your drink while you sit and eat feels almost unheard of at Disney these days, and it's a nice little win. The space itself is huge, with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, which makes it easier to find a spot even during busy times. Still, if you're visiting during peak hours, definitely use the Disney app mobile ordering feature. It'll save…

The line is outrageous. You are better off ordering in the mobile app. The cast members at the register are not efficient at all. Only good thing is the food is food and the location has plenty of tables to sit. Also you can refill your own drink.

I got the Smoked BBQ Pulled Pork Burger (at the very reasonable price of $15.99) with fries and a Pineapple-Citrus Margarita (at the very unreasonable price of $18.50) but everything was delicious. They had the kids’ staples so everyone was happy. The decor was a shabby backlot with a bunch of paint cans so not the most inspiring ambiance, but everyone loved the food. I was definitely eyeing the Wookiee Cookie, which looked like a giant cream pie but it wasn't included in the meal plan, so we didn't get one.

Very mediocre and overpriced food, but giving an extra star because they at least had a Cuban Sandwich with plantain chips, which is better than most things that are fast-casual at Hollywood Studios. It's a good place to hide in the rain too.

I stayed at the Orlando World Center Marriott over Memorial Day weekend and overall had a good experience, but there were a few things that could be improved. The highlights were definitely the water slides, lazy river, and the variety of food options available throughout the resort. The room was clean and comfortable, the bed was great, and valet service was efficient and convenient. We also appreciated the shuttle service to Disney, which made transportation much easier. A few things kept the stay from being excellent. The pillows were extremely soft and offered very little support. The main pool was surprisingly shallow throughout most of the pool, which was unexpected for a resort of this size. For families with younger children, I also felt the kiddie pool area was too small given the number of guests staying at the resort. One of my biggest complaints was the atmosphere at the pool in the afternoons and evenings. The DJ often turned the pool area into more of a nightclub vibe than a family resort environment. While some guests may enjoy that energy, it wasn’t what we were looking for during a family vacation. Overall, we enjoyed the resort amenities, especially the lazy river and slides, and the convenience of the Disney shuttle. With a few adjustments to the family pool experience, this would be an even better destination for families visiting Orlando.

Jean was exceptionally friendly, warm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived. She remembered me throughout my stay, had a wonderful sense of humor, and genuinely made the entire experience feel personal and special. I'd also like to recognize Koby at Latitude & Longitude for preparing some of the best omelettes I had during my stay. Every meal was excellent. Miriam at Latitude & Longitude was equally wonderful. She was incredibly kind, welcoming, and always greeted guests with a huge smile. Seeing her each morning made breakfast an even more enjoyable experience. Finally, thank you to Nicholas at the Bell Stand for sharing excellent recommendations for places to visit at Disney Springs. His suggestions helped me make the most of my trip. The combination of outstanding hospitality, beautiful accommodations, great dining, and fun amenities made this an exceptional stay. I thoroughly enjoyed my visit and look forward to returning in the future.

I want to say that I have been going to the Bavarian House for the past 15 years so here is my story on it. Years ago, It was great. I would go with my mother every weekend until she passed in 2019. I continued going there with my children for memory sake. The previous owners Patricia and Achim were just great people dressed up in the traditional Bavarian outfits. My mother was always excited to go there because she could talk to Achim in German ( Mom was Austrian ). Every time the food was great because both the owners would cook and serve and when they needed help, the helping waitress was wearing a traditional Dirndl dress as well. Fast forward to 2022 - ?, Patricia and Achim no longer continued the business for whatever reason and handed it over to the now owners. I checked the website which I see has been taken down and the new owners didn't think on putting up a new one. I continued to go just not as much as I use to but almost every time it seemed to get worst, the food is dry. I gave the new owners ( 2 women both I believe are American ) the benefit of the doubt but nothing changed. There is nothing German about the Bavarian House except the German beer and other than what is in the window display and German music on the outside patio which is turned down low. It seems that the new owners do not wish to continue the German tradition but instead post a sign stating that this is not a Hamburger joint ... very tacky. Also beware of the posted Automatic 20% gratuity…

I stopped into Bar Taco planning to just grab a couple of street tacos and a margarita, but it ended up being so good that I stayed for another taco and finished with churros. I started with the Mezcal margarita, and it was excellent. It had the smoky mezcal flavor I was looking for without overpowering the drink, and the fresh lime gave it a great balance of tartness. For tacos, I tried the pork belly, shrimp, and ribeye. The pork belly completely stole the show. It had the perfect crisp on the outside, was packed with flavor, and was so good that I ended up ordering another one before I left. I’ll definitely be back for those. The shrimp taco was another standout. It had a great mix of flavors, a nice crispy texture, and was just as enjoyable as the pork belly. The ribeye was probably my least favorite, but only because the other two were so exceptional. It was still a good taco—it just had some really stiff competition. I finished with the churros, which were fantastic. They had an amazing crunch and were generously coated in cinnamon sugar. The chocolate dipping sauce was a little overpowering for my taste (and that’s coming from a chocoholic), but the churros themselves were excellent. One thing that really stood out was the atmosphere. The staff was incredibly friendly, and you could tell they were having a good time too—singing along to everything from old disco classics to 2000s hits. It made the whole place feel fun and welcoming without being over the top. I came…

Amazing dinner spot in Orlando with very cute patio. Our server Jaymarie was the best waitress we have all ever had! So accommodating and nice! This is a great spot for an easy solid dinner with a great vibe.

We had a great experience using American Social to host our wedding welcome party! They were one of the few places who had flexibility in their Food & Beverage Minimums which we were extremely grateful for! Brooke ensured coordination of our final contract was exactly what we were looking for. We did several revisions to our quote and she was very kind and willing, never pushy or annoyed. On this day leading up to our big day the staff was timely, friendly, and very attentive to us and our guests! We used the Freedom Hall with the outside terrace which created a relaxing yet intimate atmosphere for us to spend the extra time with our friends and family. Definitely a location we'd recommend hosting a special gathering!

first ever review bc WTH lol I am from Ft. Lauderdale and the Las Olas location apparently is elite because this location has disappointed me on multiple occasions now. I came out for Mother’s day in May and enjoyed the bottomless mimosas and my server, HOWEVER the turn around on food was pretty slow. My husband and I have worked in the service industries our entire working lives, 10+ years, and we took into consideration that it was a “holiday” and bigger day. This day, the head count was high and the parties were large, so we were patient and understanding. Today on Father’s Day, we tried again as the food was pretty good and they had a TON of open reservations so it worked for last minute. This time we showed up early, reservation at 1:45pm and arrived at about 1:37pm. They sat two groups before us, neither of them with reservations earlier than ours, one without a reservation at all but it was a 2 top, so it was understandable/easier to squeeze in than my 4 top. We ordered food with our drinks as we were STARVING. We ordered donut holes and french toast sticks. The server put everything in on a device AT THE TABLE so I know it was not his fault. (I believe his name was Kevin, I should’ve paid more attention as he was super nice and hunted for grenadine for about 15 min for my teenager, 10/10 dude) We waited 55 minutes. Finished our drinks and nothing. We told our server that we were going to leave and he brought a manager out for us. The manager was instantly holding…
Adeliz was amazing, attentive, and anticipated any need before it was requested. Management should consider her for further advancement within the company.
Alex was amazing
Alex was fantastic. We had a large group and I never had to wait for a drink. Atmosphere was incredible for the USA soccer game.

I love the food and wine. And the staff is super attentive and really friendly. I have to say that Carolyn (the “Cuban” bartender. Lol) is beyond amazing and then some. Friendly, professional, super respectful and genuine, she always wants to make you feel at home, and does it so well. Which is why I visit American Social and love it.
Went here for the Nextran event, it was a great place! Food was great too!
Emily was amazing!! She was so good to my friends and I. The food was of course amazing, but she really was the best part of my experience. 10/10, would recommend!

We hosted a bridesmaids luncheon, with a total of 25 people, in the back room. We were allowed to come in early to decorate the tables and space as the staff set up. The luncheon went wonderfully! The set up was beautiful, the food delicious, and the staff was excellent. It exceeded my expectations, and was very reasonable priced to boot. I’m so glad we chose American Social to host our event.
Muy rica la comida y el lugar hermoso
Increíble, atención super personalizada perfecta para una tarde en familia, el ambiente es increíble. Simplemente recomendado
The staff of the restaurant is doing a really good job, the food is good and the aesthetic too, I'll eat again here
Courtney was amazing the service was phenomenal I hope to have her back for my next experience

Food was excellent. Mervin was great.

Horrible food! Ordered a California Burrito with al pastor to go. Unfortunately I didn’t bother to look at the order until getting home. The burrito had 2 different color wraps which was the first giveaway something was up. It looked like sushi rice was used, no spanish rice, white boiled plain rice. I couldn’t find the guac that was supposed to be on it, nor could I find but two bites of some kind of meat. One of which was a huge chunk of gristle. And to top it off, a bunch of pieces of pineapple were in the burrito. Pineapple. In a burrito. And not a mentioned item as a listed ingredient. And not just a random piece that made its way in, spread all throughout. Safe to say the worst Mexican I’ve been to and unfortunately this place used to be good. Will not be returning

Such an amazing place! If you are in the mood for some awesome Mexican food you simply must give this establishment a try. I had chicken enchilada Verde while my husband tried the chimichanga with carnitas meat choice. Both were delivered in a picture perfect presentation plus the food came out in a timely manner. The service was exceptional. Our server, Evelyn, catered to our every need. We had a delightful meal in a beautiful environment to be sure. If you miss out on this local hidden jewel it will definitely be your loss!

Tuve una experiencia maravillosa en este restaurante. La comida estuvo absolutamente deliciosa, todo fresco, bien presentado y lleno de sabor. Quiero destacar especialmente la atención de Franco, quien hizo que la experiencia fuera aún mejor. Es un excelente mesero: amable, atento, profesional y con una actitud humana que realmente marca la diferencia. Se nota que le apasiona lo que hace y trata a los clientes con muchísimo respeto y dedicación. Definitivamente regresaré. Lugares así, con buena comida y personas como Franco, merecen ser reconocidos.

The guacamole was the best I have had!! It was sooo fresh beyond words. I am really picky about guacamole because I make it really good, and this guacamole was better than any I have ever had!! Incredible. I love that you can add pineapple to the fajitas, they have a great selection and everything is clean and fresh. The Selena cocktail was absolutely amazing, I highly recommend this place!!
Very nice highly recommend to any and all the staff is awsome and on top with seating and orders.
La comida estaba deliciosa y el servicio de Franco fue excelente. Muy atento, amable y siempre pendiente de todo. Sin duda volvería.
The margaritas were delicious, and Franco’s service was excellent. Super friendly and attentive definitely coming back!
Place is terrible, bar staff has no clue. Never again

Amazing restaurant. Ordered the carne asada and shrimp fajitas, the portions were generous and the flavors were great! Our server Franco was very knowledgeable and attentive, hands down best server! Will be coming back and definitely asking for him.

Went to Ñeo in Daytona and overall it was a nice experience .The restaurant itself is very pretty, clean, and has a beautiful view with plenty of parking, which I loved. The service was also very fast honestly, I was surprised at how quickly the food came out. Everyone was nice and attentive. The music inside was a little too loud for my personal taste, but I understand that’s part of the vibe since it’s more of a lively Latin/Mexican-style restaurant. My son ordered tacos and they were honestly some of the best tacos I’ve had in a long time absolutely delicious. I ordered a shrimp and rice dish and at first I didn’t really love it, but they kindly changed the rice for me and it definitely made the dish better. I’d probably rate my plate around a 5/10 overall, but the tacos were easily the highlight of the night. The michelada was really good, the coffee was good too. The only thing I personally didn’t enjoy was the sparkling water they served. Overall, it’s a cute spot with a nice atmosphere, great tacos, fast service, and a fun vibe .

Mother’s Day lunch was amazing with flavored margaritas. When seated our waiter immediately brought salsa and chips and we added cheese plus yummy roasted pork belly with a to-die-for mustard sauce. We ended our meal with regular margaritas and shared top notch enchiladas. Will definitely go again.
Service and food was great, highly recommended!!

Eric was a terrible server. I waited 9 minutes for a refill. My wife set her empty glass for a refill on table edge and it sat there for 13 minutes until our table was cleared. Our server walked by our table with the empty glass on the edge & proceeded to sit at a booth with other servers to talk for the remainder of our stay which was 15 minutes. When my wife returned from the bathroom is when he decided to get up & come to our table & ask if we needed anything else. I usually tip very well 25% when we go out to eat but needless to say during this visit he's lucky to have gotten any tip at all less than 10%.

a bit of a wait but kiddo had fun!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We recently celebrated our son Atticus’ 7th birthday at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games in Orlando, and it exceeded every expectation! From the moment we arrived, everything was organized, exciting, and so much fun. Michelle was absolutely amazing. She took care of every detail and made sure our party stayed on track from beginning to end. Even with a couple of small hiccups during the day, she handled everything so calmly and professionally that it felt completely seamless. We were able to relax and simply enjoy celebrating with our family and friends. The management team also went above and beyond, checking in with us multiple times throughout the party to make sure everything was going well and quickly resolving the few issues that came up. That level of customer service is rare and made us feel genuinely valued. Most importantly, Atticus had the best birthday ever and left with memories he’ll never forget. A huge thank you to Michelle, the management team, and the entire Andretti team for making our son’s birthday so special. Jeff was extremely accommodating and friendly. He made sure our experience was amazing! We really appreciate it!
Excellent customer service, knowledgeable and professional.

This was amazing experience to join f1 Austrian GP watch party. They accommodated us very well with our special needs son. Had an amazing breakfast and beer while watching race. They have really good games arcade to play. Special thanks to Manager Jeff and Krystal for serving us! Really appreciate you kindness and hospitality..

We had such an amazing time here! The entire place is packed with energy and offered so much fun for the whole family. The kids had an absolute blast with all the activities, and it kept them fully entertained the entire visit. ​The biggest surprise for us was definitely the food—it was absolutely delicious! You don't always expect high-quality dining at an entertainment center, but everything we ordered exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend this spot for a fun-filled family day out with great eats!
Cool place

We had a Youth Group outting and with the summer heat wanted to do something fun with our Youth. We booked a party event at Andretti this was the best thing we did, it was Organized, Fun, and very Professional. From contacting them from booking event with Luis , to the day of event Patricia was very helpful in explaining how our schedule would look like and our host Ashtmi was Fantastic very helpful, kind and attentive. The party event room was beautiful, elegant. The pizza was really good and their cookies are to die for. We went on a Saturday in the summer at 10am it was not crowded at all. Lots of activities and the food was good. The laser tag was a work out.

I had an outstanding experience hosting a corporate event at Andretti Orlando. The entire event team was helpful, professional, and incredibly attentive from start to finish. William, Felipe, and Andres went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly, and Gema, our sales coordinator, was responsive, organized, and detail-oriented throughout the planning process. The facility was clean, well-staffed, and packed with fun activities, making it a perfect venue for a corporate event. The level of service exceeded my expectations, and our group had a fantastic time. I can’t recommend Andretti Orlando enough—I only wish we could host all of our corporate events here!
Karting was awesome, arcades fun, foods good
OUT SERVER DANIEL WAS THE BEST!!!!!!! he served me and my family today and was wonderful

As a major Indy 500 fan and Andretti fan, when I was visiting Orlando and heard about Andretti karting, I had to go try it out! The karting was incredibly fun and driving electric karts was a new experience. They are fast and the track is a decent length. They also have miniature karts for the Jrs who aren’t big enough for adults karts, along with an observation area to watch them. There are racing sims and different arcade games for all ages. The place was very clean and the aesthetics were incredible. If I had the money I’d stay here all day! The staff is very polite and helpful, thanks Jeff for your help today! I would recommend this place to anybody and I will be back soon!

We went on an "off day" so it was not crowded. We were able to get through waiver check in, pay for a 3 race course, and ease of race start. The track spans 2 levels with a good amount of speed. Fun times!
The staff that hosted a party for our group was phenomenal and took great care of us the entire time.
This is a very clean place and the staff is patient and very friendly . I’m from North Carolina but if you looking for an affordable place This is it !!! Give them 10/10

Great experience. I brought 2 boys 8 and 9 yr old. They had the best day. All the staff that we came in contact with were super friendly and very helpful. Food was delicious, waitress was wonderful. No complaints here. Thanks for a great day!

We are from Birmingham, Alabama, and were visiting on our Family Reunion vacation. We had a wonderful time and truly enjoyed the great food and outstanding customer service. Very friendly staff.

This place isn’t just a sandwich shop, it’s the kind of spot you walk into and immediately know you’re about to eat something great. The sandwiches go way beyond the usual: fresh bread, wild combinations, and flavors that punch you right in the taste buds. If you’re looking for a boring lunch, look somewhere else. This shop is all about bold choices and serious attitude. Thanks for an awesome meal and top-notch service. It was absolutely worth the trip out here. You can tell everyone cares about what they’re doing, from the food to the way they treat you. I’d make the drive again in a heartbeat.

What an amazing experience! Food was off the hook, incredible. Staff was super friendly and polite. Couldn't have asked for a better first time experience. Will definitely be back sooner rather than later!! Yummy!!! 😋😋

The shop made me feel like I was in downtown Pittsburgh. It’s such a wonderful vibe to see and detach from the rat race and highly pretentious sub shops with cutting machines and the like. This place is raw, clean, and a friendly diner/feel. Everything from drinks, to the sandwich, and even the plate the sandwich is served on is all very different. I appreciated all the detail the owner put into this place. No parking headaches and there’s even tables outside so you feel like you’re eating on the street corner of New York City. I will be back again with family.

You know when you look at a food and think “I don’t know about that.” That’s this place. Got the 13 and has to be one of the scariest looking sandwiches I’ve had. Also amazingly salty. Couldn’t finish because of that. $20 for a sandwich is steep, but the chips were bussin’
Burgers and Sandwiches are now combined into the same restaurant. Really happy I can get a seed oil free burger from here.
Badass good food!

If anyone with a brain or any actual experience cooking food were designing a breakfast sandwich, they would understand that a bun this large needs enough egg, meat, and filling to create balance. Instead, the sandwich is overwhelmingly bread, making it feel cheap and poorly conceived. Any establishment charging $9 for a sandwich with this bread-to-filling ratio is simply trying to maximize margins rather than customer satisfaction. ❤️
Best place. Local spot, bread is the best thing you will ever taste all made in store. People are so loving got to try!
My bf and I went here and the food was delicious and the service was even better. Would def come back!
Wow! Just go there now! Quality food, great price, staff is welcoming & friendly. So delicious! Awesome sandwich selection with something for everyone.

The staff over there is very kind! I had to run 2 miles to get to there and they gave me a water so I decided to try some of their food and I absolutely loved what I got. The first thing I tried was the traditional bad ass sandwich. And I can’t wait to try everything on the menu. The chips were really good they were fresh made. Very unique taste in the sandwich itself. Even the bread tasted amazing. Definitely not what I’m used to.

The sandwiches, burgers, and sides are absolutely delicious & inventive. The owner is very passionate about cooking & it really comes through in the quality of his food.

I'm not usually a big bread eater, but good God, this place may have converted me. The sandwiches were fantastic, packed with flavor, and made with quality ingredients. The bread was so good I found myself talking about it long after the sandwich was gone. The owner was friendly, helpful, and genuinely cares about the customers. The staff was just as welcoming and made the whole experience even better. Great food, great people, and bread that might just change your life. I'll definitely be back!
Absolutely delicious variety of sandwiches! The staff is extelremely friendly and informative.
From the great and friendly service (Aham... Nicki!) to the absolute delicious food, you MUST try this place. It's (excuse the word) badass!!!

My Team and I went to Orlando, they had a conference and I had one job –feed them – so we ate at Bad As’s Sandwiches for the first time. We’re a nice size group and we order at least one of every sandwich. When I had a chance to ask how they were – I didn’t get not one “it was good”, no one said “it was ok” – what I got was a bunch of looks -looks of awe & comments like, “That was amazing”, “OMG my stomach and mouth are so happy”, “so happy”. I had to laugh. And the Chef – we had an 11:00am delivery time, because someone had a flight to catch. John not only cooked the sandwiches, he delivered them personally, AND, AND when I initially placed the order, we had ordered a bunch of fries, and he suggested because of the travel time, it would not be a good idea – wait honesty, incredible food & white glove service, - they definitely have earned the right to rock their name, because they are truly Bad Ass!!!!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH JONH – SEE YOU NEXT TIME!!!!!!!

Incredibly unprofessional staff, Very rude and snotty. Sandwhich was soggy with an unbearable flavor profile. I definitely would not eat here. And they need a new staff,

One of the best sandwiches I’ve had. Meat was fresh, tender and delicious. Great flavor and selection. The gentlemen behind the register knew his stuff, and explained the menu very well. 10/10! Would add a photo, but I gobbled it down too fast!

Wow truly 10/10 experience! I’ll definitely be coming back. Nick’s recommendations were incredibly and Jose made such a delicious sandwich. I don’t often leave reviews but I had to, such a great experience.
The food was delicious way better than I expected. I got the patty melt with over easy egg on top. Most definitely will be coming back whenever in Orlando.

Food was absolutely amazing. Staff is super friendly and helpful. I had the half as Garfield with tots and it was so flavorful. Perfect size and everything. Will be going back when I’m in Orlando again.

Stopped by here for the first time and the service and food were amazing. Nick and Angelo were wonderful and they definitely served up some BAD As sandwiches. Highly recommend and can’t wait to come back.

This is one of the best if not, the best burger and sandwich spots in Orlando, my friends and I received excellent service from the team member, and even the owner John. Even had the pleasure of talking with him and sharing our passion. Top quality and fresh ingredients definitely worth coming back and trying other items on the menu. Wanted to get a better picture, couldn't help myself, and got a bite or two 100/10🔥🙏🏽

Big As’s Sandwiches completely exceeded our expectations. We tried the Bad As and the pastrami, and both were incredible. The pastrami tasted like it was made in-house—tender, flavorful, and not your typical deli cut. You can tell they care about quality. Even the tots stood out—perfectly cooked with great flavor, not just an afterthought. What really made the experience though was the service. Nicki was amazing—friendly, attentive, and just on top of everything. And make sure you meet John—he’s super personable and made us feel genuinely welcomed and appreciated. This place doesn’t just serve great food, it gives you an experience. Definitely coming back.

The food is very tasty

Hidden gem! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent. Great atmosphere, fair prices, and every dish was flavorful. Definitely worth trying if you’re in Orlando. Highly recommended!

I’m a big fan of Vietnamese food, and this place is next level. Its been there for 30 years, so the menu is well rounded with so many options. I tried a rice crepe with minced pork and mushrooms inside for an appetizer, and a bun bowl with spring rolls & veggies. Girlfriend got a chicken curry bun bowl and a side of spring rolls. Everything was fresh, great textures, and delicious flavors. So glad we tried a new place, right next to Mills Market and Zaru.

I'm surprised at how great the food was. It was flavorful and definitely tasted fresh. Every dish tasted authentic, and the ingredients were clearly high quality. The staff was welcoming and attentive. I'll be back again lol

As a Vietnamese girl, I can tell you that this Vietnamese food tastes the most authentic in Orlando. I ate here with my family, we are visiting from California. It tastes homemade just like my Vietnamese grandmas cooking. The ambience was good as well, and the service was quick and friendly. Overall, I would recommend this as an authentic Vietnamese place with very flavorful dishes.
The best authentic Vietnamese food. We ate the Vietnamese Canh Chua n CA Kho was yummy 😋
it has been way too long since i have had good and authentic pho in FL as a viet person. so so so good. it hit the spot even if it was 100 degrees out

From one Viet girlie to the next, the food and space is always authentic and the service was as expected. The place was packed so the service was a little on the slower side, but nonetheless the staff was so sweet and the food is always delicious! ✨️🫰

We were able to find parking at the lot behind the building, but it is small and can get packed. Anyways, their menu is HUGE and extensive. I was in awe at what they have because it felt like you can find literally every Vietnamese dish here. Anyways, we dined in, and this is what we ended up ordering: ♡ Goi Cuon Tom. 9/10! The goi cuon were very fresh and good! My bf enjoyed this one the most. I liked the peanut sauce, and I thought it was delicious and reminiscent of my family’s version. ♡ Bun Bo Hue Anh Hong. 7/10! This was pretty good! It had plentiful meat, and the broth was spicy just how I like it, and the portion was huge. Also, they have chili oil on the side if you want more spice! ♡ Mi Vit Tiem. 8/10! My bf ordered this because he wanted to try duck for the first time, and he thought it was tasty but very rich. The noodles were good, and he liked it! ♡ Che Thai. 6/10! I was a little disappointed in this drink. For the price, I expected there to be more toppings like the green jelly and the red seeds. Instead, it seem like there was just jackfruit and longan (?). It was mostly just coconut milk. ♡ Fresh Sugar Cane Juice. 8/10! My bf ordered this, and he thought it was good and refreshing. It was very sweet though, but the ice helped dilute it. ｡ ₊°༺❤︎༻°₊ ｡ FINAL VERDICT: This is a great restaurant if you want to try out different Vietnamese foods/drinks all in one at a good price. Service was good too. The only thing I dislike is that parking is tough to find…
Amazing service
This is our favorite place for pho and vermicelli noodle bowls and Cindy is always nice to my family. Thank you!
The best vietnamese food I ever ate in America. I'm live in vietnam for 10 year so you can tell this is really good!
Steam roll with pork was really good. Chicken wings were good also.

This place has been a consistent go-to for a decade and a half. Easily eaten here dozens of times. Emblematic of the excellent Vietnamese restaurant cuisine available here in Orlando. This is my favorite spot for Bánh Xeo, as well as the pork, shrimp, and papaya salad. Pho Tai is good, too. Really not a bad meal to be had here. Love the Bun Cha Gio Thit Nuong - grilled pork and spring roll vermicelli. Don't remember a better one in town. Your trip will be better if you park in the back because, just for a brief moment, as you wend through the short alley, you imagine yourself in a back street in Vietnam. It's a grittier arrival. It’s ritual at this point. I refuse to park in the front. Besides coming in the back door always feels more like you’re…an insider. You’re not. I’ve eaten here over three dozen times and they don’t know my name. It’s not that kind of joint. The kind of joint it is, however, is one that puts out consistently great, authentic, tried and true Vietnamese food. You come, you eat, and then you leave. Perhaps sleepy, but always satisfied. Several items on the menu you will not find anywhere else. And if you do, it’s most likely better here. The Banh Uot Thit Nuong is the best appetizer on the menu.
Very enjoyable!

Anna's Polish Restaurant is one of the most authentic Polish restaurants I have visited in the United States. The food tastes exactly like it does in Poland and other parts of Europe, with traditional flavors and recipes that brought back many good memories. Everything was fresh, delicious, and clearly prepared with care. I also really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere and the warm, welcoming vibe inside the restaurant. It felt like a little piece of Poland right here in Florida. I was very happy with my visit and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

Been coming here for years now. My wife is Polish, and there are too few Polish restaurants in the Orlando area. The food is always fresh made, and very generously portioned. I will admit the service is not “lightning fast”, but that is one of the very reasons we love this place. The owner has been our server many times, and I love that the level of care and. Service does not depend on who is taking care of us. It is and has always been perfectly consistent over the years. If you happen to be the impatient sort or a fast drinker, my suggestion is to order a good deal in advance and don’t be shy about telling them that you’re thirsty or just crazy hungry because this is your first meal of the day.

If you're looking for authentic Polish food and a great dining experience, I highly recommend Anna Polish Restaurant!

The Strand feels like the kind of place you end up at when the group says “let’s just grab a drink” and suddenly it’s four hours later and everybody’s talking about life choices on the patio. The atmosphere hits a really rare balance — stylish without trying too hard, relaxed without feeling lazy. Good lighting, great music, strong cocktails, and one of the better people-watching spots in Orlando if you sit outside long enough. Food’s legitimately solid too. The menu feels thoughtful without crossing over into that exhausting “chef wants to reinvent civilization through small plates” territory. Everything feels approachable in the best way. There’s also something very Mills-area about The Strand in general. Creative people, date nights, industry folks after work, old friends running into each other by accident — it feels connected to the actual neighborhood instead of floating above it. A lot of places in Orlando are technically nice. The Strand actually has atmosphere. Big difference. 🦩

I had an unexpected girls night here with a friend. We meant to go to the sister bar next door but I’m so glad I ended up here!
