But despite being busy, there were a few open seats at the bar for walk-ins and I was able to snag two seats for my friends and I. It was also not overly loud for how busy it was. It felt very intimate and cozy. We ordered a drink each, split an appetizer, one entree, and a dessert and it came out to about $100 with tip, so not a cheap place but I think it was well worth it. The service was wonderful, prompt, and welcoming. They were out of a few dishes but that’s to be expected when you have a rotating menu and use fresh ingredients. We also were there on the later end of the evening, about 8pm. For an appetizer, we ordered a focaccia toast topped with some mushroom, onion, and ricotta. It was divine. My friend ordered the burger and loved it. It can’t with fries that looked like McD’s fries (which I’m an absolute fan of) but they tasted EVEN BETTER than McDs. We split dessert, olive oil chocolate cake which has a tahini mousse and sesame seeds. The cake was so well balanced. It was rich but not overly sweet and even had some saltiness from the tahini mousse. Overall one of my favorite Orlando dining experiences to date and I can’t wait to return!

After learning about The Strand during Michelin's published reviews of Orlando restaurants, we were very curious to try it out. Consider us forever fans now after having dined there three or four times now The quality and care of the dishes, the service ,and even the new bar that opened up next-door have become some of our favorite places to frequent. While the capacity is limited, especially in the restaurant, it's well worth the wait if you can book a reservation in advance or try to show up when they open and grab a seat at the bar (which I believe may be open seating around 5 PM but not entirely sure about that). The cocktails here and the food offerings vary every time we go, and they always nail the flavor combinations. The textures and presentations of the dishes are almost as if you're in a tasting menu as opposed to à la carte dining if that makes any sense; it feels very exclusive, like you're in a chef's private dining room! And because of the smaller space, the noise levels are usually fairly low, which we always appreciate anywhere we go to eat. We can't wait to go back and highly recommend The Strand for anyone who hasn't tried it out yet. Support local and check it out this weekend. You will love it.

okay so i finally tried Mofongo King and i honestly don't know why i waited so long 😭 the mofongo was SO good, perfectly seasoned, soft, not dry at all, and the carne frita on top was bussin. the vibe inside is super chill and welcoming, bachata playing in the background, staff was super friendly too. portion sizes are huge btw, i literally had leftovers for the next day lol. if you haven't been yet you're missing out from 🇵🇷

Verdaderamente exquisito un mofongo único y el churrasco ni se diga espectacular todo divino fui a comer por mi 26 aniversario de casada mi única decepción fue que no tenían Heineken ahh pero bebimos Presidente las meseras muy atentas excelente servicio lo recomiendo y el postre divinoo!!!

Don't believe the hype. My husband and I was so excited to visit. Great food presentation with no flavor let alone Puerto Rican flavor. The alcapurrias tasted like they've been fried more than once, no masa, real thin hard skin that didn't even taste like it had, plátano, guineo, malanga or calabaza. The inside meat, flavorless. Probably why they give you sauce to dip it in. No real Puerto Rican eats alcapurrias with sauces. The mofongo had this weird taste to it, like if it had mayo in it, the chicken and pork chicharrones fried with no flavor. I can truly say the best thing on my plate was the one slice of tomato and few spring mix, oh and the diet coke to was the nasty taste that was left in our mouths.
Muy rico todo las meseras muy amables.
Todo super bien. Gracias

Walked in no service walked out won’t be going back. I’m glad I didint eat here I heard they aren’t Puerto Rican they are Samoans that’s why the food dosent taste right. My friend got mofungo and it was like mashed puree .she asked me to leave a review on behalf of her experience with the food.she did say they usto be good back in the day…..

Aguante un hambre grandísima para comer este decepcionante Mofongo. Si usted sabe lo que un mofongo de verdad, no volveria a pedir esto. Mas le recomiendo que compre un platano de un cost menor a $1. Y lo sancoche lo maja con un poco de ajo y ya lo tienes, muy fácil y económico. Me costo $25.

I asked for take out. Mofongo and garlic shrimp. It was horrible. The mofongo was more like Mangu a purée (mash potatoes like). They also mixed it with a ripe yellow platain so it tasted sweet not what mofongo is meant to taste. It was horrible.The shrimp was worst, almost uncooked. When I had it home I had to finish cooking the shrimp. It’s a simple dish, not likely to get it wrong but they did. I don’t recommend it and would advise anyone from eating there. Pricey too. I paid $25.68 for a dish I didn’t like.

Vine desde Orlando a comer en este restaurante y la experiencia fue muy decepcionante. Desde que llegas, exigen demasiado a los clientes para luego brindar un servicio de tan mala calidad. La comida fue entregada con el chicharrón de pollo crudo y con sangre. Lo peor es que no fue un solo plato, sino dos platos que pedimos en familia, y ambos estaban en malas condiciones. Además, el servicio fue muy deficiente. Después de hacer el viaje hasta aquí, esperaba mucho más. No recomiendo este lugar.
Chicharron de pollo mofongo was great! Tasty, juicy, and fried to perfection. The food here is delicious.
Food is made with love
I had the best mofongo, didn't know what to expect but Im glad I went.
Food was good,there was about 4 servers but service was slow,front door mats need atencion and there was multiple flies in dinning room area.
One the greatest food I’ve had in a while. Went down to Miami from Jersey and visited them and I’ll come back for sure.
Moving is very good.
Very disappointing.
Recomendado💯%Mofongo relleno de pechuga al ajillo, chicharrones de pollo, pastelillos de carne, sabor boricua😋Espectacular🥰

Title: Absolutely incredible churrasco mofongo de maduro! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ If you come to Mofongo King, you have to try the churrasco mofongo de maduro. Replacing the traditional green plantains with sweet maduros gives it this unbelievable sweet and savory flavor profile that completely elevates the dish. The mofongo itself was perfectly textured not dry at all and the churrasco was incredibly tender, juicy, and seasoned to perfection. The portions are generous, the food comes out fresh and hot, and the service is always welcoming. This spot definitely lives up to its name. Total hit, 10/10 recommended!
Absolutely delicious! Recommend it..
Food and service was great. Evento ugh we got there 30 mins before closing they still took care of us like if we were the first ones there.
Es un lugar para pasarla bien y disfrutar de la comida ,un lugar donde los latinos nos sentiríamos como en casa por su ambiente ,música y local.

Visited on a Sunday evening for the character dining on our FIRST night at Disney! We were so clueless on how to use the dining credits and they were incredibly helpful and patient. The food at the buffet was good, lots of drink options, fun characters, overall great!

Lugar muito bonito. A atração de tomar cafe da manhã com algumas princesas é o ponto alto. Elas sao muito atenciosas principalmente com as crianças. A comida é bem padrão americano, mas nada espetacular. Ainda assim é um ótimo passeio pra fazer com crianças.

This was probably the worst most expensive mediocre dinner ever. We had to walk from the distant parking lot down the road and across the street because the courtesy driver shuttle called out of work we were told. Once we finally got into the hotel, the restaurant was difficult to find as there are no signs. Our reservation was at 5:35pm and we weren't seated until a little after 7pm. I made the reservation months in advance. We were definitely treated like an afterthought. The food was sparse and terrible. The only positive thing I can say is that the kids enjoyed seeing the characters. I would never visit this restaurant again.

The food quality and selection were unacceptable, particularly for a premium-priced restaurant at Disney’s flagship resort. Among other issues: • The eggs were gelatinous and unappetizing. • Many of the items intended to be served hot were cold. • Omelets took approximately 15 minutes to arrive, and our server indicated that they were not prepared on-site. • The fruit selection was extremely limited. • No milk was available at the buffet for the cereal, requiring guests to locate a server and then wait for it to be brought to the table. • The bagels were hard and stale and appeared comparable to low-quality frozen grocery-store bagels. There was also a strong and extremely unpleasant odor throughout the restaurant. It was difficult to understand how the condition could have gone unnoticed or unaddressed by the restaurant staff. The service was slow and inattentive. Basic requests took an unreasonable amount of time, and the overall level of service was nowhere near what a guest should reasonably expect when paying more than $300 for breakfast. The experience felt disorganized and neglected from beginning to end. The character performers were excellent, and the smoked salmon was good. Unfortunately, those limited positives could not overcome the poor food, inadequate service, unpleasant odor, and lack of basic buffet amenities. I am genuinely shocked that an experience of this quality is being offered at the Grand Floridian under the Disney name. The food and service fell…

What an amazing place. The buffet was very large and a lot to choose from (carved meats, pasta, salads, veggies, soups, desserts). The character dining is very cool and worth the price. They really go out of their way to make it fun.

Had reservations for dinner so we could see the princesses after taking my daughter to Bibbidi Bobbidi Boutique and we arrive 15 minutes early, after walking through florida heat for 15 minutes... to find out the reservations are running 35-45 minutes late... this is the 3rd terrible experience we've had. 0 for 3 at disney resort dining.
Food was delicious, Helen was attentive and friendly. Loved it so much.

Worst character experience ans horrible service. Our waiter was retirement age came over and spilled all the drinks on ous and our food. The characters come to your table once ONLY and if you party is not all at the table they ignore you and your kids excited little faces to see you and move to the next table. DO BETTER DISNEY this place is very expensive and the vibe is all off. The waitors and other workers are rude and just want to clock out. Retire your old staff and train people to actually want to work. What happened to the disney standard? Save your money and go to mcdonalds. You will get treated the same honestly

Our waitress Steph was amazing! Explained everything in detail, very friendly, made sure the kids were taken care of! Would 10/10 recommend this place, they made sure to ask if all the princesses visited our table and snow white made a special trip to come and see our kids. Food was excellent as well

This is one of the best character meals at Disney. This is one that after going the first time, you know you are going back when you plan your next Disney trip. The breakfast buffet is loaded with variety and it is all so very good. It makes you rethink your park day. Thankfully as much walking as you will do, that feeling subsides within the hour. The staff are all amazing, kind and quick with drink refills. I will always request this character dining every single time!!

For the price what a adventure, large buffet with something everyone should like. From prime rib to cheese pizza. The dessert are just as good as the shrimp. Plus Disney Characters make a guest appearance at your toes. I would suggest saving a little money and go enjoy a once in a life time meal at a beautiful resort
The brunch buffet here was fantastic, lots of options and the strawberry soup was a standout.

This was our second time at this restaurant. We loved it even more than the first time! We had delicious food, great service, and met Aladdin, Cinderella, Mirabel & Tiana. The staff there were all so kind & helpful! I highly recommend this restaurant! ❤️
It would be way better if you still played the band organ on the balcony.
Absolutely amazing in every aspect! Love it!

The food was probably the worst part of the experience, it was better then another buffet place we tried at disney, but still not very good and wasnt worth going back for seconds. I've had better buffet food not at disney. Service was pretty decent, best part was they were very fast at refilling our drinks, which we very much appreciate while being at disney and walking around a lot, need to keep hydrated. The best part is meeting the characters. But they swapped out a character when we got there and gave us no warning or anything. We might not of done the dinner if we knew they were going to swap mirable for snow white. Snow white is cool and all, but this was our third time seeing her. Never got to interact with mirable while on our trip (which Encanto is my favorite disney film). Aladain tho was really great, think he was the highlight, he sounds so much like the character and was just so much fun. We met tiana before at another dinner, but I liked that this time she had her explorer outfit on, so made it different and fun. My mom was very happy she got to get a pic with Cinderella (her favorite princess). The inside of the dinner area is ok, not that fun to me personally. But I guess it does match the rest of the buildings look, but none of it is as fun looking as other disney buildings.

Character interactions was wonderful!!!!!! Each character not only stopped at our table but stayed and talked to each child for a long time. Our waiter Bob was phenomenal and offered suggestions and took great care of ua.

On our “off day” in the middle of the week, we scheduled a breakfast buffet at 1900 Park Fare, located at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa. The setting is elegant, and the buffet is excellent, with all the classic breakfast offerings. The highlights had to be the Mickey-shaped waffles—particularly delicious, even without syrup—and a standout breakfast pizza from the kids’ section: gravy, cheese, egg, and bacon on a croissant. Phenomenal. The default mango-guava juice was also excellent. Four characters were roaming the dining room, giving the kids a chance to meet Cinderella, Aladdin, and Tiana, which made the experience even more memorable.

We had such an amazing night at 1900 Park Fare! It was by far my kids favorite night of our trip- thanks to the cast member who played Aladdin. He made it unforgettable for my son and I am sure he will be talking about it for months! What a wonderful experience and dining option.

This is the worst breakfast at Disney World. It is on par with included continental breakfast available at places like Hampton Inn, but at a very high price. I strongly suggest they end breakfast service to save face for the hotel to maintain its image. I will never return.
One of the best character breakfast at Disney. The characters move through quickly so you’re not sitting for extended period of time waiting trying to keep kids entertained.

I visited this restaurant for dinner and found it to be very accommodating overall. One of the highlights was the character dining experience—four different characters visited each table, which made it especially fun and memorable. I did not use the meal plan, and the total for one adult and one child came to $120.35 after taxes. The dinner food itself was very good, with a nice Southern touch that I really enjoyed. Unfortunately, dessert was a major disappointment. The vanilla cupcakes were extremely dry and tasted like they came from a grocery store rather than a restaurant. The biggest issue, however, was the service. My reservation was delayed due to accessibility-related conflicts, which was frustrating. During the meal, I felt rushed by staff—they began cleaning and even sweeping near my table while I was still eating. I was also repeatedly asked to give up my plate while I was clearly not finished, which made the experience uncomfortable. Overall, while the food and character experience were enjoyable, the service significantly impacted my visit in a negative way.

The breakfast buffet was severely lacking. For the amount of money they charge per person, it was beyond disappointing. I’ve seen better looking food options with more variety at hospital cafeterias. There was nothing special about this.
Had a wonderful time at our dinner. The service and atmosphere is incredible. Foods just ok but you're paying for the experience. Would absolutely return
Delicious buffet, characters are fun and charming, and they are wonderful with unusual allergies!
One of the best pizzas in town!!!

We had a remarkable experience dining at this restaurant. We were the entire family celebrating the birthday of my wife. The food was delicious, all the plates were great, no exceptions. We ordered the cake and the complimentary service was amazing. Jose did an excellent job managing the orders of 20 people. Everybody loved the occasion, the restaurant, and left very happy. 1803 Pizza/Kitchen with its warm atmosphere is highly recommended.
Came into this restaurant randomly. The pizza was incredible and service was top notch. The new mango cheesecake is unreal!
Excelente sabor, atención pedí la supreme con adicional de anchoas y definitivamente deliciosa . Traje a unas amigas por primera vez y quedaron encantadas 🧡

Nice family owned restaurant. Pizza was excellent. The supreme I ordered (took off the olives) was probably the best pizza I’ve tasted in Orlando. Asked for wings to be cooked extra crispy and they came out perfect to how I like them. Mozzarella sticks, garlic bread and the chicken alfredo linguine were just as tasty. 1803 definitely lived up to the 4.7 overall rating it received on Google Maps. I’ll be back…highly recommended!!!.

We are in town from Texas and my daughter wanted Italian. Going off the reviews, I felt like this would be a good place to eat and it was. Their mozzarella cheese sticks were delicious. We had the chicken Alfredo, chicken parm, and my husband had some sort of shrimp with linguine noodles. All the dishes were flavorful and delicious. If we come back to Orlando, we would DEF be coming back
The food is wonderful with choices of sizes which is hard to find anywhere. The wait staff was extremely attentive. We will definitely be back!!

Todo estuvo GENIAL! Fuimos en Familia y salimos contentos! La pizza pesto con Burrata es Increible La Pasta con Queso Burrata es Hermoso y Sabroso La Chicken cavatappi tiene Otro Nivel.... La Limonada es Fresca y Original, Las Cervezas Bien Frias y la atencion por sus propios duenos te recomiendan que ordenar y en todo aciertan 1000% Genial Los postres de guava y maracuya Los mejores .. pero vamos a ir de nuevo. Probar todos esos postres gracias ! Update 2026 3 años despues de haber venido, estuvimos en la Zona y volvimos a comer aqui y dejenme decirle que es una JOYA DE ORLANDO. La comida sigue siendo GENIAL , los precios y los postres todo es genial aqui.
One of our favorite places! The staff is wonderful. The food is fantastic. From our weekly meetings to family gatherings, you can find us here!
Excellent! My favorite pizza place in Orlando, no cap
Hoy fue nuestra primera visita nos los habían recomendado y la verdad quedamos encantados deliciosa la pizza el servício nos dejen de ir
Always a great pizza. The Bianca is the best pie around!
Great fresh food! Thank you Jose for outstanding service, we will definitely be back.

Today almost turned into a really bad birthday dinner day for my fiancé , but 1803 Pizza/Kitchen came through in the clutch! I like to take the focus off me by saying I have a procrastination demon because I can wait until the last minute to plan things 😆. Unfortunately, I ran behind at work today and we had a 5:30 reservation for Bar Italia. I’ve only been there one other time and when I went, it was still fairly new to the area so it wasn’t busy. Apparently the residents of Winter Park have now adopted this spot as their official happy hour headquarters because this place was PACKED. I messaged the staff ahead of time letting them know we were running late and asked if we could move our reservation, but unfortunately they told us there weren’t any later reservations available. We still decided to drive there anyway since we’ll take you without a reservation. Upon arrival, there were already several groups ahead of us asking about seating and everyone was being told the same thing: they were no longer taking reservations for the night and to try back again in 30 minutes. (I didn’t expect to be accommodated because I know we were late so please don’t take this as me complaining; I am just giving the complete run down.) Thankfully, I had a backup restaurant for us to try which was 1803 Pizza/Kitchen. I had read some reviews that were amazing and some that were kind of on the fence, but I figured we should just try it for ourselves. Surprisingly, there was only one other table…
Best pasta in Florida! Located in a cute fun spot and the inside is a adorable, clean and staff recommendations were all fantastic.
Eduardo was wonderful and the food was great.
Great food, great people. Eat here!
Lugar muy Bonito. Empleados muy amables y eficientes. Ambiente agradable y el servicio Excellent!!! Comida Muy Rica!!! VOLVEREMOS!!!
First time - will be back!
Food here is amazing!!! Service is great!
Great service, excellent quality food, and very relaxed atmosphere
Great people, great service, unique food options
Great pizza and awesome desserts!!! Recommend.
Best Pizza in Orlando !!!
The pizza and pasta are delicious! The desserts are incredible as well.
Everything was delicious! Super quick service as well.

There are so many great restaurants in Mount Dora you would not miss out on anything by skipping this one. The food is average. The price points are absurd for what you are actually being served. Our waitress Anya was great. She was very sweet and knowledgeable and made an effort to make our experience special, but the food was not memorable in any way and we won’t return.

We dined at 1921 Mount Dora with a large group, and they handled it with ease. I’m a vegetarian, and my meal was excellent, they told us almost all the veggies are local farm fresh, and you could tell. Others had various beef dishes, which came with a unique touch, the owner explained much of it was sourced from a local high school FFA project. The entire evening was thoughtful, with attention to detail in both the food and the hospitality. The dessert they said was made fresh in the kitchen from their pastry chef!

It's our favorite place to go for date nights and special occasions. The menu rotation always provides something fresh and new to experience. We just found out that 1921 is being considered for a Michelin rating

Patrick the bartender was absolutely awesome food was great only thing was the blueberry cobbler had almost no cobbler and for $15 give me some more cobbler please the fries were so freaking delicious

We've been for dinner several times and previously had great experiences. Completely different experience sitting at the bar for cocktails and dessert. The rude and inattentive bar staff led to us regretting our decision to seek out this particular spot for our night cap. Save your money and hit up a dive bar for the same quality cocktail as what's served here. You might even get better service too.

I dont even know how to begin, i will start by our waitress Annie, she went beyond to accommodate my beer taste, she gave me samples, she helped towards the right direction, the food was an amazing explosion of flavors, the braised ribs were very good, the burrata was also a nice choice, the pork ribs were so good, the octopus also a must try. We were a difficult to please bunch and left this restaurant totally satisfied. Thank you Annie for your nice welcome to this place.

Muchísimas gracias a Ani, una alegre y atenta mesera que hizo nuestro almuerzo especial. La carta es impresionante y la elaboración súper. Un lugar especial q no puedes dejar de visitar en Mount Dora. La sugerencia de la mesa: Blistered shishito peppers & Burrata. Un plato espectacular!!!

This restaurant has a fun eclectic look. Option to purchase art sitting on the wall. Went to the restaurant for a special occasion. I tried the Fig bourbon drink and it was delicious. The oysters were absolutely delicious. I decided to go did the burger, it did not disappoint!!! Literally one of the best burgers I’ve tried! Staff was attentive and friendly. Wonderful for date night.

Always love sitting at the bar at 1921. All of the food and service has been wonderful. The one item that was not up to par was taken off the bill when it was noticed that very little of it was eaten. Was there tonight and cannot wait to go back. The menu is always changing so what ever is listed on the site is not guaranteed to be there. Farm to table! 🙏

Beautiful place with delicious options! This is the perfect place for date nights or anniversary dinners. Update: we had lunch as family today and they did not disappoint! The atmosphere was amazing! The staff was friendly and attentive! Great restaurant in beautiful Downtown Mount Dora area!
My family loves 1921! We have all our family celebrations there! Wait staff is awesome 🤩 and we always enjoy the food 🎉

“Excellent service! Our waiterDarcy,was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. she had a great attitude, checked on us at the right times, and made our dining experience even better. Highly recommend — outstanding customer service!”
Service was great. My drink was really good. The shrimp ceviche was amazing! And the happy hour oyster too. The olives were meh. Will definitely be back!

I made a reservation here with family for mother's day. The menu looked great online and the reviews seemed to paint a picture of a many well done dishes. Well, unfortunately that was not the case with our experience. We ordered two carrpt soups, two vegetable plates, the cobia and the ribeye. The carrot soup tasted heabily of a curry soup. It was good but there was no carrot flavor. The vegetable plates had zero seasoning. I mean ZERO. Not even salt. They tasted like they picked the vegetables from the ground, through them in a pan for a few minutes and put them on the plate. They were also undercooked and the carrots and squash were still very crunchy. The fried mushroom pieces were the best part of that dish. The farro at the bottom was well cooked but also extremely underseasoned. This was the same with both dishes. The cobia was very well cooked and well seasoned. However, the rest of the dish was a bit disappointing. It was served over of few scoops of diced beets and a smear of beet puree. That's it. That's the dish. The beet pieces were bitter and didn't seem to pair well with the cobia ans savory sauce on the top at all. My husband's ribeye was the best dish. He said it was not the best he's had but was well cooked and the potatoes were tasty. Hard to mess up steak and potatoes. We all enjoy all kinds of cuisines and flavors from around the world and enjoying many styles of cooking. However, this meal seemed to mis the mark. The menu had today's date printed on it…
Oh, yes. Mushrooms. Olives. Shrimp. Ani might be our new all-time fave server. Exceptional food and service. So glad we checked it out!
Excellent food but service was slow and the place wasn't busy

We love a dog friendly patio, and this one loves dogs so much they have a statue out front. They have excellent wines, even on happy hour, and their food is delicious. Shout out to Darcy for excellent service!
מנה אחת הייתה מעולה, השניה פחות. סה"כ מקום נחמד מאוד. הכיסאות בחלל המרכזי, היו נמוכים ביחס לשולחן. ישיבה לא נוחה.

Spectacular upscale, modern restaurant for a gourmet experience in Mount Dora. I went for my 60th birthday and was gladly impresed that the menu was printed with a "Happy birthday" message in my honor! The works of art are a very nice bonus. The food is almost worth a Michelin star: The perfection of the steak and duck, and the wonderful meat and cheese platter with jams, mustards and pâte, are out of this world. It reminded me of the time I had dinner 35 years ago at the Paul Bocuse restaurant in Lyon.The prices may seem high, but it's worth every dollar! The list of wine, cocktails and spirits is impressive. Our server, Chris, was very helpful and didn't miss any detail. Impeccable service. Applause for Chef Chris Edwards and sous chef, Jose Fabre. I was very happy to have chosen this lovely, historical place for my birthday: unforgettable experience.

Drinks were great. Appetizers (grilled oysters) were delicious, I'd do them again and I'm not an oyster person. I also got a curry onion soup which came out cold the first time but they replaced it no problem. Entrees were okay (underseasoned for my taste), not as good as the appetizers or drinks but still good. Overall a good experience being so close, and I will visit again.
Had the wahoo fish was overcooked. Ordered their bread it was stale, dessert chocolate cake was also very dry. Second time there first time was great second time not so much

Made a reservation for a birthday dinner. Arrived on time and was seated in the bar area at a high top when there were tables available in the dining room area. But we did not say anything. Server came up and did not introduce herself or make any conversation other than offering drinks. We asked about the menu and she could not answer some of our questions. We both ended up ordering the Wahoo. It was a tiny piece of fish, very dry with the skin still on. The description mentioned white beets, which were not included and the greens were bland.Overall, it was an expensive disappointment and we will not return.
Had a delicious dinner! The cheese board was amazing, and the rolls were definitely the yummiest part of the meal. Everything was fresh and flavorful, highly recommend!
Place is solid.great cocktails

This was a disappointing experience across both service and food, especially at this price point. Service was disorganized from the start. Our hostess doubled as our waitress and never introduced herself. The experience felt unstructured and inattentive throughout. There were multiple execution issues with the food. A pizza from the kids’ menu came out with chives on it and had to be remade, basic attention to detail was missing. My wife’s medium Wagyu burger arrived with a completely soaked bun. A properly prepared burger should rest before being plated to avoid exactly that. This felt rushed. I ordered the $165 “Wagyu × Platinum” 16 oz ribeye, and it was the biggest disappointment of the night. The steak was chewy and lacked the tenderness expected from anything labeled Wagyu. The presentation also didn’t match the price point, heavy sauce pooling on the plate and an overall unrefined look. There were also inconsistencies on the plate. The carrots were overly charred rather than properly glazed, while char appeared on bok choy from a different dish that nobody at our table ordered. That points to a lack of control in the kitchen. When we raised concerns, we were polite and simply asked to have the items removed. We then waited approximately 20 minutes for resolution while being told the manager was dealing with another issue. Waiting that long especially with a six-year-old at the table is unacceptable. While some items were removed, the overall handling of the situation…
Fantastic food, great old school waterfront low-key joint. The staff is great and the vibe is laid back. Highly recommend.

Went here with a couple friends on a Friday night and had a really good experience. The seafood tasted fresh and was cooked just right, especially the shrimp and crab cakes. Portions were decent for the price and everything came out pretty quick. Our server was friendly and checked on us without being overbearing. The place was busy but still felt relaxed and comfortable. One small thing, my side dish wasn't very hot when it arrived, but they fixed it right away. Overall, I'd definitely come back when I'm craving seafood again.
YEEE
Food was delicious, brought my bf for the first time. Hannah K took an extra $20 for tip, but outside of that everything was amazing so we let her keep it. Just a FYI

Heard really good things about this place. Kinda of disappointed. Ordered 2 shrimp baskets and came with 2 sides, charged for salad and baked which had two black bad spots in the potato.Scallops at market price, were, ok. Grouper was good. Peanut butter pie was so frozen we took it home and let it thaw out to eat. Key lime pie was good. For the price, I expected more! Waitress told us we could go somewhere else when our guest asked for a mixed drink, not realizing only beer and wine served there! Well, lunch possibly...dinner, not impressed. 250+ could have been better

Very disappointing lunch experience. The fish portion was extremely small, and the Cobb salad was not fresh. The vegetables tasted old and wilted. The total bill was around $50, which felt far too expensive for the quality and quantity of food served. Overall, not worth the price, and I would not return.
Great little hole-in- the- wall bseafood place.
Not alot of parking, service was par, and the food was not good.

I was excited to try The Diner after seeing so many positive reviews, but unfortunately, our experience didn’t live up to the hype. First, I have to give credit where it’s due—the service was prompt and friendly. Beyond that, though, things went downhill pretty quickly. The restaurant itself felt dark and surprisingly cold, which didn’t make for the cozy diner atmosphere I was expecting. The food was also much more expensive than the quality justified. My daughter was especially excited about the stuffed strawberry French toast, but after one bite, her enthusiasm disappeared faster than the whipped cream. My coffee tasted like instant coffee, and my chicken and waffles were equally disappointing. The chicken tasted like it had taken a long vacation in the freezer before being reheated and sent to my table. Maybe we visited on an off day, but I’m genuinely confused by all the glowing reviews because this was not a memorable breakfast for the right reasons—and I rarely leave negative reviews. To top it off, our party of six was automatically charged a 22% gratuity. I understand adding a gratuity for larger groups, but 22% felt excessive, especially considering the overall dining experience. Eighteen percent would have been understandable; 22% felt a bit like ordering a side of sticker shock.

I recently tried the BBQ at A-Aki Sushi & Steakhouse Avalon for the first time. I’ve been there before for sushi and have never had a bad experience-at most, service was a bit slow, but the food has always been enjoyable. Unfortunately, my BBQ experience wasn’t as great. It was just two of us dining, and the restaurant was empty when we arrived, yet service still took a while. It seemed like there wasn’t enough staff at first, and I even wondered if our server was the only one working in that area. As more customers started coming in later, our server became more active in the area, but the initial service felt limited. The BBQ price was $29.99 per person. The food itself wasn’t bad—the short ribs were pretty good. I didn’t catch my server’s name during the visit, but my receipt listed her as Sarah I. When we received our check, I noticed that a 20% gratuity had already been added for just two people. According to Sarah, this is automatic regardless of service and is “how it is everywhere.” That surprised me, as I’ve usually only seen automatic gratuity applied to larger groups (typically 6 or more, often around 18%). For comparison, I recently dined at Gen BBQ in Waterford with four people and did not have an automatic 20% gratuity added. I gave my server at Gen a 25% gratuity anyways cause she was amazing! Overall, the experience was okay, but the slow service and unexpected gratuity policy made it less enjoyable. I’m curious if this practice is actually common everywhere…

I politely asked for some napkins, and the server said she’d be right back. Instead, she stood right in front of us talking and laughing with another server for about three minutes before wiping the table. She could’ve easily dropped the napkins off first and then continued her conversation — I wouldn’t have minded. The table next to us actually got their food, ate, and were finishing up by the time she returned — which honestly made the whole situation even more frustrating. As a server, if someone asks me for a few more minutes, I always check back in 2–3 minutes. It wasn’t busy enough to justify that long of a wait, so it really just felt like we were forgotten. We also asked for bread, and again it took about 10 minutes. During that time, we saw her chatting at the bar instead of grabbing it. We have been going to Armando’s for years and have visited all three locations; Winter Park, Orlando, and Lake Nona so we have had consistently great experiences in the past, especially at the Winter Park location, which has always been our go-to. The food came out lukewarm, overly oily, and overall lacked the quality we’ve come to expect. Service was also off. Our waiter seemed well-intentioned, but he didn’t check back in on us during the meal or refresh drinks. The only time he returned was after dropping the check, and even then, it felt rushed as he came back multiple times asking if we were ready to pay, without giving us a chance to finish our drinks or enjoy the moment. We were not there looking for a free meal, it was her birthday and I just wanted her to have a nice meal. We will not be back!

We came to celebrate my wife 27th birthday, and this turned out to be one of the highlights of our Disney trip! From the moment we walked in, everything was exceptional. The atmosphere is warm, welcoming, and just a genuinely happy place to be. After spending hours in the Florida heat, we were pretty tired, but our server, Giuseppe, completely turned our day around. He was incredibly kind, warm, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our experience special. His positive energy lifted our spirits and made us enjoy every minute of our meal. Truly one of the best servers we’ve had in a long time. We ordered the burger, the chicken sandwich, and the famous pot roast. Every single dish was delicious, but the pot roast absolutely lived up to the hype—it was outstanding. The portions are huge, making this a great place to share plates with family or friends. We also really appreciated how accommodating the kitchen was with every modification we requested. A special thank you as well to Jose, the manager, for helping create such a welcoming experience. It’s clear the team takes pride in what they do. Between the incredible food, generous portions, outstanding service, and wonderful atmosphere, this was an easy five-star experience. We can’t recommend this place enough, and it will definitely be one of our first stops the next time we’re at Disney Springs. Thank you for making this birthday so memorable!

Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' is my favorite restaurant at Disney Springs, and it's not even close. I've celebrated Father's Day here for the last two years. I've come here for my birthday. I already have plans for a visit when my family gets here in two weeks. Obviously, the food is phenomenal. I usually get Art's Famous Fried Chicken, which they say is Buttermilk-brined for 24 hours then and then flash fried. I have a severe shellfish allergy, and they're always very cautious. No matter who the server or floor manager is. Typically, it's served with creamy mashed potatoes, but I usually swap it out with Momma's Mac and Cheese. I've also had the Smothered Chicken, Bee Haven Fried Green Tomatoes, and the Skilled-fried Chicken Paillard, which is what most of the staff recommends as their favorite dish. And you always have to get a cheddar drop biscuit. That's a non-negotiable. This restaurant is very popular and often gets quite busy, so I recommend to make a reservation as soon as you're ready. But the busyness of the restaurant won't matter once you take a bite. The food is the ambiance and changes everything. Just trust me.

Located in Disney Springs, Chef Art Smith’s Homecomin’ serves generously big portions of Southern comfort food. The mashed potatoes were creamy, while the country fried steak and fried chicken were crispy and well-executed. The meal became a little gelat after a while due to the richness. Recommend to make a reservation before coming.

My husband and I had reservations on Sunday 2026 Father's Day for brunch at 9.45 a.m.. We arrived about 10 minutes early and we're promptly seated. One thing that we did not know and we had researched this pretty good. But they allowed us to get off the breakfast or the lunch menu. We had read and watched on YouTube that you had to do either or if you went early but they allowed us to do both. Right off the bat the music was so loud along with the voices of the people that we could not talk to each other. We were waited on by a wonderful lady who did a great job. Food came out reasonably fast. We started with their famous biscuits. And they were absolutely horrible. Very, very dry with a powerful baking soda taste. My husband got the donuts, fried chicken and creamed potatoes meal. The chicken was probably the best chicken we've had in 7 years of being in Florida. The donuts were okay and the cream potatoes were fair. I had a child's plate. You don't have to be a certain age and the serving was large. It came with scrambled eggs, fruit and the special potatoes that have the corn flakes on top. I didn't care for the corn flakes but the potatoes themselves were delicious as was the fruit. My eggs were fine. For dessert we had the shine cake which came with ice cream and. It was very good and my husbands favorite thing. So our experience was 50/50. It was so loud you couldn't even hear yourself think and half of our food was really good and half of it wasn't. But the waitress…

Chef Art Smith's Homecomin was outstanding! The fried chicken was the best I've ever had, the deviled eggs were incredible, and the shrimp & grits were a true Southern classic. Honestly, everything on the menu looked amazing. Highly recommend!

Service was wonderful and our hostess Tara was excellent and so was the manager that made sure our daughter was taken care of with her allergies of nuts and fish. They really take the time out with their customers to show they really care. We will definitely come back and I strongly recommend!!! Keep up the excellent work ethic, customer service care and kudos to the kitchen chef.

The atmosphere is cute, I love how you can see the water outside when sitting by the windows. And our server was very nice. The food was… ok. The price definitely doesn’t match up to the quality. My skillet fried chicken plate didn’t have much flavor, other than the sauce which was just ok. The Mac and cheese was good and so was the chicken sandwich. The fried chicken is chicken thighs, which we were told about in advance, but personally we should’ve picked something else. I did like the doughnuts. We also had half portioned of deviled eggs. Which had a strong taste of vinegar and mustard.

Legitimately one of the best dining experiences we have had at any Disney World location. Food was 10/10, atmosphere was fun and upbeat, and our server (Tiana) was amazing and didn’t steer us wrong. We will come back every time we visit Disney World.

While on vacation in Orlando we stopped at Disney Springs and ate at this restaurant. We booked a reservation a few weeks prior to dine here. I ordered the Fried Chicken entrée with Mashed Potatoes, Mac & Cheese and Greens. The food portions were generous. The food was okay but, it does not taste like traditional Southern Cooking or Soul Food. The Fried Chicken was crispy, but it lacked flavor. The chicken and breading was basic which was disappointing since this restaurant supposed to be Southern-style cooking. The Mac & Cheese was cooked perfectly but they used white cheddar cheese instead of traditional cheeses that most people are familiar with. The Greens were okay but they did not have much flavor either and they tasted like Turnip Greens which is not my favorite. The biscuit was delicious. The waiter were very attentive, nice and professional. The restaurant manager was professional and came by to check on the customer's satisfaction of the food and service. I love how immaculate, meticulous and clean the entire restaurant was. Overall, we enjoyed our visit but the food needs improvement if they want to fulfill the Southern-style cooking they advertise.
Absolutely delicious food! Friendly staff as well. Portions are HUGE can definitely be shared!

Every time I visit Orlando, a stop at Chef Art Smith’s Homecomin’ is a must. Their famous fried chicken and donuts never disappoint and are one of my favorite meals in the area. This Father’s Day, I enjoyed another wonderful meal with my family, and everything was as good as I remembered. Great food, generous portions, friendly service, and a welcoming atmosphere make this one of our favorite restaurants in Orlando. Highly recommended! 🍗🍩😊

I am not sure what all the hype is about. The chicken wasn't very flavorful. It wasn't dry so that is a plus. The biscuits were oversized, but dry. The sauces and gravy were the stars of this menu. The service was wonderful. No complaints there. The place looks like it could use a good wipe down. Bathrooms were dirty and unkempt. No seat covers, trash can overflowing, dirty floors feminine trash can falling off the wall.

I just wanted southern comfort food and saw the chicken paillard and knew I had to come here. This restaurant is in Disney Springs and parking is free. I ordered the chicken paillard and replaced the potatoes with the broccolini. The chicken was cooked well, but the sauce was just ok. The side dishes were good. I also had the white peach sangria which was so flavorful and delicious, even while eating outside and the ice was melting, the drink didn’t taste watered down— it is on the sweet side. My companion had the fried chicken and donuts and it was deliciously seasoned. You can select white or dark meat or a combination. The dish came with mashed potatoes which were delicious. Donuts were fresh and soft and didn’t have the after taste of oil that sometimes comes with donuts. The Hummingbird cake with pineapple and banana cake was a disappointment after such a good meal and probably knocks odd half a star. It was more banana tasting and the icing was a stiff and sugary sweet icing rather than the cream cheese frosting advertised. Despite the dessert, we would definitely return, but skip the dessert.

We had an amazing meal at Chef Art Smith’s Homecomin’! We started with the hush puppies and deviled eggs, and both were absolutely delicious. For our entrees, we tried the country fried steak, meatloaf, and smothered fried chicken. Every dish was flavorful, cooked perfectly, and tasted like true comfort food. One thing that really stood out was the portion sizes—everything was generously served, and we definitely left full and satisfied. The food was fresh, hearty, and packed with flavor. If you’re looking for a great Southern-style meal with large portions and tasty dishes, Homecomin’ is definitely worth a visit!

Every time we come to Disney Springs we try to see if we can get seating at homecoming. The food is always excellent and the service is top-notch. This past time we had Erika, Allison, and Nicole at the bar. They were so funny and personable. A definite must-try.

We were extremely disappointed with our experience at Chef Art Smith’s Homecomin’. We traveled all the way from Maryland and made our reservation nearly two months in advance because dining here was one of the experiences we were most looking forward to during our trip. We walked over a mile to get to the restaurant, only to be told upon arrival that they could not serve us due to a power outage. What made the situation even more frustrating was watching other guests continue to be seated and served while we were turned away. Had we been notified in advance or treated consistently with other guests, we would have understood that unexpected circumstances happen. Instead, after planning ahead, traveling a long distance, and making the trek to the restaurant, we were left feeling overlooked and extremely disappointed. We understand that power outages are beyond a restaurant’s control, but communication, consistency, and customer service are not. Unfortunately, this experience left a very negative impression and was a disappointing part of what was supposed to be a special vacation.

Food was great. Service too. Atmosphere was comfortable. No paranormal events but we had a great time. Prices we're easy on the wallet. We ate upstairs with a great view of the whole place.

Ashley’s of Rockledge absolutely lived up to the hype! My girlfriend and I stopped in hoping for great food and maybe a ghost sighting. While the spirits must have been taking the night off, the food was hauntingly good. I ordered the burger with fries and a side salad. The burger was cooked perfectly, the fries were fresh, crispy, and some of the best I’ve had in a while, and the salad was fresh and crisp. My girlfriend had the sliders with fries, and they disappeared so quickly I almost thought a ghost stole them. We also shared an order of buffalo wings with ranch, and they were outstanding—hot, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. Even though we didn’t experience anything paranormal, the atmosphere was fantastic. The building has a lot of history, and the historic charm combined with the local ghost stories gives the place a unique character you won’t find at a typical restaurant. If there are ghosts at Ashley’s, they’re clearly staying because the food is too good to leave. We’ll definitely be back—maybe next time the spirits will join us for dinner.
It was awesome
Not haunted as advertised but interesting and great service.
At lunch: Fabulous wings, great BLT, others raved about sliders and the Italian sandwich. Great service. I love a historic building like this. Why did it take me so long? I'll go back.
Been going to eat here since the early 80's.
Reasonable drinks and fun karaoke on Fridays!

This place used to be great. Currently under new management. Like the 5th time in two years and the absolute worst so far. If you like hockey try the burgers, inedible. Water treatment plant across the RR tracks offers a smell that is incredible.

We had a very pleasant experience at this establishment. Jo, our server and barmaid was very nice and helpful. She even told us about the history of this haunted restaurant. The food was excellent too! Highly recommend
Jo r server WAS GREAT, she was very friendly and attentive! She is such an asset to this place. Compliments to the cook for our delicious food too.
Great food! The wings were delicious. Super friendly staff! Antoine was our server and he was awesome.
The food was delicious, the service was great, and the atmosphere is unique.

UPDATED: A lot has changed since we were last here. And I like it. The menu has changed. There are now theme days, such as Taco Tuesdays, Smackburger Mondays, and Fish Fridays. I ordered a Greek salad. The portion was quite large. The salad was good. My husband often orders chicken wings here. The chicken wings here are also delicious. Always well taken care of here. Servers very pleasant. Excellent food. Bibimbap is an experience!

I took my son who wanted to try sushi. Im not a sushi conisour but I do enjoy it from time to time. It is in a very nice area, bright and clean. What a wonderful experience, the staff, waitress and runner were diligent and always around when we needed them, the food was very good, edamame servings a bit small, but not a big deal. Great quick sushi place for our family. They had regular plain rolls available even though they weren't in the menu and gluten free soy sauce.

Amazing! Great sushi at a very fair price at a restaurant with a vibe that matches. Whether eating inside or on the town square this sushi experience is a win all day long. Timely, friendly service with fresh sushi using fresh fish, vegetables, etc. What a great place for brunch or a first date. Absolutely in love with the food, the ambiance and the service. 5+ Stars.

We've been coming from Tennessee to Aunt Catfish since I was a little girl (I'm now 42!). As soon as we arrive in Port Orange we go see our relatives and eat at Aunt Catfish! It never disappoints! A family tradition that never disappoints. Trudy kept the cinnamon rolls fresh and Brook made sure the delicious food made it to us. Amazing!

I just got off the plane and was hungry. Someone at the airport suggested Aunt Catfish's. I really enjoyed my dinner and our waitress was wonderful. I did have leftovers too.
Great to food and a wonderful staff. Need to go here for the fixing bar.

Their call ahead seating process is a joke. Only had four of us on a Wednesday night they'll say it's one thing and then it ends up being another. So many other great restaurants in the area not sure if this is worth the wait though.
Warm cinnamon rolls! AYCE rolls and sides bar comes w most meals. Food and staff are fabulous. Worth the wait.

Request Ella, she’s spectacular and go early! It’s packed by 5:30. Our food was good- the buffet for some quirky sides was definitely unexpected but a cool idea. Higher end rooms on a disney property. The boardwak is great at night and it has many more eating choices. BUT remember this is a resort property so you only get the best places by reserving your tables weeks in advance.

Stayed here over Father's Day Weekend in a 2 bedroom villa after getting done with a Disney Wish cruise. Long time DVC member. Villas adjacent to multiple restaurants and walking distance to Epcot World Showcase entrance.
Lovely resort with amazing staff. Cool pool set up and a small quiet one for the villas. Ideal is EPCOT and Hollywood Studios are your choices for Disney Parks.

Boardwalk villa was very spacious with deep soaker tub that my toddler loved. Having a separate bedroom was beneficial for our family. Our only issue was another resort was have a party at 10 pm at night that was heard clearly on our rooms.

It’s hard to beat Boardwalk’s location, and we loved the setup of the studio for the first night of our family vacation! Love the walkability to both Epcot and Hollywood studios (and the ability to boat!), and the proximity to good restaurants is also great. Excited to know there is a new quick service restaurant coming to the area soon!

Prime location! We had an amazing stay at Boardwalk. We will be back! The rooms could use a little paint touch up, but that didn’t stop dampen out magical trip!

Very short walk to Epcot, boats are easy and STROLLER FRIENDLY! Skyliner is easy access as well. Boardwalk area is very fun at night with performers and food is actually very good! Highly recommend breakfast at Cake Bake! Pool is great and slide is very kid friendly.

Great vacatio. Loved Boardwalk. Had a balcony that we requested and enjoyed sitting out there with our coffee in the morning. Transportation was flawless.plenty of busses. Never had more than a 15 minute wait. The dining plan saved us a lot of money. We did experience the rain and had to leave a couple of parks early. I was impressed with how accommodating the front desk staff was. Someone was always waiting out front of the desk to assist with any questions you might have. 5 STAR EXPERIENCE

The room had shocking little storage space. There were only 2 of us but the room fits five. We barely had space to put our things. The bathroom has no shelves or sink space for bathroom items. The room was very clean, we loved the little balcony and how close it was to Epcot. Cast members were great, as they always are. We overall loved the hotel but the rooms need improvement.
It was nice and the staff was very friendly!
Diamond was very helpful and knowledgeable. Her smile was very warm and welcoming. She is truly an asset to the Wyndham brand. I will definitely come back.
Completely satisfied

On the first day; our toilet did not flush, our hair dryer did not work, and the TV cut off every ten mins. A male staff member knocked on our door at 10pm with the replacement hair dryer and asked to enter our room to collect the other. Rooms are dated and musty. Pool is awesome though.
Nice service.
Wonderful staff wonderful place to stay look forward to coming back next year!
Prime location at International Drive, walking distance to restaurant and activities

Had to find a place to stay at quick notice that was a reasonable price and this did just the trick. Staff was very nice, answered all my questions and overall was a positive experience. Do the rooms need updating? Yes…but that’s not a reflection of the staff that’s on the property owners. Was it clean? Yes. They are also very upfront with how their housekeeping policies are which I had no issues with but others may do pay attention to that. I had no issues with noise it was very quiet. Water was always hot…and the a/c worked just great. Was perfect for what I needed but I also was traveling alone and didn’t have a pile of kids to entertain. So if you need a clean place to lay your head for a night or two and you don’t mind a property with minimal decor in the room then I’d recommend it.

Do not recommend – terrible service and maintenance We had a very uncomfortable stay here and would not recommend this hotel due to poor service and maintenance issues: Uncomfortable Bedding: The bedsheets and blankets were so uncomfortable we could barely sleep. We asked for a change, but the staff never did it. Neglected Housekeeping: They only clean rooms every 4 days. We requested simple things like fresh towels and a trash empty, which were completely ignored. Maintenance Issues: The elevator is poorly maintained and the floor indicator screen wasn't even working. Landphone was not working still requested to fix not addressed. Important: if you get a room in the tower, it can be very noisy! People talking in the courtyard sounds like they are right outside your room. So try to get a room in the main building. Rooms are fine, but you'll never get anyone to bring you a towel so you'll have to steal it off a cart when you see it. Other than that, pool is nice, restaurant has good variety, good location to walk to restaurants or mini golf etc. I would stay here again.

The hotel offer a “good breakfast” when you book , but when you check-in they tell you have only 2 breakfast by room you have to pay for the additionals, that doesn’t make any sense. Additionally the “breakfast” doesn’t even include a coffee. they only have one cashier so the lines are very long. attached is a picture of the juices, totally disaster the breakfast.
Very clean , very polished and polite!
Had a great experience, at check in Janice front desk clerk was absolutely amazing. Customer service and muti tasking ability made my stay great
Excellent place! Clean, right in the middle if everything

I’ve only been checked in here, not even a full hour, and I finally just got my room because they kept messing up on the room numbers and what my room was supposed to be. The first time they sent me to a floor with a room number that didn’t even exist, The second time they sent me to a room that wasn’t facing the correct location I had originally requested when I had booked, The third time they just sent me back to the original room that I was supposed to be in but what with the correct number. Now that I’m in my correct room. The AC isn’t even working. This is my first and last time here. Absolutely ridiculous

Great place to stay when going to Universal! There are free shuttles available if the times work for you. But also just a super fast and cheap Lyft or Uber ride away! I would however like to see the check-in process more modernized. You can “complete your pre-arrival check-in” online like they ask you to in an email. But then you still have to fill out information by hand when you get there… That’s kind of annoying.

Horrible check in experience. Twenty minutes standing in the hallway outside my room while they look for new batteries for the door. Zero help at front desk just go wait. Grounds are not clean at all. The entire property reeks of age and lack of maintenance. Everything is dirty and smells musty. The location is just a step above a bad county fair if a four lane highway went through the middle of it.

For my birthday, my wife and I went to Orlando Florida. We stayed at the Wyndham. The hotel was nice. The room needed to be updated. The people at the hotel were great. Next time we go to Orlando we will stay there again. Thank you for time on my birthday.
Allie was amazing at check in extremely friendly and provided such fast and friendly check in service . She made us feel right at home!

Janice did an amazing job to make a potential negative experience into an extremely positive experience. She listened and ensured that we were pleased with the outcome of our situation. Cudo's in an epic way to Janice!

We loved that restaurants that were in the hotel. This made it very convenient after a long day at the park. Bar 17 was absolutely phenomenal (service, food and view). The staff there remembered us every time we went. The location of the hotel was very prime as well. 15 to 20 minute walk to the parks and Volcano Bay was right next door.

Star Review I had an extremely disappointing and upsetting experience during my stay at Universal’s Aventura Hotel. We were there to celebrate a birthday, but the night was ruined by poor customer service, unprofessional behavior, and a complete lack of proper follow-up from management. From the beginning, the check-in process was unpleasant. The receptionist was rude, impatient, and dismissive when we asked basic questions about charges and fees. Shortly after arriving to our room, a staff member came regarding a noise complaint. I immediately complied and turned the TV off. About 15 minutes later, a manager came to our room with security and immediately began accusing me of making offensive comments about the previous employee. The manager never clearly explained what was allegedly said and repeatedly told us that “actions have consequences.” The situation felt aggressive, accusatory, and unnecessary. We were not given a fair opportunity to explain ourselves, and we felt singled out, uncomfortable, and unsafe in our own hotel room. What made this even more concerning is that the accusation appeared to be based on something allegedly overheard after our room door was closed while we were speaking privately in Spanish. That raised serious privacy concerns for us as guests. Because of how long and stressful the situation became, we missed a birthday dinner reservation and were charged a $100 fee. I contacted the hotel multiple times afterward asking for the matter to be…

3 adults staying. 1 was my daughter 18 and autistic. We chose this hotel as we wanted to be close to universal within walking distance. On arrival it's a lovely bright clean friendly hotel. Staff checking in were lovely. However the lady doing the park tickets not so great. We asked for a paper copy ticket for our landyards. She huffed and puffed. We did check and yes can do it. Eventually we got them. The room were perfect very spacious and very clean. Lovely views actually it's a wow view. The robot was a great addition. My daughter instantly relaxed it's a nice quite hotel with space. I'm sure whoever designed it had neaurogent people in mind too. The pool was perfect especially after a day at the parks. Daughter not a fan getting in, so safe for her to sit on the side and enjoy what she wanted to do on her phone/computer. WiFi great. Food court yard. We tried most stations and all the food was lovely and fresh. Lovely walk to universal parks and being able to nip next door to get the bus / water taxi perfect. Volcano bay Just being a hop skip and jump from the hotel brilliant. Just one thing and it's not the hotels fault. We thought it would be easy to walk to international drive. We ended up getting Ubers every time not expensive at all though as couldn't work how to get there on foot safely. Overall brilliant sad TUI not having this hotel on there books is very sad. ( We are from UK) I personally would recommend this hotel to anyone. Also getting to Disney if you doing…
Loved this vacation. This hotel, the service, the staff, and housekeeping/maintenance people were all so very nice, talkative, and made us feel like family. We will come back.
Excellent place and good atencion!!!!

This hotel was perfect for our requirements, it was just 2 adults on this occasion but I wish I’d stayed here with the family when we came on 2 previous occasions, the hotel had everything we needed, it was clean, very close to all the universal parks (volcano bay is just a short walk out of the rear gates at the pool area), modern, the restaurants on site were ideal, and offered plenty of good food choices, we didn’t manage to visit the roof top bar/restaurant which I'm sad about, but would definitely make the effort when we return, which I’m sure we will. The only negatives were that there was a “clunking” noise in the room which I can only put down to the lifts constantly on the go, so not much that can be done about that. I also feel that I need to mention that the pool has lifeguards which is great but they spend their whole shift pacing back and forth in the same small area which is a little unnerving and makes trying to relax around the pool a little off putting and uncomfortable. Small crosses to bear and certainly wouldn’t stop us staying here again! I would highly recommend.

very unprofessional super visor, held items at the desk which were for delivery to rooms. construction that was unannounced occurred, causing loud noise and issues with sleep. refused to give florida resident discount. doubtful i’ll be staying here again, will be reaching out to higher positioned staff

Let me start by saying that I will definitely stay at the Adventura again. First impression: The front desk was great, very informative and straightforward. I wish Loews had a mobile key/check in but even so I had a great interaction when checking in. Parking: It was easy and seamless with a large parking garage that has its own elevator to the lobby. Amenities: The pool was pretty basic. But honestly it was way more enjoyable than the Cabana Bay. Less people and just overall way more clean. I personally preferred it but you're also allowed to swim at Cabana Bay or Sapphire Falls if you'd rather something more lively, with a lot more people. Food/Beverage: Starbucks is super convenient and we went to Bar 17 for drinks/appetizers. Okay so Bar 17 was super cool... BUT... I don't know about this Korean infused menu. The drinks were not good. After trying 4-5 different…

No. Generally it was new but felt cheap. Minor niggles such as a sink which did not drain. iPad control was pointless. Aircon noisy. On our first day we had issues with air conditioning and a small leak in the bathroom they were fixed within the next hour thanks to receptionist and engineer. Would recommend to anyone.

Disappointing room quality, great pool and location. We stayed for 8 nights, family of 4. Check-in was quick and easy (note: they charge for the entire stay upfront on day 1). We were assigned to the 4th floor; the elevator worked fine, but it didn't look like it belonged in a resort and it takes quite a while. On the way to the room, you can see guests' clothes and towels hanging over the railings, which looks very tacky. The room was the worst part. The appliances are of terrible quality. Starting with the fridge: it wasn't cooling well. We called the front desk and a staff member came to check the tiny fridge, only to say everything was "fine" and that they didn't have spare ones. Fortunately, it cooled a bit better the next day. The air conditioning is one of those wall units (looks like a motel) and even if you set it to 60°F, it doesn't cool properly. To be fair, outside temperatures were over 90°F, but the room temperature was still uncomfortable. The coffee maker is a joke; it's a strange model that no one can figure out. We never found the coffee pods or instructions on what to buy for it, and they just give you two paper cups. The TV was okay, though they swap out the remote control so you can only watch standard programming (no movie apps, etc.). The microwave was also okay. Overall, the appliances are so bad they make your stay difficult. Also, the ice machines didn't work; only one was functional, and it was in a different building. The best parts of this resort…

Nos hemos hospedado en el Avanti International Resort por quinta vez y seguimos eligiéndolo cada vez que visitamos Orlando. Las instalaciones son muy buenas, las habitaciones son cómodas, las camas permiten descansar muy bien y la piscina es excelente. También valoramos mucho el horario de funcionamiento de la piscina, que nos permite disfrutarla después de un día de compras o paseos. Sin embargo, lo que realmente marca la diferencia en este hotel es su personal. Queremos destacar especialmente a Maggie y Antonio, del área de desayunos. Cada vez que venimos nos reciben con una sonrisa, una amabilidad excepcional y una atención que nos hace sentir como en casa. Sending one party member in while the other is secure a table outside is a much better idea if you are able. Now onto the food. We tried the frozen hot chocolate, which was very sweet! I wish I’d had coffee with that particular beverage but if you like very sweet chocolate adjacent frozen drinks, then this would be for you. I would recommend going unless you didn’t have reservation at the other restaurants in Hollywood Studios or your family members were starving.

A very nice restaurant in Winter Park. According to their website, they want to “... modernize and responsibly curate classic Cuban café culture (including ventanitas, café con leche, and family recipes) in contemporary settings so these traditions can endure for future generations.” This restaurant actually does a good job of doing just that. It is located just to the east of the Orange and S Orlando Ave in a very nicely refurbished older building. The parking is located on 2 sides of the building. You enter straight into the counter where you can order from their menu which is classic Cuban food. You order and pay at the counter. The appetizers (ham croquettes and papa rellanas, etc) were in a place by the counter and so we got those as we left the counter. Very smart in my opinion. They have several seating options to include a window bar to your right from the counter, some outside seating on a patio and a large inside area with benches with tables. The drinks and food came out quickly and were delivered to our table. We got ½ Cubans with Black beans and rice. They were very good as were the appetizers. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and amount. The staff was pleasant and the restaurant was very clean and bright. Overall, a very nice experiences that I would highly recommend to fellow travelers

Some local institutions survive on nostalgia alone — trading on decades of goodwill while quietly coasting on food that peaked sometime during the Ford administration. Beefy King is not that place. Since 1968, they have been doing one thing in Orlando, and they have not stopped doing it well. I joined a line that suggested the locals know exactly what they're about, and stood in it without complaint. The roast beef is sliced to order in front of you, which in an era of mystery meat and heat lamps feels almost radical. It was excellent. The hash browns were the kind that make you briefly reconsider your entire lunch strategy. Everything about it was straightforward, confident, and completely without pretension — a place that has never once needed to reinvent itself because it got it right the first time. Fifty-seven years. Same thing. Still a line out the door. There's a lesson in there for a lot of restaurants.

Freaking incredible pizza. Horrendous service. We’re on a family Disney trip and are still figuring out how the Quick Service Dining Plan works. This was only our second day using it, so we’re definitely still learning what different restaurants allow and how everything is supposed to work. The pizza was really good. The service, though, was shockingly bad. Three different employees at the pizza station were rude, and the cashier really took the cake. I honestly can’t remember the last time I was treated so poorly or felt so unwelcome at a restaurant. We weren’t being difficult—I just wasn’t super confident because I’ve never had a pizza made this way before, so I was probably moving a little slower than the average Blaze customer. It was made clear multiple times that I was not moving fast enough for their liking. I also asked a couple of questions about what was included with the dining plan. Every restaurant seems to handle it a little differently, which is completely fine, but that does mean guests are occasionally going to have questions. Instead of being helpful, the staff were annoyed that I was asking them. I know Disney Springs is a mix of Disney-owned and independently operated businesses, and I’m not expecting pixie dust and over-the-top Disney service everywhere I go. We booked a Father’s Day weekend stay hoping for a relaxing family trip and paid $430 for two nights. Unfortunately, our experience did not meet expectations. When we arrived, our room had not been cleaned from the previous guests. We reported it right away and were apologized to and told we would receive a refund due to the inconvenience. On the second day, there was no housekeeping service at all. We had to call for fresh sheets and towels and ended up making the beds ourselves after returning to the room for the evening. For a resort, we expected regular room service and better attention to detail. That night, there was also loud music from other guests that continued until around 3 a.m., which made it difficult to sleep. For a family-oriented resort, we expected more enforcement of quiet hours and consideration for guests. In the end, we were only refunded $83, which did not feel reflective of the issues we experienced during our stay. Overall, the cleanliness and service were not what we expected for the price, and we hope improvements are made in these areas for future guests.

If I could give this place a -10 review, I would. Horrible customer service. I genuinely don’t understand what took so long. We ordered one large pizza and were told it would be ready in 20 minutes. If it takes 45 minutes to make a single pizza when the restaurant is empty, I can only imagine what the wait is like when they’re actually busy. And to top it off, the pizza was extremely salty… just like the establishment. The issue wasn’t just the wait. The atmosphere strikes a great balance between casual and upscale, making it just as good for a date night as it is for lunch while walking Park Avenue. The food is packed with flavor and offers a nice change of pace from the usual restaurant options around town. The fresh bread, dips, kebabs, and traditional Turkish dishes all feel thoughtfully prepared, and the portions are generous. If you’ve never had Turkish cuisine before, this is a fantastic introduction. Service was friendly, attentive, and happy to help with recommendations. The outdoor seating is also perfect for people-watching and enjoying the energy of Park Avenue. One of Winter Park’s most unique dining experiences and a place that’s earned its reputation over the years.

It is so hard to pick an entree from their manu, everything sounds delicious just by going over the descriptions, they have lamb shank, chicken shish kebab, mixed grill platters, stuffed grape leaves, and traditional Turkish desserts like künefe and pistachio baklava. The portions are generous, the presentation is beautiful, and every dish feels thoughtfully prepared.

As a frequent business traveler who spends about 50 weeks a year on the road, I stay in at least three different hotels every single week—sometimes more. I’ve seen just about every chain, every room setup, and every level of service out there, from luxury spots to bare-bones motels. After all those nights away from home, it’s rare to find a place that truly stands out and makes me want to come back. That’s exactly what happened at the Best Western Port St. Lucie (7900 S US Highway 1, Port Saint Lucie, FL). This property is a genuine gem, especially for road warriors like me who need comfort, space, and genuine hospitality to recharge between workdays. The staff here are, without exaggeration, some of the friendliest and most knowledgeable I’ve encountered across hundreds of stays. From the front desk team who greet you by name after just one visit, to the maintenance folks who are quick to help and always cheerful, everyone seems genuinely invested in making your stay great. They know the area well—recommendations for nearby spots to eat or things to do are spot-on and thoughtful, which is a huge plus when you’re in a new city weekly. The rooms are massive—true suites that feel like a steal for the price. There’s plenty of space to spread out, work comfortably at the desk, or just relax without feeling cramped. Two TVs (one in the living area and one in the bedroom) are a nice touch for unwinding or catching up on news while getting ready. But the real standout? The bed.…

Excellent Smoked Wings and Great Happy Hour Spot Stopped by Broken Barrel Tavern at Palm Bay Road and Babcock and had a great experience. Service was prompt and friendly, and the happy hour specials made it an even better value. I ordered the wing basket with 8 smoked wings and onion petals. The onion petals were crispy, flavorful, and paired perfectly with the spicy remoulade sauce. For the wings, I tried both the Carolina Vinegar and the Hot Garlic flavors. The smoked wings themselves were outstanding, and the Hot Garlic sauce was especially memorable because it featured real garlic, which added incredible flavor. These are definitely wings I will come back for and highly recommend to anyone visiting. My partner ordered the BBQ pulled pork quesadillas with seasoned fries. The fries were more like freshly cut chips, nicely seasoned and delicious, and the quesadillas were excellent as well. Overall, Broken Barrel Tavern delivered great food, quick service, and a relaxed atmosphere. If you’re in the Melbourne area and looking for outstanding smoked wings, this place is absolutely worth a visit. We’ll definitely be back. Dark and floors so sticky I couldn’t move my chair easily.
