Excelente gastronomía turca y ambiente familiar, con un detalle importante sobre las mascotasCalificación: 4/5Celebramos el Día del Padre en familia en este restaurante y pasamos una velada sumamente agradable. La experiencia culinaria fue excepcional; la comida turca destaca por su autenticidad, frescura y gran sabor. Asimismo, la atención por parte del personal fue impecable, mostrándose profesionales y atentos en todo momento, lo que complementa a la perfección el ambiente cálido y acogedor del lugar.Un punto logístico muy a favor es su ubicación estratégica dentro de la plaza turística. El restaurante se encuentra a muy pocos pasos del excelente estacionamiento gratuito disponible para los visitantes, lo cual facilita enormemente el acceso en una zona que alberga múltiples opciones gastronómicas.Como observación importante para otros usuarios, el establecimiento permite asistir con mascotas, pero únicamente en la terraza exterior, incluso si se trata de perros pequeños que permanezcan dentro de su cochecito; el acceso al interior del local está estrictamente restringido para ellos. Por esta normativa, aunque la experiencia general fue muy positiva, es un lugar al que lamentablemente no podremos volver durante la temporada de verano debido a las altas temperaturas en el exterior.A pesar de esta limitación estacional, es una opción totalmente recomendada por su alta calidad gastronómica y excelente servicio.

I would say this was the best kanafeh I have ever had. I also ordered the chicken kebab, baba ganoush, balloon bread, and a blueberry cocktail. The kanafeh was truly excellent — rich, fresh, and absolutely delicious. The baba ganoush and balloon bread were also very good, and the blueberry drink was really enjoyable as well. The only item I personally did not enjoy as much was the chicken kebab. I usually prefer my meat to be cooked a little more well done, so that may have been something I should have mentioned while ordering. At other Turkish restaurants, I am usually comfortable with how the chicken is cooked, but here the texture and taste of the chicken kebab just were not quite for me. One thing I noticed when I first walked in was that the restaurant had a slightly strong food/meat smell. It was not terrible or unbearable, but it was not the most pleasant first impression either. Other than that, everything else was excellent. The kanafeh, baba ganoush, balloon bread, and drink were all great, and the waitress was very helpful, friendly, and welcoming. Overall, it was a good experience, and I would definitely come back for the kanafeh.

The decor is so very nice. The atmosphere is great. The staff were all very friendly. So we chose this restaurant to celebrate my daughter's 27th birthday. Our server Kecia was awesome and a very sweet young lady. Let me get into it: Being from NYC, I have eaten at various Caribbean restaurants. Good Caribbean food is key. I was hoping that this restaurant would really wow me since such a great man's name is on it. Well, the food was good but not what I expected. We had their salsa and chips. It's just okay, a little too spicy, and loose. The rice and peas were just a bit bland for my taste, and they didn't give much rice & peas on the plate. I am used to getting a nice portion to eat with a half chicken. I had more chicken than rice. Literally, like a serving spoonful. The jerk chicken was delicious, and the plantains were as well. The stew chicken was not to my daughter's liking and a bit too spicy. She didn't even complete her meal. The rasta pasta was pretty good. Now, let's talk drinks! The bartender was soooo on point. I had a rum punch, and my daughter had the mojitio. My son in law had a guava juice. He really enjoyed it. The best drinks that we had in a while. Thumbs up, Mr. Bartender. The band that played was really good. We enjoyed the sounds. Maybe we will give this restaurant another try and taste something else. The location is at City Walk. Universal Theme Park.

Today was my wife’s and my anniversary. We chose Bob Marley’s on Universal Studios City Walk to celebrate. We’ve been there several times in the past though it has been a couple of years. As always the place was spotless, had great music and an incredible atmosphere. The food was also great as always. My reason for this post was how amazing the service was. This is not to imply it isn’t usually good, it’s always good but today it was 10 steps above good. Jamaican John L. was our server. He is a shining example of how someone who takes the service career seriously and made a normally good experience amazing. Professional service like this is rare and I hope he is rewarded for his love and passion (you can’t fake what John brings to the table (pun intended)). We were so impressed I asked to speak to the manager. The manager, Joe, came by and explained that Joe is this amazing every day. We hopefully tipped him to a point he realizes how much we appreciated his care and service. But to anyone heading to Bob Marley’s ask for Jamaican John you won’t be disappointed and you’ll leave with a little bit of the islands in heart. Thank you, John you helped make our 23 anniversary celebration amazing.

They served me undercooked, or bad clams on the chowder soup along with raw potatoes. The calamari was tainted! Eating raw clams comes with a risk of foodborne illness caused by bacteria like Vibrio, viruses such as norovirus, and natural marine toxins. While you may experience no ill effects if the shellfish are strictly regulated and properly handled, consuming raw clams can lead to severe gastrointestinal distress, fever, and dehydration. Now I'm sick to my stomach! I'm never eating here again and I will boycott this facility to everyone I can! Eat at your own risk!

Boston’s Fish House feels like the kind of place you’d accidentally discover on a road trip and then spend the next five years telling people about. The menu is packed with New England-style seafood favorites, the portions are generous, and the whole place has that comfortable nautical vibe that says, “we’re more concerned with good seafood than being trendy.” I came hungry and left questioning whether I had accidentally ordered enough food for a small fishing crew. If you’re craving fish, shrimp, scallops, chowder, or anything that belongs near a lighthouse, Boston’s Fish House is worth the stop. 🌶️

I took my husband here for his birthday during the Bite30 offer. When we came in there were two other families, but other than that the place was a ghost town which should have clued us in. As we sat down we were greeted with a little bread basket which normally is great, but this bread had been sitting for so long that it was hard and a little stale. The salad bar and sides were not only lacking in options compared to other steakhouses, also it all looked old from just sitting there. The service team were very nice and attentive. Another disappointing part was the actual meat selection itself. We were not served not one cut of fresh or hot meat. Every meat especially the chicken and pork looked like it had been sitting there for hours. Over cooked and warm if you got lucky. The taste and seasoning of the meats were mediocre to say the least. Oh and please be aware normally Bite30 offerings include the 3 courses, not here however, dessert is separate. Needless to say, I didn't want to disappoint my husband even more with a most likely lack luster dessert so we left and got a sweet treat else where.

Beth's Burger Bar is so good that we ate here twice during our vacation to Orlando. The burger patties are very tender and juicy and seemingly melt when you bite into them. Many sides to choose from, mostly fried things; we enjoyed the fries, onion rings, fried cheese curds, and fried pickles. Only minor negative is that the fries and onion rings were a bit too salty, but the flavor overall was excellent. Every single person working there both times we went were always smiling and super friendly and helpful. Very quick service; order and pay at the counter and they bring the food out which allowed us to have a great meal and then move on with our day instead of wasting a bunch of time like you would at a traditional sit-down restaurant. The best burger cant wait to go back
Best burgers i have found since moving to Florida from California! Always juicy and flavorful. Top it off with the side of sweet potato fries and a peanut butter shake.
Great burgers, great service and only 2 miles from Epic Universe. Served us in under five minutes and everything was super fresh. Really friendly staff.
Great burger and most delicious sweet potato fries
Really great burger spot. Very quick, friendly service and the burgers tasted fresh. It’s a casual spot, nothing fancy, but it’s great if that’s what you’re looking for!

Stopped by chance and turned out amazing! Wife and I brought my 10yo son and he finished the burger before me which only happened once before. Wife and I got a double and it was so good! Sides we got are the fried okra, normal fries and parmesan cheese fries. All of them were amazing. We got two dipping sauces to try, peanut butter and pineapple jalapeño. I wish I got the pineapple jalapeños on my burger! If you like a spicy relish taste then you’ll love it. Fast service! I would highly recommend this place!
Such a good 'mom and pop' owned restaurant, great food, great atmosphere, and the service is great, try the pizza burger and the sweat potato fries, literally my go to every time I go.
Probably the best burger I’ve had in Orlando. Incredible staff and great ambiance, but the burgers are insane and don’t miss out on the garlic parm fries and frickles!!
Great lunch options. Fast and friendly service. Clean and comfortable. Really enjoyed it.
Just stopped in for a burger and left with phenomenal experience! Absolutely great food, friendly service, and clean atmosphere! Will certainly be back!!!

⭐⭐☆☆☆ (2/5) I visited today for lunch and ordered the raw salmon poke bowl. Unfortunately, the salmon appeared to be spoiled and was not safe to eat. I brought this to the attention of an employee, not because I was looking for a refund or free food, but because I felt it was important that the kitchen and manager be made aware so the fish could be checked. The employee did not apologize or seem concerned about the issue, which was disappointing. I ended up ordering a bánh mì sandwich instead, which was decent, and I paid for it without issue. I understand that mistakes can happen, especially in the restaurant industry, but when a customer reports a potential food safety concern involving raw fish, I would expect at least an apology and assurance that the matter would be brought to management's attention. Hopefully this was an isolated incident and the restaurant takes food quality concerns more seriously in the future.
The banh mi and wings were amazing. Basic decor, awesome food and prices! I live in CA and I'm so happy someone recommended this place.

I come here at least 5 x a week for boba tea. They are my 2nd best choice in Orlando. The bowls i have had are good as well. However, I’m giving 3* because the point system they implemented is not good at all. Every time i come I have to request they manually put in my 1 point because for some reason the Cash App system they use only gives my point if I’m using the same cc each time. On top of that if you pay cash you don’t get your points even though you’re still paying. Despite my many complaints the lady says she is going to inform management but it’s been 2 months now and still nothing. At this point I have simply given up on going there for the point system

We order the steak all the time, however this time it came completely raw inside. I was eating in the dark and realized after taking a couple bites. Really disappointing, I wouldn’t trust the kitchen again after this
Quaint spot of some teas and Asian style fares. Perfect location for the area but parking can be a challenge
Super cute space, and yummy food! The employees are also very sweet. I got the tuna poke bowl, and i think it was one of the best i’ve ever had !

Amazing! We tried this place for the first time via Door Dash and we’ll definitely be repeat guests. Incredible food; fresh, flavorful and generous portions. We had the flights of bao buns (all options), yakitori chicken, pork dumplings, pork belly banh mi and mango green tea. 10 out of 10!

I hate to do this, but I ordered my food through DoorDash. The food came on time so it’s not the driver’s fault, but it was luke warm soup with raw wontons. Serving raw wontons with raw pork inside is unacceptable. I bit into one thinking it was cooked, because the listing for the food didn’t say otherwise. I know some dishes you “cook” the meat or ingredients in piping hot broth, but the broth wasn’t hot when it arrived. The rest of the meat that came with it was fully cooked, but really dry. Then for my drink I ordered passion fruit tea with popping mango boba. The drink was like thick syrup instead of tea. I’m really disappointed as I spent $30 dollars and got this thinking it would be something nice to treat the flu I have right now. Will not order from here again.

Okay, this is probably my favorite little boba shop. Just a sidenote that if you park in the back parking lot, you can use their back door to enter. I typically get the coconut milk slush with honey Boba, and it’s my absolute favorite here. But my go-to food is definitely the beef pho and popcorn chicken! The staff is friendly, the restaurant is nice and clean, and the atmosphere is very welcoming. Highly recommend!
First time trying food was amazing.. the caramel coffee and avocado are always on point 🤤.. service is nice aswell

The boba here is great, we come here regularly Id say about 4-6 times a month. Each time we have come here, the smell is unbearable. It hits you in the face when you open the door and there has been times we had walk out and go next door. I dont know how they work here with the smell but Im guessing they are use to it. The people here , younger group, seem to care about talking to themselves rather than greet you but I guess they give you a second to take in the smell before you actually order. Ill delete this review once this place starts smelling better but I doubt itll ever change.

Had to update because the Noddle Salad just isn’t the same anymore :/ the chicken tastes different and they’re no longer adding in a spring roll? I have also tried a few others items like the Korean chicken wings, pad Thai, and pho and they’re just subpar. Not sure what has changed :/ Great food, great atmosphere, super convenient online ordering!
The food was delicious, and the place is nice and clean. I’m so bummed I got there too late to grab a drink with the labubu! 🥲
Great experience
Excellent place. The food is delicious, the boba drinks are some of the best, and the atmosphere is cozy. The service is always friendly and fast. Definitely a spot you want to come back to.
Amazing poke, spectacular bao, and excellent milk tea. Thank you so much!

The drinks and food are devistatingly delicious, so much so I went one day and came right back the next! :D The staff are so friendly and patient. They let us stand back to look at the menu, answered our questions, and we were able to take our time without being pressured to make a decision. They offer a very relaxing and fun environment. There are also board games so it's a great place for a date or just hangout with friends!
The bobatea is okay, but not worth the price. I also don’t like that they are promoting a fake Labubu.

Came in about an hour before closing and the cashier seemed really uninterested, no greeting or energy at all. The drink itself was just okay, nothing special. With so many great boba spots around Orlando, this one didn’t really stand out. Probably wouldn’t come back when there are better options nearby.
Outside looks nice, inside could look much better. Not much decoration, messy, unorganized furniture. Food is ok, pricey for what it is. Good selection of drinks like BoBas. Service too laid back.
Nice place
FO-gettaboudit! Asking me to rate Boma is like asking how my 6 hour feather bed massage went! It was amazing ×7. Think Disney, add buffet, and you wind up at Boma. Nuff said.
Incredible food enhanced by great service and musical interludes!!

Great food, lots of choices both African inspired and All-American options. Traditional fruit juice just like we enjoyed the last time we came... many years ago. Our waitress Jessica was attentive without hovering.

I love Boma. I’ve eaten here for dinner once and breakfast probably 3-4 times. I love the atmosphere, the cast member service, the jungle juice (pog juice), and the lamb bobotie. I highly recommend eating here, this is one of my top Disney locations to eat. At dinner time you get zebra dome cakes for dessert and they are sooo good.

Great food and desserts both for breakfast and lunch/dinner. A bit pricy but that's disney. The hotel is beautiful to walk around before or after your meal. A lot of variety including a carving station, salads and several stew options. 2 things I would like to suggest: 1) have all stews available all days, especially the oxtail stew. It's a travesty that it's only available some days. 2) make zebra domes with no alcohol.

Great breakfast buffet. Tried a bit of everything. Must try the African inspired dishes, savory and spicy. The butterscotch toffee pudding made a great ending to the meal. Recommend to go on a day you don't go to the park. You will leave stuffed.
This buffet is my family’s favorite at Disney. We even canceled a character dining experience to come back here. Try the Mac and cheese, the sauce is made in house.

The restaurant is located in Lake Buena Vista, Florida. It is in the Disneyworld Animal Kingdom park. They prepare a buffet breakfast or dinner with cuisine from various countries of Africa. The dining area is large but can get busy at peak times. I dined at the dinner buffet. Nice variety of soups, salads 🥗, appetizers, entrees, sides and desserts 🍨 with a carving station. Staff bring beverage requests and clear dishes quickly. The food was very good and interesting. Friendly and helpful staff.
Great food, I wish they had a tiny bit more options but I’m not complaining!
I can't get enough of this place... I remember when Animal Kingdome Loge opened... It's incredible after 24 years they've kept consistent high-quality on everything they do.

We chose Boma for our granddaughter's graduation dinner because we knew she would be tired after a long day and, being mildly autistic, can sometimes be sensitive to noise and overstimulation. The staff went above and beyond to help make the evening special. The day before our reservation, they assisted me in selecting a table that would provide a quieter environment, which made a tremendous difference. Throughout the evening, the staff was exceptionally attentive and genuinely caring. One of the most touching moments was when they presented my granddaughter with a card signed by team members in their native languages. It was a thoughtful gesture that she absolutely treasured and will remember for years to come. The food at both breakfast and dinner was outstanding and well worth the expense. More importantly, the kindness and attention shown to our family made us feel truly welcomed. We are grateful to the entire staff for helping make our granddaughter's graduation celebration so memorable.
Génial

BOMA is my top 3 places to have breakfast. Kona and Ohana are my other two. I love the variety here. I love the way they season their foods; so tasty. I love the desserts. I love the culture. We're definitely a BOMA family.
One of our favorites to visit. Food is always delicious and fresh and plenty of it.

Phenomenal buffet! WOW. We were blown away by their buffet foods, all from various African cultures and countries. It was one of those places you have to go for another plate even after you’re full. The buffet has a good variety of options but it’s moderately sized enough that you can try a lot of the food without feeling like you’re missing out on the rest.
Super allergy friendly. Amazing buffet. Coconut rice is to die for!! Super fun Boma Oasis drink with a light up lotus flower!
Two words...Zebra Domes.

We can’t say enough good things about this place: it is definitely our new favorite buffet style restaurant at Disney world. All of the soups were delicious but the stand out to me was the land and beef stew, it was incredibly flavorful and my gf liked the salmon and the mustard sauce they had up at the meat station. The ribs were fantastically flavorful but especially when you put the bbq and mustard sauce on them and all of the desserts were great too but especially the bread pudding. The only thing that I think they should change/add is to either make the steak more flavorful (because it’s pretty bland) or to just add a gravy to put on the steak and mashed potatoes. Other than that, we DEFINITELY plan on going back during the next visit.

Boma - Flavors of Africa is one of my favorite Disney restaurants. It’s not cheap, but it’s a great meal in an incredible atmosphere. Boma is very popular, so be sure to make a reservation before you drive over to Animal Kingdom Lodge. This African-inspired buffet makes it look like you’re eating in an authentic marketplace, enjoying AYCE breakfast and dinner buffets. You can watch them cook in an “onstage kitchen.” They serve both American and African dishes, with a large variety of seasoned meats, seafood, salads, and desserts. There for dinner? Be sure to get the zebra down dessert. It’s just as good as all the online critics say!
The server, Bryan, was fantastic! Very personable and attentive.

My wife and I stopped by today and grabbed lunch. I had the Taco Duo and she had the All American Burger. As always, the food was excellent. However, this time I’m also giving a 5-star rating on our server Bryan. Not once did he let our drinks get low and he was very engaging to talk to. We love bringing our business to BTW in Tavares!!

Place looks nice and I had high hopes but definitely won't be going back to BTW. ☹️

Atmosphere in the bar area is Alice in Wonderland themed and very cute. Food was delicious but overpriced. Being served a $30 meal (hamburger and macaroni and cheese) on a paper-covered metal tray and paper cup with plastic utensils felt incongruous. Wait staff varied. Our original waitress forgot to deliver one drink order completely, and was not attentive or visible for most of the remainder of our meal. The other waitress seemed to be doing double duty covering all tables, proving why tip-sharing is a travesty.

We came here for lunch and overall it was a decent experience. The atmosphere is beautiful and really adds to the vibe. The fries were a little overcooked, so they came out pretty crunchy with each bite.

BTW is normally one of our favorite restaurants but tonight it was awful, we got there around 8:30 it took forever to get our drinks and when the food came out it was cold, the charro beans were awful and cold, the waffle fries weren’t fresh it was if they were sitting around for awhile and flimsy , I ordered the chicken sandwich and it was so salty that I couldn’t even eat it and I tried because I was starving but couldn’t get it down, the chicken was tender but the batter was so salty. Hopefully this was a case of the cook just having an off night. We’ll try it again in the future because like I said It was one of our go to spots.

We had a delicious dinner with incredible service from start to finish. Our waiter Kumar was outstanding, very friendly and anticipated our every need. Prices were affordable and the food was delicious. Highly recommend for a casual dinner!
Server kumar! 5stars to this guy. food was great. Loved the vibe. Much recommended

Edit 6/28/26: I came back today after several months without visiting and first thing the owner shook my hand and greeted me at the door. I ordered my usual chole bature and kurkurai bindi bhel; I got goat biryani instead of chicken, which was so good! A couple of things: I've been going for years now, and the prices have stayed the same and the quality of the dishes has been consistent. I can't recommend this place enough. The staff is so friendly and are eager to help you. I could not be happier with the experience I had today. Edit: went back yesterday and the food somehow was even better! Ordered the chole bature again and my friend said it's the best thing he ever ate. Got the chicken biryani this time and the spice level is perfect. I also ordered KURKURI BHINDI BHEL and it's very crispy, light and refreshing. It tasted good on its own but especially as a condiment for the biryani. Ordered the HARA TEEKHA MURGH TIKKA which is just a spicier chicken tandoori and it was very flavorful and not too spicy for either me or my friend. The garlic naan is sensational as an accompaniment to the HARA TEEKHA MURGH TIKKA and was perfect for filling with chicken and veggies. The prices are fair for the quality and portion sizes. If you eat here, you'll be addicted, trust me! Indian food is my favorite and in Orlando you are not going to find a better Indian restaurant than this. Please see the attached photos for proof. Speaking of the food, I audibly wept with joy as I ate my goat…

Loved the food and service. We tried Tikka boa, Grilled paneer thecha and they both were nice. Must try..

Great Indian Flavors in Orlando! Bombay Street Kitchen was a fantastic find! Great ambience, attentive staff, and food that didn't disappoint. We ordered the Chicken Bao, Chicken Lollipop, Chilli Chicken, and Paneer Thecha all tasty and well-made. Only feedback would be on the bao two pieces felt a little light for the price, three would make it a more satisfying portion for one or two people to share. That said, the Bhuna Mutton and Chicken Chettinad truly stole the show both were rich and packed with authentic flavor, easily the highlight of the meal. Overall a solid spot for Indian food in Orlando, and we'd happily go back for that Chicken Lollipop, mutton and Chicken Chettinad alone!

Fantastic food, good portion sizes, left very satisfied! HIGHLY recommend getting the KEBAB PARATHA SLIDER (Smashed chicken kebab, flaky paratha, spiced herb sauce). As my husband (who LOVES hamburgers) said, "Dare I say it? They fixed the hamburger??"
Excellent food, service, and atmosphere. Great location for a casual business lunch!
Best Indian food in Orlando! Service was super fast and the food was delicious! Nabil was great!

Bombay Street Kitchen never disappoints! I’ve been here multiple times and have tried most of the menu, and every dish has been consistently delicious and full of flavor. The quality, taste, and presentation are always on point, which is why I keep coming back. Whether you’re trying one of their street food favorites or a traditional entrée, you can tell everything is made with care and authentic ingredients. The staff is friendly, the service is great, and the overall experience is always enjoyable. If you’re looking for amazing Indian food in Orlando, I highly recommend Bombay Street Kitchen. Consistently excellent every single visit!
love this spot. our server, kumar, was helpful and friendly and the food was great!
The food was pretty good. I was not blown away. Unfortunately I won’t be back. Sizzler on I drive is better and I would recommend them instead.

My friend has been raving about this place for months so we finally were able to go and try this place out. I can say that I was thoroughly impressed with the menu and the food. I think what this restaurant does really well is the simple things. The highlights of my meal were the Masala Dosa, the garlic naan, and the kale chaat. The paneer mahkni was good as well too. The masala dosa was crispy and the potato mixture inside was well seasoned. The garlic naan was flawless, good amount of garlic but was not overpowering. Definitely will be back here again to try more dishes!
Great takes on the Indian street food! Can never go wrong! Great place to bring people curious about Indian cuisine.

⭐☆☆☆☆ Went to Cafe 34 Istanbul to watch the 11 PM Turkey vs. Paraguay World Cup match. Before arriving, we were told the restaurant was extremely busy, but when we got there it was nearly empty (that should’ve been a sign). We told host that we were here to view the match and wanted light food and Turkish tea. She then took us to a separate seating area which just had one TV. Next, we were attended by one of the most incompetent waiters I have ever met. From taking our order to final bill, she couldn’t answer any questions and had to bring in a second or third person to address any of our concerns. The food arrived with inadequate utensils. We were group of 4 and they brought 1-2 sets of cups , utensils and plates. We had to keep repeating everything, a bit annoying. The food arrived in the wrong order, they brought us out dessert first and wings last , goes to show lack of care or attention to customers . The food itself was ok , not the best Turkish food but above average. The biggest issue was the bill. We were not shown a detailed itemized receipt before payment, and when we questioned certain charges afterward, we did not receive clear or satisfactory explanations. The lack of transparency left a very negative impression. Unfortunately, what should have been an enjoyable World Cup viewing experience turned into a frustrating one. Unless you’re looking for a double D, disappointing and deceiving experience, please avoid this place .

We attended the Marvel Character Dinner at Cafe 4 on June 21, and it ended up being one of the highlights of our Universal trip. The food was good, don't expect fine dining. It's good for park buffet food and there was a nice variety. But let's be honest, you don't come to the character dining for the food. The waitress taking care of our table was friendly, attentive, and kept our drinks filled throughout the evening. What really made the experience special, though, were the characters. We met Wolverine, Storm, Cyclops, Spider-Man, Captain America, and Rogue, and every one of them was fantastic. My son's two favorites are Spider-Man and Captain America, and both of them went above and beyond to make the night memorable. They remembered his name when returning to our table several times, which made him feel like a true superhero. Captain America even let him hold his shield for photos, something he'll be talking about for a long time. Spider-Man was especially incredible. He spent a good amount of time interacting with my son and even brought him over to another area to get a great photo in front of the Marvel logo. Seeing how much genuine attention and kindness he showed my son was something I'll never forget. If you're considering the Marvel Character Dinner, do it. The character interactions alone made it worth every penny. For our family, it was a 20 out of 10 experience, and we'll absolutely be trying to book it for a special occasion.

Les Halles Boulangerie Patisserie is easily one of the best quick stops if you are craving something sweet and fresh. The place has that classic French bakery feel, and the display of pastries alone makes it hard to choose just one. I tried the strawberry shortcake and the napoleon pastry, and both were really good in their own way. The strawberry shortcake was light, fresh, and not overly sweet, which made it very easy to finish without feeling heavy. The napoleon pastry had nice flaky layers with a rich creamy filling, and it felt more indulgent compared to the shortcake. The line can look long, but it usually moves pretty quickly. There is a decent amount of seating nearby, but it can get crowded during peak hours, so finding a spot might take a few minutes. Parking is through the main park parking, so nothing separate here. Reservations are not needed since it is a quick service spot. One tip is to visit either earlier in the day or later in the evening to avoid the rush. Also, take a moment to look at everything before ordering because there are so many good options and it is easy to miss something you might like more. Overall, this is a must visit if you enjoy pastries. Great quality, good portions, and a perfect place to take a sweet break.

We got our Pretzel Knots appetizer, and once again marveled at the fact BWW continues to only give out 5 knots instead of 6. It means sharing is not quite even. BWW take a hint and start giving out 6 pretzel knots, please. When our wings arrived, I noted my wife had some very nice plump wings, and I seemed to have gotten served pigeon. I pointed out to our server how I had 10 out of 15 wing tips and that all the chicken was small. He asked what I would like done, and I agreed to the fact that it would be a time before a new set could be made, so I surrendered to eat what was provided. Nick did offer to have them replaced, if I so desired. I told him not to bother, and I chalked it up to one out of numerous visits that could have been better. The Crispy Asian Zing sauce was even better on the wings. Overall, a satisfying night, but not a very satisfying one. We will still come to BWW on a semi-regular basis. Buffalo Wild Wings is still a good place for a lunch, dinner date, quick bite, gang get together, office party, family…

No. But it’s also not the horror story some reviews make it out to be. The pool is one of the highlights—it’s huge and would be perfect for families. The complimentary breakfast was also better than I expected, with a good selection to start the day. At the end of the day, you have to consider what you’re paying. If you’re looking for an affordable place to stay in Daytona and understand you’re booking a budget-friendly hotel, this property offers good value for the price. I recently visited BigShots Golf, and it’s a fun concept that combines entertainment with casual dining. The biggest highlight is being able to practice your golf swing at the driving range while hanging out with friends—it makes for a really social and interactive experience. It’s a great spot if you’re looking to do something a little different than a typical night out. That said, there are a few drawbacks. The acoustics inside can be pretty rough—there’s a noticeable echo that makes it harder to have conversations, especially when it gets busy. The menu is also somewhat limited, and the food options lean more toward snacks and light bites rather than full meals. While that fits the driving range vibe, it might leave you wanting more if you come in expecting a no-nonsense dining experience. Overall, it’s a solid place for fun and casual hangouts, especially if you enjoy golf, but it’s probably best to think of the food as a side feature rather than the main attraction. It’s also not the best choice for thoughtful or detailed conversations.

Cafe Mineiro is a great option for a Brazilian steakhouse experience at a reasonable price. The buffet offers good-quality food, and it was especially nice to find dishes from Minas Gerais, such as feijão tropeiro and brown beans, bringing back authentic flavors from Brazil. The meat selection included with the buffet is somewhat limited, but the all-you-can-eat option with beef, chicken, and pork sausage offers excellent value. I'm giving the food 4 stars because I would have liked to see more than one beef option in this category. The full rodízio is best for those looking for the complete churrascaria experience, although it costs nearly twice as much as the buffet option. Despite being a steakhouse, there are plenty of vegetarian choices, including salads, traditional side dishes, and the delicious grilled pineapple. I recommend it if you're in Orlando, whether you're traveling alone or with a group.

Cantina’s food used to be really good, so this was honestly shocking. I ordered the spinach enchiladas to-go tonight for my birthday, and everything was ice cold. Not just “cooled off,” but cold enough that there’s no way it had just been made. Even setting that aside, the food itself was awful. The rice was completely overcooked, just mush. The beans were watery. The enchiladas had no white sauce at all, just spinach and some cauliflower inside what tasted like a raw flour tortilla, with a thick layer of cheese dumped on top. Because it was so cold, I had to microwave it all, and not for just 30 seconds either, but for over 2 minutes to get it to an acceptable temperature. By this time, the cheese on top was a hard, rubbery layer, and there was way too much of it, almost like it was trying to cover up how bad everything underneath was. I also ordered queso, and it was so cold it had hardened into a strange, Play-Doh-like texture. I’m really bummed. I actually sat here trying to eat it, thinking, how can it possibly be this bad? I couldn’t even finish it. It’s not possible, which tells me it’s not just a bad cook but the ingredients too. I rarely leave reviews, but this was that bad… I had to say something. It’s honestly sad, because if the food is consistently like this, there’s no way this place can stay open. Looks like I’ll be eating yogurt from my fridge for my birthday instead.

I am beyond frustrated with my experience at Build My Burger. This was hands down one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. What made it even worse was watching a group of seven people come in after us and receive all of their food in less than five minutes. Seven meals came out before our TWO. That is completely unacceptable and shows a total lack of organization and respect for customers. It honestly felt like there was no management present at all. No one seemed to care that we had been waiting, and there was zero effort to fix the situation or even acknowledge it. We felt completely ignored. If this is how customers are treated, I would not recommend this place to anyone. Long wait times, poor service, and no accountability. Do better.

I’ve dined at several Capital Grille locations and have come to expect exceptional quality and service for the premium prices. Unfortunately, the Orlando location fell short on both the food and the overall experience. My Chilean sea bass was rubbery and bland, served in a watery demi-glace that lacked any meaningful flavor. The fish itself showed no proper searing and was missing the flakiness and taste one expects from this dish. Similarly, the filet mignon arrived without a good sear and was slightly overcooked for a requested medium. Both entrées also lacked thoughtful presentation. The pacing of the meal was off as well — sides arrived far too late, allowing the main courses to cool, and the overall wait time for food felt excessively long, especially if dishes are prepared sous vide. That said, the manager did stop by to check on us. When I mentioned the pacing issues, he genuinely listened and comped the sides from our bill. I appreciated this attentive and customer-focused response. I hope the Orlando team uses this feedback to improve, because I’d genuinely like to return and have a better experience in the future.

I had the Calypso Burger and it was one of the BEST BURGERS I have had in my life. The view was great and service was fast and friendly. AC was cold. We left the strip to come here because all of the restaurants there were so hot.

Food - Update. Just ok. For the price, not so special. Service - tend to have to wait quite a while when first seated. Service has been getting worse. Not sure what's going on but heading in the wrong direction. Atmosphere - This is their saving grace. great view, have heaters and fans and live music daily. Dog friendly.

The food was great and the staff was awesome we came with a bigger party and they charged us gratuity which is fine but it’s almost 33% so it turned out to be a good bit since it was all on one check other than that it was not bad
Love the place and seafood🌞
Wonderful food and service and great waterfront location

Wonderful atmosphere and food. Our server Jason T was amazing. Great guy with the kids and very attentive. We keep coming back and have had him a few times. Ask for him, he makes the experience even better!
Manager was a bit of a meathead with others in our party... but overall great. Loved it.

Food was good. Not too much flavor like your typical seafood restaurant, but good. Gator Bites we're not my favorite too much to chew, too tough compared to most places but my husband enjoyed that they were hearty pieces. Will visit again & try something different

I had really high hopes for this place...it has a decent atmosphere...it is right on the Intracoastal Waterway (Halifax River)...but the food and the price were not comparable to one another. The cost was expensive for food that was overcooked, seemed to be rushed to plated, and just wasn't very good. It could have been an off night for them. Would not recommend.

A little loud with the live music, we didn’t know they had that, but the food was delicious. Had the coconut shrimp and jerk chicken, oh and gator bites! Kids had a giant salad and a kids meal pasta, both loved the fries and food.
Good meal, nice view. Recommended.

We visited the restaurant about 20 minutes before closing. Granted it was late but being from out of town we didn't realize they closed so early. As the lady was about to seat us another lady whispered something to her. Then we were told we could only stay until 9 p. m. I've worked at restaurants and definitely been to plenty but I've never been told that I would have to leave after getting there 20 min before closing at closing time on the dot. Most everywhere I've been if you arrive before closing you're able to eat your meal and leave. I even add an extra tip for any inconvenience. I wouldn't even expect to have the food properly prepared and served within that time frame. In addition to that we had to wait to be seated until they finished conducting business on a phone call and not once did we complain about having to wait. The time it took to walk by and see us standing waiting to be seated could have been used to seat us and take our orders. More than disappointed in this location's service. I couldn't rate the atmosphere or food because we never had the opportunity to experience it. Even if they'd offered to have us place our order to go would have been a better alternative which we'd have appreciated and accepted as more accommodating.

I’ve been to Caribbean Jacks in Daytona Brach about 5x now and today was the worst experience I’ve ever had. My husband and I went for dinner around 5pm, one girl (the one who seated us) welcomed us in, and then hubby and I were discussing with each other whether we wanted to eat inside or outside. The hostess never said a word to us except to be rude and tell us “well it’s hot outside & cool inside”. No laugh, no smile, and looked at me like I was stupid. I told her we wanted outside. She told the other lady to take us “up top” where it would be plenty cool. They spoke is some foreign language (didn’t sound like Spanish) and then she took us to a tiny table at the far end of the restaurant by the water that was barely at the edge of the roof, and the wind was blowing so hard, the menus wouldn’t even stay on the table. It then started to sprinkle, so we just got up and moved to another table under the roof. Our waiter was very nice and treated us great. The drinks were good, the Caribbean pickles were good, but the food was just ok. I was very disappointed in how we were treated at the front when we came in. We almost left. But the service and food is usually really good there. Not today. (with the exception of our waiter, he was great!). We won’t be back unfortunately.
Great seafood restaurant, right on the river.
Some of the best food and service we have in Daytona!!
Amazing food, with a real authentic Lebanese taste!! Great service and ambiance

We had a wonderful experience this Sunday! Came with a large group and since the moment we got there the stuff made us comfortable, the Moroccan girl who took care of us was incredibly kind and welcoming. She took the time to explain the menu, answered our questions, and made great recommendations. The food was fresh and everything we ordered was delicious. The service was attentive without being overwhelming and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great Middle Eastern food and warm hospitality!

La peor experiencia que he tenido en un restaurante al los alrededores de la Fl. La mesonera con la intensidad de servir tan rápido que no deja leer no el menú tranquilamente (siendo un restaurante típico y relajado su ambiente, no una franquicia) la viveza de la mesera bajita con cabello rulo fue patética, no quiere que veas la factura al pagar y aparte te obliga a un mínimo de propina, argumentando que eso es obligatorio (cosa que no es cierto) me atacó de manera grotesca hasta el punto de intentar mostrarme otra factura que no me pertenecía y le coloco el party de 18% extra cuando éramos dos personas en una mesa pequeña. En la vida vuelvo a ir a este lugar. El malestar que me produjo hasta indigestion al salir. Patético servicio de esa persona y su equipo estuvo observado está falta de respeto ya que intenta explicarle que eso no era obligatorio y mucho menos su actitud de intensidad e intento de cobrar lo equivocado. Ellos no hicieron nada ni su manager. Entonces concluí en no darle ninguna propina. Evidentemente. Por grosera. Fatal servicio 0000
La comida súper rica y los tabaquitos de de hija de uvas súper rico

Best Lebanese food you can have in Orlando. The service was top notch and the ambience was great as well. Really liked the kafta kabob and hummus with meat. They somehow kept the original taste of meat along with making it extremely juicy and tender. 10/10.

Service is great. I’m Lebanese so I have highly selective palette for our food. I’m generous ranking it 4 stars just because they’re in the US and Orlando. Their Knefeh is really good, very authentic and highly recommend it.

We moved from Detroit and so have not had middle eastern food in a couple of years. We found this place and LOVE it. The food is authentic and delicious. The staff are very friendly and hospitable! We live 45 minutes away but worth the drive. You can sit inside or outside.

We dined here for my husband's birthday and enjoyed 2 appetizers and entrees. Everything was phenomenal. With every bite we were in awe of how amazing it all was. Natalia was a wonderful server. Next time we are in this area we will come back specifically to eat here. 10/10
Food is good but customer service is rude.

We had 3 appetizers Tabouleh, Hummus, and Fattouch, which were all fantastic with homemade Pita bread, we shared an entree cedars chicken chefs special which was also amazing with rice and sautéed vegetables. We had iced tea fresh made also, our server Sergio was great very attentive answered all our questions and offered recommendations. The food was great and the prices were very good, we will be coming back soon.

Made a reservation a week in advance for a Saturday night, my daughters 16th birthday. We are of Lebanese decent and she requested middle eastern cuisine. I did not receive a confirmation until I called the restaurant...then I got an email. Frantic we were late 15 minutes but when we walked in there was plenty of empty tables. Seemed like they really didn't know of my reservation of 8 because they were expecting a table of 25. Table setting was only for 5. We were missing 3 sets of napkins with silverware. Waitress forgot one of the meals. Seems drinks had free refills but bread did not, when I asked for another basket of bread which was 4 I was given one more as a courtesy but warned I would be charged for another. I wanted to order the Lebanese feast but everyone at the table had to order it and my kids are vegitarian. I didn't get a paper check with a breakdown she only showed me total on the payment device. I informed them ahead of time it was my daughter's birthday no mention of it announcement or anything, I had to ask for dessert with a candle in it. You could barely hear the soft Arabic music. No live music..no DJ or dancing like videos show. I asked about the belly dancer they are supposed to have Friday and Saturday and told they didn't have one. Expect to pay at least 30 to 50 a person for a mediocre atmosphere. Food was ok but small portions for the price. Wasn't worth it to me. Not even a photo prop area for pictures. We took pictures in front of a parking lot…

First time here and it was fantastic! We were greeted immediately as we walked in. Our server Amine gave us excellent service!!! He was very attentive and very pleasant! So refreshing to see a server like him!!! He made the experience even better! The food was very delicious and it came out on time. The restaurant had a nice vibe and very clean. We will definitely come back !

I have dined here over the years but really enjoyed my most recent meal there particularly. The food was fresh and well prepared. The vegetarian platter was an ample serving and provided an additional meal at home. The taboulie was great! I hope to enjoy another meal there soon.

​If you’re looking for authentic Lebanese flavors, this is the spot. The mixed grill dish was incredible, perfectly seasoned and clearly made with fresh ingredients. You can tell they don't cut corners here. The hummus was velvety smooth, and the pita arrived warm. Definitely best Lebanese restaurant in all of central florida!!
Food & service are very exceptional.
I am so glad I tried this place! It was wonderful! Amine was the best! Thank you for everything Cedar’s!
Food was ok, but over priced, tips included in price for a so called large party, however we only had 4 adults and 4 children.
Everything is excellent. We did enjoy.

First time at Cedars Lebanese Restaurant and it did not disappoint. We started with hummus, tabbouleh, and fresh pita - everything was incredibly fresh and full of flavor. We had various entrees including the grilled lamb chops and mixed grill. Both were outstanding. Great wine selection, warm atmosphere, and even better in company of good friends who recommended it. The entertainment was lively and entertaining. Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to.
Excellent
Came from Michigan and visited the restaurant for the first time. The taste of foods takes you back to the nostalgia days of Lebanon ❤️

I had a wonderful experience at Cedar’s Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. What made the visit even more memorable was the warm and welcoming atmosphere. I had the chance to meet the owner, Charles, and we had such a great conversation. He was incredibly friendly, funny, and genuinely made me feel at home. If you’re looking for great food and a place where you’re treated like family, Cedar’s Restaurant is definitely worth visiting. I’ll absolutely be coming back!
Amine is amazing server, we really love this place!! 100% recommend!

It’s been years of coming here for lunch and food and service are consistently amazing. My boyfriend is very picky with Arabic food and he loves it. Ask for Amine to be your server, he event serve water for my dog. Great experience!

Course is in good condition but a 5 hour round in the Florida heat is unacceptable - especially on a Tuesday. Four groups waiting on a par 3 so we called the clubhouse, we were told "nothing we can do about it"!! Don't think I will be going back anytime soon.

You lost a star when you took the cart girl off the course at 11am; this is a very nice course, great staff, but in 97 degree temps you need a on course beverage cart as the only two watering stations on each side of the front/back at the comfort station isn't enough. Yes, you can fill up at the turn, but you need to provide ice for the cart coolers, and yes you have an ice/water station at the clubhouse; so how many cups do you need to fill up the cooler, doesn't make sense. You had Marshals all over the course - but no Cart Girl...lets focus on that missing "STAR"...will be back again to play, as its a very nice course.
Decent shape but many areas in the fairways rough. Greens pretty good

Chose here as most Disney courses were closed. Good value course. Greens and tee boxes could use some work, but again, good value. Club house and carts are nice. Food was great. Staff was very friendly. I would come back 👍🏼

I booked Celebration GC for a group of 12 players to play 36 holes about 7 weeks before our trip. The first thing I asked was if there was any maintenance going on or around the day we were supposed to play. The agent told me that there was no maintenance scheduled and that we were good to go. Two days before the trip celebration calls me to confirm the tee times and then proceeds to tell me they have just punched their greens. I was obviously shocked by this and I told them I never would’ve booked the course had I known that. They could not have cared less and offered us absolutely nothing. We were shocked by their apathy and absolute lack of customer service and accountability. They must be doing great to not need the revenue from 24 tee times in the summer. Thankfully Falcons Fire had openings for our whole group and for 36 holes and they could not have be nicer or more accommodating. Leave Celebration off your list if you’re playing in Orlando. They don’t care and clearly don’t need your business
First time here and we’ll be back! Amazing staff, amazing course conditions despite the drought, course plays long and we enjoyed every second of it! We’ll be back!

I took my family golfing on Sunday and we were blown away with how nice the course was (and of course the beautiful weather!). The course is well maintained and the staff was very friendly and helpful. We can’t wait to go golfing here again!
Course had just been renovated, so it was rough, but the people and service were amazing
Very good course green fast fairways like carpet

Fun course, most of the staff were 10/10… however there was one Marshall that was an absolute donkey. Had a group of 12, three foursomes. Started off a little slow and ended up around 10-min off pace on a day where the course was cart path only… it was the first 2 holes that slowed us down, but we kept pace from that point forward… while we are walking off the green of the hole 13 par 3, before the group behind us even pulls up to the tee box… the Marshall rolls up and says “Can you help me out… I’m a little confused…” and continues to be a general clown trying to talk down to us about pace. I typically respect my elders, but man…
Bad course conditions and service other than in the golf shop
A fun and challenging golf course. Plenty of bunkers and water hazards to make you focus on your next shot!

great course, super friendly staff. little things like ice and towels for the carts and plush seats made it a great experience. greens were recently punched but rolled well. the range being a big pond was an interesting experience! lunch before the round was reasonably priced and very good.

The course is in the best shape I’ve seen in a long time. Staff is very friendly. The restaurant is really a hidden gem. My wife and I often get food to go. They have put a lot of money into making the entire course look great.
Great course and lunch included made it even better !

I'll start with the good which was the staff, everyone we interacted with was amazing and the check in to first tee process was very smooth. But... Seems to be really trading on past glory. Greens and surrounds were pretty shoddy and the tee boxes were downright atrocious. Be warned that the 4hr 30 min expected time doesn't appear to be enforced. We tee'd off 25 min after the group in front, caught them and only just got done inside the expected time. Maybe it's the golf boom and location but I wouldn't expect these conditions given the prices charged.

Always enjoy playing Celebration Golf Club but this time I noticed a couple of things. I signed up as a single and paired with a three some. The other single was in a cart and they let us out with 3 carts. My wife later wanted to ride the back nine with me so I told her to come on since we had the 3 carts. When she got there and checked in with the pro shop to see if it was ok, they tried to charge her for a round of golf . She said a bit pricey for riding 9 holes not playing they reduced the cost to $16.00! I was surprised since I already had a cart and played 9 already. Second thing I noticed a lot of poa in the greens, pretty bumpy. Hopefully they will take all the extra money from cart riders and fix the greens.

Celebration is well designed and fun to play. The issue right now is condition. Tee boxes, fairways, greens just aren't at the level you'd expect for the price. Rates are still high, likely due to demand and location, but from a course quality standpoint, it's hard to justify. Worth playing the design, but lousy conditions at the moment.
Rude customer service!

The course was a little disappointing. Lots of bare in the fairways and the approach areas of the green. Can't understand why the teeing area is in such poor shape too (through out the course). If you pay for a premium steak you wouldn't except less quality. You would be talking to the manager. I did enjoy the cookie and the food voucher. I heard they are in-between superintendents.
Amazing place….. great value. I have played this course at least a dozen times and today - it was probably in the best shape I have ever seen it. Always a great round at celebration!!!
Club personal are friendly. Course was excellent
I love this course.

We have been playing here for years. Cannot tell you how dissapointed we were with the conditions. They said they had a bad winter. Ok! But when they charged us full price, that was not right. Then we had one per who was dissabled and did not walk well. She wanted to ride in the cart with us so she could watch and have fun. Thet charged us $50! How rude and unaccepetable! One guy said, "Well, that's our policy"! Really! Very rude! Never again, we are done!
The course was in amazing condition, lots of wildlife! Would definitely play here again!
Fun layout. Easy track. Greens were a little slow the day we went but to be fair, there was a fair bit of rain the day before.

9 day golf trip with the Guys from Green ohio, this is a stunning golf course great lay out, everyone there was so nice Fairways are great Greens also great Make this one of your florida Guys stop will not disappoint
Food is always excellent. Service is great. Nice sized portions. Try the table side guacamole! Definitely recommend this place.
The service was phenomenal, and Jesus really went above and beyond, and the food was to die for. The enchiladas and birra tacos were out of this world. We will definitely be back!
Everything about this restaurant was exceptional. From the facility to the staff and the food. Great job!

Es la primera vez que vengo y se ha convertido en mi restaurante favorito, Ronald fue nuestro mesero, fue muy amable y atento con nosotros, el lugar es muy bonito y la música era solamente de cantantes mexicanos, la comida estuvo muy rica y al salir todos se despedían de nosotros, todo el personal muy amable, te hacen sentir como en casa
I was impressed by the quickness and quality of the food being served. The prices are on the higher side for sure. But they do have some lunch specials.
Best in Melbourne. I go there once a week.
Delicious Margs with a cute patio! Food and service were great.

Tried this place for the first time on a Saturday afternoon. Even with a good sized crowd, our server was very attentive and the our food came out super quickly. Everything was fresh and delicious, including our margaritas. We will definitely be back and recommend this place to anyone who loves good Mexican food!
Jesus was an excellent server and the portions were enormous! Food was delicious! So tasty. Highly recommend! 👍🏼
Real good food real good service, pleasant atmosphere. Always a great time.
First time visiting! The portions were huge. Our server, Ricardo, was very kind and attentive. The food and atmosphere were great!
Fun vibrant place to eat and drink!
Jesus was our server he’s did a great job, the foods was very good, we’ll be back!!!

Have eaten here several times. Food, service and atmosphere is great. Had lunch today and ordered the fresh guacamole and fajitas, with a skinny margarita 🍹. Everything was delicious! Valerie was our server and was the best!
Great little place. Nice theme and great food. Had the blackened chicken salad. Very good.
Food was nasty, not worth $20 per plate Stingy with salsa at a Mexican restaurant, chips tasted like soap

DO NOT EAT HERE. I’m a local and used to come regularly, but it’s gone down hill since new ownership. Chincey over portions and drinks, to go orders they give you left over chips that taste like cleaner, staff is rude and profit comes before customer service. $80 to go order with 1 (ONE) salsa and I ordered $8 queso dip and they charged me for another bag of chips. I guess they want you to drink the queso

Food is awesome, but their takeout policy is weird. You get a big bag of chips and one tiny cup of salsa, no matter how many people you’re getting food for. I place an order for each person separately so that everyone eating can have salsa, and pay in cash to avoid the high service fee of paying with card. It also makes it easier for everyone ordering to have the correct bill when I’m picking it up for them. I had four different people trying to take my payment, all speaking in Spanish to each other and acting very annoyed with me. They kept saying “it’s a lot of work to do it this way” while counting my change. Maybe don’t have a cash option if you don’t want to count cash? Or don’t make the tiny to-go salsa cups the same price as the full bowl of salsa you get in-restaurant? Again, the food is very good, and you get great portions and quality for the price, which is why it’s so strange that they nickel-and-dime you on the smallest things. And are so rude about it when they do.
We enjoyed it very much. We will be back. It was recommended to us and we gave it a try. Excellent food and choices.
Everything was A+!!! Service was outstanding, food had great flavor and the atmosphere was A plus as well.. I would recommend this place to everyone I know and we will definitely be back

I've been in Florida for 4 years and finally found my favorite Mexican restaurant. The service was amazing. Jesus was my server. He was on it quick fast with the food. The order great service highly highly recommend
Great food, great service!
Nice atmosphere. we have not eaten here since last year. The food was delicious and cooked perfectly. our waitress wasa Shelby and she was training Lenny.they were very attentive and professional.
Nice location
Great atmosphere, friendly staff and food fabulous as usual. It's extremely rare I have a bad dining experience at the Sanford location!🥂🍾

I met a friend for lunch at Carrabba's Italian Grill and was pleasantly surprised by how smooth the experience was. We arrived during a busy period, but we were seated fairly quickly and our server was attentive throughout the meal. I ordered the chicken parmesan, which was served hot and had great flavor, while my friend enjoyed their pasta dish just as much. What stood out most was how the staff handled special requests without any issues. It's the kind of place that makes it easy to enjoy a relaxed meal and good conversation.

Shelby served my family on Mon June 15. I have been in the restaurant industry for 45 years. I know great service. She was truly spot on with everything from discribing the menu items,suggesting upsells, great pace between items and checked on us often. Shelby is a great asset to your establishment. And she was very outgoing and super friendly.
Bread was a little hard. Everything else was wonderful
Kayley was very nice
Had a very nice dinner with my best friend love their food and berry sangria
Besure to catch thier special event. Definitely worth the money

We have been customers of Carrabba’s for over 25 years, but unfortunately, the lasagna at the Sanford location has changed. Our recent order arrived with almost no pasta, mostly cheese and sauce. The manager kindly replaced it and offered a discount, which we appreciated, but the second lasagna still only had one layer of pasta. This is not about compensation — it’s about consistency and quality. We hope Carrabba’s brings back the lasagna quality we have enjoyed for many years.
Decent food at a good price
Excellent food,and services in a delightful atmosphere with reasonable prices.
ANDREW IS THE BEST HE RUNS A TIGHT SHIP WITH HIS ATTENTION TO HIS CUDTOMERS AND THEIR TIME IN HIS SPACE
I ordered food to go and the staff was so nice and the food was perfect!!! Thank you so much!!

We are here today celebrating Mothers Day and had a really bad experience. Never have I experienced here the kitchen being so far behind. Party of 13, call ahead for 5:00, waited 45 minutes to be seated then once seated was told kitchen was extremely backed up, was finally served our food, very disappointing, salmon meal was stone cold, other meals were not what expected. We saw many many to go orders going out while people are still waiting for the food sitting at tables. On a busy day like this, there should be NO TAKE OUT ORDERS including Door dash/Uber, we all asked To box up our meal after only taking a few bites. Unfortunately, we will not be dining here anytime soon!

Food..it was ok, but it seems like they proportioned the pasta prior to my order ( because the pasta was a little set sticking to each other) and then they put the sauce on top , then the meat so I had to push the meat aside to mix the psta/sauce before proceeding eating. Not a biggie but... Noone else complained about there meals so I assume they were ok
Thank you Alex and thank you Carrabbas’s for the free Mezzo Luna ❤️

They save the smallest portions for takeout. I ordered the Pollo Rosa Maria. A nearly $30 entrée. I even sprang for the asparagus, which wasn’t up charge. Six small pieces of asparagus? Two small chicken breasts that couldn’t even contain the stuffing and toppings that this entrée is supposed to feature? If this was put down in front of me in the restaurant, I would’ve laughed and sent it back. But as it was takeout, I suppose the smallest portions are saved for those in their cars.
The food was excellent. I ordered the lamb chops and they were seasoned and cooked to perfection. The waitress staff was on point and attentive to the needs of our party.

My first time was excellent, server Anthony was informative and very helpful, asked question knew the answer to make my experience amazing. Highly recommend this location based on the food tasting homemade not processed like other restaurants. Go see Anthony here at the sanford location.

We have dined at this location a few times but end up ordering take out more often than not. I don’t even know why we keep ordering. I guess we’re hopeful? We used to live next to an amazing Carrabbas location but the Sanford location is a poor excuse for Carrabbas. There is something wrong with our food every time we go. Tonight I ordered a filet (per usual) and got a sirloin that was already sliced? I don’t even understand how you cook a steak to medium well (ordered medium rare) and it’s dryer than the Sahara. My side of Alfredo was so grainy. For previous visits we have received pasta missing in whole ingredients (like Alfredo that is like water) or we have needed a steak re cook and it came out 2 more times wrong. I’ve spoken to management, been offered meals, whatever else they feel like makes it right. But it doesn’t. This location needs a serious management team that actually cares. Because the current one does not. Not the whole team anyways. Definitely not the kitchen manager. A very poor excuse for Carrabbas. And then having 5 star reviews from wine dinners try and carry your google rating is even more ridiculous. Steer clear of the Sanford Carrabbas.

I used to love Carrabbas, was my favorite place to go but after my recent outing I was completely disappointed. The pasta was undercooked, the meatballs were burnt. The cheesesticks were burnt as well. The service is lacking and the booth seats are so wore out they scrape my thights when I sat. Definitely need people who knows how to cook.

I feel really bad saying this as my server was nice I still left twenty percent but my experience was bad initial service was good but after that I was left when I mentioned this and waiting for pasta was long . I sat along time and a few other weren’t happy it wasn’t packed so not sure what was going on . I was there a few hours . The manager offered free desert after that my server came and he’s polite but maybe had too many tables I waited I had to ask another server for the bill and he left the machine with me I figured it out paid my bill found pen in my bag and gave him back as he was serving another table the card machine . People were nice but service was so so slow and my pasta honestly was really awful tasting I couldn’t taste the sausage . Normally I feel bad to leave a comment but if people weren’t nice I wouldn’t have paid and sadly that’s the truth I don’t know what happened tonight but honestly it was probably the worst I’ve had in years as in slow and bad dinner the check thing sorting it out myself wasn’t nice . A couple at the bar didn’t have a nice time either . 😢
Not busy on Sunday morning. We had party of 7 for birthday celebration and the service was outstanding.

What a great experience for a change. Great service, great food, and quick waiting time for food. Love the bread, and the chicken marsala is amazing, although I think the marsala sauce was different, but the creamy one they used to have, and only 4 mushrooms. All in all it was great, just disappointed in the marsala sauce
Natalie was the best! Wonderfully attentive without being interruptive. She helped us have a lovely birthday celebration.

I had my first experience at Carrabba's in Orlando recently and it was phenomenal. I had the chicken with lemon and capers, it was so good. Fresh, hot and such a wonderful flavor. The service was great. I will be back.
Ordered takeout. Food was great!

This was me and my bf’s first time in a carrabbas, Natalie was so attentive and communicated with us at every point possible. She was so personable and handled the busyness with her whole chest. Thank you for everything. Our date night was wonderful with you! Shout out to the whole staff, we watched them work together and the food was delicious so literally every hand did a fantastic job. That peach cobbler was fan freaking tastic too Edit: NATALIE BABE I HOPE YOU GOT YOUR 2 DESSERTS CAUSE THE KNICKS WON BABBBYYYYYY!!!!!!!!! (Don’t worry I didn’t buy a pack of ciggies❤️)

Ali provided outstanding service from start to finish! He was friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit. His professionalism, positive attitude, and attention to detail truly stood out. He went above and beyond to ensure we had a great experience, and his excellent customer service made our meal even more enjoyable. If you have the opportunity to be served by Ali, you’re in great hands. Thank you, Ali, for such exceptional service! 👏😊
We have dined at Carrabbas many times. Natalie, our server, is a wonderful complement to the experience. She does act like a friend or cousin & is very thoughtful.

Kevin was my server and he was excellent! The food was amazing and Steven the manager was very pleasant. I love the environment and the music creates an excellent atmosphere. Overall great experience. If I could leave 10 stars I would.

Natalie made our visit to Carrabba’s an absolute delight! From the moment we sat down, she was incredibly warm, kind, and delightful. She has that rare gift of making guests like us feel like old friends rather than transactional customers. Her positive energy, genuine smile, and attentive service turned a simple dinner into a truly enjoyable experience. She anticipated our needs, checked on us at just the right times, and made the entire evening feel effortless and fun. Carrabba’s is fortunate to have someone as wonderful as Natalie on their team. My experience with the parking system was very disappointing. I purchased a multi-day parking pass and later lost the green parking permit that is required to be displayed in the vehicle. That is when I discovered there is no solution for customers who have legitimately paid for their parking. I was able to provide proof of purchase, including the original QR code, my reservation information, and the charge on my bank account. However, I was informed that replacement permits are not issued under any circumstances. I understand the need to prevent misuse of parking passes, but those policies should not penalize customers who can clearly prove they paid for the service. If the system already tracks reservations digitally and issues QR codes linked to each purchase, there should be a reasonable way to verify the purchase and assist customers when a permit is lost. Unfortunately, the current policy offers no practical solution and creates an unnecessary burden for honest customers who have already paid.

I stayed at this hotel over the weekend, from Friday to Sunday. My first impression from the outside was that the hotel looked older and a little neglected, but once I walked inside, my impression changed completely. The entrance area was pleasant, clean, and had a nice smell. The staff was very professional, helpful, and friendly. Everyone I interacted with treated me well. The property appears to have been renovated with an 80s-style vibe. I do think the hotel could use more investment and updates in some areas, but it still has some very nice features. One of the highlights is the lazy river pool, which is perfect for relaxing. However, it is not really a traditional swimming pool; it is more for floating and relaxing on a tube. The room was very spacious and comfortable. I stayed in a double queen room that also had a separate sitting area with a sofa bed, which made the room feel very roomy and convenient. The room was not perfectly spotless, but it was clean enough and had everything we needed, including towels, a refrigerator, and a microwave. Housekeeping does not clean the rooms daily, at least during my two-night stay, but that was not a major issue for me. The main area I think needs improvement is the bedding. The mattresses and pillows could definitely use an update, as I was not able to rest as well as I would have liked. The breakfast was very good and had a nice variety. It included hot breakfast options such as eggs, pancakes, sausage, fruit, cereal,…

I found out the day before we were to arrive that Expedia was unable to verify our accomodations and cancelled our room. I contacted Beachside directly and they were able to accomodate (mostly) what our original reservation was for a better rate. The staff was friendly and helpful in rebooking. After a 13 hr drive, check in was easy, staff was fun and friendly, gave us dinner suggestions, we spent some time in the lazy river. The next day we used beach "rental" items to go visit Cocoa Beach, spent time on the lazy river, enjoyed some more local food, and did some laundry before our cruise. They have several washers and dryers. The food is good, the on site restaurant is good, the staff was friendly, the location was perfect for us. We would stay here again if/when we find ourselves back in the area! The buildings are showing some age but they have tried to make updates and keep it comfortable and maintained. The frustrations I had were more with fellow patrons behavior than hotel issues.

While the rooms appeared clean, it did not take long for a cockroach to show up. Literally crawled up my husband's leg. Immediately switched rooms/floors and they gave us half of our money back which was appreciated. Pics look great on the Internet but once you see it up close the place is actually pretty run down. Lazy river was almost as boiling hot as the air outside, not refreshing. Frequent toilet clogging issues as well though maintenance was responsive to it quickly. Would stay elsewhere, this location and area are a bit run down and anywhere with cockroaches is a big no.

The hotel is VERY, VERY OLD!! They are trying to maintain it with fresh paint but the age of the building is impossible to hide. The room had a STRONG SMELL OF DAMPNESS . Old AC. After speaking with other guests during breakfast, I realized they mentioned the same issues: damp rooms, a worn-out condition. Some even told me they had areas in their rooms where mold had simply been painted over. I did not report it to the front desk because I was only staying for two nights and just needed a place to sleep. Now, the positives: The…

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ Beachside Hotel & Suites offers a great location near Port Canaveral and Cocoa Beach, making it a convenient choice for cruisers and beachgoers. We were able to get an excellent rate through a travel agent discount, which made the value even better. The highlight of our stay was definitely the staff. Everyone we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and helpful. A special shout-out to Angelo, who provided excellent customer service and made us feel appreciated as guests. The lazy river pool area is fun and unique, especially for families. However, the pool floats are available on a first-come, first-served basis, and there were only a limited number available. Several were also deflated or in need of replacement. While the online photos are attractive, guests should know that the property is older than it appears in the pictures. The buildings have been updated cosmetically, but some areas still show their age. The exterior buildings and elevators could benefit from additional cleaning and maintenance. There is only one elevator, and during busy times it can be slow. Parking was generally adequate, although accessible parking spaces were somewhat limited. One thing to keep in mind is dining availability. The staff follows posted hours closely. We arrived shortly after the kitchen closed and were unable to order food, so plan meals accordingly. Overall, Beachside Hotel & Suites provided a comfortable stay with a fantastic location, friendly staff, and a fun pool area. If…
