Wow. Charley’s Steak House absolutely exceeded our expectations from start to finish. The food was outstanding — every dish came out perfectly executed, beautifully presented, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients. The steaks were cooked exactly to temperature with that signature char that you can tell comes from real expertise on the grill. Every bite reminded us why this place has the reputation it does. But what truly elevated the experience was our server, Michael. He delivered top-tier service from the moment we sat down. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu — walking us through cuts, preparations, and pairings with genuine confidence and warmth. He had thoughtful recommendations when we asked, and he clearly knew the food inside and out. Beyond his expertise, he was attentive without ever being intrusive: drinks were refilled before we noticed they were low, courses were perfectly paced, and he anticipated little needs throughout the meal. It’s rare to encounter a server who balances polish, personality, and professionalism this well. The atmosphere was warm and elevated — perfect for a special dinner but still comfortable. Between the quality of the food, the thoughtful service, and the overall experience, this was easily one of the best steakhouse meals we’ve had. If you’re considering Charley’s, go. And if you can request Michael, do that too — he made the night.

Honestly, this isn’t the worst hotel I’ve stayed at. I’ve lived in Orlando, Florida for about six years, so I’ve had the chance to visit quite a few hotels in this area. While it may not meet the expectations of tourists looking for something upscale, it’s not a bad option for the average visitor. The beds are comfortable, but they are definitely noisy—just shifting around can make them creak. It seems like the base is enclosed with a metal frame, which is probably why. The shower setup could also use improvement; the curtain leaves about a foot-wide gap, so water easily gets out and you can feel outside air coming in. As for the area, based on my experience living here, it’s not as bad as some reviews make it sound. It’s a busy, high-traffic tourist area with a strong police presence. A lot of the noise people mention—talking, yelling, laughter—is likely coming from ICON Park nearby. You can hear it, especially at night. Overall, I’d recommend this place if you’re just looking for somewhere to rest and plan to spend time around ICON Park.

Chatham’s Place came highly recommended by a friend, and it absolutely lived up to the praise. Reservations are required and very limited, with booking only available through an email request, which makes the experience feel even more special. The customer service was outstanding from start to finish. Our server was prompt, attentive, and professional, making us feel well taken care of throughout the evening. The atmosphere is intimate and elegant, with dim lighting and live piano music that create the perfect setting for a date night or a dinner with close friends or family. One of the things I appreciated most was that you are never rushed. They truly encourage you to relax and enjoy your meal at a leisurely pace. They also offer an extensive wine list and a full bar, and the cocktails were both well-made and delicious. As for the food, everything we had was incredible. The highlight of the night for me was the off-menu pesto Parmesan pasta prepared tableside in a wheel of cheese. It was one of the best pasta dishes I’ve ever had. The lobster salad was amazing, and the beet salad with goat cheese was absolutely heavenly. While we ordered several items from the menu, there were also many enticing off-menu dishes available, which made the experience feel even more unique. We definitely plan to return and continue exploring the many menu options Chatham’s Place has to offer.

To be fair, I wouldn’t enjoy that dish anywhere, and I didn’t realize what it was until I tasted it 😅. That aside, everything else has been wonderful. 🌟 Overall: Chatham’s Place is a gem for memorable evenings, fine dining, and celebrating life’s special moments. ✨ We visit several times a year, and it’s consistently exceptional. Chef Tony’s unique approach—seating guests once and focusing on quality over turnover—truly delivers 👨‍🍳👏. “The Great Chick-fil-A Standoff of 2026" Look, I don’t know what kind of logistical glitch in the Matrix is happening at this Orlando location, but I am currently writing this review from stage three of Chick-fil-A drive-thru captivity. We ordered ahead on the app, thinking we were hacking the system. We were fools. We have been sitting in this two-lane structural bottleneck moving at the blistering pace of exactly one car every five minutes. I have watched the sunset, the sunrise, and I’m pretty sure the family in the minivan next to me has aged out of their middle school phase since we pulled in. Chick-fil-A is usually a finely tuned Swiss watch of fried chicken efficiency. The employees are normally running around like a high-speed NASCAR pit crew. Today? I think they are back there hand-rearing the chickens from hatchlings. I've had shorter layovers at MCO. This is officially the longest Chick-fil-A wait of my entire earthly existence. The only reason this isn't a one-star review is because I know that when I finally reach the window in the next calendar year, someone is going to hand me a warm bag of waffle fries, look me dead in the eyes, and say "My pleasure," and my broken soul will instantly forgive them. If you are hungry today, maybe pack a rations kit, update your will, and clear your calendar before entering this dual-lane abyss.

🌯 The Fiesta of Despair: A 1-Star Review Welcome to the least festive fiesta in town! Walking into this establishment is like arriving at a party where the piñata has already exploded, but instead of candy, the floor is just covered in trampled cilantro-lime rice and human sorrow. Let's break down this absolute "celebration" of a meal: • The Ambiance: The dining area is aggressively dirty. I’m pretty sure the sticky tables are now structurally supported by dried sour cream and abandoned dreams. • The "Art" of the Roll: Calling the food preparation "sloppy" is honestly an insult to slop. Watching them assemble a burrito is less about culinary skill and more like watching someone aggressively stuff a soaking wet sleeping bag into a sack that's three sizes too small. It’s a leaky, structural disaster just waiting to ruin your car seats. • The Culinary Experience: The food itself is tragic. The steak has the texture of a boot that just hiked the desert, and the salsa looks like it’s been through a war. • The Party Hosts: The employees here scoop black beans with the sheer, unbridled enthusiasm of a Victorian gravedigger on a double shift. They look utterly miserable, act perpetually grumpy, and dole out the shredded cheese like it’s coming directly out of their own inheritances. They always warn you that the guacamole is extra, but at this location, the crippling sense of regret is completely free. Do yourself a favor and eat anywhere else.

I would avoid this location! I included a picture of their trash area to give you a visual of how unclean they keep this restaurant.

Celery City is a hip beer bar in the heart of historic downtown Sanford. They offer an extensive draft beer selection, along with a solid variety of non-alcoholic beers and mocktails. The staff is friendly, welcoming, and attentive. The venue features plenty of outdoor seating, including tables, chairs, and picnic tables spread throughout a spacious beer garden. Sushi & Seoul is conveniently located within the beer garden, making it easy to grab a delicious bite while enjoying the atmosphere. Smoking, including cigars, is permitted in the beer garden, but the large open-air layout, fans, and excellent airflow help keep the space comfortable. There’s also an outdoor entertainment stage that adds to the lively and social vibe. Overall, it’s a great place to relax, enjoy a drink, and experience the charm and character of historic downtown Sanford.

The restaurant itself appeared somewhat outdated. On the positive side, our waitress, Kylie, was exceptional. She was kind, attentive, and provided excellent service. The drinks were exceptional, with margaritas and beers that were refreshing and flavorful. The appetizers were satisfactory, with the mozzarella and egg rolls being particularly delicious. The main course was enjoyable. I had a steak that was cooked to a perfectly medium-rare temperature. The loaded mashed potatoes were delectable. The chicken tenders were average, while the French fries were fresh and seasoned to perfection. I was particularly impressed with the chili, which I will definitely return to try again. All in all, I don't recommend this restaurant.

The Quesadilla: Crispy, Cheesy PerfectionTexture: The flour tortilla was toasted to a flawless, golden-brown crisp. Filling: Packed with tender, well-seasoned shredded chicken and a rich blend of melted cheeses. Flavor: Every bite offered a satisfying cheese pull with just the right hint of spices. Accompaniments: Fresh guacamole, zesty salsa, and cool sour cream balanced the savory heat beautifully. The Lava Cake: A Decadent Finale Presentation: Arrived warm with a delicate dusting of powdered sugar on top. Texture: The outer cake sponge was incredibly moist and light. The Center: Cutting into it released a rich, velvety river of warm, molten chocolate. Balance: It paired beautifully with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The cold creaminess cut through the intense chocolate richness. If you are looking for a meal that hits every craving, this savory-and-sweet pairing is an absolute must-try!

​We were looking for restaurants near our hotel and decided to try a Mexican spot. We found this place where many people were giving it 5 stars and got curious. The restaurant was definitely busy, and we had to wait a bit for a table. Once we got seated, our server was really nice and polite. The menu had a lot of Tex-Mex selections, to choose from, and they started us off with chips, homemade salsa, and a jalapeno ranch type dip. ​I ordered the Chicken Flautas from their house specialties section. They are supposed to be chicken and cheese inside corn tortillas, fried until crispy. The crisp was definitely there, but inside, all I got was dry chicken. After she finished making the bowl, the employee with glasses stopped her and asked, “Is that extra chicken or double chicken?” She immediately seemed nervous and replied that it was extra chicken. At that point, I was confused and clarified that I had never asked for extra or double chicken. I had simply ordered a regular chicken bowl. On my most recent visit, they were completely out of beans. They did have corn salsa, but told in-store customers it was reserved for online orders—which is hard to justify. It also appears that online orders are now being handled in the front of the house, taking priority over guests who are physically in line. This creates a frustrating experience, as in-store customers are left waiting while staff focus elsewhere. The employees are generally polite, but they seem overworked and unsupported. There’s no visible management presence during evening hours, and the overall operation feels disorganized. It often seems like a young, understaffed team is left to run the restaurant without adequate guidance. I recently visited this restaurant and had a mixed experience overall. On the positive side, the servers were very friendly, and we were seated quickly, which made a great first impression. The food also came out fast, which I appreciated.However, there were some downsides. A few of the dishes arrived cold, which took away from the overall enjoyment. The chicken tenders, in particular, were a bit of an acquired taste. In my opinion, the lemongrass or rosemary flavor was too overpowering and masked the natural taste of the chicken. Additionally, the flavor lingered quite a bit, which ended up affecting the taste of the other food I ate afterward, and that was not appreciated.On the other hand, the fries were really good—they reminded me of Chick-fil-A’s, which was a highlight.I also liked that the restaurant offers vegan-friendly options, which is a nice touch and makes it more inclusive for different diets. Overall, I’d rate my experience a 6/10. There are definitely some good aspects, but there’s room for improvement.

The chicken fries are like something you would see at a high school football game. Also our food did not seem fresh. It came out very quickly which is nice, but it was lukewarm and got cold fast which leads me to believe it was not made fresh to order. The first thing you see when you walk in is a big self serve kiosk, but at the same time they want a server to take care of you so they can ask for a tip. It is kind of confusing to me why they have a kiosk if they also want to have servers. As a matter of fact I recommend to just use the kiosk to save some money. My girlfriend and I tried this place because the reviews were really positive. Now I am very confused how people rate this restaurant so highly when I frankly had a disappointing experience.

★★★★☆ My experience at The Cheesecake Factory was generally positive, though not without a few drawbacks. That said, the restaurant offers an extensive and diverse menu capable of accommodating a wide range of tastes and preferences. If you are torn between a rich, savory meat dish and a bright, buttery seafood classic, look no further than combining Carne Asada and Shrimp Scampi. This pairing delivers an exceptional contrast of flavors and textures that elevates the concept of surf and turf to a whole new level. Why This Combination Works The Carne Asada: Grilled to absolute perfection, the steak boasts a deeply charred, smoky crust that locks in juicy tenderness. The marinade—rich with citrus, garlic, and cumin—cuts through the richness of the beef and leaves a vibrant, lingering warmth. The Shrimp Scampi: Plump, snappy shrimp swim in a luxurious pool of melted butter, white wine, and minced garlic. A heavy splash of fresh lemon juice and a sprinkle of parsley cut the richness, providing a bright, acidic lift that wakes up the palate.The Perfect Balance what makes this meal truly memorable is how the two components interact. The smoky, robust profile of the carne asada stands up beautifully against the delicate, velvety garlic butter of the scampi. Alternating bites between the savory charred beef and the zesty, tender shrimp ensures that neither dish overpowers the other. It is a indulgent, highly satisfying dining experience that satisfies both comfort food cravings and upscale tastes in one sitting.

Cinnamon Tree Café is truly one of Port Orange's hidden gems! From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with a warm, welcoming atmosphere and the aroma of fresh, scratch-made food. Every dish is beautifully prepared, and you can taste the quality ingredients in every bite. The crepes, croissant sandwiches, pancakes, and coffee drinks are absolutely outstanding, and the portions are generous without sacrificing quality. The staff is consistently friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about providing a great experience. What sets Cinnamon Tree Café apart is its commitment to fresh, made-from-scratch food and exceptional customer service. Whether you're stopping in for breakfast, brunch, lunch, or just a specialty coffee and pastry, you'll leave impressed and already planning your next visit. Port Orange is fortunate to have such a fantastic locally owned café. Highly recommended! Five 🌟 restaurant!

My girlfriend and attended the Dining in the Dark event, and while we genuinely enjoyed the experience itself, we left feeling disappointed by several unexpected charges that significantly increased the overall cost of the evening. When we purchased our tickets, the base ticket price appeared to be approximately $64 per person. After ticket fees and surcharges totaling $38.04, we expected our final cost to be around $136. However, at the conclusion of the event, we were surprised to discover an additional venue service charge of approximately $16 per person ($38 total) that had not been apparent to us during the purchasing process. As a result, our ticket costs ultimately increased to approximately $213 before we purchased any food or beverages. After ordering a bottle of wine and appropriately tipping our excellent server, our date night totaled nearly $350. Keep in mind too this was not including the $20 for parking too. Why not consider including this as a fee or validating the parking? Our concern is not necessarily the cost itself, but rather the lack of transparency regarding the full cost of the experience. Had we been aware of all fees upfront, we may have made a different decision about attending. Discovering an additional mandatory charge at the end of the evening left us feeling as though important pricing information had not been clearly communicated. We believe customers would benefit from seeing the complete expected cost of the experience during the booking…

The food in the Club Lounge was very good and everything so extremely clean. They even had flavored straws! The concierge left a big bottle of red wine in our room with two glasses since we had waited so long on the room to get ready. Housekeeping was also extremely nice. Everything spotless. And if anyone wants to do the most fun attraction at Disney, go down to the boats at the Contemporary or the Grand Floridian and rent a pontoon boat. You don't have to be staying on property, but you do have to show your ID. No boat license needed. They will show you how to operate it, and where all the life jackets are. And while you are out there you are watched by the lake patrol officers so if you need anything you just wave both arms at them and they will come to your rescue. They are also watching the weather for you. If any storms come in the area, they will let you know. Oh,…

Tables are always messy, the servers can't be bothered to wipe anything down. There are always crumbs everywhere. If you are Celiac or gluten-free this place is your worst nightmare. My first visit to The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes was for a conference, so unfortunately I did not have much time to fully explore all the facilities the resort has to offer. Even so, it was easy to see why this property is regarded as one of Orlando’s premier luxury resorts. The resort is beautifully landscaped with a relaxing atmosphere that feels far removed from the busy theme parks nearby. I was fortunate to be given a room with a balcony overlooking the pool, which provided a pleasant view and a nice spot to unwind after a full day of meetings. As a Marriott Bonvoy member, I also received vouchers for complimentary coffee and pastries each morning, which was a thoughtful touch to start the day. Although I did not get to experience the spa, golf course, or extensive recreational facilities, I enjoyed the restaurants and bars within the resort. The staff were consistently friendly, welcoming, and attentive to my needs throughout the stay, making the experience even more enjoyable. The only thing I felt was missing was an Executive Lounge. As a Marriott Bonvoy Titanium member, I have come to appreciate the lounge experience at many Marriott properties, and it would have been a wonderful addition to an otherwise excellent stay. Overall, The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes left a very positive impression on me. Despite being here primarily for business, I could easily see myself returning in the future for a proper resort getaway to fully enjoy everything this…

We found this place as we were headed to Clermont. Michael was our waiter..he was great and helpful in helping us choose our meals...he was attentive but didn't interrupt us! The Crooked Spoon is easily our favorite spot in Clermont. The food is always fantastic, and the specials are one of the main reasons we keep coming back. Every time we visit, there's something new that catches our eye, and we've never been disappointed. The cocktail specials are just as good and always worth trying. You can tell a lot of thought goes into the menu, and it shows in every dish. Great food, great drinks, and consistently great experiences. Clermont is lucky to have a place like The Crooked Spoon.

Casual eatery. Nice place to sit outside on the patio to relax and eat. I wouldn’t advise coming here if you were in a hurry. It is more of a place to eat and take your time. Service follows that pace. The blue cheese chips are excellent! The specialty cocktails were excellent as well.

Been coming here 10 years, the food is always outstanding. The crooked spoon was the place I met my now wife (we have 2 kids) back in 2018 and the food is just as good now if not better than when we started coming. Tonight was no different. Arrived right before 5pm to order multiple special entrées which were all fantastic per usual. Our one and two year old tore up some redfish (last order !) and pork loin. I had the bison burger and it was easily top 3 I’ve ever had. Shoutout crooked spoon kitchen and as always the bar staff . Long live the spoon 🥄!!!

Excellent will be back. Shrimp tacos were spot on. Loved the pbj wings.

And service was so quick & efficient too! We were seated, had our order taken, food served, and ate our meals all in less than 30-40 mins. The Crooked Spoon is a Clermont favorite for a reason! :)

Extremely disappointing experience. My wife, son, and I visited this Cheddar’s on June 20 and arrived around 1:43 PM. After a short wait, we were seated and placed our order, including drinks, an order of Onion Rings, and three entrées. The drinks arrived, but that was the only part of our meal that did. I confirmed that our order had been entered correctly because it was already showing on the table tablet with a total of about $63. After waiting nearly 45 minutes without receiving any food, my wife spoke with the manager about the delay and asked if they could at least bring the appetizers. About 15 minutes later, we received only the complimentary croissants. The Onion Rings we had actually paid for never arrived. After waiting even longer with no food, no updates, and no explanation, we decided to leave without eating our meal. What made the experience even worse was the manager’s response. When my wife approached her a second time, she simply said, “I’m sorry, I’m sorry,” while continuing to help other customers. She didn’t make eye contact, offer an explanation, or make any effort to resolve the situation. We spent over an hour in the restaurant and left at approximately 2:49 PM without ever receiving the food we ordered. Delays can happen, but the complete lack of communication and customer care made this one of the worst restaurant experiences we’ve had. Unfortunately, we will not be returning.

Really enjoyed my stay here. Would definitely choose this Hotel again!

I stayed here for work on a Tuesday. Kyle at the front desk nicely upgraded my room for becoming a rewards member. The king suite was fantastic and the room was very quiet and clean. The exact location isn't super walkable, but the shuttle service was the ready.

Awesome stay! What really made the experience stand out, though, was Kyle at the front desk. He made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we walked in. His friendly, professional service set the tone for a wonderful stay.
Had a great stay - highly recommend! Kyle at the front desk was especially helpful!

We stayed at the resort and when booking we’re told all our fees were paid. We get to the resort and they hit us with another 100 fee which is refunded from my understanding as long as you leave the room in good condition. The rooms were okay the fridge was not meant to be put in the cabinet so it kept hitting the doors making it hard to open there was minor cosmetic things that can be updated but besides that the hotel itself was very nice and in a great location. I just wish they were upfront on how much you’re really paying.

Hotel is a decent one. Nothing fancy like you would expect from Crowne Plaza, which I have stayed in before. The TV in rooms are old school, I know who wants to watch TV in hotel, but believe me we do. They should definitely upgrade them to smart ones. Breakfast was great, had wide selection and the server was very friendly.

We booked this room after a last minute reservation cancelation at another hotel. We are so glad we got to stay here instead. The entire experience was great from check in to check out. We will definitely return to this or other Crowne Plaza locations for future stays.
Everything pretty much perfect, clean, room and bed comfort was great.
good, would recommend however some issues with the drainage for the shower. it would leak towards the bedroom and we would have to make a barrier with towels to keep it from damaging the carpet
Great location! Fair prices! Amazing staff! Rooms are pristine!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! We were attending an event at Kia Center. The hotel is in close proximity to the Center.. easy walk. Shamara welcomed us to the hotel. She was so friendly & welcoming! Our room was very spacious & clean. All staff that we encountered were very friendly. Highly recommend a stay here!
My family and I had a great stay. The rooms were clean, beds AND pillows were comfortable, and the restaurant staff were perfect and personable.
We are staying here two nights. Our son is going to concert. We ate dinner in the restaurant and Gaby was our server. She was wonderful. So welcoming and friendly and great service.
Power went out and couldn’t check in. Booked a room with a kitchen on Expedia but was advertised wrong. Was upgraded due to blackout.

We booked the Crowne Plaza by IHG via booking.com, anticipating professionalism and easy-going stay. The hotel refused to provide us with an invoice for our stay, claiming that it is booking.com who should provide us the invoice. We escalated this further, requested the invoice from the hotel via several channels, and were not provided with it at all. This is all despite the fact that the hotel undertook to comply with booking.com Terms and Conditions, which clearly stipulate the obligation of any hotel to provide the customer with an invoice. This happened to us for the first time, I believe that this is not standard at all, and sharing this, so other customers are not faulted the same way we were.
The staff was absolutely a delight and the hotel was amazing, comfy beds and pillows! Will definitely stay again!
Very good location near downtown.

I was very disappointed with my experience at Crowne Plaza Orlando Downtown before I even checked in. My party and I arrived around noon because I had a few questions before check-in. The lobby was empty, and there were two employees at the front desk. One employee greeted me, but before I could ask my question or provide any information, another employee, interrupted and hastily stated "Check-in is at 3:00 p.m. We are not doing early check-in until then." What was frustrating was that she never asked for my name, reservation details, or what I needed assistance with. She simply assumed why I was there and dismissed me before giving me the opportunity to speak. Feeling unwelcome and unheard, I turned around and left the lobby. As I walked away, she called out, "If there is anything you need, let us know," but after the interaction I had just experienced, the comment felt insincere. Good customer service starts with listening, and unfortunately, that did not happen here. Every guest deserves to be treated with courtesy and respect, regardless of whether they are checking in, asking a question, or simply seeking assistance. First impressions matter, and this interaction left a very negative impression of the hotel. I hope management addresses this issue so future guests do not experience the same lack of professionalism and attentiveness. Some additional drawbacks we experienced included the WiFi being down, which prevented us from connecting, and a few of the elevators not…

The staff was knowledgeable and accommodating to all special request.

I stayed with my girlfriend and our son at The Crown Plaza Hotel for a concert at the Kia Center in Downtown Orlando, and we had an amazing time! From the moment we entered, the bald gentleman at the reception made us feel unwelcome. Instead of greeting us, he looked at us as if we were disturbing them. When we asked about it, the manager told us the sausage was “free” because another table didn’t want it. That explanation raised more questions than answers. Why weren’t we told that when the food was delivered? And why were we missing half of what we actually paid for? To make matters worse, we overheard another table complaining that they had received the wrong order, which strongly suggested that our table had been given someone else’s food. When we raised our concerns again after receiving the check, the manager came…

I enjoyed myself and I hope I get another opportunity to experience the Dancing Crab Restaurant experience again sometime in the distant future! Thank You.

Texas style brisket always great... but not cheap... pork is always fresh and not dry... ribs are wonderful, but to sugary for me... would love to see some dry rub only ribs. Best bbq for 100 miles

BBQ for the win! Very good, tender with excellent consistency on the brisket. The beef brat was delicious, and two thumbs 👍🏻 up on the Cole slaw! Coke products, outdoor seating only but it’s covered and there’s a fan.

As a Texan living in Florida, this place reminds me of home. The brisket was fork tender with a dark crust and smoke flavored throughout. The beef sausage link was excellent. I will come back here everytime we are in the area.

I have but one regret in life: only now discovering Cryderman's. Seriously. Absolutely the best 'que on the Space Coast and Top 5 in FLA (according to Southern Living magazine and me). Every cut of meat (pork, brisket, ribs, sausage, turkey) is better than the one before it (although the smoked turkey holds a special place in my heart/stomach). Amazing classic BBQ sides and always a few specials as well (if they have the cream spinach, get the cream spinach). Dessert that will make you want to smack yo' grandma! Shady outside seating and great people (shout-out to Nick!). If you are craving BBQ and/or thinking about trying Cryderman's, stop pondering/considering and just go. But not too late, as they are open until it is gone. Don't be that person. Do not pass Go. Do not collect $200. Just go to Cryderman's ASAP.

If you don’t believe me, just try the turkey and let me know if you know any other place that can make turkey taste this good. The brisket is insane too. If I wasn’t in a hurry, I would have stayed and hung out with the amazing staff all day. Crydermans Barbecue in Cocoa Village is a must-visit if you’re looking for amazing barbecue. The service is outstanding—the staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and even let us sample some of the meats before ordering, which was a great touch. The food is absolutely delicious, with tender, flavorful meats and generous portions. For the quality and amount of food you get, the prices are very reasonable. Everything we tried was excellent, and it’s easy to see why this place is so popular. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Cocoa Village!

I unfortunately do not have photos to share despite my intention to take one due to being 3 meats deep and half a barbecue sauce before I remembered. I will be honest, I tried the sweet barbecue sauce and forgot to try any others because I was so pleasantly surprised, I knew I found my new favorite. I don't know how they do it, but it's not too sweet and has no harsh undertones like you find in other sweet barbecue sauces. It paired perfectly with Ribs and brisket. The mac and cheese was exactly what I like - large curly noodles and creamy cheese. The beans were unique and had a very homemade feel to them instead of some mass produced, overly BBQ undertone I usually see at the mediocre places. I was very pleasantly surprised with the cole slaw. Despite my initial confusion with only purple cabbage, it was not missing anything I crave with traditional cole slaw. At this point in my…

When we brought this to our server’s attention, he appeared fairly nonchalant, although he did mention he would inform a manager. A manager eventually came over (though he didn’t introduce himself), and while he did offer an apology and thank us for bringing it to his attention, that was the extent of the response. I could rate this restaurant a 2 star or a 5 star, depending on what you’re looking for in a dining experience. That’s why I gave The Crystal Palace a 3 star review. But let me break it down: If you’re specifically looking for a magical, memorable dining experience (especially for your little ones), this is your place! The Crystal Palace features 4 iconic characters: Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, Piglet, and Tigger. Winnie the Pooh stayed at the front of the restaurant the entire time, and there was a short line for meet and greet. The other 3 characters make their rotation around the restaurant, and they are very diligent about hitting every table. 5/5 stars in regards to the atmosphere! I will say, the food is pretty mediocre. The buffet didn’t have nearly as many options as I had expected, BUT, I did enjoy the variety of cleaner foods (salads, meats, veggies, etc). It was a nice change from all of the fried park food we’d been eating. The service was average. Our waitress was friendly enough, but she didn’t go over the top.

First of all, I really don't want to leave a three star review for The Crystal Palace. I have been visiting this restaurant for many, many years. I have an attachment to it! Unfortunately, year after year, the quality keeps going down...down...down (much like the rain that falls in the Hundred Acre Wood). POSITIVES: Extensive salad bar, cute and extensive dessert choices with soft serve ice cream station, comfort food that has something for everyone, many awesome tenured servers who have been with the company for years, and Pooh's Friendship Celebration (this is a Winnie the Pooh themed character dining experience) NEGATIVES: Chaotic, beaten up, dirty bathrooms, most of the food is quite subpar, Pooh doesn't visit table anymore, not the cleanest (which can be a little unsettling since it's a buffet) I'm giving the Chocolate Mint Pie an honorable mention - that was an unexpected treat! All in all, I would say this: try it at least once. Get a reservation around 8:15pm and hang out around the restaurant afterwards to watch the fireworks. I will probably visit again, continuing to hope that the quality goes up a few notches.

It’s an amazing experience to visit the Cristal Palace The food it’s good but the most wonderful thing it’s to eat while your favorite characters are around the restaurant and they take the time to talk with you, take a photo or autograph your book. As a multiple food allergy mama, I wanted to share the incredible experience we had at Walt Disney World in Florida this past weekend! My daughter has never been able to safely eat at a restaurant before, but thanks to Disney’s Special Diets Planning Team, our entire trip felt stress-free and truly magical. My daughter is allergic to eggs, wheat, dairy, peanuts/legumes, corn, and more. Since we were in communication with the planning team the restaurants already knew our restrictions ahead of time. They anticipated what she could safely eat before we even placed an order and made us feel completely cared for. Our stand out meal was at Crystal Palace in Magic Kingdom, a buffet character dining experience, and there was even a dedicated allergy chef who came directly to our table. Chef Ted was beyond kind and so friendly! He took the time to interact and play with my daughter, checked in on us multiple times throughout the meal, and even brought out ingredient labels and lists for us to review. They prepared my 18-month-old (non-paying child!) an entire custom meal including grilled chicken breast, steak, baked potato, carrots, and raspberry sorbet for dessert. It was honestly the largest plate of food I’ve ever seen presented for a baby! We truly felt treated like royalty. As a food allergy parent, dining out can be incredibly anxiety-provoking, but Disney made us feel safe, seen, and cared for every step of the way. Thank you, Chef Ted, for making what is usually such a…

We loved our experience at the crystal palace! We had late lunch reservations. The food was good and there were quite a few options on the buffet. We definitely booked this restaurant for the characters though. Tigger has always been my daughter's favorite. If you haven’t had the loaded perogis(I didn’t get a picture of them, we ate them up so fast) I highly recommend trying them and the Shepards pie:)

As a Puertorican, that can cook, I have some hesitation to try Puertorican restaurants, but, this experience was great! ​I rarely leave reviews this bad, but people need to be warned. For an $80 tab, the food here is completely unacceptable. ​The Mofongo: A complete disaster. You are supposed to use a pilón to properly hand-mash fried plantains. Instead, this kitchen uses a food processor, which shears the starch and turns the dish into a dense, gummy paste. It was so poorly prepared it literally caused nausea. ​The Carne Frita: Completely bland, tough, and lacked any traditional seasoning or marinade. ​The gentleman helping us at the front desk was professional and courteous, which is the only reason I’d give this even one star. But a polite front house cannot save a kitchen that does not care about authenticity or basic cooking techniques. Save your stomach and your wallet.

We are so excited about this place that I had to write a review before we even finished our meal. Danino's truly lives up to its reputation as one of the best Italian restaurants in Orlando. Everything tastes homemade, fresh, and prepared with real care. Our friend ordered the cheese ravioli. I had a custom shrimp dish with homemade pasta, lightly dressed with lemon and butter, along with the caprese salad. My wife ordered the pesto linguine. Pesto linguine is such a simple dish, but that is exactly what made it so impressive. When a restaurant can take a simple classic and execute it perfectly, you know you're somewhere special. One thing that says a lot about a restaurant is when everyone at the table starts talking about how good their own meal is. That happened here. Now let me tell you about the daily homemade focaccia bread. It arrives with olive oil and a sweet balsamic reduction that is almost dessert-like before you've even started your meal. The dough is soft and airy with just enough crunch around the edges. The flavor is incredible. We asked for more. Then we asked for more again. Then, somewhat embarrassingly, we asked for even more. At this point we're wondering if it's too much to ask for a box of the bread to take home with the leftovers! The waiter mentioned their pizza dough was also made in house. Can't wait to try! The ingredients are fresh, the portions are generous, the service is warm, and every dish feels like it came from someone's family kitchen…

If you picture a true quaint Italian, olde school style, this is it. Beautiful scenic music plays on a screen by the counter area giving just a little extra touch of easy listening music. It's wonderful. The pasta was cooked to perfection. Our two dinners, chicken Parm and linguine pasta with Alfredo sauce was amazing. We have eaten here previously with family in town visiting. It was such a great experience, I wanted to return. The family will be back for another visit, so we will definitely be back again. It feels genuine and authentic. Service was also top notch without being rushed. It was comforting to be there . It is so worth the trip to try a great meal.
Mi esposo y yo amamos este lugar, comida deliciosa!

Hoy visitamos restaurante italiano 🇮🇹 DANINOS, reconocido por sus pastas y salsas caseras ! Una experiencia extraordinaria, sabor , textura, presentación y atención. Celebramos la graduación de nuestro hijo ✨ y fue la mejor elección , su dueño y chef nos mostró las especialidades y las mejores opciones 🍝 Pasta con queso gorgozola y peras 🍐 💯 Pasta frutos di mar 🌊 sabor profundo 💯 Milanesa parmesano 🔥 súper 💯 F E L I C I D A D E S

Small family owned and operated restaurant serving fresh authentic Italian cuisine in a casual environment! I am so happy to have found this restaurant! First one I find serving real Italian food. The owner and the waitress are super friendly. Food is delicious and there are plenty of free parking. The restaurant is easy to miss if you are driving by because it is not visible from the road. We ordered a beef carpaccio, A risotto funghi, Lasagna Di Melanzane, and a calzone. Everything was delicious but our favorite was the carpaccio! For dessert we ordered the Chocolate Amaretto Cake, baked by the owner's wife, which was delicious! A great option for a Saturday lunch with the whole family. We are coming back! Super recommended!
Probably the best Italian restaurant in Orlando!
Buenisima la comida la recomiendo y la atencion excelente volvere a este restaurant gracias.
The food is delicious! Feels and tastes authentic. The service is quick and efficient. Had a pizza and dessert and it was super good! Definitely would come again.

I wish I took a before photo but the food was so good I didn’t bother and dove right into the food. It’s unstoppably good. Genuinely some of the best Italian food I’ve had in years. The Lasagna Tricolore was absolutely incredible. Extremely fair prices. Great family atmosphere. Definitely owned by a family who cares about the art of good food. Had to ask for bread, it came after meal was on table. Sure it was a busy Friday but not up to snuff. Server comped my wife's meal but we really wanted a nice date nite. Had a great experience from the start. Kind of. Love the food and service and wine!! Thank you so much for a great Fathers Day experience. We will be back soon. It was also my mother in laws bday! Happy birthday Sue!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Da Vinci's Italian Grill – A Port St. Lucie Gem! If you're looking for authentic Italian food in Port St. Lucie, look no further than Da Vinci's Italian Grill. This family-owned Italian staple consistently delivers delicious food, generous portions, reasonable prices, and outstanding service. A special shoutout to Annie, who provides true 5-star service every visit. She's friendly, attentive, and makes every guest feel welcome. Great servers can elevate a meal, and Annie certainly does that. The food arrives fast, hot, and tastes like authentic Italian comfort food made with care. The atmosphere is cool, comfortable, and inviting whether you're stopping in for lunch, dinner, or gathering with family and friends. Their lunch specials are some of the best values in town, available Monday through Saturday from 11 AM to 2 PM, and the Monday & Tuesday Large Cheese Pizza Special for only $10.99 is one of the best deals in Port St. Lucie. 🍷 Wine lovers will be pleasantly surprised by the selection. Da Vinci's offers a variety of house wines, Italian whites, reds, sparkling wines, Prosecco, Moscato, Pinot Grigio, Chianti, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir, and several premium imported Italian wines. Whether you enjoy a crisp white with seafood, a refreshing Prosecco, a sweet Moscato with dessert, or a bold Amarone paired with a hearty Italian entrée, there's a wine to complement every meal and every palate. Some of my personal favorites include: 🍽️ Veal Saltimbocca –…

“La verdad, el nombre Cuba Libre no le hace justicia al lugar. Uno esperaría al menos escuchar algo de música cubana, pero no ponen ni una sola canción de Cuba. I went to Cuba libre at the beginning of this month to have dinner before a comedy show. We were sat in the upstairs area near the bar. Was pretty dead in there being as they closed at 6 for a private event and it was 5pm. When looking at the menu prior to arriving we noticed they had a happy hour with food and drinks (at the bar or bar tables) also was a sign in front of the restaurant stating their happy hour was Monday through Thursday 5-6pm we arrived at 5:05 Thursday evening, ordered the things listed on the happy hour menu online. The food took almost 40 minutes to come out for a party of 3 and only two other tables seated, the food was good no complaints there until I got my bill and noticed that nothing was happy hour priced. When asked the server about it I was told I have to ask for a happy hour menu in order to get the happy hour prices, it then turned into we are closing at 6 for a private event. In which I replied well does the happy hour not matter when you close after it’s done? At that point I was getting no where with the waitress so she brought over the manager. He also stated that you need to ask for the happy hour menu in order to get the items at happy hour price even though they had the info online, a sign outside their front doors and we ordered the exact things on the happy hour menu. He stated that he doesn’t know if people want the happy hour prices if they don’t specifically ask for it, so I asked him why he would assume people don’t want to save…
Everything was okay but when music started was told very rudely my little one couldnt be on the dance floor. While the dance floor was empty only had one person on it.
Se pasa muy buen rato, no es costoso, atención de primera la comida increíble y el ambiente excelente 👌

Cuba Libre, Cambridge UK* *مکس ریویو*: - *پلس*: Food lovely، Cuban music، atmosphere nice - *مائنس*: سروس سلو، 40 منٹ انتظار۔ 12.5% ٹپ پہلے سے لگ جاتی ہے 46cf *نوٹ*: اگر آپ Karachi میں "Cuba Libre" ڈھونڈ رہے ہیں تو وہاں ابھی کوئی برانچ نہیں ہے۔ آپ شاید "Cuba Libre Drink" والا کوئی کیفے ڈھونڈ رہے ہوں؟ آپ کس شہر کا Cuba Libre پوچھ رہے ہیں - Karachi, Lahore, یا باہر کا؟ نام بتائیں تو میں exact location + مینو بھی نکال دوں گا۔

We stayed in a non smoking room but as soon as we walked in we could smell chlorine due to the ac being on and the pool being right in front of our room, but later then we could smell cigarettes so we had to turn off the ac and we were hot all night because we couldn’t stand those two smells. Just as we thought that was bad enough, it was time for bed so as i’m getting into the bed, I pull the covers and notice that there sand. On the bed! We had such a long day we had no energy to switch rooms. Wish I had though. The people next door were up ALL night talking loud, and you could hear them throwing up. Amazing four course St.Patrick's Day lunch! Chef Michael definitely knows fine dining. The atmosphere, service, and food was excellent. I was also pleasantly surprised that Chef Michael has house made Sangria flavors on the beverage menu! Very special Sangria, my favorite is the Blueberry Citrus, but the Triple Berry Sangria was very good as well. Never had anything like this Sangria before, the flavors are very balanced. He should sell it in stores. My husband and I had a wonderful dining experience. Next time we visit we hope to try the famous French Onion Soup! Definitely one of the best restaurants in Central Florida!
St Pattys 4 course meal was amazing. Chef Michael worked the room like a pro and the food was exceptional! 10/10cwould do again!!
French onion soup in a bread bowl comfort food,

Not our first time here, but first time with subpar service and food. Hopefully was a 1 off, as always had good service and food before. Came in Sunday for lunch, quickly sat, greating not too far afterwards. But ordered app and 2 types of tacos, both tacos came out before the app, tacos were horrible - shimp chewy on one set, and fish was so over seasoned you could not taste anything but. Server told about the issue, says oh thats not good and walked away. No other offers to correct, no offers for more drinks or anything. Then when he came back with out check and took both plates of uneaten food he advised "I took 10% off your bill for you" - I was not looking for a discount, I was looking for edible lunch. Usually get good service and great food, maybe a bad day for server and cook - i dont know.
This is the pinnacle of FL beach vibes. The staff, drinks and food are great, it's on the beach itself, the atmosphere, music and people are fantastic.

Madilyn (I think, but we kept calling her madison) was wonderful and patient with our table of 7. She gave good recommendations and knew the menu well. The food was great but I do wish the jerk seasoning had more cayenne. It was still tasty nonetheless. The salsa was good and chunky too!
Great experience
Great atmosphere, fast service and great food. The drinks where nice and strong as well.

We had an amazing experience at Coconuts on the Beach! The food and service were both excellent. Our waitress, Shay, was fantastic—friendly, attentive, and gave us great recommendations. We ordered the grouper tacos and the mahi bowl, and both were absolutely delicious. For dessert, the pineapple crème brûlée was incredible, and the signature frozen drink, the Pain in the Ass, was the perfect beach cocktail. The ocean views are beautiful, creating the perfect atmosphere to relax and enjoy a meal. We also really appreciated that they’re service dog friendly, which made our visit even more enjoyable. If you’re in Cocoa Beach, Coconuts on the Beach is definitely worth a visit. We’ll absolutely be back!

If I could leave zero stars I would. I was told my group of 5 just had to come here to eat. From the moment we came in we were met with sub-par customer service and then less than sub-par food. Our waitress, Olivia, was half asleep and no help at all and a bit snarky when we were paying the bill. The scallops had “sand” or let’s hope all it was sand in them. So they were dirty. The other plate of Shrimp Scampi, the noodles were way over cooked. I believe mine just had a gallon of sauce poured on my plate. I cannot even begin to talk about the other two plates of food. This is a popular place and yet we all walked away just feeling blah about our whole experience. Do better. Do better.
If there is a launch at the Cape, this is the place to be, fantastic. Food is ok but your are there for the view, it's a beach bar and a busy one.
Outstanding cocktails and service!
Still a favorite after all these years!
Everyone was so nice and helpful!! We will be back again!! Food was fabulous!!

In town for a few day and decided to try Coconuts on the Beach. The wait for a table was about 20 minutes on a Thursday evening. The staff was friendly and pretty prompt (it was very busy), food arrived quickly and fresh, it was also pretty amazing! Would definitely return and highly recommend stopping here if in town.

Jerk Mahi is highly recommended! The fish dip was excellent and the shrimp and scampi appetizer didn't disappoint!! Jerk Grouper tacos were tasty too. Our group of 10 had an amazing server! Be sure to buy the cooks a shot!! We included our server, she was very thankful (said that has never happened)🙂

If you go for a birthday make sure to not pay bills before getting the cake. I went for my wife’s 40th and after about 5 times reminding the waiter about the cake he thought it was smarter to charge everyone before the happy birthday which made people think night was over and start leaving. Do NOT celebrate a birthday there.
The corn and crawfish chowder was incredible. Great selection of tasty frozen drinks and a lovely view of the beach.

We went here to start our trip to the Cape Canaveral/Cocoa Beach area and we do not regret it! Our waitress, Lisa, was super nice and friendly. Our food came within 10 minutes of ordering, too! I ordered the 10 wings made in BBQ sauce with ranch. I finished all of them and they were excellent! My grandma got Coconut Shrimp and says it was awesome and she loved the curry sauce with it. My grandpa got the Cod Sandwich and says it was wonderful. Also, the environment, both with the beach and some funny low-flying birds really demonstrated an excellent restaurant with a wonderful atmosphere.
Would have given it 5 stars but someone there tried to scam me with taking a photo then charging 20 dollars and kept pressuring me on it. absolute scam, will never willfully go here again.
I love everything about that Beach
I ordered chicken tenders, and they do not have honey mustard. I have never been to a restaurant that does not have that flavor.
Great food and good prices
It took 2 hours to get food

Beautiful restaurant with a great staff. I love the fact they cater to people with allergies. My neice cannot really eat out anywhere, they cater to her allergy needs and she can eat safely here. Fabulous restaurant!

We had our anniversary dinner at Corkscrew and the team could not have been any nicer. Jonathan made sure we had a great table, Tristan was a fantastic waiter, and the meal was amazing. The place was packed when we first arrived but they still managed to make us feel special. I am now a “raving fan” of this place. Total class act.

First time in & I will be back! Bartenders, Nick and Kyle were great. I started with the guacamole which was extremely fresh. Then for my entree I got the Parmesan crusted mahi. Every bite was delicious. The place is clean and has a good atmosphere to it. Excited to try more!
Super Essen. Sehr nette Bedienung und super Margaritas.
Greatest food experience ever, Sarah was an awesome waitress, and the food here was phenomenal.

The food was delicious, perfectly portioned, and equally filling. The decorations were detailed and fun. They had gluten free options, which was nice. 5/5 stars, would recommend!!❤️ (P.S. the B.L.T.A. is a good option if you want something simple, and it's cheaper.)
Stellar menu and service. One of my favorite places in Florida.

First time finally getting to try this place after so many people recommended it to me. I went for lunch and there were 4 of us. While it was hot outside, we decided to sit outside because the environment with landscaping is beautiful and the breezes were terrific. Service was prompt and friendly. I tried the Corkscrew Burger and fries. Pictured here. It was great. I would have like a bit more flavor in the meat and grilling the pineapple would have been much better, but it was a huge burger and cooked exactly the way I asked. The BLT was for my friend. He was only able to eat half of it. He said it was terrific and everything was very fresh. I will definitely be back to try more of the menu and to dine inside for a dinner. For lunch, I recommend it without any question.
This is one of my favorite places for lunch in New Smyrna Beach. Their curry chicken salad is the best I have ever had!

Great food, nice atmosphere, would definitely try again. Had prime steak Philly and buttermilk chicken sandwich. Had to take both home as we had a starter of pretzel sticks, which we very good but filling.

The food is delicious. The service is way above par. Our server was David and he was just a delight. I will definitely keep coming here and if you do be nice. The folks are deserving of everyone’s best behavior.
Atmosphere,food and service SPOT ON!!!
Amazing service and food! Top notch!!

I wanted to try a different restaurant and A friend recommended as a nice place and said the food was “ok”. So My first time visiting Corkscrew Bar and Grille and I agreed with her. The food wasn’t bad but was just OK and average. The atmosphere was awesome! Nice Upscale. I would probably only go back if I went with others that specifically wanted to go there. They also offer outside seating. Pretty pricey.
Awesome food an margaritas
Never let's me down! Meal is always fresh, hot and tasty.

I had a BLT with the bacon on the side it was very good my wife had the avocado chicken she said it was good, the sweet potato chips are very good we also had the cod fish bites I forget what they called them they were okay I thought they were undercooked but we didn't want to send them back service was very good we would definitely return.
Might have been our best meal of the year (7 of us went). I had the grouper special, amazing. Exceptional service, very fair pricing, just a little bit loud inside.

Stopped in for the first time with family. Loved the atmosphere-and service was on point. My BLTA (BLT with avocado) on toasted sourdough was delicious. Blackened shrimp spring salad was flavorful, but curry chicken stuffed avocado fell a little flat. Menu had a nice selection of meal options. Parking lot was full but we were seated right away. Overall a decent dinner experience.

My daughter surprised me for my birthday and flew in to celebrate with my husband and me. We decided to go to the beach for a few days and stopped for dinner. So glad we did. The atmosphere was perfect for enjoying time together and the food was delicious. We loved our cocktails and the Caymus! We don’t see it on menus by the glass and it’s one of my favorites. Kate was our server and she was excellent! She was attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. She was very helpful with recommendations, including the amaretto almond cake for our dessert which was over the top delicious. Thanks Kate for helping to make my birthday with my daughter one I’ll always remember.

I went here with a group of friends and ordered the Victoria’s Spaghetti. When asked if I wanted to add meatballs, I said yes. The food came out with one giant meatball and when the bill came out there was an extra ten dollar charge that was not disclosed when I ordered the meatball. The server did not disclose this to anyone at the table, nor were we aware of the forced gratuity. I have no problem tipping, but for a waiter to mislead us into spending more in order to receive a bigger tip absurd. Those 10 dollars would have went to my portion of the tip, but instead we were forced to spend more for no reason.
Impressed! Food was authentic and delicious! Reasonably priced! Great ambience!
Amazing food and service!
Great
The BEST food and service! Everything is made from scratch and it’s phenomenal. 10/10.

Ate here twice. First experience was outstanding! Food and service was outstanding. Not the case the second time. My lasagna was over cooked. Noodle was crispy and charred. Too long under broiler? My wifes eggplant parmesian was also overcooked. Very noisy and busy. Suggest if you go here go at an off time. Convention Center was nearby so it was busy with conventioneers.
I hosted my wedding rehearsal lunch at Mia’s it was great ! The host were amazing drinks and food were delicious. I will definitely book again. 10/10 all around ♥️
Food reasonable but I've had better. In keeping with most of the food I've had in America, far too salty. The pizza's are snack sized and the pasta overcooked. Very noisy.

Made a reservation and was accommodated immediately by hostess Madison and Melissa. Waiter’s name was Daniel and he was an ace. Accommodated every off menu request we had, even getting my father a custom dessert. Would come here again without a doubt. Asking for Daniel next time!

The waiters were very nice, drinks came fast and food came quicker than normal resteraunts and the appetizers were great! I went here on my birthday and the waiter wished me a happy birthday and gave me a tisumara cake with a candle.

The service was great for ordering and serving drinks and plates. My son and I ordered the same plate, Rigatoni Bolognese. This is a plate we regularly order at multiple Italian restaurants. We were told that everything is made from scratch and that the place has the best pasta in Orlando. We started eating, but my son noticed the red pepper spice flavor we hadn't been told was in the sauce. He couldn't finish the plate because of how spicy it was. I was able to eat it. After that, we both went home feeling that something was not ok with the food that we had just eaten. Both had very poor digestion of the food, and my son started feeling unwell. We had to get medication to cut the upset stomach. Don't know if it was the amount of spice in the sauce or something in the meat, but we definitely won't come back.
I ordered the Bolognese Lasagna it was delicious. However, it was burnt under the bottom which took away from the delicious desire.

It was our 1st time visiting Mia's Kitchen, and it was phenomenal! We sat at the Pizza Bar which was really cool. Our server, Roger was outstanding! He was so friendly, patient, and efficient! The food was unbelievably amazing! They have the Best happy hour for food and drinks! We will definitely be back.

Mia Italian Kitchen was absolutely amazing! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentically Italian, with generous portions that left everyone satisfied. Every dish was beautifully prepared, and you can tell great care goes into both the ingredients and presentation. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made our dining experience feel special from start to finish. Whether you’re looking for a date night spot, a family dinner, or a place to celebrate with friends, this is a restaurant worth visiting. We will definitely be back the next time we’re in the area. Highly recommend! 🍝🍷✨

Great experience, the family meal is great, $39 per person and you share everything, includes salad and dessert plus 5 items of your choice for starters or entrees. It was a great experience, we left there really full and will definitely come back!

After making a reservation a day in advance and arriving promptly on time, I waited 15+ minutes to be seated. Kind of defeats the point of a reservation, we were addressed as though we had just walked in and had no prior reservation at all. Got to the point where we just decided to leave and not eat at all.
I love it here! The food is always fresh and delicious, get the all you can eat brunch, some sangrias and bring your friends 10/10

This place is absolutely beautiful and the food was amazing. Our server, Desiree, was so wonderful and patient with me. She truly is an asset to this restaurant. She helped make my birthday dinner special. Can’t wait to come back to eat and see her again. Thank you so much :)

We were there for work dinner. Got stuck with an older Indian server who was terrible at his job (my guess is they stuck us with the worst server knowing he'll get automatic gratuity with a large party). He got our orders wrong and was very sloppy clearing table.

We have been traveling over an hour and a half to come to Mias for 5 years in a row! We went on 6/20/2026 for father's day dinner and had reservations and the experience was not good this time! We ordered 2 meatballs that were still good but not as good as previous ones. The entrees were definitely not the same quality as before. Also our waitress was horrible....... she never refilled our drinks our food order took forever to put in and we waited over an hour for our entrees. I'm sad to say we will not be returning! The 256$ we spent was not worth it this time!
Food was amazing! The Summer Citrus Sangria was incredible and the server Jennifer B was exceptional! Thanks! I enjoyed the place
Food was amazing! The Italian Sangria was incredible and the server Jennifer B was exceptional! Thanks! I enjoyed the place

We recently hosted our end-of-season volleyball team dinner at Mia’s Italian Kitchen for a group of about 45 people, and the experience exceeded our expectations. We chose the family-style dinner, and the food was fantastic with plenty of delicious options at a very reasonable price point. Planning an event for a large group can be stressful, but Harriet, the Event Sales Manager, made the entire process seamless. She was responsive, friendly, accommodating to our requests, and truly a pleasure to work with from start to finish. The wait staff was equally wonderful—attentive, welcoming, and great with both the kids and adults in our group. The ambiance was perfect, and the private area in the back provided more than enough space for everyone to comfortably gather and celebrate. If you’re looking for a venue for a team dinner, family gathering, or large group event, I highly recommend Mia’s Italian Kitchen. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience! 🍝🏐🎉
Lots of food and always a hit service is on poibt too , try ir but make sure you are hungry
Second time coming in today! The service was awesome! Thank You Kyle!
Kyle is the best waiter EVER! The Beef Bolognese Lasagna is really good.

We celebrated both Mother's Day and my Birthday on 2 separate occasions. We enjoyed their Bottomless Brunch both times. Our waitress Zoe and waiter Francisco were amazing, friendly, informative and very knowledgeable of the menu. Everything is made fresh in-house to include their pasta. The beautiful art on the walls and ceiling created an artsy feel taking your eyes on a journey through Italy, including a beautiful wine bottle chandelier. My number 1 favorite was the breakfast Bruschetta, it was incredibly fresh, vibrant, delicious, and woke up my taste buds on all levels. I could eat that everyday. My second favorite could almost tie with my number 1 favorite and that was the Fungi & Tartufo Pizza, it was insanely delicious with robust flavors of garlic, black truffle-buttermilk crema and fresh herbs. I ordered 2 of them. The Banana French Toast hit every delicious mark. The Italian Scramble was cooked to perfection with bold and fresh flavors. Mia's Signature Meatball Benedict might have sounded strange but I assure you that as I cut into the perfectly poached egg the creaminess of the egg over the meatball was rich and pleasant tasting. The freshness of ingredients made the Sausage & Peppers pizza over the top, said my husband. House Made Pasta dish called Rigatoni Alla Bolognese was divine and again you could taste the freshness in all the ingredients.They have an outstanding red sauce. Lastly, we ended with both the Tiramisu and the Cannoli, both again made in-house.…
Great food, lovely staff
Amanda was an excellent server! Great service and great food
Amanda is so great we love her. give her a raise!! 💗
Amanda was the best server she needs a raise. we love her
Food was great. Service great. Food was a little over priced but was good
Great food. Found it on my last night in town. I would of come back again. Oh well next time!! Gator was wonderful, even my picky daughter liked it. Biggest chicken sandwich ever!!!

We came to Cocoa for a few days after an exhausting Universal trip. My mom suggested we go here as she had been in the past. Well we loved it so much the first day that we ended up there all 3 days we were in town. The best staff around. Our waitress Mary Kate was the kindest and sweetest! Our experience with her is part of why we came back. Also, where else could you get $1 mimosas on a Sunday?!? Also as someone who loves Cajun food, highly suggest the gumbo. One last thing - the gator tank is adorable.

Chrissy at Cocoa Beach Fish Camp Grill was our server, and she was absolutely amazing! She gave us five-star service across the board. She was so nice, sweet, attentive, and helpful the entire time. The shots were perfect — you couldn’t even taste the alcohol, but they were still just right. It really felt like paradise. Chrissy also gave us great tips on where to go next, like the Sandbar and other fun places uptown in Cocoa Beach, which we really appreciated. The environment inside the restaurant felt very family-oriented. There were kids singing karaoke, playing arcade games, and adults playing pool, so it had a lively and fun atmosphere. I will say, the songs I originally wanted to sing didn’t really fit the environment, but I still appreciated the overall vibe. Overall, it was a great experience with amazing service. Chrissy definitely deserves five stars across the board!

Fried catfish sandwich good but too much bread and server tried hard but was not readily available but she was so sweet..atmosphere very fun but not a place for younger children after 8pm..drinks watered down.we dined in.
For a fish camp I was surprised that they had no other seafood other than fish and a couple different shrimp orders

Cool (elevated) fish camp vibe right across from the world famous Cocoa Beach pier! Great renovation from Durango's Steak House days inside and great outside backporch bar space as well. Best bolied peanuts (outside of fork-in-the-road old man in a pickup) and awesome menu, everything very good if not great. Best HH on the Cape, with 1/2 price on all drinks from 2-5 Mon to Fri and great daily specials (esp Wed rib night). Awesome staff (shout-out to Candice, Skylar, Tawney, Sierra, and Nikki) and awesome outside deck/bar, especially in the evenings when the sun is behind the building.
This place has a GREAT atmosphere and the waitresses were so very nice. Such good food and good music. Definitely recommend!

We stopped in because the place was packed, so we assumed the food would be great. Unfortunately, after talking with the other 12 people in our party, most were disappointed with their meals. My pulled pork sandwich was decent, though a bit fatty. The service was also lacking. Our waitress was inattentive and never offered drink refills. The water had such a strong chlorine taste that even the sodas tasted off. She didn't seem to notice or ask why several people barely touched their meals, including large bowls of mac and cheese, a salad, and a chicken sandwich. The restaurant was busy and clearly popular, but our experience didn't live up to the crowd. No live entertainment when we were there on a Friday for dinner, they had 2 pool tables that couldn't be used, and a few old games to play in the back room.

Great food, had frog legs, mardi gras something or other and shrimp and grits. Super tasty and a LOT of food. Only reason a 4/5 on atmosphere is nothing on the restaurant it was more about me because I hate seeing people live streaming their meals which someone was. Will go back!

14 of us visited on June 18th and unfortunately, down to the fountain drinks were so bad. Im giving it a 3 star because of the the staff and atmosphere. I hope whomever sees this review understands that they are doing their great staff and atmosphere a disservice by having food that tastes so bad. All 14 of us ranging from older to younger was ridiculously shocked. Also, please check the system for the drinks because everything taste like bad tap water with a hint of soda/juice.
Great selection of food. Staff were reasonably attentive and the surroundings were pleasant.
Always a good relaxing place

What an awesome find right at our hotel! Our server Amanda was great, the food was as superb as the drinks, and the 50% off topped off the night! Our next visit will definitely be for the fresh gator bites!
We had such a wonderful night at the Fish Camp Grill! Terrell was on Keys and was amazing! Our waitress was amazing! The food, best Mac and cheese I’ve ever had! Will definitely be back!
Great spot! Food is amazing, and staff was wonderful!
Food not great. The piano bar performance and atmosphere was excellent and very different for us

Love it to the fullest, entertainment, service, food was so....good. just awesome. I can't wait to get back
Great food, great service.
Yuck. Never again
