Good food but price a a little high.

Never thought I’d have anything bad to say about Culver’s because I’ve always loved their custard. Unfortunately, this location was a huge disappointment. The problems started when they didn’t listen to my order. I ordered a chocolate malt, but was given vanilla custard with chocolate syrup mixed in instead. When I politely asked for it to be remade, it seemed like they simply added more syrup and insisted it had been redone. It still wasn’t the chocolate malt I ordered. Mistakes happen, but the lack of attention to the order and unwillingness to correct it properly was unusual and frustrating. Won’t be back. Shout out to whoever is taking care of the plants outside. The flowers are lovely.
Food was good, inside was dirty.

I generally love Culver’s, but this location is awful. I was given someone else’s drinks, was not given the fries I ordered, the burgers were over cooked, and was given a plain burger without condiments.
Delicious burgers.
For the last couple of times I've gone to Culver's the hamburgers have been cold. Like at least microwave it.

Service energy was on point right out of the gate. The young workers appeared to be genuinely excited to be there. The food was great too, deluxe fast faire. (Can heavily recommend the cheese curds.) Eating space and bathrooms were clean. Overall, first time experience at a Culver's wowed me. Wish we had one in my city.
Love this place! Best staff the burgers are always on point!
Very good food and service. These prices are good. Wish there was one in Vista lakes.

Pleasant staff. Ordered the Butter burger with cheese. Not impressed with it. Loved the onion rings. The cheese curds were ok. Since not completing my burger I ordered the Walleyed. That was very good. A bit oily but really good. The company was amazing. A person in my party said the Ruben was good. Love the Boom Boom sauce.

Every floor in the restaurant is sticky. Somebody needs to figure out how to mop correctly. Also, service was really slow. 12 minutes from order until my food was ready. It’s supposed to be fast food.

Food was delicious and the drinks were great as well. The only thing I would suggest is considering adding an air-conditioned dining option so guests can choose between enjoying the deck or being comfortable indoors. We ended up rushing through our meal because it was just too hot in the middle of the day with a heat index of 100+ degrees to fully relax and enjoy our time there. Other than that, we had a great experience!
Very friendly and fast service.
Amazing fish, fantastic atmosphere and super service! Kudos to Addi!!!!
Excellent atmosphere with good service crab cakes were average.
We've been going here for years. It's a terrific place on the water. Friendly service, great food!

great place, screaming birds that flew in brightened the mood alot, not very busy on wednessday at 2pm, scalops were great and they gave alot, fries were good, crab cake is good, i enjoyed everything, and they even gave me a personal pitcher of tea
1/2 n 1/2 Shrimp n Crab Legs was some of the best I've ever had! Definitely order extra huspuppies.

Service time I have eaten here in the past month First meal of scallops was wonderful ! Today I had clam chowder and was a bit disappointed. I am accustomed to smaller diced potatoes ... And more clams goodness. I will try a different menu selection on my next visit !
Food was good and sitting by the water was fun to watch the staff throw fries at the catfish. Would not recommend the stuff and tuff taste like microwave dinner

Did takeout of fried fish, boiled shrimp, seafood platter, shrimp wrap. Shrimp were absolutely HORRIBLE and un-edible. NOT deveined, mushy and fell apart when you tried to peel them,,,,nothing but Trash! Fish sandwich was limp fried fish and No flavor. DON'T eat here unless you are dining in so that they don't serve you crap.

First, there is no air conditioning except in the restroom. The service was great because all servers cover everyone so for example a guy with refresher water was going table to table. Our table server was efficient and checked with the kitchen on questions we had. The ribs and vegetarian sandwich were very good. However they didn't bake on the sause on the ribs, just slathered it, so it wasn't caramelized. The onion rings are very good. The pups are even better. Cole slaw is a large helping and it was quite tasty. Up front if you offer to pay cash you get a half pound of shrimp free. They are tasty, but a little spicy, and unfortunately you have to peel them, and trust me, that was not easy. I am not sure if you could get them cold, but you could ask.
The food, service, and vibes here are always fantastic.

Great location and service. Just eat before you go. Had the platter. The grits were amazing, everything else was frozen. Nothing local or fresh. Stay away from the fried items on the nenu and you might be ok.

Food: 2/5 Service: 5/5 Atmosphere: 4/5 We visited on a Saturday around 5 p.m. and only waited about five minutes for a table (we didn'thave a preference sitting inside or outside). The service was easily the highlight of the entire experience. The staff works as a true team—multiple people check on you, take orders, refill drinks, and make sure you never need to flag anyone down. Not once did we wait for anything, and my absolute favorite part: we never had to worry about getting a refill. We took advantage of the free steamed shrimp basket for paying $25 in cash. The shrimp tasted good but were a bit hard to peel. The hush puppies, though, were the standout—they should be what this place is known for. Our group ordered fish, crab cakes, and a burger. The crab cakes were a little dry and really needed a sauce, but lemon helped. The mahi mahi was good. Flounder was only available fried, so we chose a different fish sandwich, which turned out good as well. The burger and fries were exactly what you’d expect—solid but nothing memorable. Overall, everything was fine, but nothing really wowed us. The atmosphere was great. Even sitting inside, you still get nice views, and the fans kept the space cool so it never felt hot. I rated it 4 stars only because our table was lopsided and kept wobbling and rotating, which was frustrating but manageable. Service alone made the visit worthwhile, but the food didn’t quite match the level of hospitality.
Beautiful view on the deck. Had blackened Mahi Mahi. Excellent.
Great riverside restaraunt and bar. MAHI sandwhich Mondays, Great price and really good food. At at bar Great service too. True beach atmosphere.
Great food and location Family friendly. Highly recommended.
Cool place 😎
We were there for lunch the food wasn’t good also watch you tipping they will add to your tip. They did ours and didn’t catch until my credit card bill came in

My family and I stayed at Coronado Springs for 7 night and could not have asked for more. We stayed in Cabanas 8C. We tried food from 5 different locations within the resort and enjoyed them all. Every staff interaction was what I hoped for. The front desk staff was very knowledgeable and helpful with information regarding the resort and the parks. The grounds were beautiful and well kept. I have never experienced lifeguards that were more attentive to the swimmers. I noticed lifeguards answering guests questions while never taking their eyes off the pool. I noticed that the resort never felt chaotic or too busy. The atmosphere really allowed our family relax and enjoy our downtime.

I had a terrible experience. I purchased a complete package that included meals, the hotel stay, and tickets. The rooms were dusty and not at all nice considering the price. Regarding the meal plan—and I had chosen the most expensive one—they ended up denying me both the fast-food options and one of the sit-down meals that I had already paid for, all due to a mistake by the hotel restaurant. It was a chaotic waste of time and money. I will never stay at a hotel like this again, nor will I ever purchase a meal plan.
Great experience at resort.
Great resort. Fitness centers. Very very big. Total acreage more than magic kingdom. 2000+ rooms. Great places to eat. Will stay here again if possible.

This was my first visit to Coronado and I absolutely loved it. This was my first trip as an independent adult and Coronado was the perfect place for me and my girlfriend to visit. The restaurant we went to on the resort was the three bridges and the food was unbelievable. The breakfast had a great variety of options that were all fantastic. The pool was fantastic and for such a large resort it was easily accessible to get to the lobby from where we were located.

We absolutely loved our stay at Coronado Springs! The room was gorgeous and extremely clean and we had plenty of space. We loved how much storage there was as well! Plenty of drawers, a small closet, shelves in the room as well as the bathroom, and plenty of counter space in both the main room and the bathroom. The resort as a whole is absolutely stunning. The layout is nice and even though the resort is quite large, it’s not that far of a walk to get anywhere thanks to the bridges over the lake. We stayed in the Casitas Village and had a perfect location - very short walk across the parking lot to the bus stop, short walk the opposite direction to the gift shop & restaurants. The resort and room were very nicely decorated with just a hint of Disney. We liked that it was not so “in your face” like some of the value resorts and feels more like a luxury resort.
This place was awesome, the facilities were clean and safe. Service was impeccable, and the food at every venue was great.
Great stay and a wonderful time with family. We’ll do it again.

The hotel is very beautiful, ample gardens that even offer fishing. The sports bar was great for watching a world cup match. The gym is a bit small and not "state of the art". but it gets the job done. Good call on the chilled towels provided. Stayed at a "rancho" style room.

Really bad experience staying here. Went to check in at 3pm - stated check in time. Had to wait for a room to become available.. Then drove to the room with the given keys and had to wait almost 30 mins till the room was opened because the keys didn’t work. All in the heat outside with a baby. Why is this place so disorganized? paying a room fee to be stranded outside the hotel waiting to be let in…. Didn’t expect this from a Disney hotel
Beautiful resort. Great dining options. Nice pool area. We stayed in Casitas 5 and the transportation was easily accessible. Highly recommend.

El mini refrigerador no enfriaba bien, llamamos para que lo arreglaran y después de arreglado siguió igual, se nos echo a perder la comida. Había cucarachas en la habitación, el aire se descompuso y tuvieron que venir arreglarlo. El día que llegamos tuvimos que ir desde el Lobby del Hotel hasta nuestra cabaña empujando todo nuestro equipaje que era bastante, nadie nos ayudó ni nos llevaron en algún carro de golf de los que allí habían en el Hotel que eran bastantes, ni el que nos recibió en el Lobby nos dijo nada sobre algún servicio de ayuda para transporte hacia nuestra cabaña. Nos demoramos tanto desde que llegamos al Lobby del Hotel y hasta que llegamos a nuestro cuarto que perdimos el día gratis en el parque acuático, que es una estafa eso también de darte un parque acuático gratis el primer dia si cierra a la 7:00 pm el parque acuático y ellos no saben a que horas uno llega al Hotel de su viaje, lo pedimos para otro día explicando lo que nos pasó y no nos lo dieron, entonces no era gratis, es una estafa permitida bien planificada. No fue nada agradable nuestra estancia.

First time staying at this resort in Disney World, we loved the property. Our room was fine at first, then our 2nd day the water in our room shut off while my husband was in the shower, then when the water did come back on it was running brown in the shower, and both sinks. I had to call a couple of times to reach the actual front desk, the first response was to "let it run for a while", we were then offered to move rooms, but we only had one more full day at the resort, so that was not a good option for us. We were quite underwhelmed with the service we received at the restaurants we dined at. The 3 bridges was just ok, our server seemed mad the whole time and by the time we got our drinks the beers were luke warm. Michael at the pool bar was the friendliest employee that we had an interaction with. He actually engaged with you and had conversation. The resort itself is very close to all of the Disney parks, we used the buses and never had to wait longer than 5 minutes, coming or going. We stayed in the cabanas; it was quite a long walk to the quick service and dining areas. We got the refillable cups, and I don't think we got our money's worth, because it was so far to walk just to get a refill. We probably could have stayed closer to the food area, but since it was our first time there, we were not aware how spread out everything was.

The rooms were fine. Our fourth-floor room was very far from the elevator and stairs. In fact, to find the correct elevator you had to walk around the entire building to find the one that goes to the fourth floor.
All of us enjoyed our stay at the Coronado Springs Resort. From the Mexican theme to the spacious rooms & lovely customer service. Close to all the attractions in Disney.
Great stay, everyone was very nice and helpful. Two small things - the gate to let guests back in - was a bit difficult for me to tap the room card. Also would have helped if the room had microwaves.

The room was an okay size, but needed a table & chairs. The first night, we requested more towels and washcloths, but they never came. The location of our room was quiet and peaceful, but a bit of a walk. We would’ve preferred to be closer to the bus and to the tower.

Their customer services is lacking in the department that includes the bell person as well. If you’re just staying for a day or two then it would be great but longer than 2 days- I would suggest another resort that takes care of the customers.

Corando Springs it's a great resort with a lot of restaurants and things to do. One thing I would have liked to see more of is more Disney art and around the resort, there was subtle touches but I would have liked it to be more immersive.
Only complaint is we had noisy neighbors 3 out of 4 nights. But this resort was very nice.
6/19/26 Wonderful Michelin rated restaurant. Had paella. Very good! Previous visit: Ate at Toledo restaurant on the 16th floor. Great food. Wonderful service.
The Gran Destino Tower is beautiful! Our room was large, very clean and beautiful. There were so many food options at Coronado Springs!

Unfortunately, I expected so much more from Disney. There was nothing ‘special’ about the resort. The rooms were meh (smelled a bit moldy) and I was shocked that housekeeping only comes every other day. In addition, there wasn’t even water in the rooms. The property was fine, again, nothing special. I will not return here as I expected so much more from the Disney brand.
Very nice and comfortable hotel right on Disney property!

This was my boyfriend's and I's first time staying here and once we pulled up, we fell in love instantly. Between the location of the room to things around the resort, dining options, amenities such as the pools, and how friendly the staff was from the moment we checked in till checkout. Him and I will definitely be coming back when the price fits our budget, I am now a Coronado girly for life :D

Okay............... So, it's self service park food. We had a lunch with kids and grandkids and it got the job done. Nothing fancy. But everything was edible. Ask for Ice water to refill your bottle before heading back into the park. It was noisy and crowded. But it was also airconditioned.

This place is horrible we came here and when we got here there are no tables open so one of the waiters kicked a family out who was waiting for there for us to sit and the food is nasty not worth the money at all it’s not seasoned and it sits out all day and was cold
The grilled chicken sandwich was not edible. It was hard as a rock and I couldn’t eat it. The truffle fries had a sauce that was just too much so I couldn’t stomach them. Service was AMAZING!

Our meal wasn’t great. But I’ve had meals here in years past that were very good. My recommendation is to stick to chicken tenders, burgers and fries. This time we got the patty melt and the chicken salad. They didn’t get eaten but maybe half or less. I only rated it a 3 because I’ve been here multiple times and had better. The patty melt is not recommended at all. And the salad- I don’t realize it came fully dressed with salad dressing because it doesn’t mention that on the menu. So while this trip it wasn’t great, I will still try it again in the future just not the salad or patty melt

Food is so low effort my daughter's chicken sandwich was rubber and my hamburger had been sitting under a light for who knows how long. We did a mobile order and it said it was ready but I stood at the front of the line watching all these other people getting help and getting ignored. I finally start loudly asking if anyone was working then some one finally brought our food 🥑 Pretty pricey for some garbage, gotta try harder if you wanna charge these prices. Lounge robot was cool about the only positive thing I can say about the place.

Everything was great except it took us 30 minutes to place our order because of a broken register, and it took 20 more to get our food. I am pretty sure that our situation is not the common experience though.

Facilities were very clean. Gave us halal beef on request and we did not have to make a special reservation or anything. Price wasn’t bad either. Would recommend but always ask what’s halal as it varies from beef to chicken daily
The food is very good. There is ample seating, and there is also air conditioning relief.
Food is mid. They should consider getting rid of the robot. Let some college kids sing or something. Service was good. Fast.

I'm sorry but this place is gross! I got the truffle burger while the rest of my party just got the cheeseburger. All of them were nasty. Only thing good was the fries. They have like this sort of, artificial grill taste? Maybe like liquid smoke? Either way, avoid. The little animatronic downstairs is neat though.

This is a good Magic Kingdom food option. I recommend doing mobile ordering and pick your food up, instead of waiting in a long line. They give you a pickup time after placing your order. The food prices were reasonable, and the food was good.

This restaurant was a breath of fresh air for us. A large air-conditioned indoor area with a shaded outdoor seating area to enjoy our food near Tomorrowland and the Speedway. We ate a Classic Ranch Salad with Grilled Chicken and the plant-based Patty Melt. They were lovely, really filling and a change from the usual pace of burgers and hotdogs. Our little one had some Mac and Cheese which she enjoyed too. This unique cafe hosts Sonny Eclipse from Yew Nork City too, the piano playing host inside who plays original songs that only Sonny can play! I only gave the atmosphere a 4/5 because it's a little noisy, but that's to be expected from a restaurant next to Tomorrowland.

IMO some of the worst food in Magic Kingdom. I have eaten here many times because after 8pm, only a few places are left open. But I’m done after last night. I have tried the burger, chicken sandwich, tenders, fries, fruit and salad. All horrible. Last night, I got a ranch house salad. $10. When I picked it up, there was no salad dressing. So I went to the condiment bar, there was ranch out of the pump next to the bbq sauce. It was thick and had an old taste. The lettuce was also wilted and old. I went back up the counter and asked the employee if there is any other salad dressing. The boy said “all we have is the delux ranch dressing in the packet”. I said well I didn’t even get a dressing at all with my salad, you don’t have balsamic or a house?” I told him if not, I will just take the delux ranch it should have came with. He went to go check in the back for a while, other customers were mad staring at me. Finally he comes back with an old greasy package of balsamic and says “look what I found”! Salad was already ruined with the old ranch dipping sauce. I can’t believe employees don’t even know how to do their job and the food quality is so low for the cost. Disney is outstanding for entertainment but seriously drops the ball on food. You have to really hunt for real food here: Best places to eat at MK are the egg roll stand and Harbor House where you can actually get Real vegetables. Avoids cosmic rays unless you want low quality fast food.
Excelente servicio rápido y de buen gusto 😉
Very family friendly and they even take cash

Food: love the buffalo sauce chicken strips, the regular chicken strips, but the fries tasted a little strange and the sprite tasted very metalic. Sevice: I don't know how to answer that one so I'm just gonna give it 5 Stars. Ambience: Very space themed and plus I love space themed stuff. So I would do something about the fries at Cosmic Rays Starlight Cafe and also make the beverages taste less metalic at...well everywhere at the park.

Mooi restaurant, snelle bediening, vriendelijk personeel en handig dat je met telefoon in de Disney App kunt bestellen. Wij hadden de truffel burger en frietjes met truffel saus & parmezaanse kaas. Helaas niet de smaakbeleving die we hoopte, een burger bij de MC is lekkerder... dat zegt genoeg.

For a Disney quick service restaurant, you get a nice value for your money. Chicken strips were satisfactory though you get a generous portion of fries to go along with the combo. The cast members held down the fort & were pleasant and upbeat. Seating was a little tight, easy to bump into other families. Overall great place to eat if on a tight budget at the parks.

Their chicken strips with ranch smells so good, a lady walked by while we were still in line and I can smell the tasty ranch flavor! Lines are very long and indoor seating is extremely limited. Service is pretty slow so wait time is about 15 minutes at least. Ambiance is like a food court.

We stoped by Cosmic Ray’s Cafe for a little break and food stop. We had burgers and chicken strips. The food was so so, nothing too exiting. On the nice side the prices were good and not outrageous. Pretty crowded and a bit loud. I’d say it’s OK for inexpensive stop to grab some lunch.
Mobile pickup took 10 minutes after we were notified the food was ready. Food was cold by that time. Weird smell in the building.

A bit cosmic, mostly convenient. As a quick mobile option Cosmic Ray’s is highly accessible in Tomorrowland with a straightforward, kid friendly menu. The setting itself is nice and walking in seems to still be possible as it’s meant to be a fast dining option in the park. We mobile ordered about 40 minutes out which is very helpful as you can plan things out in advance and pickup was very quick, you just showed and click you’re nearby on the app and they have it out in about 5 min or less. There’s also a water refill station in here if you need to get hydrated although it is veeeerrrryyyyy slow to fill your bottle up. We ordered the truffle-french onion burger with fries and their hand dipped fried chicken sandwich with a mandarin. The burger was, well, something. It wasn’t bad but it certainly wasn’t good, but what can you expect at Disney? It was very soggy and messily put together, not very appetizing at all to look at. The fries were much better than the burger though! As for the chicken sandwich it was much the same. The chicken looked bland but tasted average, nothing really to write home about. The mandarin was quite literally a mandarin so nothing to say about that. Cosmic Ray’s is what it’s meant to be: quick, entertaining (singing alien playing piano), and affordable. As a cheaper, lightning quick option for those who plan ahead or as a kid friendly pitstop amongst the chaos, this a good option for anyone in the area to stop by for some fuel.
Everything was fine at this cafe. Very hard to find a seat
Grest price for.the amount of food u get...It was def good and well worth comin here to eat with plenty of places to sit and eat
Fantastic food, great service, cute place to have a nice meal. Will 100% return.

Coffee and water was brought by 2 different waitressess. Our coffee creamer was curdled. The place was practically empty. Waited over 10 minutes and no one came to take our order. When we got up and left and mentioned no one came to take our order one of the waitresses was VERY rude. Went to pay for coffees and we mentioned to the waitress that brought our coffees that she never came to take our order. Said they share, we said why didn’t anyone take our order. She didn’t have a response. Left and went to McDonald’s for breakfast.
Food was good. It was made prior and heated up. Price was a little high. But overall good.

This is a really nice shop. Some really cool items and gifts for everyone in the family. I picked up one of the seasonings. It's a really cool line. The seasoning that I got was to help prepare ribs. And tasted absolutely amazing. Definitely stop by and check this place out. If you're in the area. You'll definitely find something you'll want to take home or give as a gift to somebody. The customer service is very friendly and not pushy. Walk in, grab a frozen wine slushy, and shop.
adorable little restauran… A coffee, yummy and the muffin was warm to perfection!
Love this place.

Started walking downtown Mt. Dora and stopped by this quaint cafe. Sat outside and enjoyed their breakfast sandwiches. The little fruit cups were full of exquisite sweet fruit. Friendly staff and good food.
A great little breakfast spot. Bonus points for the quiches being gluten free for those with celiacs or other gluten issues. We visited twice while we were in town!!
The closest thing I've experienced to a perfect restaurant. Great food and great staff in a wonderful atmosphere. This'll be our new go to place in Mount Dora.
We got the BLT on an everything bagel. Cute atmosphere and great service!
Coffee is super fresh and pure. We loved it! Thanks

Food was good, not great. Service wasn't the best, too busy chatting about personal issues that could be heard by most. Never checked back on coffee refills. Because it's downtown Dora, parking isn't the greatest.

We eat at Cody’s once a month. Their breakfast sandwiches are always excellent. Today we had asparagus quiche & bacon & mushroom quiche with a side of clam chowder. Both quiches were very salty with little other taste and the soup was heart but too watery. We were very disappointed today.

I am 49 years old and have never left a poor review. Today was the 2nd time I got run out at 1:45 in the afternoon. The sign says they are open and posted operating hours are until 2:00. Clearly they close sometime in the 1:00 hour. I’ve been looking for a favorite place to replace the One Flight Up restaurant that closed a while back. Well this isn’t it! They could care less about their customers. You should have seen her face when she noticed I sat down at roughly 1:50. I don’t know if they are afraid of work or afraid of paying their people. It’s a cute place but I couldn’t tell you how the food is. I was looking for good food and a small town feel and this isn’t it. If this continues it won’t last. Maybe something that stays open longer to serve the Community will take its place. I learned a long time ago to do it right or don’t do it at all and half hearted commitment shows worse than anything. There are lessons to learn here! The Salted Fry is great and bus at 2:40pm. Mount Dora has a lot of options!
The crustless farmer’s quiche was delicious! I also enjoyed the cappuccino. There were several quiche options along with many other menu choices. Fast and friendly service too! A 5+ in my book!
Had a club with ham and potato soup. Delicious! Polites staff, clean and homey feeling.

Wow. Such a great spot to relax and enjoy the conversation with the staff. The food was excellent, the Cobb Salad was fresh and the Tomato Basil soup was hot, along with the Grilled Cheese sandwich was amazing. If you are in Mount Dora, you must stop in and meet the folks inside.
Great breakfast spot with tasty food and good lattes too!
Great!

Unexpected disappointment! We went there a day before ( after reading a few reviews ) for coffee (really good latte) and were told that everything is made inhouse and items are fresh. Wow.. What a different experience the next morning. We order: - Drip coffee. It was OK. - Two Croissant sandwiches. The croissant was not fresh. It tasted like the ones from Costco (but smaller) that have been purchased 4 days before. Be ware: Every item is in at a smaller scale with a big price tag (tourist trap).

Unfortunately we went in for breakfast at 10:30am. They advertise breakfast until 11. It is printed on the menus in fact. No breakfast available. Sadly this is not the first time that this has happened to me. I love the food here but the somewhat arbitrary hours are puzzling

The owner, Cody, is the rudest business owner I have EVER come across in my lifetime! And Im in my 60's. I was in this small sandwich shop picking up a $90 business lunch (sandwiches) and either did not get a receipt or misplaced it. After trying to call at least 15 times ( no one answers phone) I got a wait staff on the phone. They said they might be able to get the receipt. After not hearing back the next day, I called and asked for the owner- I politely asked if I could get a copy of the receipt and she said NO, they cant do it and hung up on me. I was in shock. I will NEVER go here and will let ALL my physician customers and others in the area know to NOT patronize this place. I am APPALLED THE owner would not help! Unbelievable.
Fresh and delicious! Enjoy! This place won’t disappoint
Delicious and very efficient/attentive service.
Great steak, delicious sides and a nice upscale atmosphere

Just not impressed for the price point. Food was mediocre at best. Came out luke warm. I don't often go out to dinner with my 3 adult kids due to hard for all of us to get together, so did not voice anything to restaurant and just enjoyed seeing them, but wont be back. I would chose Ruth's Chris, Ocean Prime or even Outback over Del Frisco's.
My wife and I were very happy with the whole experience. Food was on point and the waiter was knowledgeable on wines 🍷. We'll be back again

We hosted a private happy hour event last night, and James and Amanda were absolutely fantastic. From start to finish, they were friendly, attentive, professional and genuinely pleasant to work with. They handled our group with ease, stayed on top of food and drink service, and made sure everyone felt taken care of throughout the evening. Even during busy moments, they remained calm, organized and incredibly kind. Their positive attitudes and attention to detail played a huge role in making our event a success. Thank you, James and Amanda, for helping create such a memorable experience for our guests. We truly appreciated your hard work and hospitality and would be thrilled to work with you again in the future!

The service was indescribable! Jean Pierre was AWESOME! Steak was tender and juicy with truffle butter sauce. Fantastic time. Ask for a more private section if you want it quieter. Definitely recommend. Steak ! Blue cheese wedge salad! Butter cake!
We had about 50 people in our party and had an amazing event. Debbi and her entire team were fantastic. Food And Service was absolutely perfect.

Food was good, had the salmon dish with the spinach, which paired up nicely. Service was ok, our food took about 45 min. We were in the restaurant for about 2.5 hours, which was just too long since we had an itinerary to follow. Also our server was also not the nicest, it broke my heart when he raised his tone to another colleague when the plates were being brought out. In an high and rude tone he told him why hadn’t all the plates been brought out at the same time, the poor man with the large plate was already full of dishes. Any person that saw him would’ve noticed. Atmosphere was very elegant. My overall experience was ok, not sure if I’d go back for the food or service.
The food was excellent. I have to point out that even though the restaurant was fully packed; the service was great and Tiffany was very attentive throughout.

Absolutely delicious food, beautiful restaurant and wonderful service. The steaks were perfect! The creamed corn was recommend by our waiter and we loved it. The butter cake was to die for...highly recommend! We were celebrating my birthday so they brought out cheesecake and a card too! Throughly enjoyed our first time here!

Just dined here for the first time and we were thoroughly impressed. The food was delicious, from the Del's Salad to the cheesecake to boot. The service was incredible. Succinctly smooth. Overall, we enjoyed our time in this space and would love to dine here again next time we are in town.

All I can say is absolutely amazing. The servers we impeccable and always kept our table cleared of any empty dishes. Our server recommended the perfect wine for my meal. The food was Devine. I had the double bone pork chop, medium. The temperature and cut were excellent, as well as, the amazing flavor. The atmosphere was very nice. You could here the other guests, but conversation at our table was very easily heard and enjoyable.
A very special place with an awesome food and service. I would love to come back again. The premium cuts are recommended
The steak was cooked to perfection!

My wife and I were in town for vacation and decided to try Del Frisco’s based on reviews and it didn’t disappoint. I had the dry aged ribeye and my wife had the oysters Rockefeller. Both were delicious. My steak was cooked perfectly. Carrie, our server, was sweet and very attentive. We based our dinner choices on her recommendations. We would definitely recommend visiting this establishment.
This is my favorite restaurant in Orlando and it's not attached to any resort. Feels local, experience is just as good as any high end resort restaurant.

We had an amazing experience. Food was excellent and service was SUPERB. Mattias was an incredible server and gave great advice to our large party. Very grateful to him. Bar tender was very kind as well as we waited for our table, she was very lovely. Mattias is awesome though.

An interesting situation occurred with my experience today for my sister's graduation. I left my car unlocked while dining at the restaurant. I found a random set of house keys in my car when I returned home. They didn't belong to me My wife and I were very perplexed so we called the restaurant, in doing so whomever I spoke with asked if we could bring said keys back to the restaurant. Or offered to have somebody drive and retrieve them. So I drove them back to the restaurant 35 minutes away. I was then handed a business card and a handshake and was told they want to do something nice for me.. in retrospect this leaves the ball in my court to reach out and ask for some kind of compensation this is absolutely ridiculous. I didn't even valet!

This is definitely my favorite restaurant. The Rockefeller plaza location has been the favorite but I live closer to the Orlando location. Kyle and David have excellent customer service and certainly make the experience worth it.
Steaks were cooked perfectly, Jailbird drink was amazing and the butter cake at the end was absolutely delicious.
Amazing food. Brilliant service.

We had a great time at Del Frisco’s! We were a large group of 12 and the service was top-notch. Our waiter was excellent—attentive, friendly, and did a great job managing a table of our size. The food overall was amazing. We started with the crab cakes, shrimp cocktails, and the veal meatballs, which were excellent. For the mains, everyone loved their steaks, and the sides—especially the mashed potatoes, mushrooms, and creamed spinach—were all delicious. We finished with desserts, and the butter cake and the beignets were really good. I’m only knocking my rating down slightly because a few things missed the mark. We were enjoying a specific wine and ordered two bottles, but when we went to order a third, they had run out. Having to switch wines mid-dinner isn't ideal. Additionally, I ordered an Espresso Martini, but their in-house version contains hazelnut and was much too sweet for what I was looking for. I also had the salmon, and it just wasn't 100% to my liking compared to the rest of the meal. Overall, it was a fantastic evening and a solid spot for a big group.

The food is always old/gross. The curbside pickup is closed for a full 24 hours no matter how long the rain lasts. Talking to the location directly does absolutely nothing. This place has seriously gone strsight downhill since they opened the other location.
Mia was extremely sweet and completed her job to the extreme.

Loved this Chick Fil A, they played a Freya Sky song which made my daughter jump through the roof. The play area was great for the kids. The food was delicious as always and perfectly made. They allowed us to order breakfast and lunch on the same order which was amazing and so appreciated. Highly recommend trying this place.
I’m just over fried food and all. I used to love chick fil a but it’s not for me anymore. Doesn’t taste like it used to. I wonder how often they change out the oil? The food tasted rancid.
Good service and food
All good.
Always good! Real lemonade, recommend!

Um dos melhores, senão o melhor fast Food para Brasileiros. Excelente custo benefício, atendentes são educados e atenciosos. O ambiente é limpo, organizado e eles levam a bandeja até a sua mesa, diferenciado! Peçam o chicken fill a deluxe (não é apimentado).
Would not sell me a cup with whipped cream for my dog, even though other CFAs do. Poor management

Ordered the bacon, egg and cheese English muffin at 8:30 a.m.. Prompt polite service. Sandwich was brought to the table made fresh and hot (not something from a warmer like other fast food restaurants when they're not busy ; looking at you. McDonald's).
Mr. John was so awesome!! He made our night. Great service
Great service from Mr John!!
MR. JOHN IS THE BEST!!! First time here and he made it the best gave me so many souvenirs. I LOVE JOHN ❤️
Very kind staff for a busy night great food
Love this Chick-fil-A, they are so busy but handle it perfectly. Everyone is nice, the food is great, drive-thru is always a breeze!
Not busy. Staff very friendly & helpful. Very efficiently run. Order correct & hot. Clean. Welcoming atmosphere. Ample parking.
Always a good time at Chick Fil A. Good chicken burgers, clean and well presented store.

This last bastion of Southern American breakfasts does not disappoint! I ordered corned beef hash, topped with two eggs over easy, grits, and English muffin. Muffins were buttered, grits were well seasoned, the eggs were perfect, and the hash was exactly what I wanted. And their coffee isn't some fancy roast, it's perfect traditional American coffee. After a week of eating exotic seafood and Latin food, this hit the spot on our last day of vacation.

My first time was Father's Day breakfast. It was excellent. The atmosphere was hometown breakfast restaurant. The coffee was excellent. I had french toast and bacon. Great! My daughter had half order of eggs benedict with home fries. So good! Great service. Good prices. I tipped extra. I was very happy. Grandson had pancakes and girlfriend had Belgian waffle. Everything was amazing. Inside and outside seating.

Been here twice, once for breakfast and the second time for lunch. Second time we arrived around 1:45, and even-though they close at 2:20, the staff was still incredibly welcome and kind! The food is good. Got the same server both times and she was very nice and attentive.
Great place
They are good

I just left and it was the worst experience I’ve had to deal with in a long time. I sat outside with my handicapped brother and waited for like 20 minutes and no server had the decency to take out order?? I even talked to the cashier and waitress inside who confirmed that the server outside another woman was with us and got up and left. Not sure what the issue was but I will not be coming back ever!!!

Decent food, nothing special it’s just breakfast. Eggs over easy were perfect. Bacon very crispy. Home Fries plain fried cubes. Country Fried Steak basic run of the mill. Service was on point. Thank you.
Good Steak & Eggs
For the price, I expected a good breakfast. The eggs had a funny taste to them. The hash browns were so thin and hard, it seemed like they had been microwaved too much.

My go 2s are the western omelet and turkey club with a side of there ranch so so good. Sharon is amazing waitress she is my main one but the ither girls arw amazing also. Just a nice olace to go any day but especially after church its a great place
Delish!
Excellent

I have been promising myself a trip to this Restaurant! I was not disappointed! Of course I am truly a lover of Mom and Pop restaurants because they offer so much charm, warmest and overly friendly staff! The prices were pretty good as well. I stay at Marriott properties frequently throughout the country, and I can confidently say that the staff at this location truly stand out. Jonathan Chapman, consistently prepared my coffee perfectly and provided excellent service throughout my stay. My only suggestion for improvement would be to expand the breakfast options for guests with gluten-free dietary needs. As a loyal Marriott Bonvoy member, I have stayed at countless Courtyard properties over the years, but this one is the worst. This location seems like lack of proper management and maintenance. The light switches felt loose and poorly installed. Even worse, the lighting was completely mismatched—some bulbs are with white light while others were warm, making the room feel pieced together. The hallways and stairwells were incredibly dim. Combined with their deep blue walls, the entire property felt dark. Finding drinking water was a hassle. There was no water station easily accessible to guests except for a single water dispenser hidden inside the first-floor gym. Otherwise, your only option was to purchase overpriced bottles at the market. And I found two little bugs on the desk of the room. On top of the poor property condition, Marriott’s recent benefit cuts have made things even more frustrating. I pay a high annual fee for my premium Marriott credit card, expecting promised perks like reliable breakfast and waived parking. Instead, free breakfast has been completely replaced by a dining credit—which has now been slashed from $20 to just $10 a day per room, and parking is no longer waived, thinking switching to other hotel brands. This is the worst courtyard I have ever stayed, totally not recommended. There are plenty of same tier hotels nearby, no need to stay in this one just because the location. BTW, even they have the shuttle to Universal, the schedule is a bit…

We had a great stay and would absolutely stay here again. From the moment we pulled up, the hotel looked clean, modern, and well-maintained. Our room was clean, spacious, and comfortable. The bed was very comfortable, and there was plenty of room to spread out our belongings. The bathroom had limited sink space, but it wasn't an issue because there was plenty of other space in the room for toiletries and personal items. The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle to Universal, and all the details and schedules were provided during check-in, which made transportation simple and convenient. Every employee we interacted with throughout our stay was friendly, welcoming, and helpful. My only minor critique would be that the shower pressure was a little low, but it still worked perfectly fine. On the plus side, I absolutely loved the complimentary shampoo, conditioner, and body wash provided in the room. Overall, this was an excellent stay. The hotel was clean, comfortable, convenient, and staffed by wonderful people. I would definitely recommend it to others and would not hesitate to stay here again.

The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar is a unique dining concept that combines two completely different styles of food: sushi and burgers. Located in CityWalk, the restaurant leans heavily into the idea of mixing Japanese-inspired dishes with classic American comfort food, creating a menu that feels more like an experience than a traditional restaurant. The interior has a fun, energetic atmosphere with colorful decor, making it a popular stop before or after visiting the nearby parks. The biggest draw is the “burgushi,” which combines burger and sushi elements into one dish. It sounds like a gimmick at first, but some of the combinations actually work surprisingly well. The sushi options are creative, with specialty rolls and presentations that make the dishes stand out, while the burgers provide a more familiar option for anyone who isn’t looking for seafood. The menu has a good variety, so groups with different preferences can usually find something they enjoy. Beyond the main dishes, the appetizers are also worth exploring. The crab rangoon dip is one of the more popular choices and fits well with the restaurant’s style, offering a fun twist on a familiar flavor. The fries and shareable items make it a good place for groups, especially if you want to try multiple things instead of committing to just one entrée. Service can vary depending on how busy the restaurant gets, and wait times can become longer during peak hours. Reservations are helpful, especially around park closing…

The prices are very high. The size of roll are petty good but at 30$ for a roll I expect more the amount of wagu was less that 2 oz and had chuncks of fat and tendon from the ny strip We did dinner late but the server was worn out and clocked out.

Was here with my wife not to long ago to have a couple bites before a movie. Honestly I have frequented this place quite a bit in the past and we always come back. Yet I have noticed over time that the service and atmosphere has been quite lacking lately. The server's aren't quite as attentive as they used to be, and the atmosphere is a little over the top. Yet the food for sure is delicious, that I will give you. I don't know if it is due to new management, turnover or something else, but It would be nice to see such a favorite place of ours and many, start to bring back that attention to detail service wise that it used to be at. So, starting with the food, we got the Edamame to start, and as it should be, it was hot, fresh and salty. I then proceeded to get the Blackened Tuna Nachos, and wow those were amazing, the portion generous and the flavor top tier. My wife got the Spicy Crunchy Roll and loved it. The texture, flavor and overall preparation of the roll was top-tier. We wanted a shake for dessert but the last few times, it took roughly 35minutes to get a shake that was ordered since there is only one machine and one person prepping them, and our favorite Nutella shake was taken off of the menu, so we decided to skip dessert due to time constraints of us watching a movie.
It was four of us the shakes were God sent amd the sushi was delicious.. My burger was top tier as well the truffle bacon fries. Definition of a match made in heaven. Good atmosphere.

We are sushi lovers and the sushi here was pretty good. Had the pearls of wisdom drink. Ate the tuna poke nachos, tropical storm roll, Jen's find and the cheeseburgersushi roll. Would definitely eat here again

While the food was good and Alex the bartender was excellent and very helpful the front desk service was a little ridiculous. We got there on time for reservation and then person downstairs says no tables are available then we go upstairs and every table is available except for 4 and I asked the front desk what the deal is and they say because they dont have enough servers when there was 4 ladies in the front not doing anything and they said they can't seat us so we went to the bar instead. Then a few minutes later we see the same people standing in the front seating other people that are coming in when we were waiting for 20 minutes after arriveing for our reservation. I am not sure if they were judging us but such horrible service from the waiting staff and front desk and it is very disgusting and I enjoyed this place before but because of this experience. If you visit here just eat at the bar you will have better waiter service from the bartenders and they do 2x the work than the waiters. Waiting for dinner waiters to come in from switching from lunch is a poor excuse if other people are seated and there are waiters they can work multiple tables horrible service but I give a great big props to ALEX which is why we tipped well to her thank you Alex but the front desk staff are immature

4 servers standing around joking and talking when we ask if we could order we were told they will come to us then after a extended time the server came to us and said in so sorry I was in the bathroom 😳🙄 what the! And the other servers are standing around like they don’t have anything better to do.

My family has made it a point to visit this place every time we go to Universal. We love it. I’ve been coming to it since it had the touch screens that let you make your own personalized fish. The quality has never dropped… until now. Someone has decided to remove the Parmesan truffle fries from the appetizer menu. This was the wrong decision. It’s still a side but needs to be brought back as an appetizer. I have literally been all over this country sampling some of the finest foods. No one does truffle fries like this place. Please bring them back
Sushi was excellent, burgers were awesome along with the service. Best place to eat on city walk and I’ve been to all the places.
We had a large group, and waited an hour to be seated outside. Food was ok but was a little overpriced for what you got. Waiter was friendly and helpful. Overall our group had a good time.
Horrible customer service
The cheeseburger sushi roll is the best!!!

Waited 1 hour for a reservation… the person at the front seating guests messed up on who to seat first- was then told to wait much longer for an open seat. I can not recommend this place. There are other options that are more organized

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience was disappointing enough that I feel compelled to share it. From the moment we were seated, our waiter never introduced himself and was largely absent throughout the meal. He came to our table maybe three times total, and our water was only refilled after we specifically asked. The service felt inattentive and indifferent from start to finish. What made the experience especially upsetting was the behavior of several waitresses standing near our table. Throughout our meal, they repeatedly pointed at me and my cousins, stared at us as they walked by, and even made visible disgusted or gagging faces in our direction. It was uncomfortable, embarrassing, and completely unprofessional. We were there for a small family reunion, looking forward to spending quality time together, and the atmosphere was unfortunately spoiled by how unwelcome we were made to feel. The food took over 30 minutes to arrive. While it was decent, it certainly wasn't worth the price. Nothing about the meal justified the long wait or the cost. To top it off, our waiter never checked in to see how our food was, never asked if we wanted dessert, and seemed eager for the interaction to be over. Overall, the combination of poor service, uncomfortable treatment from staff, long wait times, and overpriced food made this a very disappointing experience. Sadly, I would not return and cannot recommend this restaurant to others. Take your business elsewhere.
I always love this place the sushi was amazing. The atmosphere is great if you can catch a slow day I highly suggest it.

Came on a saturday night with reservation, I had the shrimp tempura sushi and i couldn’t have been more disappointed. Honestly it was very bland and soggy not crunchy at all, asked for some spicy mayo and i think it tasted even worse the mayo was more spice than anything. I wasn’t the only one who thought that because my sister and fiancé also tried it and said the same thing, my fiance had a burger and said it was super flavorless as well, I understand saturdays get busy but no place this expensive should focus on just getting people out.. other than that our server was super nice

We loved Cowfish! Burger sushi and Chinese chicken salad were awesome. A must try for the kids! But great for adults, too. Mimosa was fresh squeezed orange juice - delicious. We got there at opening and requested a seat on the patio for the view, but were told they only had the indoor bar section open. That was disappointing.

Not the worse, not the greatest. Probably won’t come back, good to know the place. Nothing special about it. It actually was expensive for the food they serve but for tourist coming out of the park and hangry, it’s a good choice.
Staff were nice and professional. The food is incredible! Definitely a must.
Very delicious BBQ, not dry, there mustard bbq sauce top notch taste! Will return
Best brisket ive had in a long time. Sides and everything were good
Good bbq, quaint little place! Would rather have different bbq sauce options but otherwise good!

Although the food was good, we were disappointed with the portion size. Ordered take-out. 1lb brisket (3.5-4 slices) and 3 sides of French fries (equal to 1 large side or 2 small sides). We have been to other BBQ places and this family size meal was equal to a good size 1 person meal. For $26 not worth the money. We won't be back.

Let me first start off by saying the staff was really nice and welcoming. With that being said I was highly disappointed with how tender and juicy the meat was with absolutely no lick of flavor in sight. The baked beans were ok. The macaroni had no flavor and the cornbread was semi sweet.
Good food and service

Food - decent prices and portions. Happy hour on beer. Service - order at the counter and they deliver your food to the table. Servers were friendly and food came out quickly. Atmosphere - Sat on the patio. Right next to the I 95 exit ramp so very noisy. Patio and tables were clean. Worth a stop.....
OMG! You get so much food and good, quality food! Must try the Fat Boy sandwich. So much food!

The Fat Boy sandwich was FABULOUS. French fries were excellent as well as the fried okra. Friendly and attentive staff. A big plus, located next to the Teddy Morse's Daytona Harley-Davidson Dealership and Showroom in Ormond Beach off I-95.
Food was great! Slow cooked on a grill. Huge serving and not too pricy! Staff was wonderful!
Always stop here when traveling through Daytona
10/10 experience brisket was nice and tender, the ribs were delicious! Great potato salad and coleslaw!

My wife and I travel to the Orlando area all the time... and almost every time we are on our way back home we stop and eat there! We have never had a bad experience! The food is always good and the service is always amazing!

I wish I could leave 10 stars, all these young ladies were fabulous. Food was the best fast food BBQ I've ever had! Sorry Texas your out! This is a must stop, the Grammy greens are homemade and very great, not burnt like some places. Anyways I could not eat everything as the portions were huge ( and I'm not shy when food is in front of me, my belly shows it). I'll be back 120% when I get the chance. Thanks ladies

Saw the name along the interstate thought it would just be a small stand. Colts is a full restaurant with a Southern BBQ atmosphere. When I walked in they were quite busy and I can see why the food was great the service was great. Will definitely stop here again.

I had the sausage plate with fries and macaroni and cheese . Macaroni tasted very starchy . The sausage was very odd tasting ( I was told later it had bacon in it ) . My friend had the turkey plate . Turkey was extremely dry and did not have a smoke ring . The " smoke " taste was kinda bitter almost like liquid smoke . She salad was good .
Great smoke on all the meat, fall off the bone ribs, tender brisket, sausage was juice and had a snap when I bit into it. The sides are great, especially the corn bread and potato salad.
Food was horrible. Service OK
Outstanding 😊 excellent brisket, green beans 😋, Quick service, hot food.
Delicious pork and macaroni and cheese 🤤
Very nice people. I really enjoyed eating at this place. I was traveling thru to Palm Bay Florida.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ If you’re debating whether it’s worth the drive from St. Augustine—stop thinking and start driving. Colt’s Pig Stand is officially “road trip required” status. We rolled in hungry and left questioning all of our life choices… mainly why we don’t eat here every week. The pulled chicken? Juicy enough to make you emotional. The green beans? Somehow made us feel like we were being healthy (we weren’t). Mac n cheese? Creamy, cheesy, and borderline addictive. The Redneck Reuben? A masterpiece that probably deserves its own holiday. But let’s talk about the real MVP… the Brunswick stew. I don’t know what kind of magic, wizardry, or backyard sorcery went into that pot, but it was hands-down the BEST we’ve ever had. Like “argue with your grandma about it” good. We’ll 100% be making that drive again—and next time, we might just order two stews… for research purpose of course. Highly recommend. Bring your appetite and maybe some stretchy pants.
Brisket has great flavor & cooked right

A gente sempre fica um pouco receoso em ir depois que lê algumas avaliações... Mas minha experiência em 2024 foi ótima. Super bem localizado com um Walmart ao lado. Fiquei com medo do cheiro de mofo, mas não tivemos esse problema(apesar do quarto ter carpete). Não tivemos nenhum contratempo e até conseguimos (com meu parco inglês) entrar mais cedo (early check in). O quarto era arrumado todos os dias(lençóis arrumados e toalhas trocadas). O hotel tem transfer para os parques mas os utilizamos somente na volta. Na ida fomos de Uber para chegar assim que o parque abre e aproveitar mais. Estou indo novamente agora em setembro de 2026, mas dessa vez alugamos um carro(não cobra estacionamento). Para quem vai sem carro da super certo também. Uber por mais que seja mais caro que no Brasil, sai bem mais barato que alugar um carro lá. Vamos de carro dessa vez pela comodidade e para fazer o teste para saber se vale a pena (minha mulher acha que vale)

El lugar se encuentra bien ubicado, un Walmart detrás, 10 min de Disney y 25 de Universal. Buena piscina pero los cuartos un poco descuidados, además, falta personal que hable español (suponiendo que es para extranjeros). Relación precio calidad servicio, excelente opción.
Buen precio.

I don't usually leave bad reviews, but this experience couldn't be ignored. I had to give this hotel one star only because there wasn't an option to give zero….This was one of the worst hotel experiences I've ever had. I would not recommend staying at this Ramada by Wyndham. The customer service was terrible, and the hotel was dirty and poorly maintained. One of the biggest issues was housekeeping. They do not provide daily housekeeping. Instead, service is every other day if you request it. If you don't ask, your room won't be cleaned at all. When one of the guest asked for additional towels for a room of four people, the front desk clerk said, “We only give one bath towel per room. You are supposed to use it and then hand it to the next person." Another guest standing there responded, “Ma’am, I've never heard anything like this." The clerk simply replied, "Yes, that's how it goes." I was shocked that this was actually their policy. The toilet became clogged, and not to mention one of the outside waterfalls in the waterpark area was pouring out dirty water. I had to call the front desk multiple times to report the clogged toilet because my calls kept getting hung up on before someone finally answered. Overall, this hotel was poorly maintained and provided some of the worst customer service I've experienced. This stay was very disappointing. Save your money and stay somewhere else.
Great family getaway

Our stay at this hotel ended in the worst possible way. My 4-year-old nephew was seriously injured when a glass door shattered during normal use, causing multiple cuts and a head injury that required stitches. While the accident itself was traumatic, what truly shocked us was the complete lack of care and empathy from the hotel's staff afterward. No one checked on my nephew. No one came to our room to ask how he was doing or whether our family needed anything. There was absolutely no follow-up from management. The manager told my brother-in-law that we would receive a copy of the incident report. When I personally went to request it, I was only handed a blank form and told to write down what had happened myself. I was then told to come back another day. The lack of communication and professionalism was extremely disappointing. I especially want to mention the Head of Security, Tomás. His attitude, tone, and complete lack of compassion while dealing with a family whose 4-year-old nephew had just been taken to the hospital were unacceptable. I have worked in the hospitality industry, and I know that when a serious incident involving a guest occurs—especially a young child—the minimum expectation is empathy, clear communication, and follow-up. None of that happened here. This review is not only about the accident. Accidents can happen anywhere. It is about how this hotel chose to treat a family after such a traumatic event. The complete lack of humanity and concern was deeply…
The rooms are big and spacious with a good layout; the staff were friendly and helpful; the location is great, near a lot of shops and food and close to all Orlando has to offer
Excelente ubicación grandes instalaciones, muy cómoda las habitaciones, se agradece café, agua fría con naranja y limón todo el día un muy buen detalle
Great location and atmosphere. Everyone was kind and helpful. Mulligan's is a great little bar where you can relax after a full day at the parks. MB is a great bartender. I'll definitely be back.

Excelente. Desde el primer momento, la atención en recepción fue cordial y profesional. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas, limpias y cuentan con todo lo necesario para una estadía agradable. El desayuno es muy completo y de excelente calidad. También destaco la ubicación, que resulta muy conveniente para recorrer la zona y el servicio de traslados a los parques, que fue puntual y eficiente. Sin dudas, una experiencia muy positiva de principio a fin.
Exelente

Excelente experiencia. El hotel superó mis expectativas desde el momento de la llegada. Las instalaciones estaban muy limpias, el personal fue amable y atento en todo momento, y el ambiente era cómodo y agradable para disfrutar en familia. Todo el proceso fue sencillo y me hicieron sentir muy bien atendida. Sin duda lo recomendaría y volvería a hospedarme aquí en una próxima visita.
Buena relación calidad precio, cerca de Disney y Wallmart
Todo genial. Muchas felicidades por excelencia atención de Jessinia. Y la tiendita tiene de todo lo que necesites a buen precio.
Amazing place! I really recommend this hotel l very close to everything, clean, organized and the people is so kind
Amei tudo, todos muito educados e cordiais , as acomodações muito limpas e confortáveis. Satisfeita demais .

Don’t let the sleek tower in the website photos 📸 or the street view fool you. If that section is sold out, the remaining accommodations felt much more like a roadside motel, complete with that unmistakable odor 👃 and flickering lights 💡 that immediately raised concerns. I actually canceled my reservation upon arrival rather than continue with the stay. To the property’s credit, the staff was wonderful 😊 and exactly what you’d hope for from a customer service perspective. There are multiple pools 🏊, laundry facilities, and space for larger groups, which may make it a reasonable option for some travelers. Parking is fairly plentiful 🚗, although after the Disney crowds return 🎢, be prepared for a walk from the back lot. If you’re on a strict budget and smells don’t bother you, you may be perfectly comfortable here; I simply wasn’t.
Siempre es una buena opción para comer.
La comida, deliciosa, ambiente maravilloso

En mi opinión la mejor comida cubana que he podido encontrar, la ropa vieja y el combo cubano lo mejor de lo mejor, fue como si estuviéramos en casa,la atención especial,lugar agradable y bonito. Lo recomiendo cuando visiten Celebration, que es un lugar de ensueño

Was in Orlando for a convention. Could not leave the area without visiting the Columbia, just love everything about it, the food, service, and atmosphere are top notch. Ordered their beautiful Cuban and world famous 1905 Salad. The salad is wonderfully fresh and a meal all by itself. Ordered two more salads to go, so I can share with family tonight for dinner. Thanks for a delicious lunch Columbia! Can't wait to visit again.
Calamari, empanadas and shrimp were all outstanding. Loved my patella. Travis was very knowledgeable with the menu and gave great service.
We always get great service at Columbia. The venue is upscale and elegant and the town of Celebration is cute and charming in a Disney kind of way.
Food and the service were impeccable. Christhian’s service is absolutely fantastic. Give the guy a raise!

Columbia Restaurant continues to be a bastion of great spanish food. We were a party of 5 very hungry people. We sampled beef, fish, and chicken dishes which were superb. Bar drinks were strong and fresh. Service was superb and entertaining! A bit on the pricey side. Very nicely adorned, bathrooms clean. Ample parking. Near Disney, and I-4 corridor. Great place to entertain and impress!

My wife took me there for a 4pm reservation she made for a Father's Day dinner. We got there and like florida a rain storm with strong winds came in. We get to restaurant 15 minutes before our reservation. as we wait to be seated the outdoor area customers are all coming inside the restaurant because of the strong winds and rain and they call us to sit and to our surprise they walk us outside and we said look its raining and strong winds you can't sit us ourside. so we walk back to hostess and the person infront of us has same issue the hostess tells the person they would have to wait 45 minutes, when he gets to us he said sorry your wife booked outside (which she booked the time with opentable and did not see it was for outside only) so you can go back outside or wait 4hrs! We looked at him and said are you serious? you told the customer in front of us 45 minutes and us 4 hrs? So we left as the the weather app said it would continue to rain for 2hrs. This being florida and at times this type of weather happens they should have certain protocals in place for when it happens for the safety of the customers. also to tell one customer 45 minutes and the one next to that person 4hrs is insane. We can't leave a review on the food as we never got to eat, the atmosphere and place did look nice.
Irina and team were amazing! Great location.
Great food, beautiful restaurant and the service was exceptional.

Overpriced plates for the taste and quality. Paella rice was not cooked and barely any protein, one clam was borderline spoiled. The palomilla tasted like they poured a whole condiment bottle of pepper as its only seasoning. This is not true Cuban taste and quality in food.
I love this place! The best combination of good food and great atmosphere.

Best Spanish food in Orlando. I had the Merluza . It was delicate flaky and so delicious. The Yuca was soft and just enough garlic not to overpower but add a flavorful bite. The onions and peppers were chopped way to large in the yellow rice but the lovely aroma of the rice was an added treat. The waiter was aloof but I enjoyed the meal. Ended with a treat of churros. Fun and a pleasant addition. Will be back
Loved this place! Definitely worth it!
Amazing food, such a great historical restaurant in Florida.

Me and the wife ate lunch, as it was recommended by a hospital staff member, and we were new to area. I look forward to eating and enjoying what the locals recommend. But, this time it fell short, really short. The food was just mediocre at that, the staff was not tentative at all. We waited 15 minutes to get drinks, and the mojito was not tasteful or fresh! I ordered a calamari for appetizer, because if you screw that up, I wont even bother looking at entrees. That also gives me time to size up the service. Promptness, attentive, presentation. They failed in all three areas as my appetizer took 15 minutes, which it probably was out of a bag, due to the consistency in quality and cuts. Unfortunatley, we left after spending short of $100, for a sandwich, appetizer, two drinks. I TRULY DONT UNDERSTAND HOW PEOPLE CAN RATE THIS RESTAURANT SO HIGH, IT SAID NOTHING ABOUT THE QUALITY OF FOOD OR SERVICE.
There salad is well know. Service was great
Great service and food

Rainy Monday, so not busy. Wait staff didn't come , so I had to find one. Split a plate with my girlfriend ( got the Milanesa, very good and huge plate) so asked for a second plate, which never came. I gave the place 4stars because of it's location in Celebration and the view from the covered outdoor seating. Great looking place with wonderful looking pottery. But , if you say the wait staff is the best right in the menu, they should be pretty damn good. Ours was not. Sangria could have been served in a bigger glass for $9
Great food parking little difficult but worth it 👍👍

If you’re looking for authentic Cuban food, Copacabana is definitely worth a visit. The food was fresh, flavorful, and full of authentic Cuban taste. The portions were generous, the service was friendly, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. Everything we ordered was delicious, and you can tell they take pride in their food. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone craving great Cuban cuisine.
Poor customer service and terrible food
Pésimo servicio y no es buena la comida incluso estaba crudo un pescado frito
This is nothing but basic looking bland overpriced cafeteria food. Do yourselves a favor and eat elsewhere. Atmosphere is nice but service and food sucks.

We used to come here regularly and the food was great, very authentic. Lots of patrons. We are Cuban descent from Miami and know the real thing. Today Copacabana was a huge disappointment. The black beans were terrible. The oxtail was mediocre. The mojito was so weak, we asked for another shot. It didn’t help much. I think the rum was either watered down or extremely cheap. The Cuban bread was below average and had something that resembled butter but wasn’t. When we left, a couple (latins also from Miami) approached us to ask if we had been to this restaurant before. They had the same issue. They used to go there and it was great but now it was terrible. They said their mariquitas were extremely greasy and they had to send them back. They also hated the bread. They ordered a steak sandwich which they were going to give a chance. Imagine - Their experience was so bad they asked perfect strangers about our experience. I don’t know if there are new owners but they need to get it together. The waitress was extremely sweet and efficient. The only positive experience.

1 star is way too generous for this place. As someone who grew up on real Cuban food in Miami, this was honestly insulting. Esto esta de….! The food was so bad I actually sent it back and left. No flavor and nothing about it felt fresh or authentic. It felt like they didn’t even try. Just don’t bother. Again.. don’t even bother! Trust me. Save your time, save your money, and go literally anywhere else.
I stop by for the Cuban coffee. Perfect cortaditos.
In spite it advertise cuban food it is really no a typical cuban food restaurant, it is more like Mexican
Forgot to enter the promo! Please send 20% off coupon. Thanks!
Had the special: Cuban w/fries $10. So good!!!

Quick service! Excellent server - she was friendly, patient and knew her stuff! The food was good! I enjoyed the Cerviche and Tostones - fresh and delicious! Nice and cozy atmosphere but it was a bit dark inside though.

Review: Beware of Potential Scams I recently dined at this restaurant and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. We waited over an hour for our food, which was extremely frustrating. There was little communication from the staff about the delay, and we felt completely forgotten. While I understand that restaurants can get busy, waiting that long without any updates is simply unacceptable and greatly impacted our overall experience. To make matters worse, we also had to wait an excessive amount of time for our check. Tired of waiting, we decided to leave cash on the table and exit the restaurant rather than wait any longer. Just as we were about to leave, our waitress finally appeared. Since we had already prepared the cash, we opted to pay that way and declined change. However, after we left, the waitress accused us of being $20 short. My boyfriend insisted that wasn’t the case, and I asked if they had checked the table or the kitchen. In an effort to resolve the situation, my boyfriend retraced his steps and went back inside to look for the missing bill. We explained to the waitress what we had left, but she was insistent that we were lying. When my boyfriend asked to speak with a manager, we were told there wasn't one on duty. After requesting to review the security footage, the hostess eventually came out to say they found the $20. There was no apology from the waitress, and when I asked where the bill had been found, I was told it had been stuck somewhere.…
Excellent cuban sandwich! Very friendly atmosphere. Definitely will be back.

This place was recommended for lunch by a nurse at a doctor’s office in Tavares, and I’m so glad we chose it. I originally tried to place a catering order online, but their website was down the day before Memorial Day. I called instead and spoke with Arelly, who was absolutely slammed because of the holiday rush, yet still took the time through several back-and-forth calls to help get everything arranged. Beni even responded after hours to personally guarantee my order would be ready for pickup the next day. Everyone I interacted with went above and beyond to make our lunch happen on short notice. The atmosphere was great, and the restaurant was already busy by 11:30 AM, which says a lot. The food was even better than the service, and that’s hard to beat. I’ll definitely be back and highly recommend this place for both the amazing staff and excellent food. Thank you again!

Nada nada de comida cubana, la comida estaba quemada, sin sazon, el aceite estaba sobre utilizado . Pedí vaca frita: no tenía cebollas, no limón, no sal. La mesera no llegó a preguntarnos cómo estaba la cena, nos abandonó y luego tuvimos que pedir la cuenta a la cocinera que salió de casualidad. No vallan, es más la comida me hizo doler el estómago
Zero authenticity. Food is not as described on the menu. We weren't hungry when we left. Meh
Probably my favorite restaurant while visiting Mount Dora. The food is to die for and the staff are super polite and helpful!

0 stars!!! The people are terrible the service is awful the place does not look clean. The guys are not friendly!!! I watched the bar tender not wash his hands and making drinks. B careful to much going around to risk sickness. And they pay none of their customers attention at all they just walk around you and ignore you. And then laugh. 0 stars!!

If I could give zero Stars I would these people are horrible! Uber eats and doordash people customers too! The order not going through your system or you not paying attention to it is not my fault I waited it out and then you kept lying to me about the time 30 minutes goes by and then you told me they just drop it again it'll be still 10-15 minutes and then you tell me because I asked you can you be honest with me about the time that I can leave no horrible horrible service!!!! Paramore about your employees we waste our time to come up there and sit there and wait it's our money too we're on the clock!

The place has great potential, as it is located in a beautiful, growing small city. Perhaps the employees—who are very friendly and eager to do their best—are simply in need of some proper training. The first round of cocktails fell short, but the second round was prepared very well. I enjoyed the food, though there is room for improvement. We like the overall concept. The music was fantastic. El lugar tiene un gran potencial pues está localizado en una hermosa pequeña ciudad en crecimiento. Quizás sea que les hace falta un buen entrenamiento a los empleados los cuales son muy amables y quieren dar lo mejor de ellos. Los primeros cocteles le faltó y los segundos si los prepararon muy bien. La comida me gustó aunque puede mejorar. El concepto en general nos gusta. La música estuvo buenisima.
The food is tasty. We enjoyed the Stuffed peppers and Mixed Veggies. The server was not very attentive and got a couple things wrong on our order. The restaurants atmosphere is nice.
Very bad attention!!!
Good food, great people.

Went here for Mother’s Day and we were so disappointed. The food was absolutely disgusting! I wish I could rate it zero stars. Most importantly, when we walked in, there was a huge roach under our table where we were eating. Never again!!!

I stayed at Comfort Inn & Suites Orlando North for a quick weekend trip and was pleasantly surprised by how smooth everything went. I arrived later than expected due to traffic, but the check-in process was fast and the front desk staff were welcoming. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and I appreciated having a quiet place to unwind after a long day. One thing that stood out was how well the common areas were maintained throughout my stay. For the price and convenience, it was a great choice, and I would consider staying here again on a future visit.
Staff very welcoming and helpful our entire stay. Quiet and restaurants close.
