Excelente servicio al cliente desde que llegas . Facilidades cómodas y buen desayuno . Lo recomiendo

The hotel was so clean, staff very friendly. I felt safe and secure. A lot of restaurants surrounding the hotel truly a hidden gem. The Only issue was the bed was so hard and the breakfast could have been better.
This is a good hotel for a the value of visiting UCF or dropping or picking kids up from UCF. Manager Jae Lee is very friendly and helpful.

I was greeted very warmly when I first checked in the room was excellent. The temperature was wonderful. The cleanliness of the hotel is what I loved about the place. The only problem I had the whole time was the toilet was a little low to the ground. When I was younger, it was easy, but at 77. It was a little hard to get up and down. made me use my muscles. Ha! Ha! But I did love the hotel. I definitely will be coming back.
Stayed just one night while attending a soccer match in Orlando. Very easy access to and from the stadium. Good beds, ok breakfast, nice service. I would happily return.
Area too crowded, some staff spoke broken English, door hard to open
Positive: The breakfast was the best continental breakfast we've ever had Negative: The only thing was the conditioner, I think it was filled with shampoo. Everything else was amazing

Whenever you want to go get yourself a hot dog on a nice summer day hoping it will fill your stomach and pull the heat off your face with a nice Mexican coke. 9 times out of 10 something will be missing, bacon will be chewy, cheese will be fake, or the dog has a lovely boiled chemical flavor. Walking into to Harrells you are immediately greeted with the nice smell of gas grills fired up, authentic dogs cooking, and a welcoming staff making you feel like you are going to your friends barbecue on the weekend. My personal favorite? The Mac monster dog. When ordering this, my body is telling me that this will be another greasy, flavorless, salt bomb. But the name “Mac Monster Dog” couldn’t peak my interest more, so I order it anyways. Sitting while watching the staff assemble this, I notice the crisp bacon, fresh Mac n cheese, Garlic Aioli, slathered on top of a beautiful beef hot dog stuffed in between a brioche bun. Considering past relationships with other shops quite frankly ruining my taste for these things, I still kept my expectations low. But the first bite took all that away, you are greeted with the tang of the aioli, hit with the perfect amount of saltiness from the cheese and CRISP bacon. The brioche buns chewy nature combined with the crunch of bacon would make your knees buckle. All of this to say that this shop was one of the best experiences I have had in regards to a beef hot dog. And I will be back.
Fantastic experience amazing food

We showed up around 8:30 pm and the lady at the front was very friendly but the lady that came from the kitchen started arguing with the employee up front and started closing everything up. The lady that was helping us was trying to tell her that they don’t close until 9 pm but she wouldn’t listen and started shutting the place down. She was very rude and unprofessional. We went outside to eat at the table so we could get out of their way as we felt uncomfortable staying inside. I felt bad for the employee up front! What an awkward experience. Highly recommend new help!
Great hot dogs. Some really tasty outside the box menu options. Fries are also good. The new dirty sodas are delicious.
Excellent hot dogs. Really love their peppers.
Shout to Adelisa and Dontavious! Great food, great service, great atmosphere, great price.
Kadie and Daneyah are amazing! They're extremely friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. They helped me narrow down what I wanted and gave amazing recommendations! Will definitely be back
Adelisa was helpful when ordering and explained everything perfectly definitely coming back
The truffle fries were great, Adelisa was very helpful in taking my order and making my food.
Awesome job from Adeisa and her colleague who gave fast and polite service. Extremely helpful with our (2) boys and a complex order. Food was delicious as always, will be back.
Adelisa was great! Love Harell's so much!
Love this place.

Big shoutout to Dontavius for being so incredibly warm, hospitable, and helping us find the best hotdogs we’ve ever had. We got the New York Hot Dog and the North Carolina Hot Dog 🤤🤤🤤 based off Dontavius’ recs. They were soooo good! Another shoutout to Josh for sharing with us about how the hotdogs are made and why they are the best hotdogs in Orlando! I love leaving a place feeling full and like my money was well spent. Harrell’s delivers!! Thank you for such a great experience!

We live in Winter Garden but first time visiting today. Everything was great and will definitely visit again to build my own dog next time. I had the stadium dog and my husband tried the Chicago dog. It was a little messy to eat but was great. The truffle fries were delicious as well. Staff was welcoming and friendly.

Not only was the food disgusting but I’m sure I’ll be sick soon. The Mac n cheese was old dry noodles the lady tried to mix a cheese sauce into. The chicken nuggets were black so I gave them back. Later the server came back and said I was right and he cut one open and it was raw inside. Said the oil was to be changed out but the guy never came and when he looked the oil was nasty looking. So glad I had already eaten a bunch of fries cooked in that oil. What a way to ruin my whole day.
The food was overly salty..... It made it inedible. For the price it should have been better. Staff was nice at least
My kids loved it thank you.

I think I may be addicted to this place, and I'm not even a hot dog person. The food is beyond delicious, elevating something as simple as a hot dog and fries to something beyond it's parts. The cheese sauce, the "dirty sodas" that taste incredible, and a staff that seems to actually get joy from what they are serving....if I was rich I'd invest and spread this around the country, it's that good.

Arbany has amazing customer service, the food was delicious she was so kind and was so much help, the atmosphere is great it’s a nice spot to grab some food and to walk around. The food was made fast and fresh as well as kept communication with us. 10/10 will definitely will be back soon, thank you again to Arbany for being so helpful on my 1st visit

What an adorable place on plant street!! 100% recommended, we loved the atmosphere! The very kind woman up front, Arbany, was so so friendly and extremely hard working! Thanks to her, we’ll absolutely be coming back for more! The food was serviced fast, was hot and fresh, and served with a SOU, which is fantastic for customers to see. Arbany kept up wonderful conversations with us whilst making the food, which we thought was very thoughtful. She was informative on the food and what Harnells serves, very helpful for us as first time customers! 5/5’s across the board.

This spot is so inviting. The hotdogs are so good and their truffles fries are my favorite! They have multiple options to pick from which makes it even more delicious. The workers are so awesome and they hold intentional conversations. I realized they had regulars which makes a statement
Emily always takes amazing care of me every time I visit for the best truffle fries

Cute little hideaway on Plant Street. Lots of options for hot dogs as well as put your own ingredients together. The hot dogs were delicious; buns were soft and slightly sweet and toasted with butter. The flavors all tied in well and the sandwich was gooey with melted cheese. The fries werent bad. The truffle fries had an interesting flavor but it definitely is not for everyone. Customer service was good and the host was heplful. We will be back for the hot dogs whenever we're in the mood again.
That north Carolina dog was amazing, one of the best I've ever had. Great vibe, friendly service, love this place

I love the Downtown Winter Garden area. With all the little cozy shops and restaurants, it's a great place to explore. I was craving a delicious hotdog so I googled and thid place showed up first. I got there and the staff was very nice and helpful. I ordered a hotdog with ketchup, mustard, relish, and onions and chili cheese fries. I sat outside and they brought it out to me once it was done. Everything looked pretty good except for the size of the hotdog. I thought they would be a little plumper for the price. I also felt like the toppings were a bit too heavy for my taste. It made me feel like I should have stood there and watched so I could control how much or little was added. The chili cheese fries I couldn't finish. They were way too salty. First it's seasoned fries 🧂, chili more🧂🧂, cheese and cheese sauce🧂🧂🧂. Definitely a salt bomb. I'd suggest asking the customer if they like seasoning on the fries or not. But this is just my option. It's a cute place but taste wise, it just didn't satisfy what I was craving.

Huge beer selection and delicious as well! Awesome atmosphere! CORRECTION!! this by far is the best Brewery in all of Florida! My second visit confirmed it! Chrissy (not of Three’s Company fame 😉) was spot on!! She was energetic and very knowledgeable! The beer was awesome the second time around, so I know it wasn’t a fluke. Well done guys!

We visited on a Saturday morning a little bit after noon. Even though it got a little busy the bartender kept up with serving beers and food. The food was delicious. The beer was outstanding, these are some of the best beers to be had in central florida. We ended up taking home some of the Lambic. Great selection of bears that we had also. Highly recommend this place if you like better beers.

What a great place to celebrate a successful Artemis II Launch with the fine men and women who made it happen! Fantastic food, top quality service, and a very memorable evening. Thank you to the staff for making it one to remember!
First time here! Staff were super friendly and the beers were great.
Wow, excellent brews! Great IPAs... and they do some very cool experimental! (The Margarita Angel is wildly excellent). You will enjoy yourself here--we already cant wait to come back!
Very nice

Update: Special craft beers flavors are rotated in addition to their regulars. The food menu is small and seasonal so it changes. They do many events such as Monday night trivia plus special beer pairings offerings. Staff is wonderful. There is both inside and outside seating. Board games are available. Bar is very clean. Original: We sampled a few beers before deciding on one of their IPAs. We ordered two sandwiches, the Reuben and the Cuban. You have choice of either chips or pasta salad as your side. We split our sandwiches and we liked the Cuban better although the Reuben was good. The pasta salad was ok but too much mayo for our preferred taste. We loved the old building and we had great service. It is housed in the old hardware store and they kept the wooden hardware cabinetry on the wall to use.
What a great place beautiful atmosphere service is great beers are to die for and food. When you're in Titusville this is the place to be.
Snicker and 2 IPA
Great atmosphere and great beers. Peanut butter week is my favorite. Staff is great. Mostly appetizer for food, but those are really good.

This is our favorite place when we are visiting and staying at the Titusville Marina. The Margarita Blonde Beer with the cream rim is what I like to get, especially of it’s a hot day. The food is just light snacks and some sandwiches, but the beer, casual atmosphere, and friendly staff are what we come for anyway. I do also enjoy getting to order an entire jar of pickles for a snack once in awhile.

Updated review. The Hardware Store Brewing Company has been on its own (wo Brix) for quite a while now and has still got its small brewery feel as it always has. Hardware has many great new brews from the original owner/brewer as all of the original Playalinda brews went with the new owners of Brix establishment. Well worth the trip downtown with plenty of parking on the Indian River side of the brewery.
Stumbled upon this spot while in town visiting family. Staff was nice and i really enjoyed the variety of beer styles.

3/27/25 - Best blond ale around! Kyle is a great bartender and spokesman for the Hardware Store! 1/13/25 - Another great experience with Kyle at the brewery! Great selection of beer to suit different tastes. Excellent wait/bar staff. Good sandwiches and fresh hot pretzels.
Excellent beer, prices that make you feel like you are at a bar that still loves you, and a fun game pretty much every night of the week. Thank for the fun night!
Fun brewery with friendly service. Great selection of draft beers. Indoor and outdoor seating.
Stopped by for calorie replenishment after a bike ride on trail. Beer and service were both top notch. Great watering hole!
You must stop for a beer or 3. Great atmosphere, amazing beer and the bartenders are superb!
I stopped for a beer with my friend and was amazed at how delicious their cilantro beer was (essential wit)! The prices were pretty affordable, and the ambiance was great! Will definitely come back!

Hardware Store Brewing Company offers a great variety of beers, and everything we tried was outstanding. We especially enjoyed the Hardware IPA and one of their sours, both were excellent and well crafted. The atmosphere was welcoming, and the service was friendly and attentive, which really added to the experience. Definitely a place we’d recommend and look forward to visiting again.

This is our go to spot to just kick back and chill. The selections always change. We were in last night, and the cranberry sauce orange,and the vanilla stout had amazing flavor. My favorite is definitely the Blackcat stout. Kyle is a great host, he makes it a lot of fun, hope to see him on the silver screen one day. Cheers.
The rooms are extremely clean. The view is breathtaking!

-Water in the showers was luke warm and never got hot even after 20 minutes of running it on the hottest setting -View was partial ocean view and I paid for ocean view -Very hot in hallways and elevator -Bathroom door was very loud when sliding it to open and close it -Mini fridge didn't get cold -No patio chairs -Wifi was horrible and no cell service inside of room - Bath tub drain didn't work properly, bathtub would not hold the luke warm water -Shower head was old and had bad calcium build up -No usb chargers in room, I've stayed in cheaper hotels that at least had usb ports in lamps and wall outlets - Toilet would start running for no reason -Patio door was extremely hard to open and close -Horrible beds, I weigh 120lbs and I sunk down low in the bed -Room never cooled down, it was warm and muggy the entire time even at night -Ac made loud noises all night -Toilet was extremely hard to flush, the handle was hard to push down -Carpet felt moist when walking barefoot -When the guests in the rooms on both sides of us used the shower we could hear the loud noise it made in our room at 11pm at night

For Hyatt, this oceanfront property missed the mark totally on service and luxury standards. The staff provided no interaction with no greetings or good mornings. I even tried to talk to them and they seemed to be to busy to even say hello. The breakfast buffet was totally dirty and there was no plates, silverware or glasses for juice. Dining area was a wreck and tables were so dirty. I had to clean off (wipe it down) the table before we could eat. In the room, there was virtually no water pressure in the shower, and the AC didn't work well — the space always felt wet and clammy rather than properly cooled. The room stunk and felt dirty. This sure wasn't luxury and the price was high for not being luxury. We will not be returning to this location.

We've stayed at many Hyatt properties and this was by far the worst experience we've had. On arrival, we had nowhere to park since the parking lot was full. There was no one at the front desk so we ended up calling at midnight just to get assistance. We had to park across the street behind a gift shop. Once inside, the room's AC wasn't working properly in the middle of summer, which made for an uncomfortable stay. The AC vent was also being blocked by a giant lamp. The hallway had no AC either and a noticeable smell. Small things added up too: the in-room phone didn't work, the elevator was slow and inconvenient, and the shower pressure was uncomfortably intense. Breakfast was equally disappointing and did nothing to redeem the stay. The pool needed some trees or decorations to make it feel more cozy. At least the beds were comfortable and the view was great. The overall vibe was just off — it didn't feel like the Hyatt standard we're used to. We will not be returning to this property and hope management takes these issues seriously, because this location has a lot of catching up to do.

As a Hyatt Globalist, this oceanfront property misses the mark on service and luxury standards. Staff provided minimal interaction with no greetings or good mornings. The breakfast buffet was embarrassing and basic compared to higher-end Hyatts — limited options like scrambled eggs, sausage, breakfast potatoes, toast, yogurt, fruit, and granola. Dining area overlooks a parking lot leading to the beach, and sand tracks everywhere due to proximity. In the room, there was virtually no water pressure in the shower, and the AC didn't work well — the space always felt wet and clammy rather than properly cooled. Rooms and location suit a basic beach stay if you don't expect premium service or amenities. Fine for convenience, not luxury.

Me and my family have been staying at the hyatt for years and we're ecstatic to see there was one on daytona since we were going to spend one night there mid roadtrip but only left with disappointment. The breakfast had good food (first time seeing cinnamon rolls at a Hyatt), the room was decent and the view was awesome. However the room is very outdated and definitely needs a revamp. For starters we had 2 rooms and the AC didnt work in one so we had to get a different room. In our room the door would make this loud scratching noise, making us scared because we felt like it was about to break anytime we opened or closed it, along with that the door also didnt have a way of locking, it seems like there is supposed to be a handle there but there wasnt. We also went to get extra keys in the lobby and the front desk man had an attitude claiming we weren't in that room anymore because of the AC issue but we had to tell him we had 2 rooms and we wanted extra keys for the one that didnt move. Whilst also going out later, another man was waiting to check in and said he had been waiting almost half an hour to check in, we had a similar issue that it seems almost everytime we went for something, no one was at the front desk and we would have to wait for someone to show up. We love the hyatt and we're so disappointed with this hyatt. Hope they can renovate soon and keep up to par with the other hyatt's.

You have found paradise if you want to surround yourself with millennial parents and their screaming kids. As long as they’re happy, having fun in the sun, that’s all that matters. Other paying guests are in for a treat if they love excessive noise and relentless disruption.

Very disappointing experience at Hyatt Place Daytona Beach Oceanfront. Upon arrival, I was informed that the hotel was overbooked and had to wait nearly 4 hours in the lobby before receiving a room. Communication from staff was minimal throughout the process. What is even more frustrating is that the hotel later offered 30,000 World of Hyatt points as compensation and promised they would be issued within a few weeks. Nearly six months later, despite multiple follow-ups with both the hotel and Hyatt customer service, the points have still not been deposited. Mistakes can happen, but failing to honor a promised resolution for months is unacceptable. Unfortunately, this experience has significantly damaged my trust in both the property and Hyatt's customer service.

We arrived and there were tortilla chips in the ice bucket and poop in the toilet and dog pee on the floor. Obviously the room wasn’t cleaned properly if at all. We left and went to another hotel. It’s dog friendly which is good but I wouldn’t stay here. Everyone was nice though.

Great location, sub-par experience. Beds were comfortable but maintenance issues make it feel dirty. No hot water in the shower. Water was lukewarm at best. Breakfast was good...your average hotel breakfast. Just not what I expected from a Hyatt...more like super 8 level.

This oceanfront location has incredible views. Being able to just sit and watch the ocean is a favorite of mine. What this place has in views does not really make up for everything else. I will probably not ever stay here again. They do not air-condition the hallways so they are smelly and hot. The rugs in the hallways are threadbare and showing their age. There was mildew in the shower and there was no mat to keep the bathtub/shower combo from being slippery. There was no furniture on the porch. You could not sit on the porch. The breakfast was just a basic hotel breakfast. The pool was pretty but the pool furniture was pretty busted up. This location does not stand up to the Hyatt Place name.

This was easily the trashiest, most disgusting hotel I've ever stayed at - and it's supposed to be the Hyatt! Don't they pride themselves on quality? This place was dirty and grimy throughout the bathroom; brown nastiness on the rugs and on the lamp shades; mildew on the bathroom shower. We complained after arriving and they switched our room to a *moderately* better one and it was still the absolute most wretched thing I've ever stayed at. And I've done a lot of traveling as a professor. I was truly scared we might get bed bugs. We'd come back from the beach and the place would be 'picked up' but they didn't even change the linens or the bedding, it was the SAME stuff picked up off the floor and put right back onto the bed. The complementary food was served on RE-washed PLASTIC plates, which weren't even actually clean - ignoring the fact that the food was bad. There is a bar of snacks at the front desk... they ONLY have (and this isn't a joke or an exaggeration) red-hot firey chips or outdated cookies. lol And the staff weren't kind, to boot. Oh, and to top things off, the day we left, we went to put towels on the towel rack for the first time and it plopped right off the wall. We told the attendant, they said not to worry and this happens all the time... guess what they STILL charged us for, regardless, after the fact? Highly recommend you look elsewhere. Zero stars, 1,000x over.
Hotels halls were dirty. No chairs on balcony. No restaurant as advertised. Only good thing was the virw.

It felt like I was staying at an expensive Motel 6. The ceiling in the bathroom ( above the shower) was falling apart. The ceilings in the dining area of the lobby had brown spots. The elevators sound like they are going to fall apart when waiting for them, they also stop on whatever floor they want. The halls felt like the heat was turned on and the staff weren't very helpful after they finally registered what it was that you were saying.

the nastiest hyatt ever. breakfast served on one-time plastic plates, but was rewashed daily and reserved. bathroom were disgusting and covered in rust and oxidation. carpet ripped up in multiple places. hallways and elevators EXTREMELY HOT!!! do NOT waste your money here - really wish i could get my money back for this stay because $900 for a few nights in this? yeah disgusting

I booked this hotel 3 hours away from where I live. When I arrive at 10pm I’m told there’s no room for me because there’s no AC. I booked that room around 3:30pm. The guy said they have been working on the AC all day. Why have that room available if it’s not even in the right condition? Nobody contacted me through the hotel or Expedia about this cancellation. I am 5 months pregnant and now it’s 11pm on a holiday weekend and I’m trying to find a hotel to stay at that’s not fully booked or astronomically high in price. Now I have to pay double for a last minute hotel. Now fast forward I try to get a refund for a hotel I never stayed at and the hotel refused to pick up the phone after numerous attempts. So then I’m told through Expedia I won’t get a refund for my $200 stay instead I get $25? Since this hotel wouldn’t the phone I had to jump through more hoops to try to get a full refund for something that’s not even my fault.

This place is run down needs remodeling bad the elevators are hot the hall ways are hot no a/c circulating at all the breakfast is skimpy they have bed bugs very much over priced but it is in a convenient location this is the worse Hyatt I have ever seen the rooms smelled mildew this place is a no

It’s fine. The rooms are clean, nothing crazy. But the hallways are hotter than an oven and always smell like weed. The elevator is the slowest elevator I have ever used. The breakfast was fresh and tasty. The pool is clean, they have direct beach access. The lobby is swampy, and the front desk staff is meh. Not rude, but not super helpful. The parking is truly terrible. Not nearly enough spots for the amount of rooms they have. People park all over once spots fill up. Beach view from the beach view rooms is perfect. But the balconies don’t have any chairs. This feels more like a Super 8 than a Hyatt place.

Refrigerator broken, we bought snacks and had to get ice from the ice machine. Said it wound be replaced in the morning, didn’t happen. AC was not working, that wasn’t fixed either. Reported this to the front desk. It was just gross, the walls the carpet.,did not stay there another second. Front desk said sorry we don’t refund. I said idc just want to get out of this place. Hyatts use to be one of the best hotels. Not this one.

This place has a great location direct access to the beach, however this place is extremely outdated,the AC doesn't work in the rooms,we rented several rooms and noon of the rooms AC thermostats worked. The rates were good but the rooms were far from the quality that I've come to expect from a Hyatt Place Hotel. I'm a frequent traveler due to my profession, I grade this hyatt place a (3) out of 10 due to the state of the property. Hopefully management takes the time to get this property back up to standard's in which the customer's will have a different opinion of this property at some point, the parking situation is also horrible, the lobby area near the pool smells like urine, housekeeping is a after thought here, they're seems to be a shortage or just individuals that are just here to make a fast buck,😩😩
The smell in the room makes me can’t sleep!
Always is amazing the services
Buena experiencia

We had a nice stay at the Holiday Inn Express. All of the front desk staff were helpful and friendly. The rooms were clean and the a/c was cold. We had a problem with the door to the bathroom being a pocket door. It was difficult to open and close. I would imagine elderly guests or those with hand weakness would have difficulty opening and closing it.

Great Staff, alot of breakfast choices, Great cleaning staff, and the people at the desk are polite and professional. Also it's a short walk to Universal. It has multiple free shuttle bus rides and times too and from Universal. Here seven weeks for training. All around a great experience.
Very cramped rooms. Not enough room for two people. Bad design.

Highly recommend hotel, closer to Universal Studios Overall, this hotel offers the perfect combination of location, convenience, comfort, and exclusive park benefits. Whether you’re visiting as a couple, family, or group of friends, I highly recommend it for anyone planning a trip to Universal Orlando. We would definitely stay here again on our next visit.

This place was just fine. They had breakfast, which was great. He actually grind the coffee fresh for you. It’s very close to universal and a lot of other things. And on a hot day, that pool was looking good.

The waterpark, the location, the variety of options to eat & drink & ALL the staff helping with my questions. Also a quick shoutout to Roy & Miguel (for holding our luggage) Maria (breakfast) & especially Jacob (from Aquatics) everyone was very helpful & friendly making our stay more comfortable & memorable. THANK YOU️
Staff was great. They help me and my family with some accommodation. (Extra towels directions advices) Atmosphere was great. Family trip was awesome. Thank you guys.

The location is very convenient to universal. The room was pretty standard if not a tab bit small. The breakfast option was basic but be warned that it is very crowded. I’m pretty sure I was charged upwards of $10 for a bottle of water from the market which is a bit absurd. The staff was nice enough. Parking was adequate.

We had an easy check in, with very clean rooms, the bed was made and all the towels were stocked in the room. We had some time in the pool and it was very nice and quiet, and the breakfast was always delicious.
I saw a cockroach in the room
Clean and super comfortable bed! Breakfast is good with enough choices. Worth the money spent!
Good location nice staffs clean Good breakfast and free parking and restaurants and grosserie are bringing addition of washing and dryer machines available in 3 and 6 floor

This is a great hotel for a vacation at Universal. Everyone was kind and the room was clean. We mostly stayed at the parks, but we slept great and the breakfast was an added bonus. You can’t go wrong staying here for a Universal visit!!!

Comfy bed. Loose dog in the hallway lunged at me and almost gave me a heart attack. Breakfast was busy and tables were dirty. Universal shuttle didn’t run in the afternoon. Getting to universal from here is a slog even though it’s “nearest”. I guess there’s no good way to get to universal from anywhere.
Bathroom was pitiful for the price - needs an update with more than one tiny shelf in the shower. Bathroom pocket door presented a struggle to open, close, and lock. Staff was friendly and helpful
La cercanía y el servicio de quente lleven a los parques de Universal es excelente

This hotel has a very happy and friendly staff. The free breakfast is very good with a wide variety of proteins and sides with fresh ground, made to order coffee machines. We had 2 queen beds in our room. It was a bit small, but very clean with thoughtful amenities that make up for the slightly older but updated property. The air-conditioning kept up with the hot temperatures, but it remained a bit humid in the room. It was a great 4 night stay and the pool was a nice amenity. It's also close to the Pirate dinner theater which I highly recommend especially for families.

We recently stayed at the Holiday Inn Express in Orlando for 1 night while visiting Epic Universe at Universal, and it was a great experience for our family! The hotel was only about a 10-minute drive from the park, which made it super convenient. The kids really enjoyed the pool, and our room was clean, comfortable, and spacious enough for our family of 5. The front desk staff at check-in were very nice and welcoming, which made us feel right at home. The hot breakfast was also a big plus before heading out for the day, and having coffee available in the lobby 24 hours was a nice extra touch. Even though it was a short stay, we had a wonderful time and would definitely choose this hotel again for another mini getaway close to home!

We didnt' stay in the hotel much as we were doing touristy stuff; however, when we were there, the room was comfortable & the staff were helpful & friendly. There was plenty to choose from to eat during breakfast.

Can’t tell you about Holiday Inn express nearest universal unless I tell you about the woman, the myth, the legend! Her name is Miss Barbara. She went above and beyond to help my son and I. I thank her from the bottom of my heart.
Convenient location and clean facilities. Breakfast food freshness can be better (fruits).
This hotel is an amazing value near the Universal Resort. The room was clean. The staff was helpful. Breakfast had many options and was tasty.
Great place with delicious good. Bread and salads taste great and the food selection is awesome and always cooked to perfection. Shrimp scampi was delicious and shrimp were not overcooked.
By far best in lake mary
We love coming here, the food is always amazing, cocktails great and service excellent!!! We loved our server Amanda - she was attentive, friendly and awesome!! 10/10
Diego was awesome.
The nicest restaurant in the Lake Mary area. It's not even close.

The Caesar salad was also disappointing because the dressing was far too acidic and overpowering. Delicious. Highly recommend.
Leah was amazing!!! Very knowledgeable of the menu, professional and excellent customer service!! Oh, and the food was top tier! I highly recommend the swordfish.

Amanda was amazing! Her energy truly made our date night special. My wife and I really appreciated her attentive service. If you visit Fishbones, definitely ask for Amanda. The manager, Michelle, was also fantastic—she checked in to ensure everything was perfect. Thank you both; we can’t wait to return!

Amanda was absolutely amazing! My husband and I came in for a date night, and she made our experience exceptional from start to finish. She was friendly, attentive, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal. As someone with a gluten allergy, I really appreciate how many gluten-free options they offer and how accommodating they are—it makes dining here easy and enjoyable. Everything feels high quality, from the food to the overall atmosphere. Definitely one of my go-to spots in the area. 📍 More gluten-free finds on Instagram: @glutenfreewithkeith
Its worth the visit, you get less and pay more but here its worth it. The happy hour fish bites are delicious and the staff make you feal special, I keep coming back and leaving with a smile!

What a fantastic date night with my wife. Best salmon I've ever had and the pork chop was also delicious. Excellent service and management came by twice to check on things. I highly recommend this place.
Alaskan halibut was awesome. Shrimp cocktail was delicious. Everything else was great as well.

Kareem was our waiter, and amazing. He took time to explain options, give personal recommendations, and was light hearted. He was fun to talk to and really did provide the best recommendations for allergies, taste, and pairings. This place has a beautiful atmosphere, walking distance from our hotel, and menu options you'll dream about. Highly recommend.
Customer Service Is Everything! Beautiful Place, Beautiful People.

We love this Fishbones in Lake Mary. The management and service are always impeccable! Ashley was our server last night and she was amazing! She was friendly, very efficient and gave us an all around great dining experience. Steve was one of our previous servers and he popped over to say hello. He also gave us fantastic service when we had him as a server. The management that we usually see when we are there, Michelle and Alex, are always so welcoming and go out of their way to make sure our dining experience is always unforgettable. We met one of the new managers, Jessica, last night and she was also amazing. I highly recommend this location for your next dining experience!
It is always a great experience when dining here.

First time eating there, it was amazing food. Waiter Marco was very helpful and super nice. Matt the operating partner super friendly went around to every table greeting customers.we will definitely eat here again.

Had a wonderful experience and dinner! Homemade sangria, bang, bang shrimp, prime rib, and butter cake were delicious! Heading back to try escargot, oysters and bone in ribeye! Also Diego, our server, was excellent!!

We had an incredible time as always. Amanda made us feel so welcome and made great recommendations. Food is always excellent; especially the presentation of the crème brûlée! Great spot for date night.
Great experience and food everytime we go.
Amanda made our night so much more fun with her great personality and dinner suggestions. Would recommend coming in and seeing her to enhance your dinner atmosphere.
Excellent service and great food. One young lady in particular was very helpful. Her name was Samantha

Really loved my experience at this hotel. I stayed here over the weekend to go to Universal theme parks, and choosing this hotel was the right decision. The location is super convenient, it is only a 5-7 min drive to the Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure, and a 13-15 min drive to the Epic Universe. If you want to Uber to the parks, it ends up being reasonable cause of the close proximity. This hotel also offers free shuttle service to the parks and back to the hotel. The shuttles leave in the morning at about 45 minute intervals, and start returning to the hotel 5pm onwards all the way up to 9:20pm. It's super convenient to use the shuttle and because the park is super close, it only makes one additional stop (takes about 10 minutes to get to Universal Studios). The hotel was very well maintained and furnished for a 3-star hotel. The rooms are super spacious, clean, and with new furniture. They also feature a nice living area with a sofa-bed, and a small kitchen with a microwave, kettle, and a refrigerator. The bathrooms, however, are a little small but still pretty clean and ideal. The hospitality and service at this hotel is remarkable. We came to Orlando to celebrate a special occasion, and the hotel staff presented us with a small gift package, a handwritten card, and a bottle of wine! This gesture was really sweet. The staff is also super polite and try to be as helpful as possible (they're also really fun to talk to). We had free breakfast included with our…

Buen Dia, Hotel con una ubicación espectacular, muy cerca a los parques de Universal, si quisieras puedes ir caminando, además de la cercanía con tiendas de marca Outlets, Cuenta con piscina al aire libre, Las personas de servicios son muy amables y atentas!
Close to universal studios at a decent price..

I had a great experience during my stay thanks to Dawneth. When I arrived, there was an issue with my reservation because the company that booked my stay had not paid for the room as expected. Despite the inconvenience, she remained professional, patient, and extremely helpful throughout the entire process. She took the time to investigate the issue, kept me informed, and worked diligently to find a solution. Her positive attitude and outstanding customer service turned what could have been a very stressful situation into a smooth and pleasant experience. Thank you for going above and beyond to help me. Employees like you make all the difference, and I truly appreciate your dedication to excellent customer service.
Dawneth was amazing!!! She went above and beyond to help me. The room is very nice and clean.

After a long travel day that literally anything that could go wrong would, a last minute booking at the Hyatt Place across from Universal was the best thing I could’ve done. Immediately checking in with Dawneth I relaxed. She recognized we had a long day and made sure the rest of our night would not be a repeat of the day we had. She was amazing and I so appreciated her kindness. I literally breathed a sigh of relief talking to her. Great customer service and just a genuinely nice person. Sincerely Nicole Curcio
The staff here was excellent! Alissa was so helpful with getting our reservations coordinated with other family members and setting me up with Hyatt rewards.

First off, the Staff is amazing and accommodating. The ladies working when we arrived were Donna, and two other wonderful ladies. They made us feel welcomed and offered advise on everything from drinks to universal theme parks tips. No issue there, but as for the HVAC in the rooms, terrible and uncomfortable. The room stayed at 73 degrees, resulting in me buying two oscillating fans for the room to try to keep the room cool enough to sleep. I usually love Hyatt and the locations are great and pricing is real good, but I will not be staying at this hotel again. Mrs Doona was the only reason I didn’t leave the hotel for other accommodations and was very apologetic for having to purchase fans

Stayed here back in February. Rooms were a bit expensive. We soon realized that there was cheerleading/dance competition happening that weekend. Overall, it is a fine place to stay if you plan to be at the parks all day. It's a bare bones type of joint. Small hotel bar and pool. It is a 12-15 min walk and we loved that you almost got your own entrance to Universal. We would definitely stay here again and hope we pick the right weekend to go. We literally paid almost triple then what it normally costs to stay here!
Great service! Great room! Shoutout to Dawneth for being the most professional, sweet and best Hyatt manager ever!

Great location, great rooms, with a very solid breakfast. The staff was amazing and very knowledgeable about the local areas and the nearby theme parks. They also provide a shuttle to the Universal Theme Parks. I will say I was surprised there was a charge for parking, though. I was already paying for a room charging for parking seemed a bit much.

Everything was clean, peaceful (once inside), and very comfortable. I will definitely be booking here again, especially if I can get the same room again.
Great location, large comfortable room, staff friendly and helpful.

We will Not Ever stay at this hotel again or would we recommend it , oh ya , good luck trying to sleep with all the motorcycles racing up and down the area at night.

The Hyatt Place was THE PLACE to go. From the moment we entered the Hotel, we saw friendly faces at the reception. Room was huge, did not expect this at all. Once again we had an amazing stay at the Hyatt, César on reception is a credit to the company. It is people like him that makes us want to keep coming back.
service was wonderful. breakfast was delicious and staff was so kind! Karelys was a wonderful pancake chef!!! Would definitely come back.

Falta un poco de aseo pero del resto bien. Mas variedad en el desayuno

My initial room, Suite 420, was in an unacceptable condition. I have documented extensive carpet and furniture stains, as well as mold blowing from the vents onto the bed and living room furniture. Additionally, the floors were dangerously slippery and appeared uncleaned. The Pillows had no date on them and were not in compliance. While the staff was friendly and moved me to a different room upon request, the second room also had carpet stains and a broken toilet seat. When I confronted the hotel management, they admitted to being aware of the issues in the first room yet continued to rent it out. The general cleanliness of the property is poor, with large, unaddressed spills and stains in the hallways. I believe this location requires a formal inspection from the corporate office to bring it up to standard. I have photos and video footage of these conditions available upon request.
We enjoyed our stay! All staff members were friendly and the breakfast was delicious.
This hotel was great! Clean, friendly staff and close to the parks. Cannot wait until our next stay!

Excelente habitaciones la piscina fue increíble lo único malo es la ubicación por qué no le encontré tan buena pero excelente, un recuerdo inolvidable en mi vida de este viaje hacia Orlando abril del 2026

Very comfortable beds, The pool was nice but one pool was closed, Nice interior but a few paint scratches, The lobby was very good looking, The staff was very kind and friendly, lots of people was in the pool, And the exterior was almost new, The Dunkin’ and Starbucks interior was cool. It’s my wife’s birthday. I wanted her to sample everything. At that point, after waiting for 45 minutes, my wife and I decided to leave. I’ve been here before, but my wife had not. The food is delicious, but they cannot properly handle a crowd. If you decide to go, and I don’t recommend it, check google to make sure they aren’t busy. Or have a back up plan. Texas de Brazil is right around the corner.
It was too expensive for the service and quality. I was disappointed.

This is our second time dining in 2 years. I feel like it's better years ago than now. Overall just ok 👌🏼
What a great experience! The staff and food are amazing. If you haven't ever tried a Japanese BBQ you must give Gyu-Kaku a try. It's a great way to experience amazing food with friends and family!

Maybe I came on the wrong night, but unfortunately I was not pleased or impressed with my experience. The service itself was good, and I want to make it clear that my server did his best throughout the evening. However, my $80 steak arrived significantly undercooked and was very difficult to eat. The staff did attempt to correct the issue, which I appreciated, but by that point the overall dining experience had already been disrupted. My girlfriend and I were celebrating a special occasion—our first date, first dinner together, and first trip out of town as a couple. We were looking forward to sharing a memorable meal, but because my steak had to be sent back, we never really got to enjoy dinner together. Her steak was served at the same time as mine, so she had already started eating while I waited for my replacement. Since everything was à la carte, my sides became cold while I waited, and I had to request fresh sides as well. When the fresh sides arrived, my steak still had not returned, so I ended up eating the sides and sharing food from my girlfriend's plate. By the time my steak finally came back, she had already finished her meal. Her steak was also undercooked, but she chose to eat it anyway. I even had to request that my steak be cooked an entire temperature higher than originally ordered just to get it prepared correctly. At that point, I was already full from the sides and eating from my girlfriend's plate. Instead of enjoying my meal fresh as intended, I only…

My wife and I celebrated our 23rd wedding anniversary and we are so happy we decided to make reservations for Hyde Park. From the two seafood appetizers, Lump crab cocktail and Lobster escargot style to the perfectly cooked Steaks. Everything was amazing. When you spend that kind of money on a meal you expect the best and Hyde Park delivered.

We ate at the Daytona location last night and were expecting our usual pleasant dining experience. I have been in the meat industry for over 40 years and this place generally never disappoints. Well last night was disappointing without a doubt. There is a new policy that you have to ask for bread/pretzel sticks. When I asked for a 2nd time the server had an attitude about it. When our meals came the lobster originally came WITHOUT the butter. When asking for it, it finally came and it was cold and the warmers would not stay lit due to where we were sitting. When my meal came they completely left off the the topping of crab,asparagus and bernaise(yeesh). I found that the strip steak was choice at best...it used to be prime. It has become very obvious that they are cutiing back on the cost of their ingredients, the most obvious was that you have to ask for bread. The kicker is that everything on the menu has gone up in price, and I found the steak was of lower quality. The manager did comp us on dessert but between the poor service and the obvious reduction in costs I am not sure when or if we will go back. It's unfortunate since we have been eating here for close to a decade and it never disappointed. Maybe it was just a bad night for them ?

Harp & Celt Irish Pub & Restaurant feels like one of those places that has quietly outlasted every downtown trend, rebrand, and concept bar that came and went around it. Walk through the doors and you’re immediately hit with what an Irish pub is supposed to feel like: dark wood, cozy booths, a little bit of organized chaos, cold beer, and people who look like they’ve been coming here for years. The two-story layout gives the place a lot of character, and there always seems to be something happening. Whether it’s a quick pint before an event, a long lunch, or a downtown night that accidentally lasts longer than planned, Harp & Celt fits the occasion. The food is exactly what you want from an Irish pub. Shepherd’s pie, fish and chips, Guinness, and all the classics without trying to reinvent them. Sometimes tradition survives for a reason. What stood out most was that the place feels genuine. Not curated. Not manufactured. Just a comfortable downtown institution where locals, visitors, office workers, and late-night wanderers all somehow end up under the same roof. In a city that changes as fast as Orlando, places with this much history and personality are worth hanging onto. 🦩

We hosted my daughter’s birthday at Ice Factory and had an amazing time. The staff was attentive, the event was well organized and the birthday included a lot of great features. My daughter said it was her best birthday yet and all of her guests also had an amazing time. Thank you Sariah, for making my daughter’s day special.

We had the BEST time celebrating our daughter’s birthday at the Ice Factory. Our party heroes were incredible and made her day super special. They were so attentive to every detail and helped all of our guests feel welcome. We can’t wait to go back and celebrate more birthdays there! Kayle and Allison were amazing!

Friendly staff, the facility however not so good. Ice conditions were horrible, you had the back end of the arena closed off, multiple parties going on, too many ppl on a Saturday. Not a whole lot of place to skate. Skates left me blisters, and then they had everyone out for birthday party event and Zamboni ride. Keep in mind they open from 2-4pm and then reopen 7-10pm but if you close the ice for private event, it cuts our time. For a family of 4, and 2 seal rentals we spent $111
The staff is extremely kind and knowledgeable. My daughter loves the classes and we love being there. Great ice skating rink! 🫶
Kids had sn amazing time.
Great ice complex to skate at with the family. Very clean facility and nice staff.

My son and I love it and we had a blast everytime. The floor is huge and very well-maintained, which made skating easy. The staff is super attentive, kind, constantly cleaning and checking in on the floor. Music is fun.

Visited yesterday with lots of friends!! Really fun, only complaint among the group was that they changed the skates and the new ones left blisters (or something of the sort?) on all of our ankles. Staff was absolutely amazing. Looking forward to my next visit!

Friendly reminder : the skates on my child gave her a bruise on each ankle, she had been complaining all night about the change of skates. She started crying after because of the pain which never happened with the other skates.

My family just celebrated a birthday at the Ice Factory. The birthday girl couldn’t be happier. Our party hero, Alex, took care of everything and hosted the group with a lot of energy and attention, the room was pre-decorated with table cloths and party themed utensils, all we had to do was bring cake and some decorative balloons. 5 stars, fully recommend. :)

We celebrated our daughter’s 9th Birthday and had Sara as our host. She was patient, organized fun games to keep the kids entertained, and knowledgeable and helpful for the beginner skaters. Most importantly, the kids had a blast. I highly recommend them for your next party.
Nice place to have fun
This is a great place! I wish I had known about it before. My daughter is enjoying her skating classes and public skating here.

We celebrated my daughter’s 7th birthday. Our host, Alex, was wonderful. She quickly connected with the all the kids, help with every detail, and was a pleasure along the way. We look forward to our next trip to Ice Factory.
It was a birthday party. The host name was Isabel she was very good and very attentive to our party
Es un buen lugar para llevar niños, varios tamaños de pistas de hielo para patinar, los zapatos están en buen estado. La entrada principal está justo frente a una carretera que está en renovación.
Got a weird vibe. Think I'll head to the other location in Maitland.

The team at The Ice Factory were great. This is the third birthday party we have had here. Our party host spent a ton of time with the kids. The party room was fun. It was all around a good time. I will continue to book birthdays with them.
My kids take ice skating classes here. They love it. All staff are super nice.

We celebrated my son's birthday party there, he turned 5 and it was great! Isabel was our party heroe and she was awesome, parents and kids had a blast! Everything was better than I thought. I definitely recommend booking a party with them and probably will use them in the future 🤩😍
Yikes. Pass.
We love Axel's skating school. From ages to 14 to 7, my kids have a blast!

I love taking lessons at the ice factory. Jenny, Becky, Camille, sia, are just some of the few that I have worked with. They are all amazing. If you want to learn to skate there is not better place than this. The price is great but the quality is even better.

Went to go check it out and learn more because my daughter wants to learn how to ice skate. Walked around tried to talk to staff - one made eye contact, none spoke to me. I genuinely felt unwelcome. I left after 5 minutes. It smelled nice inside though.
So far it was $230 for Tuesday-Thursday but I have my service dog with me so there's a dog tax , resort fee, and parking comes out to and extra $180 . Insane

I have been staying at this hotel every time I come to Kissimmee. Staff is always friendly, assertive, attentive and very helpful. The lobby and rooms are always clean and well kept. Carlos went above and beyond today in which he didn’t have to do, but he saved my day from having a terrible experience at a different hotel. Carlos is the man. He’s a Super Visor for a reason in which he cares for the guests that stay here. Thank you sir for what you do. And I am officially a member of IHG and Holiday Inn

It's ok for a Holiday inn, i have definitely seen nicer more updated one's. 2 queen beds with a 21 in tv is kind of a bummer. And it's crazy that every room has a balcony but you can't smoke on them without catching a $100 charge. Just because it's across from the small amusement area of old town, it is $100 more per night that something 8 minutes down the road that is way better. Not to mention for a place that can handle somewhere around 500 people there isn't many handicap parking spots. Only 4 for the back building my wife had to walk from the back of the parking lot after having back surgery.
Thanks to Raphael & Carlos for the service and for the attention. Brazil and PR en la Casa 🇵🇷🇧🇷

We really enjoyed our stay here. The room was great as well at the amenities that this hotel has to offer. The staff was also very polite and kind, especially Kiara who works at the front desk. She was very helpful and polite. She made our long day so much easier!
The rooms including the bathroom/personal product items, beds/bedding, fridge and microwave nice and clean.. everything was as it should be. Very nice place
Conmfotable stay, friendly staff and close to shops, stores and entertainment

Very clean and helpful staff. We stayed on our way up to convention for the American Legion. We chose this hotel as it was close enough to our next hotel that we were unable to get into for that night. It was a win/win. Definitely recommend this hotel.
Carlos y su compañero me dieron tremendo servicio su amabilidad y simpatía fue la mejor los recomiendo al 100% me volvería a quedar aquí nuevamente
Bom serviço, café da manhã, limpeza.

I NEVEEER leave reviews but these people deserve it. I wanted to give a huge shoutout to Veronica and Parisa in the lobby! They were such an amazing touch to the event and made us feel incredibly welcome from the moment we arrived. I was visiting friends who were attending the event, and I had to take a moment to recognize how wonderful they were. A special thank you to Veronica from bookings (or groups I think she said lol) who honestly deserves an even bigger role because she went above and beyond for us. She helped us search everywhere for my lost phone, only for it to turn out that I had left it in the bathroom the whole time! Even so, she was patient, kind, and genuinely cared about helping. Thank you both for making our day and for the exceptional hospitality. All of the staff were amazing, but Veronica and Parisa truly stood out in all their pride support!
Fantastic hotel. Enjoyed everything breakfast was good. Stay was clean and view was gorgeous. Loved every memories we made.

Had a blast the weekend we stayed here. Everything you could need is in walking distance if the hotel doesn’t have it. The staff was so nice and polite, Davion was so helpful when we needed help. Plan on staying here next year!!!

I stayed at the hotel recently and the service was excellent! The rooms clean, modern, and comfortable. The pool area was well cared for and the bar/food options are great. Special mention to the great staff at the front desk! They all are pleasant and professional. Carlos assisted me with a doable booking issue which was not related to the hotel, but took the extra time to confirm it had been straightened out, thank you Carlos!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ If you’re coming to GayDays and staying at the Holiday Inn on 192, you’re in good hands! This weekend was an absolute blast, and a huge part of that was the staff. From the moment we arrived, the entire hotel team was incredibly welcoming, overly accommodating, and fully embraced the GayDays spirit. Not once did we feel like we were just another room number.
