They were always friendly, patient, and ready to help. The restaurant crew—Karin, Adriana, Marley, Sacha, and Martha—kept us fed, caffeinated, and happy all weekend long. Y’all are the real MVPs. Big love to the VIP room team: Robb, D, Rob, Skull, and Jeremy. Thank you for putting up with all of us and keeping the good vibes going. You made everyone feel welcome and taken care of. Shout out to Sheila and Rachel for serving drinks with a smile, Ryan for being an amazing VIP host, and Wilson for keeping the pool scene running smoothly while the rest of us were busy making questionable life choices in the Florida sun. What really stood out was how much the entire staff embraced the GayDays culture. They didn’t just tolerate the crowds, costumes, glitter, and celebrations—they welcomed it and helped create an environment where everyone felt comfortable being themselves. Thank you to every single person who worked this weekend. You…
Friendly staff, a bit dated could use some freshing up. The public restrooms aren't very wheelchair friendly.

I often stay here when my friends and I go for a get away weekend but this last stay was amazing. We got there late, tired, and a little disorganized and Toni was very sweet and helpful with everything. She got us checked in and of to our room for the night quickly and held the up most patience with my questions. I would visit 1000 more times if it meant Toni was there to greet us.
Carlos at check in was super polite and accommodating. Quick and he explained all the pending charges
Fun and relaxing

Great location and near many attractions. Breakfast buffet has good options! Pool is large and open late. Room service was not as hoped! We let the service desk know and they acted on it promptly, so good overall.

For the price, the quality and location of this hotel is great. The staff was welcoming, knowledgeable and helpful. The breakfast is a good start to the day and although we didn't use the pools they looked nice for families. The hotel is on a major route near Disney World resorts and has services with shuttles there as well as with other major parks. There is also easy access to public transportation. It's a bit further from Universal but relatively close to Sea World and perfect for getting to and from anything in Disney World. Also right across from Old Town. While the highway outside if quite busy, they have dark shades in the rooms that block out all light and most noise (we had a roadside room and slept without issue). The beds are comfortable and the pillows nice and hefty. Finally a shout out to Veronica C. and her colleagues for making our long days at Disney World that much easier because the hotel stay was a breeze and restful.

This hotel has very friendly and helpful staff. Room was very clean, Breakfast food was great and the service was very good. Pool area was clean and well maintained, check in/check out was very smooth and hassle free. Would definitely recommend.

There’s service, and then there’s above and beyond. Management team was so understanding and made my whole trip to FL worth it. Kayla and Veronica 15/10 stars for customer service 🙏 Found my new fav hotel 🏨

Absolutely amazing vibes. And great beer choices. We came in one day and came back the next. If you are in Orlando you must stop in if you love custom brews! Earth girls are easy is my favorite beer that’s for sure!!! My wife loves the wine slushy!!! Amazing!!! And the food is great. The owner did a great job picking the food choices for the bar.
Super cool spot. Unique brewed options. The food is quality and delicious. Our bartender was a rockstar. She was super helpful with everything. We will be back on our visit in August!
Relaxed atmosphere and the bartender was very appreciative of our visit. I’d come back any time I’m in this area.
This is a fun place to eat. Beware that their food menu is minimal but tasty.

Very welcoming place! As a first-time visitor, I was noticed and welcomed right away. The staff went out of their way to make me feel at home and provided excellent recommendations. The atmosphere was friendly, and the overall experience was outstanding. Awesome place I’ll definitely be back!
The beer selection and the buffalo wing sauce were amazing. The chef makes the sauce from scratch and it is one of the best I’ve had.
Best Staff and Beer selection

Visiting the local theme parks and found this place close to the hotel we were at. Ordered the pretzel, wings, a flatbread and quesadilla. All the food was good and excellent selection of beers on tap and in can. Very happy with our decision to stop by!

Solid spot for a craft beer and decent food. Draft list had 4 ipas, 2-3 light beers, some seltzers, 2 slushies, and several more eccentric beers which I thought were a bit out of the mainstream (eg a coffee lager). Bartender was friendly and welcoming, and attentive.
Great beers and friendly atmosphere.
Great customer service Good food
I love the chicken wings at this place. The dry rub is something you’ve never tried before. Delicious and always freshly made.
Cool spot great food cold beer not theme park prices!
Great beer, fast and good food. Recommended.

Did a take out order of Chicken Tenders & Fries because a lot of businesses in that area are closed on Sundays and needed something close. Staff were very friendly and helpful! Great selection of food aswell.

Coolest place. Owners are from Michigan. Pia was a great host and spoke with us for a while. I’ll go back and more importantly recommend it to ANYONE visiting Orlando. Beer was perfect. We did not eat but the menu looks legit.

We stopped in for a couple of beers and an appetizer. Glad we did! They have a great selection of local/regional beers and a few excellent brews of their own(Lime in the Coconut was our fav)...try the cheese kurds if you are hungry!
Fantastic little local brewery. Food and Service were amazing
Great experience here. I had the Lime and coconut sour and it was one of the best I’ve ever had period. And the customer service is the best bar none. Highly recommend

The beer is a little pricey . Stone ground mustard for the pretzel is the spiciest I’ve ever had and the pretzel is the smallest big pretzel I’ve ever had . Disappointed there are not and dessert items for food . There is lots of glare from the lighting and many of the bulbs are too bright ! The bathroom should have a motion sensor rather than a switch that you have to touch and there is a laundry basket with a lid for the trash that makes no sense as you re contaminate you hands after throwing away a paper towel as you have to touch the handle that likely clean hands have not touched .

Beers are top notch and the bar service is excellent, staff is friendly and helpful. Wings are amazing. Had the buffalo flavored ones with blue cheese. Giant prezel was fantastic. Beer cheese sauce is wonderful and the spicy mustard sauce is very good too. Definitely will return.

Lovely hotel. Staff are brilliant, nothing is tooyvj trouble they will help wherever they can, if not they will check and get you and answer. We asked for our room to be cleaned early as some days er went back no problem at all. Easy access to i4. You can walk to Vineland outlet 30-30mins catch the iride for I drive, SeaWorld and squatica easy. Applebee's no longer there but holiday Inn planning their own restaurant. Tiki bar at pool currently undergoing a refurbishment but no lapse in service, Lisa is brilliant, remembers your drink and is so friendly. Pool area lovely with kids activities, hot tubs (and they are hot) shade where needed and never been over crowded. Didn't use shuttle so no comment on that. Outside; there are fast food (Wendy's, McDonald's, chick filet) Walgreens, dollar tree in easy walking distance (5 mins tops) as well as gift store, mini golf, Starbucks and Dunkin donuts. 7-11 next door. For these turn left out of hotel. If you drive right under the bridge there are further restaurants etc. It's a lovely hotel but at this moment they are doing a breakfast which we looked at and thought for $14 definitely not worth it, there is a golden Corral 3 mind walk aest (turn right) with so much choice and better value, although there is a fridge and microwave in room so you can do a quick brekky, there us a Keurig with coffee pods and tea provided, we prefer our tea and bring a kettle. There are washing machines and dryers, card only operated $3.50 . We like it,…

While the rooms and location are ok, the overall experience is a little sub-par. We were placed on the 6th floor, which is fine... except that they set the hall AC to 82 and its musty. Hot wet smell isnt a confidence booster. While there is construction, the hotel is a bit challenging to navigate and the recurring feeling it hasn't been well maintained keeps lingering. A lot is in the details: the parking gate is awkward to navigate, buildings arent clearly labled, and portions feel dated. Some is nice. Some is... "whyd they do that?" Staff is... variable. Some are good. Some very very slow. Not a bad experience but given options id book elsewhere next time.
My room AC didn't work. The room smelled. When I informed the desk they didn't offer any help for my 3 night stay.

The location is great. It is between everything and very close to the Universal parks. The room was big. We booked a room with a bunk bed section for kids. The room needed some very minor maintenance, which I ignored. The staff is helpful. One of our friends got a room with a bad smell, and they replaced it immediately. Home service is great, and the pool is big and clean. The shuttle bus service is useless. There is only one shuttle bus to Universal Studios, and it leaves at 7 a.m., before the park opens. My plan was to use it to save on parking, but it didn’t work. I am adding a pic for bus schedules.
A bit tricky to get in and out of the parking lot but over all great
Makes you pay apart, had no towels at the pool overpriced and staff don’t speak any English!! Not worth the money
Great location and ammunition that we enjoyed with family on my son's birthday

Everyone working at the hotel was kind and knowledgeable. The room was nothing fancy but it was clean and comfortable. The restaurant was under construction when I stayed which was a little inconvenient for breakfast but there are nearby options for dinner and a mini mart in the lobby. The only bad part of my stay was the shuttle service through a third party to the Disney Parks. The first two morning drop offs are only at Epcot and it was not straightforward to get to the other parks. Buses don’t run to Animal Kingdom until 10am, getting to Magic Kingdom needs two monorails, etc. Though the schedule changed seasonally, the pick up times were late in the evening after most of the parks had been closed.

Hotel is fairly new and pretty clean. Pool is nice. Transportation is awful. They say that they are within walking distance to downtown disney but it is almost a 2 mile walk which isn't terrible but.... just be aware of that if you have young kids, elderly people, or anyone that has trouble walking for more than 20-30 minutes. They offer no shuttles to downtown disney. The only shuttles that they offer are one to seaworld for the whole day and only four shuttles to magic kingdom. If you want to go to the other parks you have to transfer from magic kingdom. They are not very helpful with info on transportaion either. Would be a great place if they had better shuttle service.
Only been here for 3 days out of the 14 we've booked but already know that we'll be back cannot fault it in any way

All of the staff was super nice and friendly. Check in was a breeze. The pool was great, the hot tubs could be warmer. The onsite restaurants were closed so that was kind of a let down. Also, the $14 adult breakfast was kind of a rip. It was just basic continental breakfast foods that is normally free at other hotels.

The hotel is very very good, the lobby amazing, the room super clean, the staff so friendly and kind, always nice and helpful, and the best of everything was Miss Judith 💕 she so sweet and fun, we really enjoyed our birthday boy vacation because of her ❤️ she plays fun games every hour at the pool for the kids, if you win you get a price (really nice price for kids) She is always taking care to the stuff that people needs and she helps and talk with a smile 😊 thank you Miss Judith you are the best and beyond ✨
Nice rooms. Hotel is hard to navigate. If you make a wrong turn you’ve really messed up. I walked in circles until I figured it out.

Pasamos varios días allí, servicio excelente. La habitación cómoda. Siempre la limpiaban. Piscina limpia, jacuzzi súper, no hay parqueadero y debes pagar 20 dólares la noche. No incluye desayuno. Ubicación perfecta para los parques, quedaba a 10 o 15 minutos máximo.

Room was clean and very quiet which I appreciate. Further away from Universal Studios. Took us around 20 mins to get there thru heavy traffic. And if your on a budget not the place for you. $14 per person for breakfast (cheaper at Ihop down the street) and $20 a day to park your car there which I feel is a dig to get more money out of you.
Pésimo servicio para explicar las cosas bien y de una manera amable. Esperaba mucho más del servicio al cliente.
Great R&R. Family enjoyment. Great Hospitality

We had an enjoyable stay recently at Holiday Inn in Orlando, Florida. The location, room for a family of 6, and the pool are all reasons to stay there. The cost was fair and my points, as a IHG member, grew. Try them out next Orlando trip you make!

"Elegimos este hotel principalmente por su ubicación estratégica y superó por completo nuestras expectativas. Si viajas con la mira puesta en aprovechar al máximo los parques temáticos de Orlando, este lugar es una joya. Lo mejor sin duda: Cercanía real: Está a solo unos minutos en auto de las entradas principales. Nos permitió optimizar el tiempo de traslado por la mañana y, lo mejor de todo, regresar rápido a descansar cuando terminaban los espectáculos nocturnos sin sufrir el pesado tráfico de la ciudad.
She was a really nice lady , Geisha helped us out a lot with getting us our essentials like towels and other things .
Great place
The rooms are very spacious and nice. Just a little outdated and some stained furniture. Other than that the hotel is very nice and well kept. Sheets, bedding, and everything else were very clean!!

Hotel perfeito para sua experiência na Disney. Fica a 10 minutos dos parques, o que torna seu dia muito proveitoso. Fácil acesso aos principais outlets de Orlando. No apartamento, cama extremamente confortável e quarto muito espaçoso, não possui café da manhã e o estacionamento é pago à parte.
Excellent location, close to the outlets and Disney Springs, be aware that traffic in that road is heavy due to volume and construction so plan ahead of time to get to your destination as needed.
This place is as cool as the name. Wait to you see the showmanship at the bar, no spoilers.

I had an amazing time at ICEBAR Orlando! The ice sculptures were incredible, and the atmosphere inside the ice bar was unlike anything I've experienced before! The furry coats and gloves kept us comfortable in the cold temperature while we enjoyed drinks served in ice glasses. The Fire Lounge was the perfect place to warm up afterward, with great music and a fun bar. If you're looking for a unique night out in Orlando, this is the place.

Ice bar was such a fun time! Great drinks, Lynn was an AMAZING bartender, quick, great to chat with, and the drinks were so delicious. All of the staff was amazing, Brianna in the front made me feel welcomed, explained how to explore the bar with her recommendations, and the atmosphere was such a vibe! You need to check out the Icebar for sure!

Decided to grab some drinks while I was in the area and our bartender at the fire lounge, Lynn, made the best well balanced and flavorful martini I had in a while. Once we were done, we headed over to the Icebar and Briana took great care of us there. If you’re ever in, ask for them and they’ll provide the best service ever.
Atmosphere was really nice, staff was very welcoming, music was great! Food and drinks were amazing!! All around great first time experience
Roxy was great. Very attentive and drinks were amazing!
Roxy was so sweet!!
Roxi absolutely crushed it! Super fast service, amazing drinks, and a great attitude. She made our visit even better. ⭐️🍸🙌

Great experience, service, and atmosphere. You most definitely have to try the ice room and wear the fur coats. Drinks were amazing, as well as service. The General Manager Corbin took care of us, awesome service, very friendly and made us feel welcomed. We will definitely return when we are in Orlando Florida.
Amazing
First time here! Definitely will be back with more friends and family.. Enjoy my pre bday celebration here at ICEBAR.. Our server Sofia was amazing 👏🏾

I was looking for a place to host a unique alumni-student networking event and this was perfect! Great food and drink, helpful for our group of about 50 to network and we also had a panel on stage which was great. Everyone loved the Icebar experience, lots of great photos. Hailey, our event coordinator, was amazing and took great care of us from start to finish. Highly recommend.
This was a very unique experience! I came for a private event. The catering was great and I LOVED the Icebar room.
Everything nice gift cheap. Friendly environment
Super cool

Very expensive. 50 dollars per person to experience sitting in a freezer with the tiniest cocktail.....no way I would ever go again. The male bartender was terrific. The female bartender wouldn't even look at us. Served 5 people ahead of us. And we were standing at the bar 30 minutes before all of them even arrived. Just awful!!
dj pop roxxx 4evr
Fun place with great music.

What an awesome place, I came in and absolutely loved my experience with the berger seidle party. The food was great, awesome drinks, and Corbin was an awesome person who helped me out tremendously along side Blake. I never knew anything about this place, they were super accommodating and even made sure my 8 year old could return to see the ice bar herself and experience the magic and beauty of it. 10 out of 10, would highly reccomend a visit. Excited to see the theme on my next visit. Make sure you check it out!
Nice alternative
Service was good. Drinks were good.
This place used to be really good. Now its just terrible!
Good food
Come here for tasty, truly authentic Lebanese Shawarma and cuisine.
La comida y la atencion excelente
Had the mixed shawarma sandwich with xtra garlic sauce, spicy potatoes, and xtra dish of garlic sauce to go. Service was friendly and quick! Will be returning for another garlic fix soon!

Food was absolutely fantastic!! For such a small place, I was so impressed by how many options they had and how fast they got it out to us. I absolutely will b returning the next time I’m down in Orlando. Lebanese and Mediterranean food is my absolute favorite and this is up there in the top 5 restaurants I’ve been to :)
This is what I've been looking for in Orlando for a long time. It's SO good. I was spoiled for choice in Europe, this scratches that itch. Highly recommend.
I had lentil soup. It was de-licious!! Also had the baklava, I couldn't taste the honey, but it was good either way.
As a fast food place, I enjoyed good foods, good services there today.

The food is absolutely terrible that we actually made a point to eat beforehand because we expected it to be that bad based on our experience as can bad. The service is no better; the staff lacks even the most basic understanding of hospitalization . What’s most concerning, however, is the management. The manager is not only unprofessional but seems completely out of depth when it comes to running a venue in the entertainment space. Based on this experience, it’s hard to see how this place sustains itself long-term.

The only thing I can complain about is that they only have 2workers, 1 is running the register,the 2nd is handling the food,which results in slow service..food tastes great..remember,this is a quick service stop for Authentic Lebanese food..if you care more about food versus service it's your place to go

I ordered a platter, which they said would take about 40 minutes. As I waited, people who ordered after me got their food and mine still wasn't ready. An hour later they still didn't have it ready. More than an hour later I got the food and I waited in the store to get it. The food in the platter was COLD and there were very small portions of chicken and beef. The platter was mostly hummus and taboule. Even the rice was cold. I'm so very dissapointed that after waiting so long for them to make this food, that it was all cold. Very, very dissapointed.

We absolutely love the food here! Very delicious, and offered at a reasonable price. The Staff were friendly, and seem to work very hard at preparing meals for their Customers. If you are looking for great food at a good cost, then be sure to stop by Habibi....you will not be disappointed!

One of the best places we’ve tried in the Orlando area. They handmade everything, I saw them scooping out falafels fresh and frying them. The guy at the register was so sweet and warm and amazing. Felt very homey and cozy. Also the prices are affordable for a great meal. Don’t sleep on them they’re fantastic.
Service was extremely slow to order and recieve food. Food was good but have had better .
Good, fresh and authentic
Hice un pedido en línea las papas llegaron crudas El Shawarma no tenía casi que nada , no enviaron ningún tipo de salsas no se que a pasado pero an bajado su calida mucho

The absolute best place for an authentic shwarma!!!!! Their food is 5 star restaurant quality!! All the ingredients are fresh and made to order! I could eat here everyday of the week lol never gets old!!!! So delicious!
The very best food in town! Cooked with olive oil and halal meat. Meaning no garbage meat from big beef or chickens raised in cages.

Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing. There was a strong sewage smell throughout the restaurant, which is completely unacceptable. As for the food, the shawarma was clearly not fresh and seemed like it was from the previous day. The taste and quality were nothing like before. I used to be a regular customer 2–3 years ago, and the restaurant was excellent back then, but now the quality has dropped significantly. The staff were also unprofessional, and overall cleanliness was lacking. I really hope management takes this seriously and improves, because this place used to have a great reputation.
A little hole in the wall, in a stripmall, and it was awesome! The food was fast, generous, and delicious!

Hotel con muy buena ubicación, las habitaciones tienen cocina con todos sus elementos, la atención de los empleados es muy buena y ahí mismo conseguimos boletos para epcot y epic con express pasa. El hotel está con necesidad de remodelación, los tapetes y baños son muy antiguos, a pesar del gran tamaño de la habitación, le baja puntos la antigüedad de esta. Punto en contra, hacen aseo cada tres días, a minoareceresun tiempo muy distanciado. Igual lo recomiendo por su ubicación y la cocina de las habitaciones que te sacan de apuros.
La atención del personal de recepción exelente y muy atentos.
Excelente la ubicación perfecta para todos los parque tiene cocina muy limpia amplia tranquila

First the good, great location with free parking. Newer washing/drying machines (at the time of this, two of each). Nice pool. Free WiFi and kitchen, stovetop is a plus. Authentic German Lunch with Great Service Yesterday we met our friends for our monthly lunch outing, and this time we chose Hollerbach’s German Restaurant in Sanford. It turned out to be a great pick. They seated us in a big, open room — no sound‑absorbing décor, but surprisingly, it never felt loud or echoey. We could talk comfortably the whole time. There’s also a charming little German market next door where you can pick up groceries and specialty items. Our server, Rebecca, made the experience even better. She was upbeat, knowledgeable, and handled our group like a pro. When we told her each couple needed separate checks, she gave a playful wink and said, “I gotcha.” She also made sure to check that I was okay with their unsweetened iced tea having a peach flavor before bringing it out. Small details like that go a long way. I ordered the Jäger Schnitzel, and the flavor was fantastic — rich, savory, and comforting. The only downside was that it wasn’t hot, more on the warm side, as if it had been waiting a bit. Still delicious. My spouse ordered the Sauerbraten, which looked great, though I thought the meat was a little dry even with the gravy. My goulash soup starter, however, was excellent. The place was busy, and I saw people waiting outside, so reservations are definitely a good idea. We all enjoyed our meals and the chance to catch up. Hollerbach’s is now on our list of places to return to for both the food and the German grocery items next door.

Storms at my destination delayed my flight so United provided me free flight rebooking with hotel and meal vouchers. I chose this Hampton from their list of eligible hotels and glad that I did. Friendly helpful staff, quick airport shuttle, spacious clean suite, decent free breakfast, a surprisingly well-equipped fitness center, and easy access to several restaurants across the street. If I need a hotel near the airport again in the future, this will be my go-to hotel. Highly recommended.

As a Hilton Diamond member, I expect a basic level of professionalism and customer service — neither of which I experienced at the Hampton Inn–Gateway Village. I accidentally took an Uber to the wrong Hampton Inn location today, (apparently there are two Hampton Inns just .5 miles from one another); and the front desk clerk, “Jailady” (sp?), showed absolutely no professionalism while informing me of the mistake. No eye contact, no effort to help, and she even snickered at my confusion before walking away. Considering this is clearly a common mix-up, I was surprised there was no attempt to assist or even offer their shuttle to the correct hotel. Instead, I ended up dragging my suitcase half a mile across a major road to the Hampton Inn Orlando International — which was a completely different experience: modern, clean, and staffed by professional, welcoming employees. Avoid the Gateway Village location.

Overall, I would definitely recommend the restaurant and enjoyed the meal. However, if you're debating whether to upgrade to the VIP package, I think it's skippable and you can still have a great experience without it.

For dessert, we didn't do the famous grapefruit cake that everyone else around us seemed to be having, but we went for the orange chocolate hazelnut cake, which was scrumptious. The gym and pool area are also excellent, though it would be nice if they could fix the water cooler to provide cool water. The parking lot is clean from litter and I always found a spot near my entrance. But the employees can’t fix terrible water pressure, thin and scratchy toilet paper that separates each play when you go to tear it, threadbare carpets, a lack of dish soap, mismatching silverware, windows that let in all the sounds and are filthy on the outside, chipped furniture, scratchy towels, etc. Bottom line, the hotel needs renovation, a better room layout, better towels, and more.

Prepare for some details, y’all. (I’d like to emphasize most of my negative experiences were the hotel chain in general, not the individuals.) The little things: Positive: AMAZING rooms. Spacious, beautiful, with a kitchenette and everything. Blankets and pillows are so soft. Best room I’ve stayed in. Negative: -shower curtain isn’t very practical; the water got all over the floor no matter what. Their shampoo and conditioner dried out my hair, but that’s a totally optional feature so I appreciate it regardless. Service: Pro: -Front desk was super nice; the regular employees were very friendly Nitpicking Con: I told them this was for my honeymoon and even though they have no obligation to do so, there wasn’t a special decoration or card or anything. Like I said, totally not needed but I’ve seen other hotels go above and beyond for their guests and I’d hoped this would be one of them. Biggest complaint: Very few vegan options. I chose this hotel specifically because it offered free breakfast. I knew we’d be too tired to go out and was excited to have something after our long night. However, when I asked which options were vegan, the answer was “the fruit.” Look, I’m not expecting a complete menu overhaul. Just having margarine cups next to the butter, almond milk next to the cow’s milk, whole wheat toast/bagels, and MAYBE pancake mix if you’re feeling fancy—that’d be greatly appreciated. If you’re vegan, it’s a good stay—but maybe pack some breakfast.

Shortly after checking in, I noticed that the television was mounted in a location that made it difficult to watch comfortably from either the bed or the sitting area. Thinking I might be missing something, I went to the front desk and politely asked whether the television could be adjusted. The front desk associate consulted the manager on duty, who immediately acknowledged that this was a known issue in some rooms. According to him, the televisions had been wrongly installed that way and there was nothing that could be done about it. I explained that I would be staying for 12 nights and that having a room where I could comfortably use one of the advertised amenities was important to me. I also pointed out that if the hotel is aware of a recurring issue that affects the guest experience, it would be reasonable to inform guests before assigning those rooms. Rather than showing concern for the inconvenience, the conversation became increasingly defensive. The manager stated that the hotel could not be expected to tell guests about every issue in every room and later mentioned that mine was only the third complaint regarding this problem. What concerned me most was not the issue itself, but the apparent belief that a known problem becomes acceptable simply because relatively few guests have…

The room was suite style, very spacious and with a full sized refrigerator and a small kitchen if you want to cook something and same more money instead of using restaurants. The problem is the problem with the digital services: I went many times to the front desk during the 3 days of my stay and they could not fix my digital key to the room (to open the room with your cell phone). Wifi not properly setup because not always allows you to get to the captive portal to accept conditions and give you access to the internet. Both nights the cold water they put on the front desk was empty and was not refilled at night. The water fountain by the lobby bathrooms (were I was sent for water) was non operational. One of The backdoor locks never worked and I also reported it. Again, the hotel is beautiful but needs More attention on Maintenance. Also, parking is not included : you need to pay extra $27 per night for parking.

This is a great choice for the money. Close to Disney Springs, close to restaurants and shopping (Target), plus free breakfast and newly remodeled, large rooms. This is a remodeled older hotel so keep that in mind. My room smelled a little old but was very clean, newly remodeled, and very large. It included a fully stocked kitchen with 2 burner stove, a full size fridge, living room with sleeper sofa, and very large bedroom and large bathroom - essentially a small apartment for the price of a regular hotel room. I'm so very impressed. The floor and room was cozy and very quiet so I slept well. This was more than just a place to sleep. I felt relaxed and could really unwind. The bed was very comfortable. I not only slept but I rested. I cannot say that for many of these high priced resorts nearby. Homewood put the "Home" in my stay. I will be coming back for sure! Thank you!
The room was very spacious and clean. Breakfast was good. Parking was ample.

We initially booked a king studio but ended up being switched into a two queen, one bedroom suite due to inventory availability at check in. I did like having a little extra space and separate living room area. The showers have shampoo, conditioner, & shower gel bottles mounted on the wall which I always prefer over the mini amenity bottles some have. The hotel has a pretty good breakfast buffet (with Mickey waffles!) and plenty of seating in the lobby area. It's in a nice location, close to Disney Springs & parks. We stayed before leaving for our cruise out of Port Canaveral & the hotel is only an hour away from the port. I didn't love the paid parking ($27/night) through a 3rd party but it is what it is. I've stayed previous years in other nearby locations, including the Hilton brand, that had free parking but no breakfast... so pick your tradeoff 😜 We enjoyed the basketball half court & pool area. Somehow we ended up with a pretty mild FL day so the water was a little too chilly for us to swim but we enjoyed sticking our feet in & laying out. The hot tub wasn't working during our stay. Overall good experience & would return.

The room size was great. The complementary breakfast was good and had mickey shaped waffles which is always a plus when staying in the Disney area. At the time I stayed the hot tub was broken so hopefully they get that back in order soon. Overall good not great but a good hotel to stay at if visiting the local amusement parks

The hotel 20 feet next door does have a bar… so at least they have that going for them.

My favorite seafood restaurant in Orlando. Every visit has been consistently great, and the portions are generous enough to share. The whole snapper was the star of the meal perfectly cooked with crispy, flavorful skin that was absolutely delicious. The salmon was also excellent and easily large enough for two people. We also enjoyed the popcorn shrimp and garlic shrimp, both packed with flavor and cooked just right. A bonus that keeps me coming back is the complimentary hush puppies, which are always a great way to start the meal. If you’re looking for fresh seafood, large portions, and a fun, casual atmosphere, this is a must-visit spot in Orlando. It’s easy to see why locals keep coming back.

Did not disappoint (unlike our experience at Boston Fish House which nearly ruined our desire for ever eating out especially seafood). I had Ahi Tuna (perfect bite if you combine everything), a side if Top Neck clams (slightly overcooked - not much flavor) Lobster tail (broiled not my favorite way and slightly overcooked but still good) and for dessert Reeses peanut butter pie. My wife had Crab stuffed mushrooms, big fried shrimp (slightly overcooked) but she liked and NY cheese cake (New Yorker like it so must be good). Our waitress was nice friendly bubbly and she was fun and attentive. We will be back! Suggestions for even better experiences: Don’t overcook lobster, clams and shrimp (Clams - garlic - needed more flavor) Steamed broccoli - my wife makes the best so she’s sharing here secret - drizzle with butter and lightly dust with sea salt Those little things would get raves by your customers and keep them coming back. Take the Gordon Ramsey approach at the pass!! It’s so easy to get complacent and your customers just leave with a bad or mediocre taste that you can’t fix. Every dish counts!

I will be filing a formal complant against 3 hotel managers here, but let me state that nothing I do by filing will compare to what God will do to this kind of evil for hitting me while I was down.... I called Wed, day prior to Thurs. arrival to ask if I could get a room that hadnt recently had a dog since I have pet allergies. The lady manager said...Yes, I have a room that hasnt had a dog in it and she made it sound as if the room was clean not currently occupied. For this reason next day when I arrived 12noon and stood in line behind all checkins being given their rooms, I was taken back when I was told my room wasnt ready yet and would be texted when it was ready. when I mentioned to the desk lady that I called day before ...I hear this loud mouth lady scream from the back office ..NO I NEVER TOLD YOU THAT and she proceded to argue with me ... Strange, as the most hospitable people we find work in the hotel industry, but this lady now yelling at me was not one of them. So i waited an hour watching all other check in's get their rooms...At this point I inquired and again my room wasnt ready so I left to get get lunch and arrived back at 3pm. Still confused that room wasnt ready I asked if I could see the room prior to checking in. Another lady manager took me up, but said room might still not be clean yet....When we get to the room this lady is now speaking rudely to housekeeping lady about the room? She opens the door. The room is clean, ready and I tell her, good can I…

First time here and absolutely love this hidden gem. The food, ambiance and service were all top! Thank you to my server Brie for the great service and delicious recommendations, I got the burger with the side salad and fresh orange juice, yum! One of my top places here in Orlando, highly recommend, thank you!
The restaurant is very nice. The ambiance is cozy. The staff is friendly and professional. The food is awesome.
Turned us away at the door…was dressed in nice clothes but was wearing leather slides. Said I wasn’t dressed up enough.

I'm from Maryland and crab cakes are our thing. These were absolutely some of the best ones I have ever had. The food was amazing, the service absolutely on point, and the staff were incredibly pleasant. The view at sunset was worth the visit. I'll be back next time I'm in town.
I just had the best steak of my life! You could cut it with a fork and it melted like butter in my mouth! Keylime pie was the best ever, too! So creamy.

I had such an amazing experience at Hillstone thanks to our server Amara! She made us feel genuinely welcomed from the moment we sat down. She knew the menu well, gave us great recommendations on both food and drinks, answered all our questions and kept everything running smoothly all night without ever making us feel rushed. Everything was really good but her service is honestly what made the entire experience stand out. This was definitely one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in Winter Park (as Orlando natives!) I will definitely be back and will be asking for Amara again!

We all know the talent in the kitchen is exceptional, consistent quality food every time, passionate chefs, exceptional service, we all feel special...but the mismanagement of how the social environment is, is noticeable. This cries out to the top managers at Hillstone, either being asleep at the wheel or have a poor agenda that shouldn't exist in hospitality, shame on who?

My family and friends have been loyal patrons for 20 years. We’ve celebrated major life milestones here. Earlier this month my family dined for my mom’s birthday. This was one of the few times we sent back a steak for being inedibly salty. My mom then requested an extra order of fries for my nephew. When the fries were brought to our table, we were told we’re banned for “wasting food”. In front of everyone, on my mom’s bday. Cathy Wathen is running this place to the ground. It’s despicable and a dishonor to this restaurant. I feel bad for every guest and employee that has had to encounter her. Please watch out.

Excelente experiencia en este restaurante tanto en calidad dela comida como la atención y ni hablar de la vista hermosa viendo el atardecer, fuimos 4 personas y todos coincidimos con esta misma opinión sobre el restaurante.
The Trout and kale salad was amazing
Very noisy. The view was great. Disappointed that outdoor seating was closed.

This is the place, we loved everything there, food was excellent, service is unbelievable, win and cocktails were amazing, sunset was there, we went on the deck and enjoyed the nice breeze from the lake. This is from now on my place to be.
Golden standard of restaurants. The service can vary, the hostess usually unfriendly, but the food is always great, best stake at perfect temperature; just love to go there.

Very nice restaurant. The food was outstanding. Everyone had a good time. Make your reservation well ahead of time. I recommend this very upscale restaurant for special occasions only because it will put a dent in your wallet
Rude, pretentious

If you’re looking to overpay for mediocre food while being treated like an inconvenience, this is the place for you. The staff are rude, the management is arrogant, and the whole restaurant seems convinced it’s far more impressive than it actually is. Save your money and your patience. This place isn’t worth either. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone. HORRIBLE!

I’ve been to Hillstone many times over the years, since I’m from WP. I sat with four friends over the course of 4.5 hours, having food and 4 drinks. Then my friends and I go down to the dock and one goes up to order more round. They allow everyone but me to have one more drink. I am not driving or displaying a signs of intoxication since I have had four drinks over four and a half hours, plus food. the bartender said I couldn’t have one last drink and then the manager came over and said “we work as team and the bartender said you had 4 drinks” The manager was never at the bar. The bartender, Katy, obviously kept Tabs but with a smile. I’ve always had a wonderful experience here, but this evening it was utter disappointment. Managers who are essentially rude to you with a smile and think they know what’s better for you. It’s quite disingenuous service. Almost secretive between the bar and management. My friends had drinks at the bar and then went to eat dinner at a table. I stayed. That’s the difference. By the end of the evening they had 5 drinks. I had 4. 200lb male with 140 lb females and one other 215lb male. Everyone was shocked. Unfortunately this place is not the same as it was a few years ago. Much more corporate and sterile.
My favorite place to eat!!!
One of the finest meals, we have had in the area!! Our server, Jen, was great! Don't miss this restaurant. The views are almost as good as the food, and the views are wonderful
Great place. Can't wait to go at the end of the day to enjoy the complete experience. Such beautiful view.

We came here to celebrate our anniversary with the family. The service was absolutely excellent from start to finish, though it was a bit noisy sitting near the bar area. For appetizers, we started with the **Chilled Jumbo Shrimp** and the **Spinach & Artichoke Dip**. Both were delicious! The shrimp were definitely large and paired perfectly with the cocktail sauce, while the spinach dip tasted incredibly fresh, rich, and went great with the warm tortilla chips. For our entrees, we ordered the **Gulf Coast Style Fish Sandwich**, **Ding's Crispy Chicken Sandwich**, and the **Thai Noodle Salad** (with chicken). The clear winner of the night was the noodle salad—absolutely fantastic flavor. Unfortunately, the sandwiches fell pretty flat and really lacked flavor. The house-made buns they use are massive, which didn't help when you're trying to actually taste the meat and fish underneath. I would definitely give Hillstone another shot because the service and starters were so good, but next time I'll be sticking strictly to the house specialties, entrees, and salads!

I'm going to have to modify my prior rating. This is still an excellent restaurant, but there have been a number of issues that have crept up that have been very frustrating. First, the outdoor seating has not been available for a long time. One of the best aspects of this restaurant was the outdoor ambience, and without outdoor seating it really hurts. Second, the Hawaiian Ribeye has been a bit hit or miss, which has NEVER been the case in the past. It is literally the best thing on the menu, so you cannot afford for it to not be perfect every time. Next, removal of the homemade bleu cheese dressing was a huge mistake. Bring it back. Lastly, the cabbage with goat cheese was one of your best sides and wasn't available for my last visit. Honestly, my last visit was the first time I have ever been disappointed going to a Hillstone restaurant. You can do so much better. Update: now they won’t do parties larger than 5. Sadly, apparently my family isn’t welcome. That’s fine. You get 1 star as a reward
Great place to have breakfast!
Our sever Ms.Caroline was amazing. The stuff trench toast was delicious! We will definitely add this to our favorites list!!
Excellent
Delicious food and wonderful atmosphere. Great service.
THE vacation breakfast spot for sure! They know their menu well and everything is delicious! From the bagels to the omelettes to the French toast, they get it right every time. Must try!!

We travel FT in our RV and always go out for breakfast. This is the best breakfast that we have found in the area. We have tried a lot of Duds but this is good. Everything is fresh and delicious. The service is also amazing. Our Server remembered us from a year ago! He looks just like Matthew Lillard and very attentive. 10 out of 10 and that's a Lot coming from me as I can be a harsh critic.
The service was good. Food was great too. I recommend the French toast. Thanks for serving my family and I
Food was absolutely amazing. The pancakes are to die for. The staff were so nice.
Breakfast was excellent. The fruit was really fresh. Service and atmosphere was perfect. Thank you.
Here on vacation, and everything was great! Way better than going to First Watch!
Great food, excellent service!

We visit this restaurant every year as we stay with family near Daytona. Absolutely the best breakfasts. The owner and staff are amazing, down-to-earth people. Year after year the quality and ambiance are always top notch.
Excellent all around as usual!
Breakfast was freaking fantastic! 😋 I highly recommend this spot for breakfast if visiting the area, they did not disappoint.
Nice hotel close to the cruise ships
Very close to the port. Bar at pool and great friendly service.
Nice hotel. No issues and they were real nice and accommodating.
Outstanding! Our room was wonderful! We stayed here the night before boarding Carnival Mardi Gras. So close to ship terminal parking.
Belong to Hilton honors and got a nice upgrade. Very nice people at the desk.

I had a fantastic stay at the hotel and I cannot speak highly enough of the staff. From the moment we arrived, everyone was welcoming and attentive. A very special shoutout has to go to Theresa at the breakfast buffet. She is an absolute gem. She greeted me with the warmest smile and went out of her way to make sure I had everything I needed. She anticipates your needs before you even ask. Her positive energy is the perfect way to start the morning.

This hotel was literally less than 5min away from hotel. I had no issues with service, room,or location. The facility was very clean, the front desk team and housekeeping were all friendly and approachable. The complimentary breakfast was well seasoned and good. In the event I take another out of Orlando this will be my go to.
Thank you Kris and Jules C For you hospitality in the front desk everyone very friendly rooms clean beds incredibly comfortable Thank you again I recommend with 10stars

Staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel was clean, comfortable and quiet. Well maintained property.|Breakfast was a good selection and well stocked. Teresa, the hostess was friendly, helpful and caring towards everyone.|Breakfast on day 2 wasn’t nearly as well maintained. Maybe 🤔 just an off day for the different hostess. |I would happily stay here again.

We stayed here the night before our cruise departed but our experience started way before that. I inquired if they accepted parcels which they were happy to do (ordered some clothes ahead of time to be delivered there). They even gave me instructions on what to put on the package address. Any questions or queries I had, I was able to reach them through the Hilton chat which was very useful. The concierge was very friendly and accommodating even though we had to check in much later than anticipated due to flight cancellations. The rooms were very large and clean. There was a nice functional kitchenette with our room. We requested a crib for our baby ahead of time and it was the usual pack and play which was more than sufficient. We got in quite late so we didn’t get to use the amenities like the pool. The hotel provides your standard hotel breakfast with a variety of your staples. They even had a waffle station which was neat. The close proximity to the cruise port will make this a staple for us in the future.
Nice Homewood. Good breakfast. Good pool. Large clean rooms.
Great hotel. Gorgeous large rooms. Food is good and if youre lucky like we were, you can see launches of rockets from Cape Canaveral.

We can’t say enough good about this place!! They were very welcoming when we arrived and everyone from the hotel we encountered were friendly and helpful if needed. The room was beyond spotless!! Shout out to Larry for being more than accommodating!
Great place to stay

I have been here about a month ago, had a great overall experience at this hotel and would definitely recommend it. The room was clean and comfortable, and it was well-equipped with kitchenware, including a stove, and toaster, which made the stay even more convenient. The lobby and lounge areas were well-designed and inviting, and the breakfast was excellent with a good variety of options. The staff were also very welcoming, which added to the positive experience. One unique highlight was their social event, where they served soup, salad, beer, and wine — something I haven’t seen offered at other hotels, and it really added a nice touch to the stay. That said, the service could use some improvement. There were piles of towels left in the hallway for over a day, which affected the overall impression. Also, housekeeping is provided every other day, so for a two-night stay you won’t receive room service, which may be inconvenient for some guests. Overall, despite a few service issues, the quality of the amenities and the unique offerings make this hotel a place I would still highly recommend.
Staff provided excellent service, with personalized care for foreign visitors. Congratulations go to Kris, Jennifer, Larry, and Lily [front desk], and Tara and Jennifer [for breakfast].
Riesige Zimmer mit hervorragender Ausstattung, nettes Personal, ideale Übernachtungsmöglichkeit für Besuch Kennedy Space Center

Close to port however will likely stay elsewhere next time. For the price the room cleanliness was subpar. Staff was friendly and common areas seemed well maintained. Breakfast staff was polite and helpful. Only 1 waffle maker if that’s your thing (long line). Gal at checkout was wonderful. Pool area and bar was nice. Shuttle service they use was helpful and prompt. For what we paid the cleanly of the room was not ok. Dirty walls, dirty/sticky floors, dirty bed covers, room had a smell (musty maybe). The bathroom was clean with no signs of mold. The view of the port was nice. Perhaps housekeeping was short staffed. Not sure but definitely not up to standard.
Friendly staff. Good inclusive breakfast. Overall satisfied.

Overall, the property is very nice. We did discover that there was blood on a pillow that my daughter used on the pullout. I brought the pillow downstairs and showed the front desk in the morning. She advised a manager will be contacting me about it as it was not acceptable. agreed, but no one ever contacted me. As a diamond member, the lack of follow up is completely unacceptable..

Room and front desk was awesome. Very clean and plenty of parking. As a Diamond member, I truly appreciate this. Shout out to Lily at the front desk for being so helpful after our long journey in from Texas
Nice spacious room, right across the street from the port.

Extended stay here with my husband for a job up at NASA. Old and dated rooms with pretty poor smell. AC units outdated and don’t take humidity out of the room- everything feels damp. Expensive nightly rates and semi rude front desk staff. Pool was freezing cold. Breakfast is decent. The best part about this place is the Tiki Bar by the pool, but it is only open Thursday- Sunday. Alex is fantastic! Difficult entry and exit point with traffic flow. I would not book here again, there are many better options.

I am Hilton gold member. I selected this property since it’s close to Disney. I paid $160 per night. I stayed in room 316 where we found cockroaches in room. So if you want to stay with cockroaches I will say book this hotel. Front desk told me someone from management will reach out to me but I am still waiting for it.

My wife made reservations weeks ago. This morning the room she reserved and we were supposed to check into this evening had an issue. The hotel called and made sure the accommodations they needed to move us to were acceptable. After checking in and getting to the room the staff had left a note and a gift basket to apologize for the inconvience. This hotel is definitely one I would stay in again if the need arises.
The location is perfect, everything is very close!! SeaWorld and Disney spring in 10 minutes. The room is very clean, the staff is very nice👍🔥
We loved our stay here..our room was extremely comfortable..We will definitely stay here again if we're in the area
Hotel is clean. Staff is pleasant. Enjoyed the stay while attending a convention.

The service at this hotel was exceptional—easily one of the best hotel experiences I’ve had. I highly recommend it. Shortly after check-in, I received a text message asking if everything was satisfactory, which showed how much the staff cared about their guests. I had a small issue during my stay, and by the time I returned to the hotel, it had already been resolved promptly and professionally. A special thank you to Jeanne and Sarah at the front desk, as well as Silvia and the breakfast team, for their outstanding hospitality and attention to detail. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained throughout my stay. If you’re looking for a comfortable and welcoming hotel in Orlando, this is definitely a place I would recommend.
Itzel was the best! She was so friendly and helpful. We'll definitely be coming back next year because of the service she provided us. She really made a difference in our stay.
Itzel did a great job with the breakfast area! She was very attentive, kind, and helpful. Can’t wait to come back.
The service of Itzel, Lupe and Andrés is very good, and de breackfast es good, I like this hotel.
Breakfast service was very good. Itzel made us feel very welcome.

It was once again a pleasure to stay at our second "Home," the Hampton Inn Orlando/Lake Buena Vista. This time, Jeanne and Sarah were there for us with excellent customer service, understanding, and empathy. They are a true credit to the Hampton Inn chain, and we look forward to going back again soon for our 12th time. The atmosphere, as always, was serene. The room was spotless, and we had no complaints. The value was excellent, better than past offerings. We had no problems with noise; the pool was comfortable and beautiful. The treadmills, Peloton, and weights filled my daily workout needs. The location has always been amazing to us. Close enough to Disney-related stores and parks, but not in the middle of all of the hubbub and noise. The only thing we had a problem with was the $7.00 charge per parking space per night. Having said that, this is way below what other hotels charge for parking. You are given a paper to place on your dashboard to confirm that you are a guest of the hotel, and you cannot enter the hotel after a certain time unless you have your hotel key. Good security, for us, IMO. Thank you, Jeanne and Sarah. We SO appreciate you. See you soon!

Arrived late, Sashane was very pleasant getting us checked in. Every staff member was friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable. As always, breakfast was satisfying. This is a good location for Disney access.

Sarah at front desk was absolutely amazing. The level of customer service she has is beyond the level of expectation. Sarah makes sure that guests feel comfortable and welcomed. My family and myself will be staying at this location moving forward.

Itzel was so hospitable to the kids. The breakfast ladies saw that my husband and child were juggling several breakfast items and brought a tray. Throughout the day I saw several ladies cleaning various area of the hotel.

We stayed here for our church youth choir tour and the staff was amazing. The morning breakfast crew Ms. Lupe, Silvia and Monica were wonderful! The hotel is clean and the location is great for all parks.
The best. As always Itzel, Silvia and Lupe the best.

Hampton Inn Lake Buena Vista is now our go to I really cannot complain from the fresh smell when you first walk in to the friendly staff Sashane at the front desk just everyone is super nice and helpful. This is our fourth time staying at this hotel and it will always be our go to for now on.I’ve even send friends family coworkers all to this one location. I’m very happy we found it. Thank you to all the stuff and I’m sure we will see you again. Oh, let me also include. It is very close to the theme parks such as Disney Disney Springs, and the outlets.

I stayed here for a few days during Memorial day. The front desk reps were all amazing. The room was perfect for my visit. I even used to pool. Morning breakfast was hot and fresh with a nice selection. Definitely worth the stay. Never disappointed. Would recommend this location to anyone visiting the Disney theme parks.

We always enjoy Hampton Inn. The front desk staff were a lot of fun - great personalities, professional and helpful. Park and Fly so we left car parked there. Shuttle service on time and very nice driver. Less than 7 minute drive to airport so couldn't be much closer. $10 a day parking and didn't include the first and last days parked there. Less than airport parking rate and worth a good night's sleep before early flight
Very friendly staff! Rooms very clean! 11 drive with congested traffic to Disney Parks! Highly recommend!

As a Gold member, I am thoroughly impressed with this property. I had a last-minute same-day booking with a 9–10 PM arrival, and Rodrigo made the entire process seamless. He was extremely accommodating, ensured my room was ready upon check-in, and provided excellent communication through the chat before I arrived. He was friendly, personable, courteous, and truly made me feel welcome. The hotel is in a great location, surrounded by plenty of food and dining options. The room was very clean and the perfect size for two people. Having both a microwave and refrigerator was a huge plus. As an added bonus, from my room on the fourth floor, I was even able to see the 10 PM Disney fireworks through the trees in the distance. Overall, a great stay and excellent customer service from Rodrigo. I would definitely stay here again.

This Hampton Inn is a great property. The grounds are well kept. The parking lot is clean and well lit. The pool area is very nice. Natalia greeted me at my arrival. She is a very good desk clerk. She is friendly and professional. She listened to my room desires of not wanting to be near the ice machine or the stairs and top floor. I like getting the exercise of taking the stairs! My room was spotlessly cleaned and very comfortable. Claudia is a very friendly housekeeper. The hotel has a fitness center. In lieu of snack machines there is a nice mini convenience shop. This is a nice addition. There are ice machines on every floor. The free breakfast is a nice perk. It's the perfect way to start the day! It is in a convenient location of the I-4! It's close to the Premium Outlets and numerous restaurants.

We were leaving universal studios the next morning and just needed a clean place to sleep. This was exactly what we needed. Not too far of a drive from the theme park, room is clean and beds are comfy!

I am a Hilton Diamond member and have stayed at Hilton properties all over the country for many years. Unfortunately, this was the worst experience I have ever had at a Hilton hotel. Despite reserving and selecting a specific room type, we were not given the room we booked. The breakfast buffet was being cleared away at 9:15 a.m., leaving guests scrambling for food. Several children were visibly upset and crying as items disappeared before breakfast service should reasonably have been ending. The problems continued throughout our stay. The pool towels were so small they were essentially hand towels, which felt cheap and completely inadequate for a hotel pool. The front desk also approved a late checkout, only for us to later be told we would be charged for it. Having staff honor a request and then attempt to bill guests afterward is unacceptable. What was most disappointing was the overall lack of attention to guest satisfaction. As a loyal Diamond member, I expect occasional issues, but I also expect them to be handled professionally. Instead, this stay felt disorganized, poorly managed, and far below Hilton standards.
Nicely remodeled hotel in a great location. Be prepared for a $25 parking fee that was not listed until walking into the lobby with a sign showing the $25 fee. Not a welcomed surprise.

My husband and I spent father's day 2026 here. The location is great, in a walking distance to most attractions. However, the room was cold. Turning up the temperature didn't help. The heat in the room didn't go up. The most annoying thing was that the toilet stopped flushing several times and both my husband and I had to keep repairing it. Regarding service: our daughter wanted to surprise us with a bottle of wine in our room. Unfortunately, the lady at the desk told her that she's not doing such service. Ultimately, we did find the wine waiting in our room. Lastly, we were told that if we want to get into our room early, we need to pay extra. Overall, our experience was not very good.
Right on Flagler Blvd - perfect spot 👌

Overall, the location and rooms were great, as this hotel was recently renovated, and it is a good location near the restaurants, bars, and beach. Jordan at the front desk was very nice and great with guests, however, Cindy lacks any customer service skills whatsoever, and should not be in a customer facing role. Layout of hotel was good and easy to find all the amenities, and the breakfast that is included each morning was very good. Keep in mind that parking is upwards of $25 per day, so do not be surprised at the end of your stay. Thanks again to Jordan for making us feel welcome and ensuring that we had a good stay.

I love the breakfast and the room service is really nice I love how neat and clean the outside seating is and I love how pretty the location is and the rooms are so pretty. I’m so excited to see what the new renovated ones look like😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

Jordan at the front desk was absolutely wonderful. He was friendly, professional, and went out of his way to be helpful from the moment we arrived. He made check-in smooth and welcoming, answered all of our questions, and genuinely made the experience better. Customer service like his really stands out, and he deserves recognition for how kind and attentive he was.

We visited Hampton Inn this past week and let me tell you the reason for my review. While most everything was great at this location, you can’t top Cindy, Associate who runs the breakfast area. Cindy made herself known simply by doing her job well. Neat, clean and organized, I had already commented on her service and would have said so in a review. But the real reason for this review is something that cannot be taught by corporate training despite their best efforts and intentions. You see when we arrived home in Orlando last night we learned that our daughter had left her Lovey at the hotel. (Small fabric thing with an animal head sewn to it. But apparently very important.) She was truly devastated. As was her mom, keys in hand, ready to drive back to locate it. We called and spoke to Jordan that night. He placed us on hold and returned to state that he did not see anything in L&F but it could be locked in the Manager office. He asked that we call back in the am and ask for Shannon. We did and were told she was not in yet. So I asked to speak with Cindy as we developed a relationship with her through her kindness during our stay. Cindy immediately understood the magnitude of the situation. And no little girl was going to have her great memories of New Smyrna Beach ruined because we could not locate her Lovey. She took my number and said she would call me back. And of course she did with great news! She had found Lovey! She was even willing to go to the post office after her…

The Hampton Inn in New Smyrna Beach is a decent option if location is your top priority. The hotel is conveniently located close to the beach, restaurants, shopping, and most of the area's attractions, making it easy to get around without spending much time driving. The rooms are very basic. clean enough and functional, but nothing particularly memorable or luxurious. If you're looking for a simple place to sleep while exploring the area, it does the job. The biggest disappointment was the breakfast. The selection was limited, the quality was below average, and it didn't live up to the standards I've experienced at other Hampton Inns. Overall, this hotel offers a great location and adequate accommodations, but the basic rooms and underwhelming breakfast keep it from being more than an average stay.

Spent 3 beautiful days in New Smyrna Hampton Inn. Located right on the strip. Walking distance to restaurant, boutiques, pubs and the beach ⛱. Rooms are sweet, lots pillows , great breakfast selection. Kudos to Rowan at desk & Zac manager well done.

Really good place very clean new rooms staff was excellent at the front desk gated parking centrally located walk to anything you want just a really good experience they followed up with text messages wanting to know if everything was good definitely going to come back

I have to travel many times a month for work and this was my first time at the Hampton Inn in New Smyrna. The vibes around the hotel were great, with a lot of options to walk around in search of good food options. The breakfast was much better than I expected, given other stays Hilton Hotels. “Breakfast Cindy” as she likes to be called was especially helpful, and I was impressed with options such as Avocado Toast and blueberry waffle batter. Upon my next return I will definitely look forward to my stay here!

Got caught in a last-minute bind and needed help. Gave them a call and they showed up on time, which was a relief. They handled everything just like they said they would without any hassle. First time using them and over here in Edgewater, I’ll definitely keep them in mind for the future.

We always stay here when we visit New Smyrna beach. But this past time was very different. They're in the process of renovating the third floor now. We stayed on the second floor and everything was fine, except I wish they would have remotes on the TV that you could actually understand how to use. It is incredibly hard for somebody that is not used to not having numbers or buttons on the TV remote to just find local news. |Now I will start on the breakfast buffet. First of all, they put the coffee in a totally different part of the lobby, so it's not even part of the buffet. You have to actually leave the breakfast room to get coffee and it used to be right in the room which was so convenient and now it is not. They did not offer even bacon with scrambled eggs. There were no pastries but little bagels and little tiny muffins. It changed so much from the past times we were there. And then they have this person walking around--I think her name was Cindy--and she interrupted our conversation ( and everybody else's that were eating breakfast) so that she could ask how we were doing and then tell us when we leave a review, let them know how good the breakfast buffet was. I almost laughed out loud.

Tiffany Assistant Manager went beyond the call of duty. Along with Belinda , Cindy and Betty. My older brother was a guest there. He needed extra care and they were on it. Hats off off the an amazing staff.
You will not find a better run Hampton Inn than this one. Super friendly staff. Rooms are clean and the location is perfect. Highly recommend

This is by far one of the best Hampton Inn experiences we have had. The location is perfect to everything in New Smyrna Beach. Park the car and walk everywhere. Breakfast was delicious with so many choices. Front desk staff was very accommodating. We will definitely stay on our next trip back to Florida.
Breakfast was fantastic! Good variety and fresh!! Would definitely come back again!!
Spend 3 nights there recently as a diamond member and Jordan was a great help, room was great, and the breakfast was worth getting up for. Great experience great staff. Highly recommend
Wonderful experience. Will return for sure.

We had an excellent stay here. Everything was clean and just right. Cindy and Betty put on a great breakfast exactly at 6 in the morning. They were super friendly and the chorizo burritos were clutch.

Location is awesome and super close to the beach, definitely gets Rowdy on the weekends so it's difficult to get a relaxing night sleep without earbuds. Checked out a few restaurants in the Flagler area, disappointed by some and absolutely loved others. The rooms were clean, although it was difficult to get to the front desk at times for any requests

Had a great time at my fraternity reunion. Our room was clean and spacious. The hotel staff was very friendly. Have to give special kudos to Cindy who was staffing the breakfast room. She was so accommodating and friendly. The breakfast selection is large and delicious. The lobby is large and a great space for groups to congregate. Many good restaurants and bars are within easy walking distance. Plenty of shops available. The beach is just down the street. Looking forward to returning next year.
We had a fabulous 3 night stay!! Especially enjoyed the breakfasts!! Cindy did an excellent job and was so welcoming!!

Stayed here for 4 night. The hotel is newly renovated. Front desk service was good. Breakfast is wonderful. My kids enjoyed the waffles. Bagels are not that great. Breakfast lady was nice. Breakfast is only until 10 am.

Loved this hotel, minus having to pay to park. Great location, walking distance to everything quiet, nice pool, friendly staff, housekeepers cleaned daily We have stayed here several times. clean, comfortable beds, yummy breakfast, it was so relaxing, loved the relaxing front porch with rocking chairs to relax.

Fantastic location for a SeaWorld visit—just a short shuttle ride away, with pickup right outside the lobby. The weekday breakfast buffet starts bright and early at 6 AM and offers a solid variety for only $18. We arrived before check‑in, left the car, and hopped on the shuttle with no hassle. After a long day at the park, we got back around 10 PM and checked in smoothly (though the bar had just closed). A personalized welcome on the TV greeted us when we entered the room, which made the stay feel even more inviting.
Breakfast is almost $20 and doesn't include fresh egg items, which is completely absurd. Mediocre rooms, cute location

The Hilton Garden Inn is situated in a great location to access iDrive and everything off of it. It also has a nice gym, restaurant, and bar. The rooms have been updated and are equipped with a coffee maker, small refrigerator and microwave. Across the street is an easy walk to bonefish Grill. There’s also a CVS so quite a bit accessible from the front door.

Overall, the stay wasn't bad. The room was clean and comfortable but had an odor. I spoke to staff about the odor and they sprayed in room but by the next day, the mildew odor was back. Staff was quick to accommodate any requests I made. Complimentary coffee was weak. I have yet to stay in a hotel that offered good coffee. They offered a free shuttle service to the parks which was nice; however, the bus was typically running late and the engine was so loud, patrons had to cover their ears when riding.
Breakfast was mediocre. Very close to Sea World. Plenty of Uber and Lift rides cheap and fast.

Hotel review I stay at Hilton garden in and location is fantastic but the hotel looks it’s run down was hold inside by the bathroom wall on top of the door ask if they could clean it and they says yes sure never was done , tile ing the shower was big crack with mold visible when check was no towels nos. Shower gel or shampoo just 1/4 left in bathroom I ask if could get some towels and the refill shampoo before go to dinner with my wife when come back nothing was taking care of needs to go to front desk ask again while waiting for the service I decide grab drink at the bar in the lobby some kind of bartender there he said is name was Anthony extremely rude and antisocial make me wait and ignore me all time was there until the front desk call me I just left did not want to drive or go out with my partner we both tired but because this so rude bartender we decided to bring our business elsewhere wich we were greeted and have fun at reservation bar at JW I highly recommend, then the ac was only blowing freezing 68 all night we just hold to ourselves and could wait to leave first and last time at this property unfortunately because has a lot potential due to the location!!
Great location.. service ok some seem like they didn't want to be at work

I understand this property gets used a lot because of its location. But, it didn't live up to its brand name in my opinion. The positives are its location, parking is available, not included in the price, but on site and easy to get to. The back door stays locked so only those with a key can access the building. I checked online and saw a fee for breakfast, we decided that we'll drive 5min to Cfa and pay half the price, or two blocks over to wawa before paying for a standard hotel breakfast. I'm ok with short drives to get what I want. The fitted sheets didn't fit properly so they didn't completely cover the mattress which felt gross. There was hair left around the room, clump on bed pictured. Things were dirty. Around the faucet in the sink, edges in the tub, the coffee pot itself hasn't had a good cleaning in a while. The hallways were unreasonably hot and muggy and this was the first weekend in May, I can't imagine what Aug feels like. I felt bad for the housekeeping staff who are stuck working in it. I did not speak to the hotel about the issues, if the sheets don't fit now, I don't expect them to have others on hand that do. If the room isn't spotless, I doubt the next room over would be either. We were in town for an event at the hotel next door and walking over was pretty easy which was the main priority for this stay. For the price per night, the rooms should be Much cleaner. Worn out and well used is expected, but cleanliness is at the minimum of what the standards…

Not bad for the price. However there are NO umbrellas by the pool! How could they do that when it’s 90°-+ in summer!? I am very disappointed. I did manage to find a bit of shade, But eventually, I’ll be in the sun again.

I freaking paid for a package deal for discovery cove... this hotel freaking is not worth it, jacuzzi don't work, hotel is not clean, empty shampoo, floor needs vacuum, And house keeping comes every other day!! Great location for the parks. But for the price paid, never again! Towels and bedding legit look and feel dirty. The shower tub feels slimy. Like We're literally staying at a hilton and I don't feel like anything in my room is clean!! No complimentary breakfast is big sad but beautiful breakfast.

While I believe in giving second chances, and I am a Hilton diamond member, this place decided to keep things status quo. Most everything I am going to state here, was exactly the way it was the last time I was here. The front desk staff is slow, rude, have snotty attitudes, and really just don't care. Our room was not ready when we arrived , (after 4:30pm) even though it was guaranteed ready after 4pm, and the front desk staff said, "that's just how it is." The AC was not working in our room, and it took over an hour for maintainance to get it fixed. I tried to get the front desk staff to change our room and he just decided to text on his phone, acting like he was doing something, then tell me oh, there nothing he can do, then continued to lean against the counter and play on his phone. There was only one towel in the bathroom, the toilet was not working correctly, the shower was not clean and the shower head needs to be replaced, ( it's covered in gunk and sprays all over. ). The floor near the elevators was constantly wet, making it slippery, and no wet floor signs anywhere, and when I called to the front desk, either from the room phone or my phone, it would just ring and no one would pick up. I went down to the front desk, and both phones were off the hook. The service here sucks, the front desk staff especially! We will never come here again.

Every time we called, no answer. The phone in our room can not call the front desk - it says the number is disconnected? They AC was not working but they did fix it. The staff just seems to not like their job.
Comfortable n fun

I have stayed at this hotel several times before and all of my experiences have been great. It takes me no more than 15 minutes to walk from the hotel parking lot to SeaWorld’s front entrance, and that’s with a very relaxed pace.
Hotel da evitare
I loved everything in this hotel. Helpful and friendly staff.

Room was nice. The pool appeared to be not maintained for a while, could use a pool boy! I also think for the rates they charge a continental breakfast could be included. We get that for less expensive stays elsewhere!
First day here and it's great. Eric was a great help to us.

Bad business ordered a king bed for my girl for Mother’s Day and a they told me that they only had double beds when people steady came in getting rooms and I paid the price of a king bed I will never ever go here again and the manager witch lookin had a attitude and unhelpful

Considering the view this hotel has, I think it leaves a lot to be desired. There is no Jacuzzi, and the smell of chlorine from the pool reaches the room balconies. Room service is chaotic in the elevators and hallways; it just doesn't feel like a vacation.
Very nice place. The breakfast is outstanding.

Check in went to room 301. Walked in the room had the worst smell, i told the manager she said they would clean it. I left and went to dinner 2 hours later walked in. The room had not been cleaned. I left pieces of trash on the floor just to see what was they gonna be doing, still where i left it All they did is put some kind of airfresher. Not good, hospitality failure. Tell you on reservation can extend do late then nope have to check out original day 11.
