Love this hotel. Reasonable priced. On the beach with a nice pool. In a nice spot just north of Daytona beach. Just a 5 to 10 minute drive in. Rooms are up to date and staff is great. Ive been staying here for years
The room was clean, but the a/c could not keep up. It was a bit warm trying to sleep.
Love it here

The hotel is a little outdated in the rooms. The downstairs area is nice. It’s unfortunate that you have to pay a resort fee every day as an extra cost! I tried to use my discount on food at checkout that I paid for with the resort fee and they told me that I didn’t do it properly and they would not honor it! Extra cost, no discount, and I never got a call from the manager to help fix this situation.
Rooms were clean, everything worked like it should. Staff was friendly, beach was great and somehow off the beaten path. Convenient to shopping and dining. Pleasant stay.

Very nice hotel. Staff was amazing. Very clean nice on site restaurant and bar. Shopping center across the street for anything you may have forgot or just want to shop. A couple restaurants are within walking distance as well.
Right on the beach walked on from pool area. Rooms are good and experienced nice staff.

Everything was wonderful until the person at the front desk was very rude after I was there for 4 days. The girl working was behind the desk on June 9th around 830 pm. I have never had an issue with hilton but this person ruined my experience.

I booked this hotel through a third party (priceline). The room I booked was a two queen bed ocean view. When I went to the desk to check in, the front desk clerk advised they had me in a single bed king room. I advised her, that I was positive I had reserved a two queen bed, room. After triple checking they said i had the king room and there was no other room they could put me in my family in. I called priceline to lodge a complaint. Priceline verified I had a two queen room but said they could not help me if the hotel did not have the room any longer. I called Pricelines customer care and they called the hotel back, at this point I had been dealing with this issue for an hour and a half and was on my way back home due to not having a hotel room. This agent advised the hotel now had the two queen room available. I drove an hour back and checked into the room I initially reserved. I got no explanation or apology for the error. The location of the hotel was nice, but it had a lot of issues. There was no air in the lobby or hallways, wall paper was coming off near the exit to the pool, it was attached with push pins, the pool gate did not properly latch. The room had some similar issues. I filed a complaint with Hilton's corporate office, they called back and said they would look into the issue. The issue with the the reservation mix up should have been handled at the hotel management level, but I did not even see a manager in the lobby the whole time I was there. I travel to…
Excellent staff. Very clean facilities. Lors of options nearby. Moat importantly, peaceful. A stay you won't regret.

This entire stay was wonderful because of Simone. She is a force and runs this place like a tight ship. Fielding questions from demanding guests, all while remaining calm and shining her light. We will definitely be back again!
Great locatIon right out.to.the beach|Comfort room.but pillows were very.much lacking
Bugs in my room and smells like weed, such a letdown
Beach front hotel, affordable staff and spacious rooms. No contact check in options available. Small convenient store. Definitely recommend stopping by!
Sketchy and rude housekeeping/management staff. Fridge stopped working and ruined our food. Halls reeked of marijuana all weekend.

Extremely rude and unwelcoming staff. Hallways reeked of weed despite being non-smoking. Fridge in the room did not work and caused our food to expire as well… If you want to be treated with respect and have peace of mind, I would recommend staying elsewhere.

Was great for our stay for Jeep Beach 2026. No complaints other than a housekeeper scolding my wife for holding a door open for me to bring in a big box item I had just bought at the Jeep Beach vendor area. She was not holding it open for no reason. Everything else was just fine. Front desk was quick and answered every question I had. The room was very clean and the WiFi was decently fast. Self parking cost extra. That’s a ripoff for sure when hotels all over the country offer free parking. That’s the reason for 3 stars. Paid parking is three star territory for any hotel I stay at. If not for that, 5 stars.

Stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn Daytona Beach Oceanfront on May 7, 2026, and had a very concerning experience. The door to Room 420 did not properly lock—after closing it, I tested it, and it opened right back up. This was extremely unsettling, especially when traveling with my minor children. Management did send maintenance, but the situation left us feeling unsafe. We ended up barricading the door just to get through the night. I was in town for my daughter’s graduation, and the fear this caused—both for my children and me—was overwhelming. While the staff was polite and accommodating, safety is critical, and this should never happen. I’ve always trusted Hilton properties, but I will not be returning to this location. ⚠️ Please double-check your room doors for your safety.

This place is not customer service oriented. Requested to have sheets changed after 3 days and it took 5 days until they got to it. It, told me they were short-staffed. No coffee service, burnt my hand trying to make in room, they had wrong size cups by the coffee maker and it overflowed all over. Went down to the lobby and asked for another coffee pod and explained to them what happened and they did not want to give me one. Eventually they gave me one. I would never stay at this Hilton ever again. Attitude of front desk personnel was very poor, my problem was not there concern and didn't care that my hand was all red and burning.

I would normally give Hilton a 5 star, however, our last experience left much to be desired. I will preface by stating that we absolutely love the Hilton Brand, and the Garden Inn in particular, is our favorite. Whenever we visit Ormond Beach, this is the first place I check for Reservations, and normally, they are spot on. This particular trip was not our greatest (for many reasons), but as it relates to HGI, there were missed opportunities. Hotel check in was fine (as usual), however, we were on the 2nd floor, and asked were there other options available, and were immediately informed there was not. Secondly, we found that our toilet did not fully flush. We finally called the Front Desk to inform them, after the AI generated "How is your Stay?" message. We were told that someone would be right up, and the gentleman that came were very courteous. Having a toilet not working right off the bat, and then waiting for some time, for it to get fixed took valuable time from our vacation. I contacted the FD, to speak with a Mgr, and was told there was none for the evening, which I found strange that there is not a Night Mgr to handle Guest concerns. I then asked to have a Mgr contact me the next morning, and we did not receive a call either to our Room or my personal phone. We eventually called back, and asked was there another Room available, to which one appeared. Our disappointment lies on several things: 1: Checking in and finding that the toilet does not work, when that should…
Did not visit the Hilton, Took my grandson to summer camp
Stopped by for a drink at the bar - a fun place to visit.

One Twenty One Bar Grill was excellent Mia gave great attention to our needs. The food was fresh and very well seasoned. Prices for happy hour were very reasonable. The menu is nicely varies from apps to entrees and dessert.
Reliable consistency with rooms and service.
The restaurant here is top notch and the drinks are exquisite

Poor customer service. No accountability by management. I was at your property. Their was a mixed up in date on my part. I was willing to pay the difference instead I was asked to pay for an entire new room at a new rate. I was told the night manager was not there so no alternative was offered. I had to sleep in my truck in the parking lot as it was late and I was too tired to drive. I spoke to the CSR at the front desk and again I was promised the day manager would call me. I was later contacted by the front desk rep who did not offer any alternative option. So then I had to cancel because I was already out of Florida and I wanted the option of hotel credit, refund or the option to choose a future date and none of those options was offered. So Hilton basically took full payment without offering service even though I made contact 2 weeks prior to my booked date. Hilton Garden Inn actions were very obtuse.
Very clean hotel
Rooms are clean, hotel was pretty quiet, which was nice! They have a little snack shop, which is convenient! And was in a good neighborhood! I’ll definitely be going back to this place!
This is nice . Out of all the choices in the area, this wins. Hands down !
The location is excellent for all that I need

The lobby smells like a huge air freshener. It’s pretty bad if you don’t like strong smells. Our room was NOT very clean. I did find a bug, which I am sure happens. Front desk was very nice and helpful. They are sending someone to clean the room and offered a room change.
Food was 5 🌟

The stay is great and so are the amenities of the hotel, the food in the restaurant/bar is actually AMAZING and so is Nicole, super friendly, professional and such a fun person, simply pleasure to deal with and be around, and when she asks you to try the desert....just go for it😍...but let me tell you this....Shayne in the reception is simply AMAZING, literally the BEST check in in a gooood while (and I stay in hotels ALL the time), simply above and beyond, she is so nice and she really cares about what she does and who she represents, she took care of me, explained everything I needed to know ahead of even thinking about asking a question, she is so cute and adorable. It have been a while since I checked in to a hotel and got such a pleasant experience! I stayed at this hotel April 10, 2026 . I had a great experience . Clean rooms . Staff was great . The lobby is very huge for large families . The only thing that I didn’t like is that they did not have free breakfast , but on the bright side they do have a bar and dining area to eat for a fee . I will definitely recommend this hotel to others . It’s definitely my go to hotel when I come back to town

We started the trip with them not being able to hand out keys because they had a software issue. This was on a Thursday morning and finally was fixed on Friday night. They had to escort each guest to their room and let them in every time we needed to get in. However, when doing this, they didn't even ask for ID to make sure they were letting people in their own room. We had friends have their door opened at 1am by hotel staff trying to let other guests in. With regards to the hotel itself, the water pressure in the shower was awful and there were issues with the toilet backing up. They also said they would have coffee in the lobby at 6am each morning, but that did not happen. The hotel itself did seem clean and the beds were comfortable. We did not eat in the restaurant or hang out outside at the pool.

Absolutely loved my stay! The staff were incredibly friendly and the amenities were top-notch. The pool area was a perfect spot to unwind after a long day, and the room was spacious and comfortable. Can't wait to come back!

Outside of the digital key not working it was a pleasant stay, I request the gift pillows which is a huge plus, I checked in late which I didn't want but I did get good sleep and it my room was near the elevator, I slept well. The hotel is a little off the beaten path but near the highway. I'll be back
1 night stay. Free morning coffee was deliciousu, bold and replenished frequently. Poolside in the morning was quiet, Peaceful and perfect to enjoy the coffee while browsing email.

Wonderful property. Stayed last minute in route to Orlando from Miami. Location is perfect. Property is kept up nicely. Large clean lobby. Tash, FD agent made provided a wonderful genuine warm welcome and thoroughly explained hotel amenities.

the location is very nice, it's away from all the shopping area but directly in line on the strips, there's lots of restaurants/shopping areas. there's no shortage of that. i used to live in Pt St Lucie (exit 118 for those who know the I-95) I only picked this location because of their pool option. I did not get to utilize it as i only had 2 sunny days & 3 rainy days. the onsite restaurant is great, price is good, the happy hour is nice as well. as for the room, please keep in mind this is a pet - friendly hotel so there's LOTS of dogs on site, which means they're all over the room as well. My room was a 2 queen bed, it overlooked a roof and semi-parking lot, not the greatest (2nd floor, room 254). I must point out that the reason why i gave 3 stars is because i have to point out that there is a night light next to the microwave, the 1st night, that light shone directly onto everyone in bed, hated that. then, the side table that is between the beds, there is an odor that lingers in that spot. it smells nasty. hotels need to get rid of these carpets if they're gonna have dogs there. it's a trap for dog hair, dander and whatever else gets left behind that the naked eye cannot see. i dont think i'd come back but it's not a terrible place.

Diamond members do not receive daily food credit. Can hotels opt out of membership privileges? Follow up in response to the hotel. At check in no offer was made, no indication of Diamond benefits. Only telling me there is a restaurant on site and that no breakfast was provided. What should have happened was the front desk should have said " with your diamond status you receive a daily report credit of $X to use at the restaurant or you can earn extra points.

Nice clean hotel with a great location for visiting Universal Studios. Our only issue was that the tub was dangerously slippery. Thankfully there was a grab bar to aid in getting in and out. Even our adult daughter in her 30's commented about how slippery it was even while just standing in the shower. Plus the lighting in the bathroom was very dim.

Valentina is always so sweet and recognizes my family and I every time we come to visit Orlando. She is very personably and attentive. Will recommend this hotel and great staff. Not to mention the yummy free breakfast!

Had an amazing trip, I wanted to mention front desk clerk Fabiana and Earl for their exceptional customer service and multitasking ability. Always friendly and welcoming. I also want to Add Valitina front desk amazing job and helpful.
Great rooms,near parks,very convenient and great breakfast.Nice people a great customer service

I travel back and forth between Jacksonville and Orlando for work. I stay at this hotel because Fabi at the front desk is so kind and accommodating. In addition, the rooms are clean, the hot breakfast in the morning is a nice perk, and the hotel is close to many restaurants and stores!
Very nice location
Fabi goes above and beyond to make my experience perfect. I always enjoy it when she is there top tier customer service.

Estuve 3 noches y supero mis espectativas, el personal super atento, la habitación super limpia y la cama bien cómoda. El desayuno un plus, y el café todo el día. 100% recomendable, volvería a hospedarme en un Hampton.
Fabi is the best hotel associate out of all the Hamptons I've been to!

The room was simple, clean, and comfortable, and the complimentary breakfast was definitely one of the highlights of my stay. I especially want to recognize Fabiana and Valentina for their outstanding customer service. They were both friendly, professional, and went above and beyond to make sure I had a great experience. Their positive attitudes and willingness to help really stood out and made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. Thank you to the entire team for a wonderful stay. I would definitely recommend this hotel and would be happy to stay here again.

After a long drive on the road with my kids, I was greeted with premier customer service from Fabi, Luan and Vale. They were very helpful with my service animal and very attentive to all the needs for my kids. They have made my travel experience great. They not only met but exceeded my expectations. I will be back. I definitely recommend coming here. The beds were comfortable. The room was very clean.
You can't go wrong at Hampton Inn by Hilton.

Fabi at the Hampton Inn near Universal goes above and beyond to make sure my experience was nothing short of perfect. I enjoyed my stay and the amazing staff at Hampton. Special mention goes to Mr Earl for continuously providing exceptional service with a smile everytime we visit. You make this place home.

Es un hotel lindo y práctico. La habitación amplia, con microondas y heladera pequeña. El personal es amable. La zona de pileta y gym es chica pero confortable y con lo necesario. El desayuno es rico, poco variado pero está muy bien. La ubicación es óptima para visitar los parques de universal y los outlets marketplace y Orlando international premium. La relación precio calidad creo que es muy buena.

Wow wow wow! We had an unexpected situation come up so we had to book something same day. We arrived late and the customer service and smile from Fabi was exactly what we needed to brighten our day. She checked us in very quickly and made sure that everything we needed was taken care of. She is sooooo nice, genuine, outstanding and definitely someone we look forward to seeing again. Fabi for President! Lol

​I had a mixed stay at this Hampton Inn. The absolute best part of this hotel is the location—it is incredibly convenient and just minutes away from Universal, International Drive, and plenty of dining options. Additionally, the staff members were wonderful. Every team member I interacted with was friendly, welcoming, and eager to help. ​However, the physical property is heavily showing its age. The rooms, furnishings, and common areas feel tired and outdated, and the hotel is definitely in need of a comprehensive modern remodel (pictures). If you are looking for an amazing location with great service as a base for the theme parks, it’s a solid choice, but don't expect a modern look until updates are made.

We stayed at this hotel for 5 days and had a very pleasant experience. The hotel was extremely clean, neat, and well-maintained throughout our stay. The front desk staff were very friendly, always greeting us with a smile and making us feel welcome. The breakfast was Good, and the staff did a great job constantly refilling the food and keeping the breakfast area clean and organized. Our room was also very neat and comfortable, and the housekeeping staff did an excellent job every day. Towels were replaced daily, and the bed was very comfortable. The hotel also offered coffee and tea throughout the day, which was a nice touch. There was a pool that looked very nice as well, although we didn’t get the chance to use it. One of the best things about this hotel is its location ,it is very close to Universal parks, along with many restaurants and shops nearby. They also had plenty of free parking available, which made our stay even more convenient. Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the area.
Fabiana was amazing and very accommodating and the rooms were nice and clean. Loved this hotel and will definitely be booking again..

I had a lovely stay here for a conference at the Orange County Convention center. The convention center was a short drive away, and there were also plenty of restaurants nearby. Breakfast was yummy and well stocked. The room was clean and comfortable. I wasn’t sure how things would be since it was nearby all of the attractions, but the hotel was quiet and the people were in good spirits. Breakfast was busy sometimes, but never overwhelmingly so, even with lots of groups staying. Most importantly, Fabi at the front desk was literally the most perfect gal’s gal during my stay! She was sweet, kind, and truly such a gem, especially for a female solo traveller. Highly recommend this location if you are going to a conference but want to actually be near things!
Fabiana is the best! Nice hotel, close to everything. Did I mention Fabiana! I will return next time I am in town.

It was located minutes from everything off I-Drive and everything associated with Universal. For Disney venues, you have about a half hour trip plus the fun traffic of I-4. Everything was nice and clean. The shower was lacking pressure and we had toilet issues the second we walked in but that was addressed immediately.

I visit this hotel frequently for work trips and Fabiana is always extremely friendly and helpful, especially for someone working night shifts. Even if it wasn't for work, I would likely still book this hotel for a future visit. -Noah R.
Definitely great prices and comfy rooms

I'm putting the overall rating this low because the milk they serve for breakfast was expired when I visited. Gave me diaharea for over a week, I'd recommend them to change the milk fresh every morning or time it is available.
Excellent in every aspect recommend
fabiana was great!

Really great experience while staying at this hotel. I am a Diamond member so I frequent numerous Hilton properties but this one continually provides a great experience. On my most recent trip, Fabiana at the front desk, went over and beyond to accomodate me and help me with rooming concerns. Highly recommended!

Beautiful place and great people. Very convenient to get to the port if youre coming in the day before a cruise as we were. Plenty of beach items for rent to relax a little bit after our flight. Happy to be a Hilton Honors member! Will stay again when on my next trip and i look forward to it

We stayed two nights at this hotel. A lot of Cocoa Beach vacationers recommended this hotel which is why I booked it. I also am a Hilton fan, but this hotel does not seem Hilton-level. It is not quiet. I could hear the neighboring room in the bathroom and you also heard doors closing down the hall frequently. I booked an ocean view room for extra which was technically ocean view, but not as much of a view as I expected for the price. The rooms also don’t have balconies which I didn’t realize, but I do understand that was my poor research. The location is great and the direct beach access was awesome. My biggest complaint was the constantly lagging TV. It was very difficult to watch TV and some channels would not work at all. I expected more from a Hilton facility. I also had my young kids with me and while at the pool at 8 pm, the hotel was playing explicit music. Overall I would not stay here again and I did not find it very family friendly.

We had a fantastic stay at the Hilton Cocoa Beach Oceanfront! The staff was incredibly friendly and provided outstanding service from start to finish. Our room was spotless, modern, and beautifully updated. The kid-friendly atmosphere made it the perfect family getaway. We’ll definitely be back!
Good experience leaving for a cruise the next day!

The hotel is very clean, very nicely laid out, and has a lot of amenities. Food was really great, and the staff was super helpful. My only issue was that you're not allowed to use the carts as they are valet only. Seems kind of ridiculous but was really the only negative for us. It is, however, understandable from the hotel's point of view.

We enjoyed the Hilton Cocoa Beach Oceanfront hotel. It’s right on the beach which was a lot of fun. If you like, you can rent things like beach chairs, umbrellas, and boogie boards. There is a small pool, which was fine because we spent all of our time on the beach anyways. They do not have a hot tub. The rooms are nice and had a great view of the ocean. We were supposed to have connecting rooms with our kids. We talked to the front desk a few months ago and requested connecting rooms for our kids, but they completely messed up and forgot which was frustrating. If you are going on a cruise, this is a fantastic place to stay the night before. We absolutely loved the beach and had a great time. Also, one of our rooms the volume on the TV did not work, which was a bummer.

Giving this spot 4 stars because the pool was smaller and you can see the grime at the edges in the water. Otherwise, the room was perfectly clean and no mildew in bathroom. All the little things were good. We didn’t see a microwave and when I called the front desk, they brought one to me. It was a little older, but it was clean and did the job. Small refrigerator that did keep some things cold. The beach was so easy to get to and our helper Brett set us up with chairs and an umbrella. Cost is $52 for 2 chairs and umbrella. A bit steep but this Florida sun is hot so come prepared. He came out to help us order drinks and brought food to us. And almost felt like a resort. We stayed in the 2 bedroom queen coastline view and had a nice view of the beach from the side which was nice. Food and drinks from the little tiki bar was good. A little overpriced in certain areas, but it was good. I will say this is definitely a family friendly vibe. I did see some diversity as well which was good. No loud or drunk crowds. Cocoa Beach is a very small area and there isn’t a whole lot to do. But this is a perfect place to get away if you want somewhere quiet for your kids to enjoy a nice safe beach and have some nice resort like accommodations. I would say this location is 100% worth it. The quick beach access and friendliness of staff sets it apart. If you want a touch of luxury in a small beach town- then I would say this is it. This Hilton does not have a marketplace like some of the…

The hotel is in a nice, quiet location and provided a peaceful stay overall. However, the toilet in our room had a leak and would randomly flush throughout the night, which was quite disruptive to sleep. If the plumbing issue is addressed, this would be a much more enjoyable place to stay.
This place is amazing and the staff is wonderfull!
Typical Hilton experience. Very friendly desk staff as well as great food counter service. I'll be back.
Great location and great staff. Room a bit dated and missed having a mini fridge.

It's just okay.. if you only care for great beach access, this is the place for you. The rooms were dated and furniture heavily worn. Carpet was so dirty it stained our feet, and it was wet when we checked in. The bathroom seemed to be recently renovated which was an upside. Pool is very tiny, but there's plenty of seating around. Those working the front desk are very kind.

This place is amazing! The attention to detail, service, and ambiance are simply wonderful. If you're visiting Cocoa Beach, this is an absolute must-stay. The property is right on the beach, and there's so much to do that you never even need to leave the resort to have a great time. Everything you need is right there. The staff was exceptional throughout our stay. Kyler, the bartender at the beach bar, went above and beyond to make our experience memorable. He is truly the kind of employee every hotel hopes to have on their team. There was also a tall bartender at one of the other bars (I'm sorry I don't remember her name) who was incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. The front desk staff were superb as well. The restaurant was elegant, with a great atmosphere and excellent service. What impressed us most was how quickly the staff responded to our needs. We requested a microwave, and within five minutes someone had delivered one directly to our room. Overall, this was an outstanding experience from start to finish. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Cocoa Beach.

Props to Katie at the front desk for being awesome. ADA rooms are mislabeled in their system and we were put in a normal sized room which was awfully small even for normal standards. Katie worked quickly to get us moved to an ADA room which was perfect for wheelchair and walker space. Restaurants and tiki bar on premises were convenient. The only negative was the amount of unsupervised children at the pool. Parents were dropping their little ones in the pool with a life jacket and going to the bar, so there were kids screaming because they couldn't swim and were scared but their parents were nowhere around. On Saturdays they allow anyone to use their beach access and those people take advantage and also use the pool, so the pool reaches max capacity quick - I would avoid this hotel on the weekend.
Absolutely top of the line for the area.

The location was perfect. Plenty of parking. Direct access to the beach. The tiki bar was a great place to relax and hear some live music. Tracy and Briana at the tiki bar are awesome bartenders. All the staff was friendly.

Nice hotel, beautiful beach, expensive rentals/bar food & drinks, coffee shop was out of a lot of ingredients. We asked for late checkout & were given 12:00, at 10:30 house keeping walked right in the room, no knocking!!!

I referred to the rules but she completely denied it and she did not seem aware of it. I even called Hilton customer service who confirmed that 4pm late check out is always guaranteed as a diamond reserve member, no matter availablity. They also confirmed that this rule apply at this property. They told me that the hotel was wrong for not granting me a late check out and told me that they were going to investigate it. I checked on the Hilton app and there was plenty of rooms available for the following night, meaning that availablity was not an issue. Since I had planned the stay based on the assumption of a 4pm late check out (due to my Hilton status), this created complications with planning the rest of the day. Overall the stay was good, but their negligence towards loyal Hilton customers left a bad taste.

What left the most negative impression was the interaction during check-out. When I approached the front desk to return the room keys, the employee took them with the tips of her fingers in a way that clearly appeared disgusted and dismissive. I found this behavior unprofessional, disrespectful, and completely inconsistent with the level of customer service guests should expect. Your standard Hampton Inn. Parking lot is a bit small, and could be a problem when they are busy. There are a number of restaurants in easy walking distance.

Great place! Spacious rooms and friendly service. Complimentary salad bar and drinks were a great surprise when I arrived. This place is clean and comfy as well. If you book this place you’ll be happy.

We enjoyed a wonderful Father's Day brunch at The Hampton Social, and it exceeded our expectations in every way. The buffet was worth every penny. From the endless seafood selection to the perfectly prepared prime rib, savory pork roast, and beautifully roasted vegetables, there was something for every appetite. The variety was impressive, blending elevated brunch favorites with traditional breakfast classics, fresh fruits, artisan cheeses, and an irresistible assortment of pastries and desserts. What really stood out was the quality. Buffets can sometimes sacrifice flavor for quantity, but that wasn't the case here. Every item we sampled felt thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. The seafood was fresh, the meats were tender, and the vegetables were cooked to perfection. Beyond the food, The Hampton Social delivers an experience. The coastal-inspired décor is absolutely stunning, creating a bright, welcoming atmosphere that instantly puts you at ease. Every corner feels photo-worthy, from the signature floral wall to the warm, beach-house aesthetic throughout the restaurant. The addition of live music elevated the entire experience, providing the perfect soundtrack for a relaxing Father's Day celebration. Great food, beautiful surroundings, excellent service, and a memorable atmosphere... this is the kind of place that turns a meal into an occasion. We'll definitely be back, and next time we'll arrive hungry enough to explore even more of what this outstanding brunch has…

So first and foremost folks this is NOT the hotel on the beach - this place is about 3 miles from the beach. The room has a very fowl mold smell coming from them. Even the hallways reek of mold and desperately need new carpeting. The front desk team is kind however they for no reason at all charged my card for the entirety of my weekend stay with a friend. Despite asking to split the stay in half between the two us. They returned her payment to her and charged me for the entire stay with no explanation as to why. When I spoke to the accounting team Ellie was very rude and dismissive. There are a lot of better places near the beach for around the same price. Do yourself a favor folks and don’t stay here. We couldn’t even take photos on the balcony bc it looks like a legit trap house balcony 🤣
Great place for relaxing and enjoying all their amenities. Where you can have beautiful sunrises and Sunsets.
Chris was a wonderful server for our breakfast both days we stayed! Such a lovely staff at this Hilton!

It was my first day of summer vacation, and I got to my room and the AC wasn’t working. Chelsea quickly assisted me, she was fast, professional, and very helpful. Will came up and worked on my AC, he was very friendly and efficient. Then we went down to the Bar where we got served by Tanya, she was very positive, and helpful with the menu. It was an amazing stay! Amy was very helpful because she encouraged our stay here and made sure that everything was the very best for us!

I give 4 stars, since they have carpet and old one, I hate carpet on hotels. Breakfast is very expensive $23 per person+tax +tip. Four people breakfast $120. Noise from construction at the hotel exterior.The beach is like river color full with dry seaweed that stinks when sun heats.

We passed by en route to Ormond from Miami. Room was clean and tidy. Must give a five stars for a delicious vegetarian meal, great service from a young lady at the restaurant, thank you. Shame the umbrellas on the beach were chargeable.

My wife and I went on our best first date on Melbourne Beach and we wanted to get married at the spot that brought us together. Planning a wedding can be a stressful time but the wedding planning process at the Hilton Melbourne Beach was flawless and stress free. This is because their wedding planner, Taylor Fant is such an amazing and helpful person. Taylor went through every detail with precision and helped us through a number of party decisions we never thought of. Taylor worked with our flower and cake vendor and our DJ to make sure that everything clicked. Hilton reserved rooms for our guests and worked with adding rooms to the block with no issues. Would do this again any time. What a great wedding at a great venue and it was made possible by an awesome planner.. Thanks Taylor for everything!!!

A wonderful family “home away from home.” My in-laws inspired our stay, as they often come here for staycations, and I booked very last minute for a Friday evening check in and Sunday AM checkout for Memorial Day weekend getaway for my husband and me. From check-in, the experience felt special. We were kindly upgraded for our anniversary and gifted complimentary drink cards, which was such a thoughtful touch. Our room was lovely, clean, and very comfortable — the bed and pillows were amazing. We really enjoyed the food and drinks throughout our stay. Room service breakfast was delicious, especially The All American, and the Ocean Grille burgers, sweet potato fries, and key lime pie were excellent. Erick at the tiki bar makes amazing piña coladas and rum buckets, and the coconut margarita was a game changer. The pool, beach, and tiki bar made for such a relaxing weekend. We brought our own umbrella and chairs and loved how peaceful the beach became later in the day. We had a great time enjoying the pool and meeting other guests. One memorable frustrating service interaction happened at the tiki bar on Saturday. After we sat down at the table a bartender shouted across the area while a band was playing instead of coming over to explain the ordering process, which felt unnecessary and a little off-putting. It stuck with me for a bit, and additionally it was a bit frustrating that all the shaded tables by the tiki bar were taken by people’s stuff while they went to the beach or…

I have been traveling to Melbourne for business for over a year and I always stay here, beautiful hotel, great views of the ocean and of the space launches. All the staff is very friendly and helpful, specially Mandy Siravo, she has always been very helpful, she should get a raise or a promotion.
This hotel far exceeded my expectations. In fact I didn't even know I had expectations about this place until I stayed there and I realized that wow, this place is kinda awesome!
Retiree event-Everything was excellent!

Went to Longboards on few occasions for drinks & food, most recently on Mothers Day. Limited menu, mostly pub food. Average quality & portions are OK too. Avoid the $26.00 lump crab cake, small not worth the price for one cake😩. Service is below par as it takes a long time to be served and if you have a large party/ separate checks, be sure to check your receipt as they tend to make a lot of mistakes. Place is understaffed on any given day & servers seems to be overwhelmed at times. Live entertainment is OK, mostly reggae/ beach vibe. Check to see who is playing on any given day & times they perform. Got there at 3:30 at Mothers Day for drinks & music. By 5:00 pm the music was over, and they do not have any outdoor music playing on any speakers. Found that strange for a beachfront tiki bar. Boring Overall experience ***stars. George M

The goods: Location is perfect. You have beach access and the hotel keeps their portion of the beach clean of seaweed. The beds are super comfortable and the AC runs very cold. Our room was clean and smelled fresh. They have a fun pool bar and their pool area is a nice place to finish a beach day at. Negatives: Management does not police smoking at the pool. Thus I question if people at the pool are actually paying guests. This said be wary of leaving a cell phone unsecured. We had a room with two beds which is enough for four people. We had to ask for an extra towel both nights we stayed here because the housekeeping staff only provided three sets. No hand soap was available fi4 washing your hands so you had to use shower gel.
Nice place, tiki bar needs work.
Arianna was the best, good food and drinks!

We were sat in the patio after a rain and never received fresh water glasses, they just poured water into the ones that had set out all day. The food was the worst we’ve had in a long time. The chicken enchiladas barely had chicken in them and were mainly cheese and sauce, and I’m not even sure it had a tortilla in it. The service wasn’t bad but we did feel like we weren’t the clientele they preferred. The atmosphere inside the restaurant felt stiff, whereas the patio was more casual.

The restaurant has a great atmosphere, however we were sat outside on the back patio and it felt like forgot about. Food and drinks took forever. Food was extremely overpriced. If you go just know they look at tacos and quesadillas as the same thing.

We love Frontera Cocina and visit every time we’re in town! The food is always amazing! Ernst, the Restaurant Manager, goes above and beyond! On our recent visit our server Azucena was attentive to every detail! Can’t wait for our next visit!
The habanero chicken was excellent and Arianna was the best server we have encountered in Florida! GREAT Guacamole! Good spot for excellent Mexican food in Disney Springs.
Service was excellent. Our server Uriel gave our group a lot of advice on what food and drinks to order.
Uriel was so kind, respectful, and attentive. If you come here ask for him. Best food I’ve ever had.
Uriel is the best of the best, greatest bald Puerto Rican server
Delicious flautas and great service from Arianna. Cool drinks on a very hot day hit the spot!

Cannot say enough awesome things about our experience!! From the welcome staff, to our incredible server Jose, to the manager offering a fruit dessert for our baby - everyone made our meal one to remember. Plus, the best food Disney Springs has to offer!!! 10/10!!

If the food is pricey, it has to be really good to be good enough. This was. I had red snapper and the touch of sauce and accompanying pico de gallo we're heavenly. Tried the enchiladas suizas too. Marvelous! The guacamole is also outstanding. Sat on the terrace over the water. Nice.
Great food, quick service, perfect portion size (no wasted food). Shout out to Daniel B. Our server who made our experience smooth.
Ate here for lunch and we're promptly seated. The food was top notch, but the best part was our server, Daniel B. He was very friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend.

Amazing lunch experience over the weekend - beautiful ambience, solid food options, and excellent service. Special shout out to our server Arianna who went above and beyond to explain the menu, accommodate dietary restrictions, and make it such a fun meal!

Uriel was awesome as our server. Food was great, only rivaled by the service we were given. Highly recommend the chips and guacamole as my kids devoured it in less than 5 minutes. Quattro leches cake is also highly recommended.

Magically Scrumptious! Was greeted wonderfully by Ash who was at the door and welcomed me in! Attentively served by Cesar and Madeline as they fulfilled my requests. Meal was superb…. I had the half chicken Habanero with White rice, plantain, and caramelized onions. 😋 Y U M. Restaurant is kept clean and beautiful. Thank you for a memorable lunch experience at Disney Springs Orlando 🎈

This is the second time that we’ve been to this restaurant. The first time was outstanding so we decided to return. There are so many options to choose from In Disney Springs, but we decided to go to this restaurant again. Sadly, we were disappointed this time. When we were seated, I had to brush off the crumbs, not just on the seat, but on the table, I handed the server a dirty water glass and asked to switch out my knife because it had water stains on it. Unfortunately, we were seated next to a table of six that were so loud my husband and I couldn’t even hear our conversation. We started our order with chips and salsa. The chips were very thick and the containers that they have the salsa in are so tiny that you have to break your chips in order to dip it in. The server was OK. We had to wait a while for her to return. We had to get her attention in order to ask for more drinks. The food was OK wasn’t as good as when we were there a year and a half ago maybe the cooks have changed. I do not anticipate returning to this restaurant. I feel there are many restaurants in Disney and we have eaten at a lot of them that would be better well spent.
Awesome place for gatherings
We enjoyed our dinner and Arianna the waitress, made it special! Thank you
Very nice atmosphere and outdoor seating is very nice overlooking water. Wait staff was very nice and food was delicious

The first experience that my family had at Frontera was a series of minor incidents that added up to an overall disappointment. However, we were invited back, and I must say that the management & staff, along with great food, turned our impressions around. The Grilled Red Snapper is fantastic. The rest of my family had a variety of menu choices and they were all quite good. The chef was able to make some needed accommodations for a food allergy as well, which was very much appreciated.

Had the best birthday celebration today. The best waiter Christopher brought my daughter a skull cake and serenaded her with mariachis. The drinks and food were great quality. Thank you so much for a memorable time.
Really good food. Drinks are amazing! We had the cauliflower tacos and stake tacos. Both really good. Staff is super friendly.
Amazing food and even better service from Sam. Our entire family all had a wonderful experience and wish we could come back again.
Sam was amazing

Samantha made our dinner at Frontera Cocina absolutely outstanding! She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and gave us perfect recommendations—the food was amazing from start to finish. Her positive energy and excellent service made our Disney Springs experience even more memorable. Samantha is a true Disney-level superstar, and we can’t wait to come back!

I have respect for Rick Bayless as a chef, but the chefs at his restauraunt do know how to cook Mexican food. This was not real Mexican food. We had taco bell the next day and I think that actually tasted more authentic and better when compared to this place.
Lo amo!! Mi restaurante favorito en Disney Spring!
Our party of 2 was seated in an outdoor area, we had great service from our waitress, and the food was delicious!

Excellent food, very reasonable, Allison was very helpful, cheery and informative about places to visit when we left Ihop. As we’re visiting from Scotland 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
Allison was a lovely waitress

AC was definitely in need of a service. 84* indoor temperature makes the experience unpleasant.

Best place ever at biketoberfest and bike week
food was delicious. drinks were good also

Good chow.

Love going to The Island but... what has happened to the coconut shrimp appetizer?? I have been ordering the coconut shrimp for years, and they have always been perfect. My last visit was 2 weeks ago. The shrimp had so much (too much!) batter on them. It was so thick and made the shrimp hard to finish. I did not send them back as we had other guests at our table already eating their meals, and I did not want to disrupt the table. I happened to be telling my neighbor about my disappointment, and he told me he had the exact experience with over-battered shrimp just 2 nights ago. We are curious. Is there a new chef? Is there a new recipe? If a new recipe, please return to the old one. I need my coconut shrimp from The Island!
Everything was perfect! Thank you!
Perfect place for great food and peace and quietness. Service was fabulous
We went by water to this local favorite with great service and good food.

Inside was closed only tables were outside but yet it took forever to get a waitress to come take our order then when she did the Pina colodas were almost virgin. I had to ask for Rum. This is why the food rating is not a 5 star. Rhe food was really good. Hubs had crab cake sandwich and fries. The fries were like the old fashioned fries that came from the Ole ice cream shop cafe!!!!! The fried conch had a ton of flavor. You sit and kverlook the Indian River i believe. It was an awesome view. Not bugs. Just a couple of friendly birds.

This is a cool spot, feels like a roadhouse vibe. We went on Sunday and everything went smooth. The mixed drinks were strong, great views, had live music. We even decided to stay longer and sit closer to the dock for another round. Excited to see what this place is like on a Friday or Saturday night. Had the t-bone meal, veggies and loaded potatoe. The veggies were really good, there summer salad was also tasty.
Great food great drinks saw a band there Blue Revival they kicked ass awesome time
I been there twice, food is good service was real good. Everybody's google maps was wrong. Tells ya to turn at the gas station instead of AFTER the gas station

EDIT: CREDIT FRAUD ALERT!!! HAD TO CONTACT CREDIT CARD COMPANY. SERVER APPLIED UNAUTHORIZED INCREASED TIP OF EXTRA $20!! We’re out of town and chose this place for the water view — and that part absolutely delivered. The view is amazing, and the live band with outdoor seating creates a really great atmosphere. Unfortunately, the experience didn’t match the setting. Service was slow across the board. Our total time on site was about 1.5 hours for a party of two adults and one child, and even getting the check has taken over 30 minutes. I ordered the Caribbean Mahi with jerk seasoning but was served blackened mahi instead, and the baked potato was missing entirely. They also struggled to get my beer order correct. The fish itself tasted good, but the portion was small and disappointing. My wife ordered the seafood sampler, and the portion didn’t seem to justify the price. Overall, great location and ambiance, but slow service and poor value took away from the experience.
This is why we live in Florida! Enjoy the scenery and have a tropical drink. I had a Pina coloda. Try the Irish Nachos and the delicious tasty wings! Go for it!
Waited for server to come for a long time and didn’t clear our table. Flies were everywhere won’t come back

We aren't usually in the area so we thought we'd try it. It's a little hole in the wall kind of bar/restaurant. We stopped for a late lunch. It's directly on the water. People were only eating outside which is fine with us. I recommend going a little farther behind the bar there are some very nice covered spots. They have cornhole setup. It looks fun but we didn't play. There were birds walking on the rocks and pelicans diving into the water. I had the Mahi Mango salad. It was fresh and tasty. My boyfriend had the philly. He said it couldve used more cheese but very good.
Beautiful facility, great riverside location.

Went with group of 15 for dinner. Very good service and food. I had their version of Shepherds pie. Frash mashed potatoes in center with peas and corn in gravy surounding with small beef tips covered with cheese. Pretty tasty.
Very good local place. Good food, good drinks
The food and atmosphere are always great. While the service is SOMETIMES a bit slow, the food in the atmosphere more than make up for it.
Good food great service

Food was very good. I had fish and chips and it was cooked very well. I think everyone in our group was pretty pleased with the chow. However, it took forever to get our margaritas and they finally came were seriously watered down (I don’t make a fuss with waiters/waitresses, so I just went with it). Also, there was a $5 “non-cash” surcharge added to the bill just for using a credit card (which everyone does nowadays). $5 isn’t a deal breaker, but I feel it’s pretty low to tack that on. In summary, a good meal but overall experience was mixed.
Our lunch was DELICIOUS! The shrimp tacos and the chicken sandwich were perfect!!!! Our server was helpful and friendly Definitely recommended and will be back!
Kyla was amazing and had great hospitality! Treated my friends and I perfectly. Will be back!!

I’ve been here a couple times and the vibes are always right. Katy has been my server multiple times and is always excellent. Went with my family for Father’s Day and she made it feel like a real celebration. We loved the beach service too! It was a perfect day!
Our waitress Gaby was delightful, all the food and drinks were delicious. Thank you for a beautiful experience, we will be back!

I visited my dear friend who took me out for a delicious dinner, drinks, and good fun at Island Beach Bar and Restaurant earlier this week. We had such a great time! Peri made the best margaritas! She even laughed at my dumb jokes. I met some truly good people who are all lucky enough to live on this island in paradise and gather at this fabulous establishment. Thank you for sharing all the good vibes and laughter! Thanks so much, Peri!

Place is terrible. Not really sure how they got a 4.7 on reviews but first time here and it was terrible. Waitress had a bad attitude from the start and service was horrible honestly. I truly believe this place should be a bar but definitely doesn’t have quality food. Had fritters and the grouper which honestly were the best thing. Other than that had grouper bites, mahi tacos, and chicken pasta and it was all horrible. Pasta came as if it was drenched in water and the Bread they give you is also dipped in water and oil. Had no flavor at all, the grouper bites had no flavor, as well as their rice and beans which was horrible. I had to add lemons, salt and pepper to even make it eatable and even then it was gross. Honestly the only thing they got on point was the drinks which is possibly the reason their reviews are so high, because they get you drunk enough to not be able to taste any of the food at all. And to top it off I witnessed one of kitchen staff, not sure if he was a cook or what he was but he used the restroom and just ran back into the kitchen without even looking at the sink to wash his hands. Avoids this place at all cost. Paid $200 which included a $30 tip that they add automatically which is the reason they don’t care how they treat you cause they get tipped one way or the other.
Brooke at The Dune (Island Beach Bar)....🍻Best Bartender by far!
Pretty good beach bar with a great burger and friendly staff and a beautiful beach view.
Dani took great care of us .had the burger special. Was great

Fast and friendly service. I was seated and had a drink in my hand within a few minutes of arriving. The food was amazing and tasted fresh. There is an automatic 18% tip added to your bill, but I was warned before ordering and it seems fair given the amount of attention the staff gives you.
Food was so delicious 🤤! You must come and visit this beautiful place! Plus drinks 🍹 are so good 🙌🏻 Maegan was amazing and gave me an unforgettable experience ❤️
Kyla was funny, courteous and attentive to our needs. The food was da bomb diggity!!! TY Kyla and team at Island Beach Bar and Restaurant!
The service was great and the food was awesome👍

I learned this lesson a long time ago living in south Florida Never eat at the restaurants on the beach you paying for the view not the food. ORDERED A Mahi sandwich they literally gave me a cold fillet on buns no seasoning A little Lawry's wouldn't hurt and cold fries.
Fun beach atmosphere. The food is average. We were seated quickly but getting our food took a very long time. Service was okay.
Great place by the Beach!!! Confortable, great food, very good drinks! Recommended, Shrimp tacos the best!!! Burger great! And grouper chips!!! 🤩🤩🤩
Shawna is the best. Been sitting with her for about 3 years now. Came over from 2nd bistro just to keep sitting with her.
W manager, truly a hidden gem must try out! price very cute <3

I used to come here often few years ago. It was one of my favorite places to have a good time with a plenty of options at the salad bar used to go all around, fruit option was good back the, even had dragon fruit. I used to come with my wife at least weekly. Today I noticed how poor the salad bar selection was and don't have any fruits there. The selection of meats ifor the ayce is not great... Unfortunately I don't think I coming back. Good memories few years ago. The waiter (Esay) was very nice and noticed how disappointed I was and did his best to make me feel comfortable (very nice guy). They should have a better power cords management.

Came in at 11:30 and decided after getting a drink that we would sit down for AYCE. By 12 they did last call and shortly after started to shut down as if we had stayed 20 minutes after close, which they do not close until 1am. I understand wanting to leave work as soon as possible after closing but the entire time we felt unattended and unwelcome. If you want a Happy hour, do the mid-day. Otherwise it’s worth the extra $6 per person to not feel rushed from the moment you sit down.

While this was my first time with Korean BBQ, and I didn't particularly care for all the meat, the experience was great. I came with about 10 coworkers for a team lunch. Chris was our server; We did the all you can eat option and he made great suggestions, was very attentive and came back at the right times to check on us. I will definitely come back for a more intimate experience.
Asa was awesome! Food was delicious. We came as a group for a birthday and had a great time.

This was one of the oddest experiences I've had at a Korean barbecue restaurant. They charged us an 18% AYCE (All you can eat) gratuity without telling us beforehand. The waiter was ok 🤷🏽‍♀️ nothing too extraordinary there. He must've forgot to tell my husband and I about the gratuity before we had started eating because that definitely took us by surprise. Didn't tell us how their menu or meat cuts worked and it caught it by surprise. My husband finished his water and never got a refill, I gave him my cup. Literally this was the worst first time experience I've ever had lol 😐 I'm typically used to someone being excited about telling us about their menu and options or being very helpful with guidance. I genuinely wish I could get my money back because also you can taste and insane/ungodly amount of ginger in some of the cooked meats and it's personally not a fav. As someone who loves Korean barbecue and frequents, I definitely and unfortunately will not be supporting this business EVER again. Thank you for listening to my Ted Talk, have a wonderful day! PS! If you are not careful and watch where you're walking you will fall. I almost tripped over exposed wires 5 times during our eating experience and I hurt an old injury and am currently caring for it now. Thank y'all for that🫤

Came here for my birthday. The food was delicious. In passing I mentioned it was my bday, and the waiter brought me this delicious dessert without any of the singing, clapping, etc. I enjoyed it very much.

Went there for the first time for my cousin's graduation dinner and it did not disappoint! We sat at the bar and anyone who orders anything from the bar area is all day happy hour! Always a go to. Been here maybe 8 or 9 times, phenomenal every single time

Received this bento box with sushi instead of did lo mein. When the photo on Uber Eats had lo mein. Everytime I’ve eaten here it’s had lo mein. Every piece of food was more delicious than the previous!! Even the buffet foods were on point! I wanted a Togo of all of it even when I was full! Highly recommend 👍

Tried this place with some friends and was very impressed. The service was good. The buffet of items looked fresh and up to good standards. Nice and clean all over. Plenty of food for your dollar. Good music. Plenty of TVs through out. Paid like $68 for all you can eat. I thoroughly enjoyed being able to cook my own food as well as socialize and eat with friends. I also like the view of the water on the other side of restaurant.

My family and I recently dined here, and unfortunately, our experience was marred by inappropriate music selection. Upon seating our group of ten, the restaurant changed the background music to all Spanish tracks. While this may have been intended to be welcoming, many of the songs played were highly explicit, dirty, and sexualized. We were deeply offended to find such music playing in a family-oriented establishment, especially with children present who were able to hear and repeat the lyrics. It's crucial for restaurants to maintain an appropriate atmosphere for all guests, and we hope management will take steps to better curate their music selection.
Literally amazing food, best tasting cooked sushi i have had as well as very delicious kbbq meats. the all you can eat is a premium price for premium food and is well worth it, so arrive hungry :)
Best place for meat, soup and small korean buffet style hot, cold bar.

We’ve been going Izziban for many years now and we usually go for the Kbbq and the atmosphere, it’s overall fun. But this time we went during earlier hours ( 2 to 3 PM) and we encountered the worst service we’ve had so far. I don’t remember the waiters name but unfortunately the service was atrocious. We ordered several things and it took on average 15-20 minutes to get anything. He forgot multiple orders that we had to remind him after 20 mins of waiting. And then he tried turning it around saying that we hadn’t ordered anything? Drinks took 20 minutes to get, also. The rice took multiple attempts for him to bring. Every time we wanted meat, it took a long time for it to arrive or he just forgot. We really didn’t want to tip him anything, but low and behold, there’s 18% gratuity included in the price. And mind you, the restaurant was not busy. The waiter had maybe 4 to 5 tables. I observed others having to flag him down to get his attention to check them out. When he would “check” up on us, he wouldn’t ask us anything and just walk off. Izziban, Do better. If you’re already charging 18% for horrible service, you’re going to be losing customers. I’m really doubting if I would actually return, especially with that horrible service. If I do return, I would be going during dinner hours because maybe I’ll get better service. 🤷🏽‍♀️
Great sushi
Gigi was phenomenal. Best server this place has!!! Gorgeous and attentive.

Izziban is one of the best restaurants in the orlando area. The food and service are always 5 star. I atmosphere is amazing if you love Korean music and culture. If you are visiting orlando and only eat at one restaurant this should be it!
The service was great, very friendly workers as well as front welcome crew. The pasta was OK. The pasta was thin and just didn't taste as good as I was anticipating.

Every time I come out to Vero Beach in Florida I come to visit. I continuously come to this favorite restaurant. Don’t forget to order your spumoni. Jazzy’s Mainely Lobster was a nice experience overall. Me and my friends tried a few different things, and while everything didn’t hit, there were definitely some winners. One of my girlfriends had the mahi with rice and broccoli, and unfortunately it was very bland and needed more seasoning. I personally would not order that again. But baby, that Connecticut hot lobster roll was delicious! The bread was soft, fluffy, buttery, and just right, a match made in heaven. It was $33, so yes, it was expensive, but it tasted fresh and real, nothing artificial about it. I also enjoyed the sweet potato fries, especially with the honey mustard. The horseradish sauce was a little too overpowering for me and took away from the flavor of the fries. The fried belly clams were good, and the burger with onion rings was good too. Honestly, the fried foods were the best part, whoever is back there frying in that kitchen knows what they’re doing because they put their foot in it! Everything fried had great flavor and seasoning. The service could use some improvement. We kept having different servers come to our table, which made the experience feel a little all over the place and kind of off-putting. They kept asking over and over if we needed help, and while I appreciate attentiveness, it felt a little unorganized. The service just needs to be more consistent and coordinated. Even with that, we still tipped well because we did receive help, but there’s definitely room for improvement in that…

So delicious and lots of tender, succulent lobster meat. I got a choice of fries or chowder as a side. I tried the NE Style chowder and it was thick and had plenty of clams and just the right amount of potatoes. I washed it down with a Vanilla Porter and I must say that I'll be stopping in every time I'm up in the area. The service was friendly and quick. BTW: you can sit inside of out. I chose inside and sat at the super clean bar. There were four TV's and two had football games, one had sports videos, and one had animal & cat videos. I loved the cat videos! Overall it made for a great dining experience and you must try it!!! I highly recommend it! 2/23/21:. Passing through town again, my car made an immediate turn into Jazzy's. I'm sorry, but the CT style Lobster roll with NE England clam chowder was so good that I had to have it again. Tried a Nitro brew that was so good. Had to get some conch fritters for the ride back. Lisa was very attentive and gave great service. Amazingly, arriving at 2:30pm and the place was crowded (that speaks volumes) but easily got seated. BTW: dog friendly.....sit outside in the tiki area. Folks, you have to try this…

Ordered the Lobster bites, $33 and there were 3 or 4 bite size pieces and the rest were smaller than a pea. Waiter had a “ care less” attitude & certainly not welcoming & friendly. Fish tacos were $25. Total cost $200 with tip for my wife, son & I.
Great chicken parm sub!
LOVED it, First time there. The atmosphere was great. The people are very nice and they have a Tiki bar, a band Thursdays , Fridays and Saturday's. Great place , great pizza!
Delicious!!!! Mahi mahi tacos Shrimp tacos

Sauce on the pizza tasted like tomato soup & was gross. Chicken tenders tossed in hot sauce that was supposed to be buffalo sauce was terrible. Drink's were not refilled. Had to wait about 20 minutes to get the check. We will not be going back.

After a rough start to our first visit to Jerry's, our experience improved. Our server, Bailey, was inviting, friendly, and a great server. We had the opportunity to speak to the owner who was also friendly and insightful. We learned that our pizza was totally made from scratch. We got a large thin crust with pepperoni. Everything about the pizza was perfect from crust to sauce to cheese. It was delicious. This was one of the better pizzas I have ever eaten. Their menu had many different offerings. Jerry's has an indoor sports and outdoor Tiki seating arrangement with live entertainment. My only challenge as an older person was the type of seating outdoors is not very comfortable. Not necessarily for us seniors. Definitely worth visiting.

We enjoy watching the bands that play there. Music is at an appropriate level - not too loud. Pizza is the best we have found in Volusia county. Staff are friendly especially Jay.

This place is a favorite spot I go to every month or two with a friend of mine who loves it. The fish tacos are superb and the atmosphere is bright and friendly with a very warm congenial staff. Highly recommend!

The fish was crispy on the outside and tender inside, paired with a great slaw and sauce that tied everything together beautifully. Beyond the food, the location was decked out in full patriotic glory for the 4th of July, with red, white, and blue decorations everywhere that created such a festive and welcoming atmosphere. It really made the whole dining experience feel special and fun. I’ll definitely be returning soon—highly recommended!

We went to Jimmy Hula's and you have to go up to the counter to get a menu Go sit down review the menu and place your order. Then you have to go back pick up your food go back and sit down and eat. My first time here AND LOVED IT. I love burgers and babbbyyyyy that burger 🍔 was great lol the Kahuna I believe it is called. Either way I loved it. I also got the coconut shrimp 🍤 that was good but not really a big fan. I love the atmosphere and also the music. 🎵 I will be back.

My wife and I eat here for almost every special occasion. The wild boar is one of the best dishes you will ever eat. Do not miss it. Amazing service, incredible food, and a wonderful, very un-Disney atmosphere. Don't miss this jewel.

Jiko is absolutely outstanding, and the restaurant is worth every bit of the hype. First of all, even though I arrived late for my reservation, I was still treated with the utmost hospitality and courtesy and was seated as soon as a table became available. Tusho greeted and seated us, and when I casually mentioned that it was my birthday, not expecting anything at all, he went above and beyond. After we were seated, he returned with a Disney birthday button and a card filled with handwritten messages from the staff. I have never received such thoughtful treatment in my life. My server, Dawn, was exceptional. She was attentive, incredibly knowledgeable about the menu, and truly made my experience a thousand times better. Her recommendations and passion for the food made the evening even more memorable. Now, let’s talk about the food. It absolutely knocked my socks off. A dish may look simple—even like a salad—but the moment you take a bite, the flavors hit you and send a wave through your entire body. Every bite was spectacular. The food truly speaks for itself. The drink selection was also impressive, even though I wasn’t in the mood for a cocktail that evening. The service continued to amaze me until the very end. As I prepared to leave, I was presented with a birthday dessert to take home. I didn’t even look inside until the next day, but let me tell you—it was one of the most impressive desserts I’ve ever had. It was a mousse unlike any mousse I’ve ever tasted. Absolutely…

Jiko – The Cooking Place is one of the finest dining experiences at Walt Disney World and the perfect place to unwind after a busy day in the parks. The Oak-Grilled Filet Mignon was outstanding—perfectly cooked, incredibly tender, and served with creamy four-cheese macaroni, seasonal vegetables, and a rich chocolate-red wine demi-glace that brought everything together beautifully. The meal begins with their warm, crusty house bread and whipped butter, which is so delicious it's hard not to fill up before your entrée. � Walt Disney World Do yourself a favor and save room for dessert. We shared the Potjie Pot, a decadent chocolate custard with whipped caramel, cocoa nib crunch, and cherries, along with the Malva Pudding, an Amarula-infused South African cake served with caramel-sea salt gelato and crispy kataifi. Both desserts were beautifully presented and the perfect ending to an unforgettable meal. � Walt Disney World A special thank you to Dawn, whose warm, attentive, and knowledgeable service made the evening even more memorable. She was the perfect host and made this the ideal way to end a magical day at Disney. If you're looking for an exceptional signature dining experience, Jiko is absolutely worth the reservation.

Very very expensive but good was delicious. Great for a treat. Would return next trip but too expensive to go multiple times per trip. Husband and I both ordered filet minion. Lots of gluten free options.

I cannot say enough good things about the food at the various Animal Kingdom Lodge restaurants and the pinnacle of the AK foodie experience. Food 5/5 Atmosphere 5/5 Service 5/5 Regarding the service, our server was Badr, and he is a certified ROCK STAR. He went so far and beyond our expectations and his service is one of the main reasons our dining experience was so good. But you really want to hear about the food: Tea Service - Assum tea was delightful, with honey. Scallop and Pork Belly App - good, but there is better. Giraffe Bread - seems simple, but it is real treat. (Overall bread service is great in all the AK restaurants.) Short Ribs - another app, this one was so good. Morrocan Spiced Lamb - this was a fantastic dish, next time I may order two so I can take one home. Mixed Greens - so good, I mean really good. Bone Marrow Crusted Filet - Another solid choice, filet was very well prepared and the flavor on the crust was delightful. Malva Pudding - good dessert, but I think there are other good ones. Raspberry Done - yes, but I also love raspberries. Birthday dessert - not sure what it was, but it was a little slice of heaven. There is so much to do at the Animal Kingdom Lodge, please arrive early and walk through the lobby. There is usually a lot going on, plus if you walk to the back and you can view the animals. It was one of the best dining experiences I have had at WDW.

Jiko’s food is something is the kind of food that you leave and want to plan when you will be back. I go to a lot of Disney Resort Hotels and this is the top of my list. The taste, portion and presentation… 5 stars!! The wine list is incredible and carefully crafted for the food. I believe is the largest collection of South African wine in the U.S.. The ambience will not blow your mind , but you don’t have time to look around a when there is so much going on with the food. The complimentary Giraffe Bread is such a great way to start your meal!

Jiko was the highlight of our stay at Animal Kingdom Lodge. The food, service, and atmosphere were absolutely exquisite. My daughter’s father-in-law talked about the wild boar tenderloin appetizer for days afterward—it was that memorable. We also enjoyed a wonderful wine flight that perfectly complemented the meal. From start to finish, the evening was exceptional and created lasting memories for our family. It was truly a dining experience we will not forget.
Good and creative fusion food
Excellent food! I heard the pork belly was to die for. Ample vegetarian options as well!

I added this restaurant last minute about two days before my reservation and I’m so thrilled I did because it completely blew me away. I knew going in that Jiko was considered one of the more upscale restaurants at Animal Kingdom Lodge, and now I understand why. The food was impeccable from start to finish. The giraffe bread service was incredible, the scallop and pork belly appetizer was outstanding, and I’m so glad I chose the seafood entrée. They rotate the fish selection and tonight it was halibut, which happens to be one of my favorites. The dish was cooked perfectly and honestly I couldn’t have asked for a better meal. What also stood out was the service. From the moment I checked in to the wait staff throughout the evening, everyone was an absolute joy to interact with. My waiter in particular was incredibly attentive without being overbearing and really made the whole experience feel relaxed and special. I enjoyed it so much that I actually decided to cancel my reservation at Boma tomorrow. Buffets just really are not my thing, and instead I made another reservation for Jiko so I can go back and try the filet mignon. Definitely worth going back twice. Definitely worth every penny. Much more my speed while on vacation.

We had a lovely dinner at Jiko. Our food was a delicious, well balanced, Americanized version of African inspired dishes. If you're you're looking for something more interesting than your typical steak and potatoes, but want to keep it a bit more casual than some of the more upscale dining experiences on Disney property, then Jiko is an excellent choice!
Top notch African restaurant. Food is authentic and excellently prepared. Dined there many times, highly recommend.
Easily one of the best restaurants in the whole resort!

I always thought that Boma was THE place to dine while visiting the Animal Kingdom Lodge. That is, until I finally experienced Jiko. It's sumptuous dining selections are only outdone by its extensive wine menu, which ,by the way, is the largest grouping of wines outside of Africa itself. Not necessarily for the meat-and-potatoes crowd, it is truly an experience one is not likely to forget. If the menu doesn't whet your appetite, the decor and ambitious will. Offering first-class service and dining options, I dare you to try this truly unique restaurant at least once. I, for one, cannot wait to go back!

What a dining experience! Everything was phenomenal. Listen to the wine pairings, it really enhances the flavors. Neurodivergent /migraine heads up: Lighting is very low. It was very pleasant. Noise level was moderate, I used my loop engage and was fine. Strong smells of cooking spices and wood burning. The spoons are large and shovel shaped (see photo) Cilantro heads up: Cilantro was not listed as a separate ingredient on the menu. Be sure you me too. It to your server at the start of the meal.

After arriving in Orlando and checking into Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge after a long day of travel, we were hungry and didn’t have dinner reservations. Luckily we were able to snag a 5:30 PM table at Jiko, the African-inspired restaurant located on the lower level of the lodge. The ambiance carries the same beautiful Animal Kingdom Lodge African theme with soft earthy tones and clean metal accents. We were seated at a fantastic table overlooking lush foliage and a serene koi pond. Our server, Michael, welcomed us with warm towels and walked us through the evening’s specials. The food was outstanding—true fine dining—from the diver scallop with pork belly to the blackened halibut, and for the first time, we tried seared venison loin…absolutely incredible. We couldn’t resist dessert and ordered the Malva pudding, and were also treated to four complimentary friandises—little sugared jelly squares that were unusual but surprisingly addictive (we ate every one!). Expect to spend around $100 per person, but it is absolutely worth it for the service, ambiance, views, and unforgettable food.BTW, they do get super busy, I highly recommend reservations!
We enjoyed the plant based options on the menu. It’s nice to find unique vegan options with a great wine list. Every enjoyable experience.

This is fine dinning. The coffee ☕️ was really gorgeous flavor. Much like kona is to Hawaii. The roast boar appetizer was my absolute favorite part of the meal. So tender, full of flavor. The filet was extremely good, and also made a great breakfast mixed with the 4 cheese macaroni. No room for dessert. Highly recommend.

Jiko is an oasis like restraint in the heart of animal kingdom lodge, not only with its atmosphere but also with its food. The food is delicious with amazing presentation. We recommend the lamb shank, short rib, chicken, and duck flatbread. There is a kids menu with many options including steak. Protip: you get bread automatically, so if you wanted to order you don’t have to. Our server was very good and proactive. The restaurant was crowded, but somehow very quiet.

Absolutely love coming here and will always recommend it. Beautiful restaurant with upscale dishes that deliver flavor and presentation. I love the unique desserts and the main courses never disappoint. I love the scallops and white fish, both are sweet and light. The apple mousse texture and presentation was divine, the portions are perfect, and everything is cooked and prepared well. I will always visit when I'm in town and recommend it!

WOW. This restaurant really exceeded my expectations. I’d heard it was very good, but the experience and the food are treasures in the Walt Disney World Resort. While I wouldn’t recommend this one for the kids, there are menu items for the older children. We LOVED EVERYTHING. And, our server, Nate, was outstanding! Thank you, Jiko!

Jiko for dinner was a wonderful way to begin our recent Florida vacation. Canoe birds are a sign of good luck and the representations of Canoe birds over us made us feel as if their status as a good luck sign was already having an effect to create a wonderful meal to enjoy.

Jessica was a joy and wonderful with our group of 9 girls. She took very good care of us. The food was delicious and plentiful. Word of advice bring your appetite or share… some food was enough for 4 people. Loved the Chicken and Waffles.
