Matcha Cafe Maiko is a specialty matcha café focused entirely around Japanese-style matcha desserts and drinks. The space has a cute and welcoming café atmosphere that fits the theme well, with a menu built around showcasing matcha in different forms rather than treating it as just another flavor option. Seating is limited, so it can get crowded during busy times, but the smaller setup works for a quick dessert stop or grabbing a drink to enjoy nearby. The main reason to visit is the matcha soft serve and dessert selection. The matcha flavor is noticeably rich and earthy, with a stronger tea profile compared to many sweeter matcha desserts. The soft serve has a smooth, creamy texture and works especially well in combinations like matcha shaved ice, floats, or parfait-style creations. The matcha shaved ice stands out with layers of shaved ice, matcha soft serve, red bean, mochi, and Japanese chestnuts, creating a dessert that has different textures in every bite. The drink menu gives plenty of ways to experience matcha, from hot and iced matcha drinks to floats and specialty creations. Options like matcha with ube, matcha lattes with foam, and hojicha drinks add variety for anyone who wants something beyond traditional matcha. The café also offers coffee options, which makes it easier for groups with different preferences. Beyond matcha, the menu includes other Japanese-inspired desserts like taiyaki, mochi-based items, and seasonal offerings. The combination of traditional…

The food is always very very fresh and homemade. You wont get juicy burgers, fresh salads with quality meat, subs with quality deli style meat, or any other food this quality anywhere else. This is a rare and amazing restaurant. If you haven't been here, you've missed out long enough. Get your rear in there ASAP!!
Got a meatball sub for lunch. I can easily say this is the best meatball sub I have ever had. Great taste, freshly made it was truly wonderful. I work close by so I will certainly be back.
Too much meat on the bread. The bread to meat ratio is off. They need to find a more balance of meat and bread.
Great place did not disappoint sandwich was A1 will recommend ..
LOVED THE CLUB SANDWICH THANK YOU :) WAS GREAT
Tuna sandwich slaps it's made just the way I like it it's not dry and flavorless it's perfect 😋
This place is unfortunately going downhill. This used to be my favorite breakfast spot. But I don’t know if it’s the new cooks or new ownership. But the quality is no longer there.
The flavors are good but the sandwiches are a little soggy…I wish they toasted there bread
I ordered a cheeseburger with fries, the fries would have been good if they had a little salt on them. The cheeseburger had no flavor as well!

Service is horrible. Waited about 30 mins to get even acknowledged at the bar. No bartender for a full bar, the drink I had was made by our waitress and tasted like no alcohol in it. Overall for a takeout order and a margarita it took about an hour 15 mins. Food wasn’t bad though.
Great food great serve great location. Get the steak fajitas yummy
Great service, fast service and food is always wonderful! We love this place.

I met 2 friends for dinner Tuesday. The server was nice and accommodating. However, I was disappointed with the portion size for the guacamole and rice and beans for the price charged, as they did not feel like a good value. The drinks were also underwhelming- they were watered down and I couldn’t taste any alcohol in them. I would not recommend this restaurant.
La Marimba has really good yummy food, the best frozen Margaritas in town, and the staff are all very nice. Plus I think it is great to support a local family operated business.
Watress forgot about us. We had to get the busboy to process our check. Was good at first. All you eat tacos were soggy and took 20 min to get two more.
This is our favorite Mexican food restaurant in all of Central Florida. Excellent every time and amazing margaritas.
It is ashamed that they stop serving Steet Corn
Not as good as they were in the past.

I went here in 2025 with my sister and some cousins one night while on our vacation. The atmosphere was fantastic and our waitress was extremely attentive and jovial! The food was absolutely fantastic! I had already had dinner before we had come here and I couldn’t stop trying to shovel more of it in my mouth because it tasted that good! And the free chips were absolutely to die for. We ate outside and hung out until close having a wonderful time! Recommend this place 100 times over!

Usually a fan of the restaurant, but today was absolutely horrible. Provided my name for a table of one and they asked me my phone number. Told the hostess what my number was not once, not twice, not three times, but multiple times. She wrote it done and I waited and hour for my phone call. I got Tired and walked back inside and asked if there was an update on the wait time to which she said, “oh we tried calling you,” to which I never received a single phone call. Absolutely unacceptable service and attitude. They secured they would try and seat me to which I asked How long the wait for food would be since I’ve already waited an hour. I was answered with more attitude and decided that I would Just go elsewhere. Like I said, been a fan for a long time, but this is just unacceptable.
Solid place to go for some Mexican food. Never had bad food there. Pretty timely service, plenty of drinks to choose from. Plenty of places to sit inside, and a decent out door section.
Great service

This used to be my favorite restaurant. Mom and I would go for lunch after church almost every Sunday. I also enjoyed the music and atmosphere. However, lately they have been playing very loud rap/R&B music which I find very annoying. I probably won't go again once I have used up my gift certificates. Very sad because the food and service are amazing.
The atmosphere is always upbeat and friendly. The food is good! And they make great drinks!
One of my favorite Mexican places in Titusville!
Their street tacos are great! Fajitas are delicious too but the service and atmosphere could do with some improvement.
Tacos were great.Tamales were basically masa rolls , not recommended

Visiting Titusville and loved this place! Very friendly and fast service. Absolutely delicious carnitas plate with salad, beans and rice. The guacamole was a small dollop, bit came with tortillas. The meat was so tender, just scrumptious. My hubby had Carne asada, he said it was great! My other dinner companions had the relliano plate (dinner portion) has TWO and the tostada and soup. We all left happy and full! Thank you. We came in early, so I can't answer about noise level, it slwas super quiet at 3pm.

Most excellent Mexican food. You absolutely must try the jalapeno poppers, they were so delicious we ordered a second round. And the nachos.... Oh, my. But fajitas? Whoa boy, fajitas. So much food you'll explode. Don't skimp - add the chorizo, cheese and pineapple!

Recently attended a wine dinner hosted by Colin (our favorite bartender). Fantastic presentations and delicious food. Frank Family wines sommelier spoke about each course and wine pairing. Generous pours - lovely evening! Looking forward to the next one. Also, love Martini Mondays and 1/2 price bottles of wine on Thursday !
Large group food did not come out together. Food cold waiting for others. New Orleans pasta very little shrimp or sausage. Server friendly frequently refills water.
Our server Huyyou was absolutely lovely!! She was so attentive and had a great personality, I would love to come back for her energy and customer service. She deserves a raise!!
Wonderful place......steak was cooked I'm beautifully.... Wonderful environment we really pleased with the ambiance and the vibe
Thank you Colin for organizing the Frank Family Vineyards Wine Dinner last evening ~ June 5, 2026. The meal was delicious and those amazing wines.
Fantastic dinner and Wine Tasting everything was perfect
One of our favorite places in Port Orange. We went to the 4 course wine dinner recently and it was great, good food, good wine, and impeccable service.

Got to the restaurant at 8:25pm (they close at 9pm). As we are getting out of the car, we see the girl walk up and lock us out. My husband calls and when they answer, he calls them out on what they’ve done. She gets a manager I’m guessing and the lady says… I’m sorry it was a misunderstanding, you guys can come in!!! Ummm, no thanks! Not after that. So disrespectful 😡

I want to start by saying our server and interaction with the manager were fantastic. That said, the food was average at best. The flavor was lacking and 2 dishes had to be sent back for being cold. The atmosphere was also bland and boring, perhaps stale is the best description. The menu was riddled with mistakes that the local staff had no control over. For what it cost, it should have been a much better experience.

I had a great experience at Malibu Beach Grill! The food came out fresh and well-prepared, with everything tasting balanced and flavorful. Service was attentive without feeling rushed, and the atmosphere was clean and comfortable. A special mention goes to the manager, Emily, who clearly takes pride in how the place runs. She checked in on guests, kept things running smoothly during a busy time, and made sure any small issues were handled quickly and professionally. That kind of visible care really elevated the visit. Overall, it’s a spot I’d happily return to for both the quality of the food and the strong sense of hospitality.

I used to love this restaurant. It has gone downhill. Needs renovations and a new chef! Food is terrible! The thick sauce on the ribs taste like tomato paste, the steak tacos had medium rare steak, and the turkey bacon panini was disgusting! The waitress needs more customer service training. She didn't tell me they were out of panini bread or what temp I wanted my steak. I didn't eat anything but the salad. I will not return!

Place smelled a little damp. Ordered 2 French onion soups and a New England clam chowder. Soups didn’t look anything like the photos and the clam chowder was extremely watery -potato’s still hard and soup cold. Calamari was questionable looking (again nothing like photos) -thick long pieces. Couldn’t cut with a butter knife and was very chewy. Had to get another server to find our server). They were kind enough to take the food off the bill but ideal for just a quick drink and maybe a gamble on dessert.

Went for lunch on mother's day. Checked out the menu prior to going .once there we find the have a special menu foe today. The choices were not good for me at all. I settled for chicken picata. The chicken was extremely greasy and had a spoonfuls of piccata sauce on it. Sides were fine. It was lunch and I had planned on a salad or a hand held. Extreamly disappointing.i think if the menu is changed for a occasion they should tell you when you make the reservation.

I worked in the service industry for decades so I understand that holidays can be busy and unexpected, but the entire experience here on Mother’s Day was just a let down. Their website said nothing about a limited menu, but upon arrival, after it was too late to go elsewhere, we were handed a limited menu. We watched others get up and leave, we didn’t have the time for that. So at 11:30, for lunch, they had no lunch items. They got rid of all their sandwiches and left generic entrees they could throw different sauces on to alter as though up had options. Management didn’t seem to care at all that people were bothered by this. They also had box fans blowing air through the very warm restaurant. At the end of the Day it was the customer service that was lacking. Staff wasn’t prepared for people to be upset and management didn’t address it. It came off like they were scared of their guests. Guilt I assume. Food was forgettable, place was bland, service was a let down.
Had a great time here, all thanks to the hostess Audrey. She is adorable and so nice.
Great place. Loved the hostess Audrey, we bonded over having the same name as well!
Audrey was great. We loved her.
Always a gift at any establishment when you have a great server. Thanks, Audrey!
Audrey was very attentive and super sweet ! the absolute best !
Audrey was the absolute BEST.
Great food and service. My family and I came yesterday and we’ll definitely be back. Audrey was a great hostess, we loved her. She definitely made our days 10x better.

We had such a great experience and the hostess Audrey played a big part in that. She was super welcoming and made everything feel easy and comfortable. It never felt rushed, and she was always nearby if we needed anything. The food was really good too, definitely no complaints there.

Audrey made our experience amazing from start to finish. She was so friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. You can tell she genuinely cares about her guests. The food was also delicious, everything came out fresh and tasted great. We’ll definitely be back!
Audrey was truly one of the best hostesses I’ve ever encountered. She was incredibly attentive and answered all of our questions with a big smile face. She’s a walking bundle of joy.

Carpet inside smells funky and is visibly worn through. Sat outside. View of a plastic playground, complete with slide. Don't believe the pics on the website. Slow service. Appetizer of goat cheese and crostini was mostly chunky tomato sauce. Chunky ragu. It was brought to the table 20 minutes after we ordered it and 5 minutes before our cutlery and napkins arrived. So we just stared at it for a good bit. Could hardly taste the goat cheese once we got to eat it. Mahi mahi was cooked nicely and lightly seasoned. Perhaps things are looking up? Nope. The filet mignon was not a filet mignon. I ordered the filet mignon and I was served a top sirloin. Cut, grain, texture... these don't lie. Asked for the manager. Assistant manager came out. I told her that it wasn't a filet mignon, it's a top sirloin. She looked at it and agreed. Yeah, that's a top sirloin, she said. Said she'd go talk to the chef. Came back, said chef disagreed. Chef says it's a filet mignon. Don't waste your time or money. Best part of the meal was the honesty and professionalism of the assistant manager. Just saw the charge on my card and was reminded of how bad this experience was. Interested to see if I'll get a response from the manager.
Disappointing dinner for three. Young, inexperienced wait staff. Bland food. We ordered street tacos, shrimp scampi, pasta pomodore w chicken. $100+ w tip. It was not a $100 meal.
Great steak and meatloaf with excellent side selections. Good cocktails.
Everything incredible, panco capper chicken or something like that, highly highly recommended,.I wish we had Malibu back in my town

The food was really good. I don’t like seafood but my partner does and our server did a great job at making sure we each got tapas that fit our pallet. Service was great and the restaurant had a nice vibe, really good mix of music. Definitely recommend for a date night!
Overall the experience of dining here has always exceeded expectations. The food, and our server Tamara, made it so much easier to enjoy the full experience of the meal and wine tasting.

Really enjoyed the atmosphere and decor within the restaurant. The service was pretty great and welcoming. I must say it was very hot and humid inside the establishment while I was was enjoying brunch. The food looked good and was pretty tasty aswell.

I liked the place. Somehow its in the middle of a residential neighborhood. Parking is 9n the street, usually adjacent side streets. No biggie. Interesting food choices. All excellent choices. The fried green tomatoes are great. I had the cheese burger and fries. It came with an egg on top ( in Asia they always came that way. You'll love it). Unfortunately, the extra thick bacon was EXTREMLY salty. I had to remove it. The burger and fries were also way to salty for me. The other 2 people I was with also had cheeseburgers. They also thought it was to salty, but 1 ate his. Ne and the 2nd glcould not because of to much salt. I brought mine home and will wash the burger and bacon then air fry it and hope for the best. I truly belive most everyth8ng else will not be like this. I do 0lan 9n returning. My other 2 friends eat there frequently and say this is a 1st for them. *** RESPONSE TO OWNERS COMMENT*** Your staff was EXCELLENT. Steve asked SEVERAL times if food was okay. I think another guy did also. I truly believe thus was a 1 time thing. Ill be back. My 2 friends go often. I didnt complain because I liked everything else and didn't want to rock the boat. Usually im very vocal if I dont like the food. I just wanted to make you aware to see it wont happen again. Im sure my next visit will be 5 star.

There simply aren't enough stars to rate our experience at Maxine's yesterday. Maxine's is so much more than a restaurant; it's an unforgettable experience. From the charming atmosphere to the personal touches, like remembering your name and the little details that make you feel truly welcomed, every moment feels special. One of the highlights of the brunch was when Kirt came to our table and performed slam poetry. It absolutely made our daughter's year and created a memory we'll never forget. The food was exceptional. Every dish was beautifully prepared, and every bite was absolutely delicious. If you have the opportunity, request a table on the patio. The outdoor seating is fantastic, creating the perfect setting for an amazing meal. They even bring a personal AC unit to your table to keep you comfortable on warm Florida evenings! Maxine's has mastered the art of hospitality, entertainment, and incredible cuisine. We can't wait to come back.

Maxine's is a quirky & fun place! The ambiance, delicious food & top-notch service made it a must visit if you have not been. And it is in a beautiful historic neighborhood as well. We will definitely be back!

Second visit, and it just keeps getting better! This was our second time at Maxine’s on Shine, and we were excited to return after thoroughly enjoying the beef carpaccio on our first visit. It was so memorable that it became the main reason we came back. This time, we celebrated my son-in-law’s birthday on Friday, and the experience exceeded all expectations. The food was absolutely wonderful—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was outstanding. Our waiter, Tom, was extremely attentive and made sure we wanted for nothing throughout the evening. As a special surprise, one of the owners stopped by our table, provided us with drinks, and personally toasted my son-in-law for his birthday. It was a very nice, heartfelt touch that made the celebration even more special. Everything about the evening felt warm, welcoming, and upscale without being stuffy. We left completely satisfied and will definitely be back in the very near future. If you’re looking for excellent food, great service, and that personal touch, Maxine’s on Shine is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

We went for Father’s Day brunch and our server Dana was fabulous, the ambiance is unique and very fun! My husband and daughter got a mimosa and sangria and enjoyed them. The food was good, but not exceptional. I’d say standard fare with our favorite part being the biscuits (for the price you can find better, again not bad, but not great, we pretty much finished our plates but I honestly think that had more to do with getting our moneys worth). My daughter and I each got the vegetarian omelet and my husband got the lobster roll and wished he had drawn butter and found the coleslaw to be pretty much cabbage either not soaked in the base long enough and as a coleslaw lover he was disappointed. Passing along the helpful info below by another reviewer you may want to take cash to avoid the credit card surcharge (not a slam on the business, we understand the reason behind it).

Awesome set of people. From the staff to the owners. Made us feel so welcomed. Thanks for giving my wife a birthday toast. The owner is such a wordsmith. Dropping bars all night. Great experience and food.

Very intimate atmosphere, our waitress was awesome and talented. Her artwork was showcased on the walls at the time. We started with "cheese cigars" omg...so good. We were fighting over the last one, so get 2 orders! The lobster ravioli with REAL lobster, the steak with mushroom sauce with also really good. You could tell the dessert was homemade, apple cobbler..which is a good thing! Maxine is delightful and makes sure every guest felt welcome.. Definitely going back again soon.
Food was exceptional as was the service. Highly recommend 👌

Finally got to make it over here for a meal with Bite 30 event. Really left unimpressed and underwhelmed. Portions for appetizers and dessert were a joke. Main meal decent size. We’ve never left a Bite 30 still hungry. Pasta dishes had good flavor. I had the steak meal. Glad I ordered it medium rare so that when it came out past medium I could at least still eat it. Server never came back so I could show him until we were done. It was charred well but lack flavor or seasoning. Even a bit of salt would have made a huge difference. Carrots and green beans tasted very good in season but were undercooked. More like blanched at best. Sauce on tops of steak lacked flavor also. Saw several dropping salt all over the meal. As should I. Inside was hot as heck. Maybe borrow some fans from outside to add some air movement. Drinks and beer are overpriced also. To many other good places to go to for a better meal.
My new favorite restaurant and Tom was incredible thanks for amazing service BTW Maxine thanks for the invitation on the walk and wine make our anniversary was amazing

The cheese cigars are by far my absolute favorite thing on this menu. Please keep them on the menu always. I have never had a bad experience or meal while visiting this restaurant for the past decade.

I want to preface this by saying I enjoyed my time at Maxine's, the owner came by the table and was fantastic and welcoming. The drinks we're fantastic & I loved em but my only gripe was the braised brisket and egg combo I had for breakfast. My brisket was soggy & not as flavorful as I'd expected while the eggs weren't as cheesy after having that added. Normally I send dishes back if I don't like what I'm but the conversation & enjoyment I was having with my friend made me forget about the dish. I am willing to return to try Maxine's again for Bite 30, I won't be trying the braised brisket breakfast dish again.

I’ve been here quite a few times, and I absolutely LOVE being here every time!! Kurt and Maxine are FANTASTIC, and all their staff are as well! The food is always tasty and cooked well!! And the atmosphere is always a joy to be in.
A must do! Delicious food. Excellent service. Whimsical atmosphere.
Did the Bite30 menu, the fried green tomatoes and pimento cheese was perfect.
I love this place. I always get the chicken and waffles on Sunday. Highly recommend going here.
Came here on a Sunday for brunch. Great food, service, and atmosphere. Definitely recommend checking this place out.
food selection and quality is very good, service was outstanding, atmosphere is good but the place is small and does not lend itself to a live musician. it was hard to talk while he was playing.
Friendly staff with outstanding service. Food was served fast accurate and was delicious. Atmosphere was charming and eclectic.

I recently went to Maxine’s on Shine for a brunch date, and it had been years since my last visit. My date made reservations, which I highly recommend because it does get busy. We got lucky and found street parking nearby, which was a plus. It was a hot day, so we chose to sit inside where they had a nice live performance going on the atmosphere was definitely a vibe. Our waiter, Steve, was great and attentive, starting us off with water right away. I ordered the Sangriato, which was pretty good. For food, my date ordered the steak & eggs and I went with the shrimp omelet, both served with potatoes and a biscuit. Unfortunately, my meal was just okay something about it didn’t quite hit for me. On the other hand, my date enjoyed his meal enough to take the rest to go. Overall, the service and ambiance were really nice, but the food was a bit of a hit or miss for me this time around.
This place is delightful 😊

It has a great and fun atmosphere. We really enjoyed the experience and the service was excellent. The staff was very friendly and attentive. We will definitely come back more often and highly recommend it.

This place is a VIBE. I love a setting that knows how to do proper warm lighting and niche and fancy esthetics and Mathers nails that. I haven’t tried any drinks , only some of the appetizers which were a delicious little treat after already being out for awhile. Second floor had a live sax player and the jazzy sounds and old school vibes really make it seem your not in Orlando but in New Orleans
Nice vibe and atmosphere except for the club downstairs.!!!!!! It was hard to listen to the band and relax but nice place.
The pizza is our favorite in town, but we are getting tired of competing with the house 🪰 swarming around our heads, landing in our food and drinks. Shakai doesn't have this problem.

The host Christian who was shorter than me a 5’3 girl, was very distasteful. We walked up handed him our IDs he immediately told us to leave. Disgusting behavior. I come to mathers all the time, will not be going back and will be telling everyone how distasteful mathers has turned into. Tiny man Christian said he needed to look out for girls like “us” to not let in. Yeah we we’re also told to look after tiny leprechauns with small egos. So pathetic.

Tried to go with friends, who had been talking all day about how great this place was and what exactly we were going to order, etc. After hyping it up for hours, getting through the door, and climbing the flights of narrow stairs, we were turned away as soon as the doorman saw that at least one person in our group was visibly trans. They said it was about dress code, but the only person they could find a semi-valid dress code item to nitpick had already been allowed through the door. I don't buy it for a second. I strongly believe they would have absolutely let the rest of us go through if that/those member(s) of our group hadn't been present. So they turned away four paying customers and hundreds of dollars in revenue on a slow weeknight, either because of a completely nonsensical dress code, or simply for prejudice. Either way, it was ridiculous.
Love this place!! Catalina was amazing!!

Not my first time to Mathers, but it will be my last. Attended a Broadway show at Dr. Phillips Center and walked up to Mathers for an evening drink and some food. We were taking friends to Mathers for their first time. We were politely greeted at the door and they checked our IDs and we walked up the flights of stairs to the top-floor bar. Only then we're we turned away because "men are required to wear closed-toed shoes". Mind you, I'm wearing dark blue slacks and $100 leather sandals. I looked respectful enough for Dr Philip Center. It's Florida, and a slow Thursday night. I'm fine having a dress code but it needs to be clearly displayed and enforced at the door. By the time I've walked up the stairs it's too late. They could have extended a courtesy and asked me to dress differently next time. They made it so awkward, I actually thought they were not actually being serious. And it should be enforced regardless of gender or sexual orientation. I don't care if they have an "old fashioned" theme, there are plenty of reasons why the way I dress is none of their business. I won't go again, and I will stop recommending Mathers to others. While it's not my case, if you're someone who's gender non-conforming I would suggest you review their dress code and make sure you're expressing according to their standards if you choose to go to Mathers. See other reviews below re: Mathers not being a safe space.

Would definitely recommend to stop by this place for any sort of occasional. Great ambiance! Shout out to the manager and owner!

I really struggled with whether or not to give five stars. The atmosphere is like NINE stars, but the drink menu is very disappointing. So incredibly limited and underwhelming. This place is great. Very unique and fun vibe. Great music, food, drinks and the staff is awesome. Really relaxed and easy to chill.

Love visiting this speakeasy. Katalena was on top of our services offering a wonderful experience for my sister and her girlfriend visiting for the first time. 10/10 would recommend. Happy hour from 4-7 is worth the trip!

All you need to do is show up. Best Asian Street Food with the best quality and price. The service is one of a kind. The environment was noisy but the value made up for it.
The food is fresh and approachable. Justin was very attentive and super friendly with my 79 year old mother.
Food was incredible but the service was a bit slow. 1 star for atmosphere because the yellow metal chairs are NOT big person friendly which made for a very uncomfortable experience.

I most definitely had a great time and would love to eat here in the future. Any Malaysian dinners would recommend Cooper to be your waiter!

Food was spectacular today all around. It’s a great experience coming at 11:00 being the first customers. PAIGE is a phenomenon server who is kind, fun, proactive, efficient and wonderful. Been here many times…today was outstanding again. Thanks’

went to Mamak on a Monday around 6 PM and the place was already pretty packed, which is always a good sign. I ordered the Chicken Satay skewers, the Mamak Nasi Goreng, and split the Crispy Pork Belly with a friend and everything exceeded my expectations. The Crispy Pork Belly was the standout. Perfectly seasoned, tender on the inside, and fire‑roasted until the outside was golden and crunchy. Not fatty at all, just that ideal crisp bite. It paired beautifully with the dipping sauce (pretty sure it was hoisin), which added the right amount of sweetness and depth. The Chicken Satay skewers were another hit. The chicken was incredibly moist, fall‑off‑the‑skewer tender, and full of herby flavor. The peanut sauce that came with it was so good I asked for extra , it was rich, creamy, and balanced. The Mamak Nasi Goreng was classic comfort. Wok‑fried with shrimp, chicken, eggs, and onions, topped with fried shallots and scallions. Flavorful, smoky, and satisfying without being greasy. For the quality and portions, the prices were surprisingly reasonable. I honestly expected it to be more expensive given how good everything was. Overall, Mamak delivered on flavor, texture, and value. I'd absolutely come back and try more dishes.

They're served over a bed of four-cheese sauce, perfect for dipping and scooping extra gooey creaminess into each bite. Pro tip: Spoon whatever of the cheese sauce is left onto your plate for bread spread! 🍫Chocolate Stampede Cake - It should honestly be called "Death by Chocolate Cake" because this double-wedge of goodness is crafted from six kinds of chocolate. Thank goodness for the scoop of vanilla bean ice cream on the side, because it helps balance out the wonderfully rich, dark sweetness overload. Again, it's ideal for sharing with your whole party, so don't be afraid to order it on a full stomach!

At another restaurant I visited recently (not this one), when we mentioned an issue to the waitress, she simply said, “Oh, I’m sorry. D’Aydrian did the complete opposite — he genuinely cared about our experience and went above and beyond to make our evening enjoyable. We were seated upstairs in the bar area, where there was also a large party that had not yet ordered, as well as another table seated just before us. From the beginning, the staff appeared somewhat frustrated or disengaged. A server handed us menus with very little interaction, and another staff member behind the bar did not acknowledge us. A younger server briefly let us know that someone would be with us shortly, as they were finishing drinks for the larger party—which we completely understood and were happy to wait for. Unfortunately, there was little to no follow-up after that. One bartender stepped away without any communication and did not return, while another staff member focused on cleaning tasks—wiping tables and putting items away—without checking back in with us. I understand how it feels at the end of a long shift—being tired, ready to be off your feet, and wanting to get home to friends and family. I’ve been there myself. Linda’s La Cantina Steakhouse is one of those rare Orlando places that feels completely immune to trends. Walking in feels like stepping into a different era. The checkered tablecloths, old-school dining room, lounge atmosphere, and decades of history immediately make it clear that this place was around long before most of Orlando’s “hot new spots” and will probably still be here long after they’re gone. The steaks are the star for a reason. No unnecessary theatrics, no tableside smoke show, no attempt to reinvent steakhouse culture. Just quality cuts cooked properly and served by people who seem to understand exactly why customers keep coming back. What stood out most was the feeling that you’re participating in a piece of Orlando history. You look around the room and get the sense that some families have been celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, promotions, and milestones here for generations. In a city that changes constantly, Linda’s feels like proof that some things don’t need updating. Great steak, strong drinks, familiar atmosphere, and nearly 80 years of doing things their way. That’s worth supporting.

We have stayed at Reunion Resort in Orlando several times and have always had a great experience. The resort itself is excellent and has a lot to offer. It is a huge place, but the staff are really helpful and the shuttle/minibus service around the resort makes getting about much easier. The on-site water park is fantastic and has always been one of the highlights of staying there. The houses we have stayed in have always been in great condition, clean, comfortable and well maintained. The restaurants in the main hotel are okay, although there are better options nearby, but overall the resort facilities are very good. Reunion is a great choice if you want somewhere spacious, well kept and convenient for an Orlando holiday. We would definitely recommend staying there.

This was our fourth time renting a house in Reunion, and while this property had some positives, it fell short of our expectations. The house itself was large and spacious, and it appeared clean upon arrival. However, it was not cleaned to the standard I would expect for a vacation rental at this price point. The floors needed a thorough scrubbing, the bathrooms could have used much more attention, and there were handprints visible throughout the home. The furnishings are starting to show significant wear and tear, and several pieces should be replaced or updated. The color-changing LED lights in the family room were particularly frustrating, as they continuously changed colors and became more of an annoyance than a feature. The outdoor pool area also needs attention. A refresh and a good power washing would go a long way toward improving the overall appearance and guest experience. The kitchen was well stocked, organized, and had everything we needed for our stay. Unfortunately, many of the cabinets, drawers, and surfaces felt sticky, which detracted from an otherwise functional space. The upstairs carpeting was another disappointment. It appeared dirty and either needs a deep cleaning or replacement altogether. Overall, the size and layout of the home were great, but the lack of attention to cleanliness, maintenance, and upkeep made it difficult to justify the cost. I explained to the contact that we specifically paid extra for the added features listed. I asked if we would have chose an elite cottage if we would have been guaranteed a pool (the only additional features specific to the elite) and the contact stated that the elite does guarantee a pool but the premium does not guarantee any of the added features listed for it. I had an absolutely fantastic night at medieval times. We took my dad for his birthday and got VIP seating so we were right in front next to the king and queen. I don’t know what I had been expecting but the chicken was delicious and they had spiced corn and potatoes that were truly awesome, and our server was incredible. She was so quick and really nice to us the entire time. Not even mentioning the show itself, I absolutely loved watching the knights compete and joust. You could feel the excitement in the room every time they started to compete. I hadn’t even known they had a hawk act, but it was so cool to see it flying around the ring on a hunt. It really elevated the atmosphere and made everything so much fun. Our group was very lucky and got front row seats at Table 1 and it was nice to be able to see the horses up close and feel close to the action. I will definitely be back (or to other castles)!

Mckee Botanical Garden is an absolute gem. From the moment you step onto the path, you feel the stress of everyday life simply melt away. The winding journey through the woods is thoughtfully laid out, drawing you deeper into a world of lush greenery, dappled sunlight, and the kind of quiet that reminds you how restorative nature can truly be. We brought the whole family, and it was one of those rare outings where everyone from the youngest to the oldest, everyone was genuinely engaged. There's something magical about walking among towering trees and beautiful plantings that sparks curiosity and conversation in a way that screens never could. The kids were wide-eyed, and honestly, so were the adults. There is a special place for the kids to run around and enjoy as well. The kids can and probably will spend at least 30 minutes running around and enjoying nature. The grounds are well-maintained without feeling overly manicured. It strikes that perfect balance between wild and welcoming. Every turn along the trail revealed something new to admire, a burst of color, an interesting specimen, a quiet clearing perfect for pausing and just breathing it all in. If you're looking for a meaningful way to spend time with the people you love, Mckee Botanical Gardens delivers. We'll absolutely be back.

It's not what it was... but you won't miss that and Disney is counting on it. What it was: If you wore a hat inside, put elbows on the table, ate less than you were served, especially veggies, tattled on other guests or really any other bad thing you did that the age appropriate staff envisioned (or remembered), you'd be punished. You could be made to stand in the corner, be mocked or shamed by other diners, sweep the floor, and other time appropriate punishments... I mean no hitting, but you know. It was a fun version of the sometimes tragic X and earlier generations endured. All of us can take a joke. It was fun. I don't know what happened during covid that changed this. I mean yeah, Disney tossed the magic in general and continues to do so to this day, but this wasn't chalked up to magic. This was theater; these were actors. Triggering the weak by saying no to phones (games / toys) at the tables or asking them to do as they're told wasn't going well for up and coming generations are common theories, I think more so the mass staff rotation ruined the theme of this restaurant. Suddenly Auntie Bessie was too young to have any experience with the theme, and too many Auntie Bessie's were clearly not even aspiring actors. Sure it used to be that cast members wanted to be a part of the magic, and there are still some, but it's not mandatory to like your job or be nice to customers anymore. When your customers pay employees, and not the employer, employees tend to extend the…

Lots of bright colored signs and murals on the walls. Atmosphere was great, at one point someone came out on stage and played the guitar. We were not expecting live music, but this was a nice touch to the experience. Lets talk about the food...As someone with Mexican roots, this food was far from being authentic. I think this was a great American take on Mexican food. Between my partner and I we ordered the cheese dip, enchiladas verdes, and birria tacos. The dip- Chips were over-salted. At one point we were scrapping all the salt of the chips, because it was SO overpowering. The cheese dip itself didn't taste like anything. Every time we took a bite, we didn't taste anything. Not sure if that was from how much salt was on the chips. My partner's birria tacos were the same. Lacked flavor, the consome (dip for birria tacos) was thick, almost like a salsa, which is not what consome is supposed to be like. The beans came in a small cup that again, had zero flavor. The rice actually wasn't bad! That was probably the only good thing about the dish. For me, I ordered the enchiladas verdes. I should have read another review below, because someone else mentions how their presentation was a bit weird. The enchiladas come in a bowl, almost like a soup? The chicken inside the enchiladas was tinga, which isn't normally what's inside…

Pretty Solid. My family enjoyed the atmosphere and food was not bad. Food was a little slow coming out, but we were not in a rush. We traveled from Venezuela last week to celebrate our son’s birthday in Orlando, and one of the places we visited during the trip was Antojitos. The evening turned out to be much better than we expected. Our son was fascinated watching Aaron prepare the guacamole right at the table. He stood there the entire time paying attention to every ingredient and asking questions. Aaron was incredibly patient with him and even joked around a little, which made our son feel included in the experience. The food was excellent, but as parents, what we appreciated most was seeing our child having such a great time. Days later, he’s still talking about “the guacamole guy” from our birthday trip. Thank you, Aaron, for helping create such a special memory for our family.

The restaurant is located inside of Universal Studio's City Walk. Parking is free after 6 p.m. daily, and there is a bit of walking from the parking lot to the restaurant. A few steps can be saved if valet is used. Valet is NEVER free. Antojito is a beautiful establishment in one of Orlando's tourists locations. The outside gave me a feeling of entering an Mexican building from the western tv shows I watched growing up. There was a bit of a nostalgic feeling. We had a reservation because we had a large party of 20. Like most restaurants, they wouldn't seat us until the whole party was there, despite the fact that more than half of the party was present. Even though we had to wait, once seated our party was slip: some at regular tables and others at high tops in an area where staff was constantly going back and forth with guacamole carts, which diminished the ability of the group to get up and socialize. Each table had a different server. The server at the low table was not very attentive. Water was not topped unless requested. She was slow taking and returning with food and drink orders. The food had great presentation, but lacked seasonings, starting with the guacamole made fresh at the table. Which is odd for a Mexican restaurant. I requested a side of lime for my guacamole, and received a mortar of lime juice. Eventually, I received half of a lime, which did not help enhance the bland flavor. For my entree, I ordered birria tacos, which were served with refried beans and…

This place has changed a lot in the past 5 years since we last visited. The menu and food has drastically changed, the chips and salsa were so bland. This should have been the first red flag, our server was slow and would disappear multiple times. The menu option were limited and all of our dishes had no flavor to them. We order carne asada burritos, which was ground meat not steak. Chicken tacos that had no flavor whatsoever even the “cilantro creama” was bland! The only thing that was enjoyable was our drinks. When it was time to pay we sat and waited for our server who again had disappeared in the back that we stood up and waited for at least 10 Mins. No other staff stop to offer assistance either. Would not recommend.
love love love the food & the atmosphere. Service is always good waiters are friendly and helpful.

My wife and I came from Indianapolis for our first trip to Orlando, and we absolutely loved everything about Antojitos. The service was top tier, the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was amazing, but the most impressive part of the night was definitely the tableside guacamole experience with Aaron. We ordered the guacamole and mentioned that I love spicy food, but my wife doesn’t eat spicy at all. Aaron immediately gave us options either he could serve the jalapeños on the side or he could split the guacamole into two separate portions, one mild and one spicy. We chose the second option, and he prepared two mini guacamoles right in front of us. It was such a thoughtful detail and honestly made the whole experience feel personalized and special. Both versions tasted incredible and you could really tell he put care into every step. This ended up being one of our favorite dining experiences during our visit to Orlando. Also, we loved the guy playing the guitar, he brought such a fun and authentic vibe to the restaurant and made the whole night even better!

We knew we wanted to go to Universal City Walk after 6 for some shopping and my sister thought let’s go for Mexican while we are there, and in the end I was disappointed. We made a reservation online and were seated within 5 min once we arrived on time. Our server was less than attentive and he rarely checked on us. Our jalapeño spicy margaritas with a pineapple pop were the best part of our meal. The nachos were salty and the salsa was mild and you ate more as you sat to wait for your food. The burrito was dry and I had to use salsa yo help. The steak was sliced so small it was almost non existent. My sister did say her vegetarian meat tacos were good, she was surprised. I said well it’s in an amusement park why did I think it would be better than it was, but my nephew disagrees with me and believes it should be good considering the location. During our meal, just as the check was taken by the server who suddenly was friendly they evacuated the restaurant. While we were eating the air seemed to turn off, then the power went out then there was an odd smell and they evacuated the restaurant. The server still had my debit card while other diners were leaving without paying. I had to ask a security guard to find my server and they told me I had to evacuate, I was more valuable. Yeah, but I need my debit card. The server did show up and then I had to sign and give a tip as the place is evacuating! The server stood by me as I signed my slip. From what we heard no one was hurt and…

Other reviews aren’t very good but after long days at the parks we wanted a place to listen to live music with drinks and food. The Birria Tacos were so good that we came back a second night for more. We noticed in the upstairs dining room that a kitchen manager was inspecting all orders before approving them to be delivered to the tables. We even observed him sending some orders back. This was a great touch and the the food really showed that extra care. The drinks weren’t the best but not terrible. Definitely try the Birria tacos. Our first night they had dancers and our second a guitarist.

If you are trying to decide where to eat at Universal CityWalk, do yourself a favor and book a table at Antojitos Authentic Mexican Food. The atmosphere is vibrant and energetic, but the food is the real star of the show. You cannot leave this place without ordering the Tableside Guacamole. Watching them make it fresh right in front of you is a great experience, and it tastes absolutely incredible—a total must-have every single time you visit. For my main course, I had the Chimichanga, and it did not disappoint. It was perfectly cooked, tasted amazingly fresh, and the portion size was incredibly generous. I left completely full and satisfied. Great service, lively vibes, and phenomenal food. I will definitely be back!

The Burger Digs is a reliable quick-service spot inside the Jurassic Park Discovery Center, ideal for families and park-goers who want a fast, familiar meal. The menu sticks to basics—burgers, chicken tenders, and fries—with mobile ordering and plenty of seating to keep things efficient. The kid-friendly theming and wheelchair accessibility make it approachable for a wide range of guests. Food quality is decent but not standout. Burgers are serviceable, though lacking in flavor depth, and sides like fries can be hit or miss. Vegetarian and allergy-friendly options exist but are limited, and clearer labeling would help. For the $10–20 price range, guests may expect more freshness and variety. Still, it’s a solid fallback when convenience matters most. Parking is handled through Universal Orlando’s system, and guests have access to valet, paid garage, and surface lot options. While efficient, it’s not restaurant-specific—so expect to pay around $30 during peak hours and factor in walking time from the garage or drop-off point.

The room layout itself was honestly impressive. We booked connecting accommodations that were essentially two apartment-style units behind one entry door. One side had two bedrooms, multiple bathrooms, a full kitchen, dining area, living room with a sleeper sofa, and washer/dryer. The second side also included a king bedroom, full bath, kitchen, living space, sleeper sofa, and laundry. For large families, multiple families traveling together, or families with teenagers needing their own space, the setup is excellent. Unfortunately, the cleanliness completely overshadowed what could have been a great stay. Our first room appeared not to have been properly cleaned before arrival. The floors throughout both units were sticky from the entry hallway onward. The baseboards were visibly dirty with black and brown buildup. One side had a strong cigarette smoke smell despite the resort being advertised as smoke-free. In another bedroom, the sheets appeared previously used and simply remade rather than replaced. We requested a room change and were initially told none were available. After returning to the front desk, they located…

Narcoossee’s is a waterfront signature dining restaurant located at Disney’s Grand Floridian Resort & Spa, offering a seafood-focused menu with one of the best views in Walt Disney World. The restaurant has a relaxed but upscale atmosphere, with large windows and waterfront seating overlooking the Seven Seas Lagoon. The biggest appeal is the combination of elevated dining, lake views, and the ability to watch the Magic Kingdom fireworks from the restaurant area. The menu focuses heavily on seafood and premium entrées, with dishes like lobster bisque, surf and turf, pork chop, shrimp and grits, and fresh seafood options. The lobster bisque is one of the standout starters, offering a rich and creamy flavor with noticeable pieces of lobster throughout. The surf and turf is another highlight, pairing a well-prepared steak with butter-poached lobster for a classic upscale combination. The sides also contribute to the meal, especially the creamy mashed potatoes and seasonal vegetables. Dessert is another memorable part of the experience, especially the almond-crusted cheesecake with mascarpone. It has become one of the restaurant’s signature items because of its unique texture and flavor compared to a traditional cheesecake. It is a great way to finish the meal, especially when shared after a larger dinner. The service is one of Narcoossee’s strongest points. The staff creates a more personalized dining experience, and the pacing feels more attentive compared to many busy Disney…

This was our first time dining here and everything was impeccable. We showed up pretty dang early by accident and they were so accommodating. One of the gentleman at the host stand, Mario, made our experience so special. We were taking some selfies since we were really excited about finally eating here and he took us by the water and took pictures of us and then a picture in front of the sign. He also had us seated well before our reservation and checked on us during dinner. I love that the servers aren’t overloaded. Each server had maybe 3-4 tables so it was very attentive and you never had to track anyone down for refills. It felt very personalized. Narcoossee’s started out high with that fresh sourdough loaf and salted butter and it kept getting better. The lobster bisque is poured table side and she explained all the ingredients. It had a good bit of lobster, but it was also super flavorful in the bites that didn’t have any. Creamy and delicious. We both ordered the surf and turf. Our steaks were seared and seasoned and cooked exactly to our preferred temperature. The red onion jam was a nice touch. The mashed chives potatoes buttery and whipped. The butter poached lobster melted in our mouth and the carrots were also fantastic. The key lime pie was good and very tart, but if you eat with your eyes first, it’s not visually stunning like the appetizer and entree. The key lime I’ve seen in the past was breathtaking and this looked more like lemon meringue pie but replace…

This place is on point every time we dine there. It doesn't matter what we get, it's always amazing. Recently the tomatoes tart was a surprise highlight for apps. The red fish is the best dish at WDW imo. The surf and turf steak was amazing too. Satvat the bar and the bartender was really good. Has been my fav restaurant on property for a decade and doesn't seem that will be changing any time soon

The only less than optimal part of the dining experience was the extremely loud and cafeteria-like atmosphere of the venue. The original building was for performing, and the acoustics are horrible for a restaurant with the loud, echoing clamor of everyone’s voices making it difficult to hear conversations. Due to the lesson optimal atmosphere, the price point for the food seems quite high.

Narcoossee’s was absolutely incredible from start to finish. The service was amazing, our server Edwin was so kind, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. The food was honestly the best thing ever (Especially the Korean BBQ Salmon). The view of the fireworks and the Magic Kingdom castle created such a magical, unforgettable story!!!

Nice for a special occasion. We were there to celebrate our anniversary. Our table had a card and rose petals when we were kindly seated by Corey. He recommended the coffee martini and it was excellent. Calamari was salty, but tender. The scallops were also tender and polenta had a good flavor, but the pork cheek was hard bacon bits. We received complimentary plated chocolates for our anniversary. We went out on the covered patio to watch the fireworks and the view was nice over the water. When we left Corey thanked us for going there for our anniversary. He is a great employee and kind person.

Arrr, ye scurvy dogs! I, Cap’n Blackbeard’s ghost, what plundered every sea from Tortuga to the Spice Isles, dropped anchor at Narcoossee’s and nearly walked the plank from sheer delight! That NY Strip? Blackened like me own Jolly Roger, drippin’ with a sauce what made me peg leg tap dance. Scallops? Crispy as Spanish gold, swimmin’ in glory. And that fancy coffee sundae with the lacy gold crisp? ‘Twas a treasure chest o’ heaven, ye bilge rats! But praise be to me server Jae— the finest matey on land or wave! Swift as a cutlass, jolly as rum, and never once made me swab the deck. She kept me mug full and me belly fuller without a single “avast” or complaint. If ye ain’t eatin’ here, ye be marooned on a desert isle o’ bad grub. Narcoossee’s be the crown jewel o’ the seven tables. 10 gold doubloons out o’ 10! Now pass the grog— I mean, the hot tea. Arrr!

Ellen our server made my birthday so special. The calamari was top notch and I’ve had a lot of calamari in my life. The marina and the pickled vegetables truly complimented the calamari which was perfectly crispy and cooked. The lobster bisque was delicious as well. The sourdough bread with the salted butter was amazing and so hard not to fill up on. For entrees, my husband loved his Shrimp Bucatini. My scallops were delicious and are HUGE. The green beans that come on top are the best green beans I’ve ever had.

Beautiful setting and truly top-tier service, which makes this a tough review to write. Narcoossee’s at the Grand Floridian absolutely delivers on atmosphere, the views are stunning and the staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming throughout the meal. Unfortunately, the food didn’t live up to the same standard. I ordered the surf and turf along with the Brussels sprouts and the seafood charcuterie board, and every dish missed the mark. The steak was overcooked, the lobster tail was easily the saltiest thing I’ve ever tasted, and the charcuterie board felt heavily over-seasoned across the board. Even the Brussels sprouts were off. Really wanted to love this place given the setting and service, but the kitchen needs serious adjustment to match the rest of the experience.

It’s always a big deal when service is this good, and Hilda really went above and beyond. Overall, this was a wonderful dining experience and one we’d happily recommend to others. ⭐ Valentina Made Our Last Night in Florida Memorable We decided to eat here after spending 45 minutes stuck in traffic because of the World Cup watch parties. Since we weren't from the area, we had no idea what was happening and arrived a little stressed after the unexpected delay. When we walked into the restaurant, it was packed. The host let us know the wait for a table would be 45 minutes to an hour, but offered us the option of sitting on the patio instead. We took the patio and were seated almost immediately. About 10 minutes later, our server, Valentina, came over to introduce herself, and from that moment on, she completely turned our evening around. She was friendly, energetic, and genuinely fun to talk to. Since we were visiting Florida on vacation, she shared recommendations, explained why the area was so busy, and excitedly told us about the World Cup and how her team was advancing. Her enthusiasm was contagious, and before long, we had forgotten all about the stressful drive. When she realized our appetizers had somehow been skipped by the kitchen, she immediately looked into it, kept us updated, and made sure they were prepared right away. By then, our entrées had already arrived, and we told her not to worry about them. She insisted on making it right and had the appetizers removed from our bill. At the end of our meal, she thanked us for visiting and apologized that our last night in Florida had been so hectic, even though we assured her it really wasn't that…

We always visit Metro Diner when we are in Daytona as they usually have a good breakfast selection. I ordered a veggie omelet with a side of grits and crispy bacon. My daughter actually got the crispy bacon. I thought maybe they got them mixed up so instead of asking for my daughter to give me hers I just asked the waitress if she could get me crispy bacon. They brought out burnt bacon. As you can see I did attempt to eat it because the waitress went to the trouble of bringing me more but it was not edible. The egg part of my omelet was cooked perfectly but the veggies were undercooked in a nasty rancid tasting oil that overpowered the flavor of the cheese. The grits were the best part of my breakfast. I tried to eat the first batch of bacon but it was too soggy from grease and cold at that point. I know for some people they would say the bacon I got was fine but it is all about the texture and I can’t eat soggy bacon. I am really disappointed that even the waitress would not point out to the kitchen that the bacon was burnt. My daughter got the basic breakfast with eggs, potato’s, pancakes, bacon and toast. Her pancakes were like heavy cardboard cakes. The guys didn’t elaborate on their breakfast but I assume they would have eaten it regardless as they were hungry. I don’t think I will be going back to Metro anytime in the future as I have decided they are overrated. I will probably try something new next time we are in town instead of the regular Metro stop. We stopped at NBC Sports Grill on the last night of our honeymoon and it turned out to be one of the most memorable parts of our entire trip! From the moment we sat down, our waiter Jhosep noticed we were celebrating and made us feel so special. He and the manager Bhushan went above and beyond to make our evening unforgettable. They were incredibly attentive, warm, and genuine the entire night. The service wasn’t just professional — it felt personal, like we were being looked after by family. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was perfect, and their kindness truly made our last night as newlyweds something we’ll always remember. This was hands-down the best restaurant experience we’ve ever had. If you’re in the area, you have to come here — and ask for Jhosep and Bhushan if you can! Thank you both so much for turning a simple dinner into a beautiful memory. We’ll definitely be back!

We came during a World Cup game. The service was great even though the restaurant was packed with people watching the game. Aaron and Bhushan were very friendly and attentive without overcrowding us. The food came quickly, the plates are big enough for 2 and delicious. Will recommend any day!

Ainda em tempo, preciso vir aqui elogiar o atendimento incrível da Jo. Fui assistir o jogo do Brasil no dia 19 de junho. Com casa cheia, host não se mostrou prestativo no atendimento para conseguir uma mesa para duas pessoas, apesar de ter várias vazias. Havia bastante gente e tudo foi meio caótico. Fomos para o segundo andar para assistir o jogo, em pé, e apareceu o anjo Jo. Jo nos atendeu e depois conseguiu um lugar, trouxe o cardápio e conseguimos comer. Comida boa. Deixo aqui meu agradecimento para a Jo, certamente voltaria por ela.

My fiancée and I had a great time at the restaurant! The food was delicious, ingredients were well selected and taste was on point, and the portions were perfect! Waiter Sergio Pohushan was very nice, attentive, and had the ability to elevate the atmosphere of the place!

This is the place to go if you want a night out or with the families. Ask for Alicia she was absolutely fantastic! Came here for a world cup game. Was unsure how it would be from the pubs back in the uk. This bar is great, more screens than I can count showing the game so no matter where you were you had a great View. The staff are brilliant and kept the drinks flowing, thanks Christi for keeping the drinks flowing. Not rushed at our table and staff were more than happy for us to keep the table for the entire game, nachos were amazing and the largest portion I’ve ever seen. Thanks Bhushan for the great banter. Englands fist half performance scrapes a 2 stars.

הזמנו מקום מראש באפליקציה ונהנינו משולחן קרוב למסכים לצפייה במשחר כדורגל, יש תפריט עשיר מאוד. הגריל פתוח פרונטלי ורואים את ההכנה בזמן ההמתנה. השקיפות בהכנת אוכל אומרת הרבה על המקום! המלצרים מאוד נחמדים, היינו צריכים לעשות שינויים במנות והכל הגיע בדיוק כמו שהזמנו, המקום ענק אבל מלא ממש , הוא הראשון אחרי הגשר מהפארקים של יוניברסל אז מומלץ להזמין מקום. אחלה אוכל הכל היה טעים, תזמינו את הפרצל שם, הוא עצום וטעים במיוחד!
Went here for my daughter’s birthday dinner. Walked in and got a table right away. Joy and Bhushan made her birthday extra special. Will recommend 👍

I will continue to come back here in the future based on my most recent and past experiences!

Fomos ao bar para assistir o jogo do Brasil contra o Haiti. Estava lotado mas com várias mesas vazias (pois é). Não sei se o local tem tempo de tolerância com relação às reservas, mas também não havia fila de espera durante o jogo, ou seja, tinha mesa vazia mas você não podia sentar. Você podia entrar pra ver, desde que ficasse de pé. Depois de quase 70 minutos de jogo, uma mesa do nosso lado desocupou e pudemos nos sentar. Fomos atendidas pela maravilhosa Jô, que inclusive nos ofereceu água enquanto estávamos de pé. As asinhas que pedimos demoraram, e ela foi se certificar com o gerente o que houve. Pela demora, não houve a cobrança da porção. Não fomos muito bem tratadas pelo pessoal da entrada, mas o atendimento da Jô fez toda a diferença.

I really wanted to enjoy my belated birthday dinner, especially since my friend was treating me, but this visit was one issue after another. I ordered a medium burger with fries, but the first one came out well‑done and the fries were barely warm. Mistakes happen, so I gave them the benefit of the doubt. The manager apologized and brought out a second burger. At first glance, everything looked perfect — hot fries, good presentation. But the moment I cut into the burger, I found a hair inside. The manager apologized again and brought out a third burger. At that point, I just wanted to eat, so I had half at the restaurant and took the rest home. Today, I went to finish my leftovers and — unbelievably — found another issue. After everything that already happened, this was the final straw. This experience was frustrating, disappointing, and honestly unacceptable. Between the repeated mistakes, the hair in my food, and the final surprise waiting in my leftovers, I can’t say I’ll be returning anytime soon. Update 6/17/26: To the owner — I attempted to access the website you provided, but it leads to a dead end. It appears the site itself may not be functioning correctly.

My husband and I went here for a date night while out on vacation with family, after not having a date night alone after having our children for almost 2 years and the oceanaire truly ruined the entire experience and night. Our waiter takes about 10 minutes easily to come to our table to gather drink orders. Offers only water options and we had to slow him down to ask about drink orders. He doesnt ask about apps- even though wed love one! he disappears again for another 30 minutes. Starting to get irritated at this point. we havent even ordered our appetizer. I can’t say enough good things about New Punjab Indian Restaurant. I’m originally from London, where authentic Indian food is easy to find, so I’m quite picky when it comes to Indian cuisine. Finding truly authentic Indian food in Orlando isn’t always easy—but New Punjab absolutely nailed it. If I ever crave Indian food, this is always my go-to place. The food is consistently amazing. The naans are hands down the best, and every curry I’ve tried has been excellent. My absolute favorite is the paneer butter masala, followed closely by the dal makhni—usually paired with a garlic naan, which is perfection. They also deserve special mention for their wide variety of vegetarian and vegan options. It’s so thoughtful that they even accommodate people who don’t eat onion or garlic, which is rare and truly appreciated. Another big plus: plenty of free parking around the plaza, so it’s always easy and stress-free to visit. Overall, the food, authenticity, options, and convenience make this place a solid 5-star experience for me. If you’re looking for real, comforting, authentic Indian food in Orlando, New Punjab is the place to go. Highly recommended!

Millie’s Restaurant & Catering — Daytona Beach Shores ⭐ (1/5) I visited Millie’s for Mother’s Day with high expectations, having heard good things about this spot. Unfortunately, my experience left a lot to be desired. I ordered the Chicken Parmesan — a breaded chicken breast topped with marinara and melted mozzarella over pasta. When it arrived, it was noticeably overcooked. The breading was burnt and the dish was not up to the standard I would expect, especially for a special occasion. When I asked the manager if I could send it back and simply have it removed from my ticket, her initial response was, “We don’t do that.” It wasn’t until she noticed my expression that she reconsidered and agreed to remove the item. I appreciated that she ultimately made it right, but that initial response was dismissive and unprofessional — especially on Mother’s Day. I did order a burger and fries as a replacement, and those were genuinely good. I also want to be clear: I tipped my waitress generously because I believe in showing appreciation for good service, and she did her job well. However, I was surprised to be charged $1 per condiment cup — including ranch sauce for my burger. That policy was not communicated upfront, and any “discount” given from removing the chicken was largely offset by those hidden charges. Had I known condiments were not complimentary, I would not have requested them. The food potential is there, but the management response and undisclosed condiment fees left me…

Today I had lunch at Millie’s, a restaurant located near Daytona Beach. I was looking for a place to take a client for lunch in the area, and this restaurant was recommended to me by ChatGPT. To be honest, the photos online didn’t immediately strike me as the type of place that would truly impress when it came to the food, but after seeing so many positive reviews, I decided to give it a try. As soon as I mentioned to my client where we were going, he immediately told me that Millie’s was a very good restaurant, which raised my expectations. Once we arrived and looked over the menu, I ordered the Shrimp & Grits, and they were absolutely outstanding. Everything tasted incredibly fresh, the flavors were well-balanced, and the dish was executed perfectly. I also had the opportunity to try a bite of a colleague’s Chicken Parmesan, and it was equally impressive. The quality of the food overall was excellent, and it’s clear that the kitchen takes pride in what they serve. Nile Ethiopian Restaurant is one of those places that reminds you how much fun it is to step outside your normal routine. If you’ve never had Ethiopian food before, this is a great introduction. The traditional injera turns the entire meal into a shared experience, and before long you’re wondering why forks became the default in the first place. Eating with your hands somehow slows everything down and makes dinner feel more connected. The aromas hit you as soon as the food arrives—rich spices, slow-cooked meats, flavorful vegetables, and sauces that somehow manage to be both comforting and completely different from anything you’re used to. The vegetarian combinations are every bit as impressive as the meat dishes, and if you have the chance to experience the traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony, don’t skip it. What stood out most was how authentic the experience felt. It never comes across as trying to cater to trends. It simply shares Ethiopian culture through hospitality, food, and tradition. Orlando has an incredible international food scene, and Nile is a reminder that some of the city’s best meals come from being willing to try something new. Leave your comfort zone for an evening—you’ll probably leave with a new favorite cuisine. 🦩

Nile Ethiopian Restaurant is a must-visit whenever I’m in Orlando! On our most recent visit, we shared the Beef Tibs, Doro Wat, and the Vegetarian Combo, and every dish was absolutely delicious. The flavors were authentic, rich, and perfectly prepared. The service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and welcoming from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the restaurant was exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Between the incredible food, five-star service, wonderful atmosphere, and spotless dining area, this restaurant consistently delivers an amazing experience. I highly recommend Nile Ethiopian Restaurant and will continue to return every time I’m in Orlando!

Stopped by Nile Ethiopian Restaurant and it stands out. The space is warm and welcoming, and the service is attentive without hovering. Everything came out fresh, well-balanced, and thoughtfully prepared. If you’re new to Ethiopian cuisine, the staff does a great job guiding you through it. If you’re in Orlando and want something different from the usual rotation, this is a solid spot worth checking out.

My friend and I shared the Chef's Special and it was more than enough for two people. It was a perfect sampling of some of their main dishes. While everything tasted similar, each was distinct and all equally delicious. We also ordered the sambusa and they were so delicious! I definitely plan on coming back and telling all my friends to come here.

Quick, efficient service and massive portions. Perfect for a sit-down meal that doesn't eat up your entire afternoon. The Damage: ~$230 (Party of 3, including tip). ​Smoked Duck Bao Buns: The disputed champion of the table. If you only get one starter, make it this. ​Smoked Duck Fried Rice: Elevates the meal beyond "standard takeout" with deep, savory flavors. ​General Tso’s Dumplings: A great choice if you appreciate a subtle kick of heat. ​Honey Sesame Chicken: Sweet, crunchy, and exactly what you want it to be. ​Spicy Ma La Happy Family: A hefty, spicy medley of meats for those who want a bit of everything. ​Spring Rolls: Reliable, hot, and crispy. ​ ​Crepe Cake & Cheesecake: Surprisingly light. A great way to end a heavy meal without feeling weighed down for your walk back to World Showcase.

We had such a great experience at the Chinese pavilion in Epcot. The atmosphere instantly transports you — it feels calm, aesthetic, and very immersive, like a little escape from the park crowds. The food was surprisingly good for a theme park. The ribs were a favorite — flavorful, tender, and perfectly cooked. I had spicy chicken, which had just the right balance of heat and taste, not overwhelming but still satisfying. Everything felt fresh and well-prepared, and the portion sizes were decent. Also, the service was smooth and quick, which is always a plus after walking all day in the park. It’s definitely a spot worth stopping by if you want something savory and comforting during your Epcot day. And great service.

Very underrated place in EPCOT! The atmosphere is nice, servers are polite (shoutout to Jiang!), and the teas are absolutely delicious. I got the raspberry iced tea and it’s by far the best iced tea I’ve had. I will say, the portion sizes are slightly small, but it’s the perfect amount food to keep you sustained, in my opinion. If you’re in EPCOT, you’re going to want to sample many foods, after all! In summary, this restaurant has a great atmosphere, service, and food. I would definitely go here again!

If you’re looking for great barbecue in Oviedo, I highly recommend Mission BBQ. Their meat platters are an excellent way to sample a variety of smoked meats, and the brisket is some of the best I’ve had—tender, flavorful, and packed with smoky goodness. The pulled pork, turkey, pulled chicken, and sausage are all consistently delicious as well. The menu is known for its wide selection of smoked meats, including brisket, pulled pork, chicken, turkey, ribs, and salmon. The ribs are absolutely amazing and always a must-order. Even the salmon stands out, which isn’t something you can say about most BBQ restaurants. Every side I’ve tried has been excellent, making it easy to build a complete meal no matter what you’re craving. What really sets this place apart is the consistency. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout, the food quality and service are top-notch. It’s easy to see why this location is so highly rated by both locals and visitors. For anyone wanting authentic BBQ with plenty of options and great sides, Mission BBQ is one of the best spots in Oviedo.

My honest opinion of Universal Orlando is a bit mixed, but overall we had an amazing vacation. Universal Studios had some great nostalgia and atmosphere, especially rides like E.T. and the incredible detail of Diagon Alley. However, many of the attractions felt overly dependent on blurry screens and motion simulators, which often felt more nauseating than fun. Islands of Adventure was a big improvement. Hagrid's, Hulk, and VelociCoaster were fantastic and delivered real thrills. The Jurassic Park area was a little disappointing with several attractions unavailable during our visit. Epic Universe was on an entirely different level. The rides were newer, smoother, and far more immersive. Super Nintendo World was incredibly interactive, Isle of Berk was a blast, and Battle at the Ministry was easily the most impressive attraction I've ever experienced. The nighttime fountain show was also a perfect way to end the day. For parents, be prepared: nearly every ride exits through a gift shop packed with toys at kid eye level. We highly recommend saving souvenir shopping for the end of the day to avoid carrying things around and to prevent constant "Can I have that?" conversations. Most employees were friendly and helpful, though we did receive some incorrect information regarding family swap areas that sent us on a few unnecessary goose chases. Overall, Epic Universe alone was worth the trip. While I personally prefer Disney's balance of practical effects, immersive storytelling,…

This is the perfect place to stay if you don't have children but you still feel like engaging in child like fun (like grabbing a tube and heading to the lazy river) without the judgment or stares I was initially expecting! There is room for improvement in the way they serve their tartare; the presentation is beautiful, but there is no way to share with the table as they only give you one spoon, and no crisps or crackers. Ignore the haters! This place is great. We had a wonderful time here with excellent food. On a past trip to Disney Springs, we actually skipped the sit-down restaurants due to the low reviews. But those ratings are not accurate! I think many folks are having anxiety-induced psychosis due to the stress of their vacations and they take it out on the expensive restaurants. Disregard the low reviews and dine here, it was excellent. We had the ribs (9/10), Singapore lobster noodles (9/10), lo mein (8/10), and the popcorn shrimp (8/10). A little pricey but within Disney norms. Staff were very helpful, the decor is awesome, etc. Don't miss this place!
