Darwin was absolutely amazing! He was friendly, welcoming, professional, and made us feel taken care of from the moment we sat down. His recommendations were spot on and ended up being some of our favorite parts of the meal. We’ve filled out a lot of restaurant surveys over the years, and honestly, we’ve never had a server as great as Darwin. He really understands what good customer service is all about and knows exactly how to make guests feel comfortable and valued. Darwin went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. He would be an excellent trainer because he truly gets what it takes to provide outstanding service. Your team is lucky to have him! Thank you, Darwin, for making our visit such a great one. We can’t wait to come back!

This place is truly amazing. We just made our second visit to Morimoto Asia in Disney Springs for our anniversary and it surpassed the already high bar we set in our memories. We split the Toku-Jyo Sushi Platter with a pitcher of sake sangria. Everything (plus some fishy ice cream) was left scraped down to clean plates. Folks in the party nervous of some new tastes? The lo-mein and orange chicken are super nostalgic and great for those looking for familiar flavors. Throughout our dinner we had different smells of smoke and fire and fruit. Our server Chein was above and beyond in terms of care. She checked our ID’s and instantly connected with us over shared birthdays in our families and even remembered both of our birth dates when recounting the story to her coworker Katy that visited the table. We had a super fun time getting to know more about her and it felt like she truly cared about our experience as guests. Overall we were left blown away yet again by the attention to detail that Morimoto Asia brings with an absolutely stunning collection to fresh fish, pheonomenal soups, and stunning plates all around. Book this location for one of the best dining experiences available in Disney Springs!

The food and drinks were excellent, and the restaurant is beautiful and well maintained (deserving of its Michelin recognition). That said, the service was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Mikado Sushi has been our family's favorite restaurant for the past 11 years, and it continues to impress us every single time we visit. The food is consistently fresh, delicious, and beautifully prepared, whether you're ordering sushi, sashimi, or one of their many other menu favorites. What truly sets Mikado apart is the outstanding service and welcoming atmosphere. The staff always makes us feel like valued guests, and over the years it has become much more than just a restaurant—it's a place where we've celebrated special occasions, enjoyed family dinners, and created wonderful memories. In a world where it's hard to find consistency, Mikado has delivered exceptional quality and service for more than a decade. If you're looking for the best sushi in the Hunters Creek area, look no further. We highly recommend Mikado Sushi and look forward to many more years of dining there!

My girlfriend came in last night and she ordered the hibachi chicken. After just a couple of bites, she realized she didn’t like it and asked if she could switch to something else. The staff allowed her to change her meal, and she ended up enjoying the new dish—but we were still charged for the original plate she barely touched. After asking why … she was told it is what it is and because she had a bite she had to pay. We both work in the service industry, so we understand how things operate, but this didn’t sit right with us. Situations like this are usually handled with a bit more flexibility and consideration. Unfortunately, this experience didn’t make us feel very welcomed. There are plenty of other sushi spots where the customer experience is handled much better.

I visited Mikado Sushi this evening and had a pretty disappointing experience overall. I enjoyed the ginger salad, but I wasn’t impressed with the hibachi teriyaki chicken. The sauce and the texture of the chicken just weren’t for me. Because of that, I asked my waitress if I could switch to a salmon, avocado, and cream cheese roll instead, which was actually fairly good. The issue came when I received the check and noticed I was still being charged for the hibachi chicken. I politely asked if it could be removed since I genuinely didn’t enjoy the dish. My waitress said she would be back and returned with the manager, who asked me what was wrong with the meal. I explained that I simply didn’t like it and would appreciate having it taken off the bill. The manager then asked if I had touched or tasted the dish, and I answered honestly that I had. She immediately responded with, “We don’t do that here.” I found that response very odd and disappointing. I understand restaurants have policies, but the way the situation was handled made me feel like giving honest feedback about a dish was somehow unwelcome. Instead of trying to resolve the issue or show any understanding, I was made to feel like I was in the wrong for not enjoying the food. I paid the bill and left, but unfortunately I won’t be returning.

It can be very difficult at times to get an elevator. The beds at the resort were very comfortable. The carpet and floor appeared clean, but the couch in our room had brown stains on it, the whirlpool tub had pink and black looking mold around the jets, the shower also had some pink and black mold. The Spare room bathtub was holding water and the actual shower temp seemed to have only one temperature, scalding, but we did call and have the cartridge for the shower changed out so the temp was more easily modified, and they took care of the standing water. Our dishwasher smelled like burning plastic at one point and did not properly eject the cleaning pods. The paint on the balcony railing kept coming off on my skin, which I didn't love. The last night I was there I couldn't sleep because someone was playing loud noise until after 2am.

My family and I recently dined at the Sanford Florida location to celebrate with my 88-year-old father, who specifically ordered the Alaskan king crab legs. While our server was pleasant and did his best to assist us, our experience was ultimately ruined by poor management and a complete lack of customer service. When my father received his king crab legs, he asked if the kitchen could crack them for him. We were told they could not and were instead given scissors, crab crackers, and plastic utensils. My father struggled to access the meat, so we politely asked a second time whether the kitchen could assist. We were then informed that no one in the kitchen had been trained to do so. The manager’s response was especially disappointing. Rather than offering assistance, a substitute meal, or any accommodation for an elderly guest, he stated that if someone orders king crab legs, they should know how to eat them and that scissors were the proper tool. The comment came across as condescending and dismissive, particularly considering my father’s age and obvious difficulty. To make matters worse, the music was excessively loud throughout our meal, making conversation difficult. Several staff members appeared to be standing around watching while we struggled to help my father with his meal, yet no one offered meaningful assistance. Despite the fact that my father was unable to properly enjoy the entrée he ordered, the manager refused to remove or adjust the charge for the king crab…

The restaurant is spacious, family-friendly, and perfect for gathering with friends and loved ones. The food was absolutely outstanding! The mofongo topped with shrimp and a perfectly cooked pork chop was packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. The shrimp were fresh, juicy, and seasoned beautifully, while the mofongo was rich, authentic, and delicious. Every bite was a perfect combination of traditional Puerto Rican flavors. The presentation was impressive, the portions were generous, and you could truly taste the quality and care that goes into every dish. The service was friendly, attentive, and made the experience even more enjoyable. If you’re looking for authentic Puerto Rican cuisine, great portions, and a fun, inviting atmosphere, this place is a must-visit. We will definitely be coming back again and again! This is our go-to place for pinwheels. They are delicious and we can't resist every time we come into the area. Pagano's sauce is amazing! We have also gotten the pizza dough and sauce to take home and make our own pizza. We love the New Jersey theme and friendly staff. Every item we have tried we have enjoyed, but the pinwheels are our favorites!

This place was so good! I found it on a whim, and it looked awesome. It’s a cute little place, and almost empty on a Saturday night. The server, Lara, was awesome, taking care of me and my family, answering our questions, and making us feel comfortable. She brought our food quickly, and it was so good. The sauce tastes homemade, the pizza was thin and everything was honestly good!
Love the pinwheels!!!! Everything is tasty. People are very nice and polite!!! I come here every friday!!!

Valerie was a great server. Food was fantastic and the atmosphere was super cute. Good music too, just the right volume so you could enjoy the music but still have a conversation. I had a cauliflower crust pepperoni pizza and my family had 1/2 spinach and onions, 1/2 sausage.
pizza place with "soul" ... excellent home coffee

While vacationing down in Vero Beach, new friends of ours, highly recommend Mo-Bay. I cannot thank them enough, Mo-Bay has the best dining experience in the area, excellent food and friendly service. Cute atmosphere with coastal views. A+, we'll definitely be returning in the future.
Brought in our fresh caught red grouper. Chef Wesley prepared it for us. It was AMAZING!! The coconut curry was my favorite.

We visited for lunch today and were blown away by the food. I had the Rum JerkShrimp Kabobs and my wife had the Curry Chicken. Both were exceptional. We shared the Banana Rum Cheesecake which our waiter Shemaar recommended and was a delicious finish to an excellent meal. Even though the restaurant is an hours drive from our home, we will be coming back to experience the other menu items.

Sometimes you just have to say it....WOW! We read some very positive reviews and thought, "what the heck," let's give it a try when we visit Sebastian, FL. There was plenty of parking across the street for our adventure van so I could relax and enjoy the meal. We were seated promptly and had a booth with a view past the highway out to the bay looking east. Our server, Leslie, was very helpful, friendly, knowledgeable about the menu items and provided great recommendations. Then IT happened. The food arrived and it was OUTSTANDING. We got to chat briefly with Chef Wesley Campbell to let him known how much we enjoyed our meal and entire experience.

Our server was very outgoing, except when she forgot our soups, but that was a simple mistake, no biggie. What really stood out, was the peppercorn crusted steak, which we have had before, and it was nothing like what we received on this trip. What was brought out was a nasty, fat and grissle skirt steak with brown gravy and some pepper mixed in. $40 for a meal I would expect from a carnival food wagon. Not sure what happened to that restraunt, but its not the same as it was a year ago.

Came here once and hated the food. This is a Jamaican restaurant and yet the food isn’t seasoned like Jamaican food. Food was bland and tasteless. When asked why the food had no seasoning they said it’s catered more for white folks cuz they don’t like spices and you have to ask for seasoning which I taught was weird. Decided to give it a shot again and we requested the fish (mahi and snapper) be seasoned and it wasn’t. We gave it two tries and they failed both times. Yall need to rename this restaurant because it’s not Jamaican at all. This place is for white folks who don’t know what seasoned food is supposed to taste like.
Me and my fiancé enjoyed the food, Johnny the waiter had great recommendations and made the service very entertaining.

Lovely local restaurant, delicious dinner, signature drinks are very good, our waitress Indigo was very friendly and attentive, highly recommend her, overall love the ambiance and really enjoyed the mix of reggae songs. Seriously, the best restaurant in Sebastian!

Have been coming to MOBay since the opened in the old location. The restaurant is a great story of success. The pepper pot soup is always a starter. The jerk chicken is great. The snapper is one of my favorites. 5/5 easily & one of the best restaurants in the area.
We went to celebrate Mothers Day early so worth it!! The food was delicious the customer service awesome! Definitely a must eat spot!! Best Rum Banana Cheesecake!!

This place used to be pretty good. Not so much anymore. The “baby back ribs” are somehow shorter than previously, like they cut the ends off or they’re cut in half. I ordered the coconut crusted snapper with sweet potato mash, there was no coconut or sweet potato mash. The waitress said she’d go get the potatoes. The fish was ok but flavorless and over cooked. The waitress didn’t come back until I was halfway done with the fish, maybe 5-7 minutes, she set the gem down and rushed off and I took a giant bite of refrigerator cold sweet mashed potatoes. Awful! The waitress did not return until I was done with my fish and my husband was done with his entire meal. I told her to not bother bringing them back out but I wanted her to know that they were cold when she served them, she was annoyed rather than apologetic. When she brought the check she said “the best I can do on my authority is give you 10% off”. We paid, we tipped, we won’t return.
Great food. Enjoyed the everything.

I love this restaurant. I have been coming here for years and I have been saying for years and years. It is the greatest place on earth. I would travel across the universe to eat here. I wish I could eat here every day until the day I die. I’m gonna say it again. I love this place so much.

Every time I visit Vero Beach, stopping by Mo-Bay Grill is a must. The Jamaican beef patties are absolutely delicious, perfectly flaky with so much flavor and the plantains are just as amazing, sweet and cooked to perfection. The food is consistently great and always hits the spot. Definitely one of my go-to places whenever I’m in town!
Consistent excellence! Food amazing, staff amazing, owner a doll!! Great great place! Husband had Cobia skewers. I had ahi tuna...the amount was amazing!!
Everything from the appetizer to the main to dessert was amazing. I live two plus hours away and would come back just to try some of the other menu items.

From the food, to the service, to the atmosphere it was an overall lovely and welcoming experience. The chicken was with coconut sauce, the jerk chicken pasta, and the Jamaican patties were delightful. Huge shout out to our server Jonny. Jonny was welcoming, respectful, and has a wonderful sense of humor and provides great service. Fell in love with this place.

The menu is very extensive, we had a hard time choosing. The coconut crushed snapper was AMAZING. The coconut flavor was subtle and the veggies that were served with it were perfect (cabbage, green beans and carrots)..... not the same old broccoli and carrots. The husband had the pecan Grouper with spinach mashed potatoes and, it too, was delicious! We had fried plantain to start, which was pan fried, not smashed and deep fried so I was a tad bummed, but it was still yummy. The atmosphere is mediocre, but that doesn't bother me, as long as it's clean, and it was. Someone did come in with a dog in a stroller and was allowed to dine, and was feeding it bites of food (the dog was table height in the stroller), I wasn't a fan of this. I take my dog to dine at outdoor patios that allow dogs, but don't think dogs (except for actual service dogs) should be inside. Our waiter, Johnny, was great! He knew about all of the menu items and was able to answer all of our questions. We will most likely go back, there are so many things we want to try.... Hopefully, there won't be any dogs inside!
The atmosphere is great right across from the river, service was awesome and the food was really really good. I've been there several times and I will keep going back. Thanks mo bay

I finally got a chance to experience Mobay. The food was amazing and the atmosphere was great. Even my picky mom raved on the Brown Stew Chicken and rice. Our Server today was great. I live in Melbourne but my mom lives in the area and she will definitely be back.
Love this place. The food is amazing and the service is too! The view out over the water is beautiful and it's just a neat place. We stop every time we're in the area and it's always 5 stars!

Went to lunch with coworkers the other day - didn’t even know this place existed. The jerk chicken quesadilla is AMAZING and I’ve been dreaming about it ever since. This was definitely outside my usual but I’m so glad I tried it.
Cute place and great food for brunch! Mr. T. (Tyrone) was our server and took great care of us!

This has become one of my family's favorite brunch locations on Disney property. We love everything from the atmosphere to the service to the food. Service here is always fast and friendly. The food is amazing. The island vibes makes this place so relaxing. Reservations are usually easy to grab here also so definitely check this place out on your next Disney trip.
Key west theme. Good food and service.

We recently dined at Olivia's Cafe at Disney Vacation Club and overall had a wonderful experience. The food was absolutely fabulous, and there were several standout items that our entire party enjoyed. The grits were hands-down my favorite—perfectly prepared and full of flavor. The coffee was also exceptionally tasty and a great way to start the meal. Everyone at our table loved the chicken and the Mickey Mouse waffles, which were both delicious and well-prepared. The majority of the staff provided excellent service and made us feel welcome. Our server, Mallory, was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and professional throughout our visit. Tyrone and Ben were also fantastic and contributed greatly to our positive experience. Unfortunately, our experience began on a disappointing note with the hostess, Jennifer (red hair, yellow sweater). She came across as extremely unpleasant and unwelcoming, which was surprising given Disney's reputation for exceptional guest service. Her demeanor did not reflect the hospitality we experienced from the rest of the team and is something that should be addressed. Despite that initial interaction, the excellent food and outstanding service from the rest of the staff made for an enjoyable dining experience. We would gladly return and recommend Olivia's Cafe, hoping that future guests receive the same warm welcome from the front of the house as they do from the dining staff.

Service was good. I got the conch fritters; they were a little spicy and soft, but the flavor was good, especially the sauce they come with. I also tried a bite of my mother's banana French toast, and that was good as well.

Olivia’s is a bit of a hidden gem on Disney property in that it’s really great food, really fast. You rarely ever have to wait at lunchtime, and appetizers and entrees come rolling right out. We always order a basket of conch fritters, and their southern fried chicken has been a favorite on the menu for years. Mickey waffles with French fries? Why not. You’re on vacation. Parking can occasionally be scarce, but it’s a short walk to the next set of villas if you can’t find a spot near check-in area.

Jesus is an amazing server. He's on top of everything. Your drinks won't go empty and anything you need he'll take care of immediately. He's so good. The coconut bread is yummy. Fresh. Warm. Really enjoyable. Shrimp and grits -- fabulous. Had this twice and each time so good. Not overly spicy just perfect. The hamburger also a great choice. Fries to burger -- the whole plate worth it. Even the condiments (pickles, lettuce) fresh and good. Sadly, prime rib and bananas foster were a let down. The mashed potatoes have a beautiful presentation but they actually taste watered down. So bland. The brocolini is OK. But I mean, it's buttered so you can't go wrong there. The prime rib is very seasoned on the crust. A bit too salty. The temp was perfect. And the amount of fat minimal. Just overall not wowed by the dish. The bananas foster bread was really tough and dry. 😔 we were really excited but this wasn't good. From the crust to the inside bread all of it was dry. The bananas were fine, caramelized fine, ice cream ok. The location is amazing!!!! Perfect spot.

Be careful using the app here. They won't give you the drinks or alcoholic beverages included on the dining plan. Then what should be considered as quick service at a pickup window is considered as table service. It's Disney wide issue here and needs an overall in th Guest Relations department.

Their brunch is a cheat code. Buttermilk chicken & waffles were delicious and my wife gave the banana bread French toast a glowing review. Becky from Cape May, NJ was our server. She remembered us from our anniversary trip several months ago! Such a sweetheart. Definitely a must-stop during our Disney trips from here on out.

No only that, but I had the small Greek salad with 4 small cubes of chicken and the fried feta....it cost me $30.

We tried this place for the first time last month and had a great experience. It was their Friday "Kokteils on the Lawn" and what a lovely way to wind down at the end of the week! The Friday concept is lots of fun. You sit outside and they bring little samples of their cocktails and mezze, and you can order from the full menu as well. They have done a beautiful job with their garden. It feels very Hellenic and the setting by the water is nice. Atmospheric Greek music as well. We started out with the combo platter, which had spanikopita, falafels, dolma, and a few other things. I then had pork souvlaki and my husband had beef souvlaki. Both were perfectly tender and beautifully seasoned. They also brought around some fun bites, including taramoslata and a fried feta bite with honey, as well as a refreshing cucumber yogurt slushy thing that was a play on tzatziki. They have a nice wine list with lots of Greek wines, and they even have Greek sparkling water. The only critique was the high top seats were a tad uncomfortable, but there are also plenty of seats that are not high tops. This was the best Greek food I've had in the area. Nicely done, Olive Tree team!
Always excellent. Great food, great atmosphere, great service. I have visited many times and have never had an item that was not totally delicious!

This is not your usual restaurant experience. This is an outdoor restaurant with a view. You order your food at the counter but it's brought out to you by a wait staff. They also have a market/gift shop. It was a refreshing experience to dining out.

I got the Aussie 3 course Alice Springs chicken, with a side house salad, baked potato with butter sour cream and chives, and the Chocolate Thunder from down under. My husband got the bloomin burger with fries, French onion soup, and the cookie skillet. My chicken was tender, well seasoned, and arrived at the perfect temperature. He said the soup had great flavor and the dessert was also delicious. Our server, Brianna, was kind, was good at check backs, and thorough.

We got seated in a nice corner and got started. I started off with an order of Bruschetta (Toasted bread topped with marinated tomatoes, garlic, basil & a sprinkle of shredded Parmesan) for the table. These were the best I've ever had. Nice, thicc chunks of toast that were actual toast and not just crackers. Also, the pieces of tomato were multicolored and very well coated with that garlic, basil, and Parm. Seriously, the best I've had. Very good stuff. For my main, I had the Veal and Shrimp Parmesan (A classic surf and turf: Breaded shrimp & veal, lightly fried, topped with marinara and baked with melted mozzarella). Wow. This thing was a spectacle. The veal and shrimps were very well pounded thin and very nicely coated with a seasoned breadcrumb mixture. Fried crispy, tasty marinara, tasty melted mozz. Just another great dish. Overall, if you specialize in national chain Italian places, definitely step outside of your comfort zone and come to mom 'n' pop places like this. The quality different is astounding. I loved it here. I'd come back.

Frequento o Oreganata há mais de dois anos e continua sendo um dos meus lugares favoritos em Orlando. O restaurante tem um ambiente bonito e agradável, ideal tanto para um almoço tranquilo quanto para um jantar mais descontraído. O buffet italiano é bem servido, com boas opções de pizza, massas e saladas, sempre frescas e bem preparadas. Um ponto que me chama atenção é a consistência: a qualidade se mantém em todas as visitas. É uma comida mais simples, claro — não compete com restaurantes mais sofisticados da cidade — mas cumpre muito bem o que propõe. Para quem está viajando com família grande ou quer controlar melhor o orçamento, é uma excelente opção. O preço é justo pelo que entrega, e o custo-benefício é realmente muito bom. É aquele tipo de lugar que dá vontade de voltar sempre — e eu realmente volto. Com certeza merece cinco estrelas.

Bizzarro's is a great place to grab pizza, especially if you're spending the day at the beach. The location is excellent, right across from the ocean, so it's easy to order your pizza to go and enjoy it with a beautiful view. The staff has always been friendly and welcoming, and the prices are very reasonable for the amount of food you get. My favorite pizza is the Hawaiian. I usually order the 18-inch size, and it's more than enough for a family or a small group. It can easily feed 4–6 people, and the value for the price is hard to beat. Parking is available right in front of the restaurant. If you're lucky, you can find a free spot, although paid parking is available nearby when it's busy. While it's not the best pizza I've ever had, it's consistently good, the portions are generous, and the combination of friendly service, reasonable prices, and the beachside location keeps me coming back.

The front counter had to keep waiting because there was barely any food ready, which forced customers like me to stand around for almost 20 minutes just to be served. What really bothered me the most was the lack of hygiene. I watched cooks using their bare hands after touching their hair, nose, and face, then grabbing food and throwing it onto the pans without washing their hands or wearing gloves. That was honestly disgusting and completely unacceptable. On top of that, the food quality was terrible. The shrimp didn’t seem fully cooked, the noodles were cold and tasted old, and overall the food looked and felt like it had been sitting there way too long. I couldn’t even enjoy my meal. This isn’t the first bad experience I’ve had at this location, but it will definitely be the last. I recently stopped by Panda Express and had a really solid experience overall. The food was fresh, flavorful, and came out quickly, which is exactly what you want from a spot like this. My go-to order is the Orange Chicken with fried rice, and it definitely didn’t disappoint—crispy, saucy, and just the right balance of sweet and tangy. The portion sizes were generous, and everything tasted like it had just been made, not sitting out too long. The staff was friendly and kept the line moving efficiently, even during a busy time, which I appreciated. The restaurant itself was clean and well-maintained, making it a comfortable place to eat in. Whether you’re grabbing a quick meal on the go or sitting down for something fast and filling, Panda Express delivers consistency and good value. Overall, it’s a reliable choice when you’re craving quick, tasty Chinese-American food, and I’d definitely come back again.

I can’t say enough good things about our dinner at Oak and Ember. The ambiance was amazing — warm lighting, beautiful accents, and a low hum of conversation that felt upscale without being stuffy. It set the perfect tone for the night. The food was even more amazing. Every dish our party of 7 ordered was plated beautifully and tasted spectacular. You can tell the kitchen cares about both flavor and presentation. We tried a mix of starters, entrees, and desserts, and there wasn’t a single miss. Our server Tiffany was fantastic and truly made the experience. With 7 of us, it can get chaotic, but she was incredibly patient, never made us feel rushed, and kept everything running smoothly. She gave us spot-on recommendations when we couldn’t decide and checked in just the right amount. The rest of the staff was pleasant too — several team members stopped by to make sure we had everything we needed. From start to finish, our whole group was very pleased with everything. Oak and Ember nailed the food, the service, and the vibe. We’ll definitely be back.

The countertop was sticky, and the overall space felt a bit neglected and unclean. The bartenders were very friendly and welcoming, which we appreciated. However, I did notice one of them eating behind the bar, which wasn’t the most professional look, even if he was probably just grabbing a quick bite. The dining room looked cozy and inviting, although we didn’t have the opportunity to sit there. Overall, the bar area could use some TLC and attention to detail. Based on this visit, we’re not sure if we’ll be returning.

Panera Honey Walnut Cream Cheese Spread: Most of us know Panera is a bakery-café fast casual restaurant chain with thousands of locations in the United States and Canada. What I didn't know, was the chain operates as Saint Louis Bread Company in the Greater St. Louis area. The name comes from a word that has roots in the Latin word for "breadbasket" (Classical pānārium, Vulgar pānāria) and is exactly the same to the word for "breadbasket" in Spanish. Panera offers a wide array of pastries and baked goods, like bagels, brownies, cookies, breads, and muffins. What better to top those delicious bagels with than fresh cream cheese? Panera offers a standard cream cheese as well as a honey walnut version. The honey walnut is sweeter and has a color that resembles Thousand Island dressing. Tiny pieces of walnut can be found throughout and while they make spreading the cream cheese slightly difficult, they do add satisfying crunch and subtle nutty flavor. Personally, I didn't detect much of a honey flavor, but it was definitely sweeter than a standard cream cheese spread. I tried the spread on both an Asiago and Cinnamon Crunch Bagel, with about equally good results. Give it a spread on your next visit if you're looking for something different. Pho Hoa stands out as one of the premier Vietnamese dining establishments in Orlando, offering a genuine taste of Vietnam right in the heart of the city. The moment you step inside, you are enveloped in a warm and inviting atmosphere that transports you to the vibrant streets of Vietnam. Having visited Pho Hoa with my family for several years, I can confidently say that the culinary experience is consistently exceptional. The menu features a wide array of authentic dishes, each bursting with flavor and prepared with care. The staff is not only friendly but also attentive, ensuring that your dining experience is seamless and enjoyable. Dishes are served promptly, allowing you to savor the delightful flavors without a long wait. If you find yourself in Downtown Orlando, I wholeheartedly recommend making a stop at Pho Hoa. It’s not just a meal; it’s an experience that captures the essence of Vietnamese cuisine. From the aromatic pho to the fresh spring rolls, every bite is a testament to the restaurant's commitment to quality and authenticity. The vibrant decor and lively ambiance further enhance the experience, making it a perfect spot for both casual meals and special family gatherings. Whether you are a local or a visitor, Pho Hoa is a must-try destination that promises to satisfy your cravings for delicious Vietnamese food.

Panera Bread real reviews I have been a loyal customer of Panera Bread in Celebration, Florida for many years, and tonight’s experience was extremely disappointing. Instead of showing any understanding or customer service, he repeated himself and changed his tone, saying, “Ohhh, I’m sorry, but it’s closed, okay.” What disappointed me most was not that the store was closed, but the way the situation was handled. My family and I traveled from Houston to Orlando for a Disney vacation, and our stay at the Renaissance Orlando at Disney Springs was made unforgettable because of one amazing manager—Amber. When we first checked in, I wasn’t happy with the room we were assigned. In fact, I was seriously considering checking out on the very first day and finding another hotel. Instead of letting us leave disappointed, Amber took the time to listen to our concerns and said, “Let me find a room that meets your standards.” She personally walked us through three different rooms and encouraged us to choose the one we liked best. That level of customer service is almost impossible to find these days. She didn’t just solve a problem—she completely changed the direction of our vacation. From that moment on, Amber and the staff made sure my family had an incredible experience. The complimentary shuttle service to the Disney parks made everything convenient, and every interaction made us feel like valued guests. Amber’s kindness, professionalism, and genuine care turned what started as a disappointing arrival into one of the best family vacations we’ve ever had. She truly went above and beyond, and she’s a perfect example of what outstanding hospitality should look like. Because of you, we’ll definitely be back and will recommend the Renaissance Orlando at Disney Springs to anyone visiting Disney. You made…

Jason made our visit to Miller's Ale House in Orlando one of the best dining experiences we've had in a while. He knew the menu well, answered our questions confidently, and helped us decide on a few items we might not have tried otherwise. His positive attitude and attention to detail made the entire meal feel relaxed and enjoyable. The restaurant itself was clean, the atmosphere was lively, and the staff all appeared to work well together, but Jason really stood out. Great service can completely change a dining experience, and that's exactly what happened for us. If you're visiting this Miller's Ale House location, I highly recommend asking to sit in Jason's section if you have the chance. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great meal, and it's clear he takes pride in providing outstanding customer service. We'll definitely be back, and we hope Jason is our server again next time!

To her credit, she apologized and had a replacement order brought out. Unfortunately, the replacement order was completely different from the original. It arrived covered in red pepper flakes, making the appetizer unexpectedly spicy and uncomfortable to eat. What concerns me is that the menu description states the mozzarella sticks are tossed in Parmesan, garlic, and oregano and served with zesty marinara, but it does not mention red pepper flakes. The original order didn’t have them, so the inconsistency was confusing and disappointing. The entire experience left me frustrated. What happened to one of our favorite places to eat in Orlando? We used to love coming here whenever we visited, but today's experience was extremely disappointing. The first surprise was that the restaurant was completely empty this afternoon. Given how hot it was outside—around 93°F with very high humidity, felt like 105°F, we were looking forward to cooling off indoors. Unfortunately, after we walked in, we quickly realized it felt almost as warm inside as it did outside. We decided to stay and place our order anyway. Things only got worse when we found out the air conditioning wasn't working. By the time our food arrived, we were sweating and very uncomfortable. The food quality was also far below what we've experienced here in the past. The brigadeiros were dry and didn't taste fresh. The empadinhas were cold and had an unusual taste. The pão de queijo was hard and cold as well. Even the juice was served without ice. At that point, we had had enough. We left feeling frustrated and disappointed. I'm leaving this review in the hope that management takes notice and addresses these issues. Something is clearly not right, and I sincerely hope this restaurant can get back to the quality it once had. We used to love coming here, but after today's experience, I'm not sure we'll be returning.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I tried the Balsamic Vinaigrette Cream from Market to Table at the Winter Garden Farmers Market and absolutely loved it. Not the greatest experience tonight. It started out well—our server, Michael, was great. Drinks came quickly, followed by the appetizers, and everything was good. The mussels weren’t overcooked, and the grilled focaccia complemented them perfectly with the broth. As we got into the main course, I noticed it was taking a while. When the meal finally arrived, I could tell as soon as my knife touched the Iberico pork chop that it was overcooked. I had ordered it medium-rare plus, but it came out medium-well. No big deal, Michael took it back, saying they were working on a new one ASAP. When the replacement arrived, it was rare. At this point, I was really disappointed that they did not cook it to the correct temp again. The grill person is usually the strong point of the team, so for this to happen twice along with the expediter not double-checking the quality, was a big miss. I sent the meal back again and decided not to reorder. To top it off, the manager never even visited my table to apologize or check in. All in all, there were four mistakes on my meal, and it left a bad impression.

Overhyped reviews imho … After asking around for the best BBQ in Orlando at 8pm I ended up at the third best recommendation in town - Pig Floyd’s with fairly high expectations. The best way I can describe the experience is: it was fine dining… as in, it was fine, and I was dining. I ordered the brisket plate with two sides and a canned beer. The total came to about $51 including a modest 15% tip, which immediately sets a pretty high bar. The brisket wasn’t bad. It had a decent smoke ring and was cooked properly, but it wasn’t particularly memorable. It lacked the rich, melt-in-your-mouth quality that makes great BBQ worth seeking out. The sides were also perfectly fine and acceptable, but nothing stood out. In fact, the green beans may have been the highlight of the meal. The biggest issue wasn’t the food itself. It was the value. If this meal had cost $25-$30, I’d probably be giving it 4 stars and happily moving on. At over $50, I expected something that made me want to come back. Instead, it felt like I paid premium prices for an average BBQ dinner. This is the cost of fiat debasing of the money. It either becomes unaffordable or lower quality. To be clear, this wasn’t a bad meal. Service was fine, the restaurant was pleasant, and I finished everything on the plate. I just left wondering why I paid over fifty bucks for an experience that was ultimately so ordinary. Not terrible. Not amazing. Just… fine. Fine dining. Piocos used to be a place I made a point to visit every time I came to Orlando. The chicken was always amazing, and it felt worth the stop. Unfortunately, my most recent visit completely changed my opinion. Since the restaurant is close to the airport and we were starving before a flight, we decided to stop for what we hoped would be a good, filling dinner. We waited in line, only to be told that ordering chicken would take 20 minutes, so we chose two combination plates instead. We were a party of three and planned to share. Because we asked for a twist on their regular mofongo to make it a trifongo, we were told the second combination would take a bit longer. That was fine with us, so we paid and started eating the first plate while waiting. About ten minutes after picking up the second combination, the same employee who handed it to us suddenly started yelling across the restaurant that she had given us an extra item and that we needed to pay for it. This happened in front of everyone. I explained that we had no idea how the combinations were supposed to be served and that the mistake wasn’t ours, but she insisted we pay anyway. We did, because we are honest people, but the way it was handled was embarrassing and completely unprofessional. I can only imagine how this would have played out if we had taken the food to go. To make things worse, the food wasn’t as good as it used to be. It didn’t taste authentically Puerto Rican, and for a moment I wondered if the ownership…

The experience of eating there is not worth the food. One of the women accused us of stealing one of the dishes, which they had given us and we had paid for (showed receipt). It ruined our dining experience. We showed them our receipt and she still charged us for the dish anyway, even while her coworkers told her to leave us alone. She was extremely rude and yelled at us from the counter, embarrassing us in front of everyone else. Also, the food did not taste Puerto Rican (as a Puerto Rican) and most of the employees were Colombian anyway, SO DO NOT GO HERE IF YOU WANT AUTHENTIC PUERTO RICAN FOOD. I stopped at Pollo Tropical because I wanted a quick, affordable meal that wouldn’t be a nutritional disaster. I’ve been keeping a food journal recently using ChatGPT, tracking what I eat, drink, and how I feel throughout the day, so I was looking for something that would fit into a normal, active Saturday without feeling like a compromise. What I got was one of the most satisfying meals I’ve had in weeks. I ordered the quarter chicken with black beans and brown rice, a Diet Coke, and enough Poyo Poyo sauce to make responsible decisions impossible. The chicken was hot, juicy, and flavorful. The beans and rice were simple, filling, and exactly what I needed after a day spent gallivanting between used bookstores, Barnes & Noble, and the mall. The whole meal came to just $11.91, which feels like a bargain these days. Things escalated quickly. The chicken was so good that during one particularly enthusiastic bite, a small piece achieved escape velocity, flew off my fork, landed on my phone, and activated ChatGPT’s voice mode. For a brief moment, my food journal became a live-action event. ChatGPT immediately began offering observations about my afternoon while I frantically tried to explain that I was under attack by airborne poultry. I regret nothing. The Poyo Poyo sauce deserves its own paragraph. Tangy, creamy, and highly addictive, it transformed an already good meal into one of those meals where you’re chasing every last bean and grain of rice around the container. As the…

Es lamentable, pero este sitio es el típico ejemplo de restaurante latino que se enfoca exclusivamente en sacarle el dinero al cliente en lugar de preocuparse por la calidad de sus productos o por ofrecer una buena atención. ​No volveré jamás. No lo recomiendo para nada.

I don't usually leave reviews, but this experience deserves to be recognized. I stopped by this Popeyes while my mom was in the hospital. She had been struggling to eat, and all she wanted was some mashed potatoes. I was exhausted and standing in the parking lot trying to collect myself before going inside when an employee, Terrica who happened to be on her break, greeted me with kindness. She told me she could recognize when someone needed a breather. She thanked me for the work I do in healthcare, and when I explained that I wasn't working that night and was there because my mom was hospitalized, she treated me with so much compassion and understanding. I also want to recognize the team working in the back. The cooks were incredibly helpful and accommodating to make sure I had what I needed to take back to my mom. When someone you love is sick and struggling to eat, something as simple as mashed potatoes becomes so much more than a side dish. Their willingness to help meant that my mom got one of the few things she felt up to eating that day. The food was exactly what we needed, but it's the humanity I remember most. From the employee who offered kindness in the parking lot to the team behind the scenes preparing our order with care, everyone played a part in making a very difficult day a little easier. Healthcare workers spend a lot of time taking care of everyone else. That day, someone took care of me for a moment, and I'll never forget it.

After FINALLY returning from Tampa for refueling after circulating around Orlando due to severe thunderstorms, we were hungry. Business partner suggested Red Robbins. RED. ROBBINS. DID. NOT. DISAPPOINT! The place had quite a few people. We were greeted and seated by friendly and welcoming staff. Our waiter, Don, was simply amazing, attentive, polite, listener, and the perfect balance/without overdoing it when it came to checking in on us . . . And the other tables around us. Don was on point!! He gave great suggestions and I went with the teriyaki with pineapple burger. For drink, I went with coke-coconut with cold foam dirty soda. I never had it before. During our conversation as we looked over the menu, I said I liked pineapple and coconut. He listened and gave the burger and drink suggested. I told him what my three things/sides I would like to try and he was on it! Not once did we have to remind him! Not once did we have to ask from a refill of our drinks or sides. He was impressive! The food was great! Definitely fresh, hot and yummy!! The manager came around and checked on each table throughout our time there. Nice guy! There is one thing that would need improvement on and it's the ladies' restroom. However, Don's great service and the great tasting food and drinks overshadowed that.

The lunch special of a double burger, bottomless fries, and a drink for $9.99 is one of the best deals around. If you haven't been in a while, I recommend trying them out.

Reel Fish is the real deal. It's my go-to favorite place when I visit the Orlando area. As an Open Table VIP member, I have dined at hundreds of restaurants around the globe, and Reel Fish meets all the key points I look for: quality of food, service, atmostphere, and esthetics. From the moment I walk in, I feel at home. The decor, art, and colors are welcoming and comforting; the service is exceptional: warm, friendly, and efficient; and the food and drink are consistently delicious and beautifully presented. During my recent experience, my son and I were enthralled and regaled by our server, Cici, whose detailed presentation of the menu and specials was delivered with aplomb, warmth, and humor. Owner Fred Thimm stopped by our table to greet us. For someone as accomplished as he, it was a genuine pleasure to experience his warmth and humble gratitude for our patronage. I tried the Lightning Bug cocktail for the first time and experienced a delightful explosion of flavors, thanks to the ginger and "buzz button" on top! The delicious Caesar salad was the real deal with garlic and anchovies. The pecan-crusted baked catfish with grits and collard greens was cooked to perfection. The key lime pie with pecan and graham crust was large enough for two. Another delightful, joyful, satisfying experience.

I was at this restaurant on May 29 to celebrate my aunt's 50th birthday, and I'm still disappointed by how our family was treated. The experience started going downhill because of the staff's attitude. She didn't introduce herself or try to calmly figure out what was going on. Instead, she immediately approached our host and insisted that she had to pay. Our host repeatedly explained that the remaining balance would be paid—she just wasn't the person who was paying it. She stepped outside for a moment to put something in her car and was coming right back. There were still plenty of family members inside the restaurant, so it's not like everyone had disappeared or was trying to run out without paying. Instead of listening, the staff escalated the situation and even threatened to call the police. The bill was ultimately paid, which proves that no one was trying to leave without paying. What makes this even more disappointing is that the restaurant has continued to mishandle the situation by responding to reviews with claims that our family was trying to avoid paying. That is simply not what happened, and it's frustrating to see false statements being made publicly instead of taking accountability for how poorly the situation was handled. As someone who was there, I left feeling embarrassed for my family. Based on how…

We were here on May 29 to celebrate my sister's 50th birthday, and what should have been a beautiful family celebration turned into one of the most upsetting dining experiences I've ever had. Our family had a large party, and everyone paid for their own meals. When it came time to settle the remaining balance, there was confusion over who was responsible for paying it. At no point was anyone refusing to pay. The balance was paid, yet the situation was escalated to the point that the police were threatened. Watching that happen during my sister's milestone birthday was humiliating and completely unnecessary. What was even more disappointing was seeing the restaurant later respond to reviews by claiming our family was trying to avoid paying the bill. That is simply not true. The bill was paid in full. Instead of acknowledging how poorly the situation was handled, the restaurant chose to publicly misrepresent what happened. As my sister's family, we spent months planning this celebration, and it was heartbreaking to see such a special day overshadowed by the way we were treated. The entire experience left me feeling disrespected and unwelcome. I hope management reflects on how this situation was handled so that no other family celebrating a special occasion has to go through what we did.

Rusteak is WOW! Located in Thornton Park this tasty gastro restaurant is amazing. There’s a few sections to the place. Main area is open area with a bar (generally louder), they have a large private room in the middle and then hidden room in the back is the speakeasy vibe location. Ambiance is cozy and the staff is very nice! Our server/bartender, Gigi handled both jobs with ease. She was friendly, knowledgeable and great to chat with - you won’t be disappointed if you’re lucky to have her. Now to the food. Let’s say we’ll be back because everything looks amazing and the price point was very good (especially for now!). We started with the wedge salad and mushroom Brie bisque soup. Both were fantastic and each was elevated from what you may have had at other restaurants. I highly recommend both items! The salad had petite size cranberries and the bacon was in med/small chunks with yummy blue cheese 😋 We also had the mussels and crab cake. The mussels is a LARGE portion, perfect the mussel lover in you. The crab cake was delicious with great flavor and the crab was very prominent in the cake! Lastly we also got the keto keto dish- which is salmon, asparagus and cheddar and pancetta cauliflower casserole. chef kiss!😘 Fabulous place, go check them out. See you soon GiGi

The first one after messing up the order, second was what seemed annoyance over asking for water refills and last was a closing shot which was a remark about our patience after claiming to be the only server in an almost dead restaurant when we clearly saw the runners host and two other girls in similar uniforms as hers assisting outside tables. My steak frites…

Came here for dinner with my wife tonight and it was amazing! The steak was cooked to perfection, and the fish of the day was great. Our server Khadeja was so sweet and so attentive, she took great care of us. Will be coming back asking for her! Great local spot

Will not be visiting again. The food was just ok. We waited at least 10 min before our waitress came to our table. We were told by 3 different waiters that they would be our waiter and theyd be right with us. We placed a kids meal in with appetizers and our appetizer came out first. Charcuterie board brought 4 pieces of crispy toast points for the whole board. It wasn't until we tracked down our waitress to ask where the kids meal was. Our food took so long to come out as well. A manager happened to walk by and ask how everything was tasting and I let her know we had been waiting. She apologized and discounted our drink and app. The waitress barely checked on us, and we our water wasn't filled but once. I dont know what the issue was but it was not good customer service. When we left there was no one at the front....we just left after paying. Its a shame!
The food is basic nothing special but not bad, just basic

Food, atmosphere, and service are great. But the price point is terrible. It was over $40 for the ravioli and we got I think 7 or 8 pieces of ravioli. That’s over $6 a ravioli!!! Similar story for the rest of the meal. The only things which didn’t feel skimped out on was the meat. Plus, most of the meat does not come with any pasta. So you are going to have to order more than one dish per person The taste of the food and atmosphere of the restaurant was not nearly nice enough to necessitate this price point Was going to give it a 2/5 and then I realized that they didn’t have the live music that they proudly advertise

We traveled a few miles seeking great Italian food, nice ambiance, and a fair price. And we found it here at Rocco's. He is hands on management and made us feel welcome. 4.1 of five stars is way, way too low.we will be back.

I am grateful for the staff who accomodated a last minute reservation for 18 people. They gave us a great atmosphere to host our group dinner and gave good recommendations on dishes. I really enjoyed my risotto with shrimp.
Came in here today for a lunch with a client. The service was good. Food was a lot more than I could ask for for lunch, but overall had a great experience.
This place is a gem! Old school Italian feel. Owner is amazing. Service was fantastic and the singer/piano player was incredible. Food was outstanding. Highly recommend!
Great fine dining experience 👌

Group of four. The house red blend was a good choice but poured at the bar with no tasting offered. We attempted to order appetizers and slow roll our dining experience. The waitress who seemed rushed and basically disinterested strongly suggested we place the entire order so they could control our meal. I suggested that we wanted to take our time to which she said, "we know what we are doing" and walked off. We ordered the caprese and calamari along with entrees. Bread came almost immediately with a very small olive oil mix for four people. Withing 3 minutes both appetizers came out. Unfortunately, the tomatoes were soft and the calamari was best described as mushy. We requested extra sauce for the calamari which never came. Water glasses sat emptied for long stretches. The waitress continued to be in a hurry and distracted. This was an early dinner and the dining room was not busy. Entrees arrived within 12 minutes of appetizers. So much fir knowing hiw to slow roll the experience. All four entrees were bland and uneventful. The two desserts were definitely the best food served. To add to the experience, there was a hefty service charge added to the bill for a party of four. Usually you think it was an off night for a server or a cook but this was an all around bad experience that was highly impersonal, inattentive, average at best and highly over priced for the product. All were in agreement this was a one and done experience. We could have more strongly voiced our…
Had a wonderful time with my wife and mother in law pre-show at Orlando Shakes. Risotto was excellent! Great service!

Update 4/15/26 been here a couple times since my last review. As always, Rocco and his staff are excellent . Update 08/01/23 - Great as always One of my favoret places to eat. Little on the $$$ but well worth it. Everything I have eaten has been great.
Intimate atmosphere, live music, friendly staff and great food it's also reasonably priced. A good place to go on a date night.
The food is fantastic!!!

We dined for Valentine’s Day weekend and had Vanessa as our server. She made our experience that much greater and went above and beyond. We enjoyed their lobster bisque, carpaccio, fettuccine Bolognese, carbonara and for dessert had lava cake and tiramisu. It really was such a special way to enjoy the weekend. Thank Vanessa for taking such great care of us!
veal and lobster risotto 10/10 our waitress was lovely she made the experience elegant.

Had a reservation and got shuffled to the bar to wait. Spent 20 minutes waiting and decided to leave. Small place with an extremely loud singer placed in the center, unable to hold a conversation with all the noise.

This restaurant has to be a joke. It was incomprehensibly terrible. The waiters were hovering, the food was microwaved and the prices were insane. It felt like an episode of kitchen nightmares inside. It was also filthy. I can't recommend it less. Please don't go here.

Went on NYE and the staff was so confusing and weird. Got approached 5 times by different people back to back and we kept having to say we weren’t ready yet. Felt extremely rushed and there was barely anyone in the dining room. Saw chef and what looked like the manager smoking on the porch and seemed intoxicated upon arrival. The food was so low bar for the price, tasted like olivia garden. Atmosphere was very strange just because the staff felt like they had no idea what they were doing. There was about 10 servers for 3 tables. Would not recommend or go again.

We will not give 1 rate We regret booking at this place will not recommend it at all. So disappointed. Thus place should not be in business in Winter park Misleading Advertising, called twice to confirm advertised music special for NY. The place looked closed and dark upon arrival, we were very confused almost left. Subpar, Overpriced Food: Food seemed frozen and was excessively priced (e.g., $50 pasta). No taste. Only thing wad ok was the bread The overall ambiance was lacking fun The owner was unfriendly

Just finished our annual Christmas dinner at Rocco’s. We reserved their private room and had a wonderful evening. Food was excellent, service amazing, atmosphere is very nice. Looking forward to returning with the family. Thank you Rocco, Daniel and Michael. All the feedback from our guests was positive! Great experience!
Nice atmosphere, good food

Bread came out 40 mins after seating, food took a hour and their were only 2 others groups in the restaurant. Atmosphere was weird, the workers were shady for no reason. Pasta was good but 4/10 experience.
Staff was very friendly! Unfortunately, the food just wasn’t good.
Good food .. portions a little small ,,,, service was good
Food came Luke warm and not a lot of it, expensive and came away hungry. Chicken over cooked vegetables none existent. Will not go back.

I went to this restaurant due to having high reviews and expecting a cooked to order meal tasty meal. The Chicken Parm come out in less than 5 mintues, and was super diappointing. I wish I had ordered a steak that would have had to have been cooked to order. There is no way my food order was cooked fresh, and it tasted like a heated up left over item. The tomato sauce tast like right out of the can, so nothing could help it be more flavorful. The portion of the chicken was adaquate, but it was so disappointing that I ate again a few hours later. The pasta was cooked well, but there was not much of the pasta, and it had the same tomato sauce which was not very appealing. I do not know how this restaurant is a resy recommended restaurant, it is average at best, and my food was below average. I could have had a better meal from a hot bar at a take out place. The owner is very nice, but I came for the food and left super disappointed. I should have sent back my food and ordered a steak or other item that was not preped, ahead of time and heated up, however time was not on my side as I had a long drive and a meeting to attend. I paid the bill and fed the chicken to my dog. My waiter had too many tables, he started out very attentive, I had to ask for my check several times and when he brought it he just put in on the table and walked away, nothing was said. I would not recommend going to this restaurant unless you have knowledge of an item that they cook to order that you like. I…

Fabulous restaurant and staff. Heard they had to close several days for ADA, I was surprised. I HAVE A DISABLED DAD IIN A WHEELCHAIR AND NEVER HAD ANY ISSUES IN PARKING LOT GETTING IN OR OUT OR BATHROOMS! We will definitely be going back so glad they didn't have to completely close. God bless all who work here they are amazing!!!
This place is New Smyrna Beach best kept secret. If you in town looking for the best local breakfast & brunch place, try out Ruth's Kozy kitchen, you will not be disappointed.

Absolutely loved our breakfast here on Father's Day! The omelette with the sausage gravy on top, the biscuits and gravy, and the Mickey pancakes were all phenomenal. Our server (unfortunately we forget her name!) was amazing! She was very attentive and made sure to check on us after we got our food, which came out quickly despite how busy they were. You could tell the food was made fresh, though. We will definitely be back when we are in the area!
If you want like friends and family feeling... it's best place... country style home cook meals..very kind good services...Thanks ..
Great place, food was yummy. Definitely try the hashbrown casserole & the special Avacado toast with egg. Server Audrey was very friendly.
Destiny was very attentive and went the extra mile for us.
Great food , service and family!
Friendly staff, generous portions and delicious dishes!
Food is 🔥 service is 🔥

Came here at 11am for brunch yesterday to celebrate, after my partner completed her 7.1 mile trail run on her 71st birthday! 💪🏻💥🎉😄👏🏻 (no waiting for a table at that time of the day.) This is the third time we’ve been here, and we’ve never been disappointed. She had the avocado toast, and I had the Greek omelette. Both were delicious. The staff were switched on and attentive, and after I tipped them off about my partner‘s birthday, they kindly brought a complementary dessert muffin + candle, and sang happy birthday for her. Even her coffee mug was unique, and not some standard ‘commercial-kitchen-supplied’ white characterless thing. Which I guess sums up Ruthy’s - it’s special. Equally important these days, was that the prices were very reasonable, especially when compared to some other restaurants in this area. Thanks Ruthy’s for making an effort to keep dining out affordable, we certainly appreciate it! Plenty of parking outside and under the big oak tree in the shade at the back, but it often gets very busy during typical breakfast hours, and there can be a wait. We left feeling fulfilled and happy, and any restaurant that makes you feel like that after you’ve left, makes you want to go back again. If you haven’t tried Ruthy’s on Canal Street, just west of US1, I doubt you’ll be disappointed. Hours are 7am to 2pm.
Ruthy's was great! Very open and spacious. The staff worked together and the manager even came around removing plates from tables. The food was wonderful. We will definitely be back.
Great food good atmosphere!
Sweet place good food good service.
Great for breakfast dinner meals.
It was good, I got gravy and biscuits, I think I’ll try something different next time. The bacon was excellent! It was thick, it made the whole meal worth it. Service was great.
Great place to watch the sunset.
Had an excellent chicken wrap! My husband really enjoyed his chicken sandwich. Sarah is awesome!
Absolutely delicious and fresh seafood. The cold shrimp, and calamari were especially great. Very friendly server and very fast service even on a busy father's day Sunday. We'll be back!
Next by the riverside. You can see boat coming in and out, very cool place to eat,drink and hangouts. Love it
Really the best place in the area... great food, great view and our waitres Marianna made our stay so amazing.. Thanks.
Food and service was great

Used to love this place. It's gone downhill with service and cleanliness. Very dirty now and just not well managed. Sad really. Update in response to owner: I did not say weathered, I said dirty. As in cigarette butts, debris and trash at the entry doors and stuck between deck boards. Pieces of food and trash on the floor inside mid afternoon. Bar full on sticky and dishes fun previous guests sitting for extended periods without being picked up. I understand your desire to reply in a way to dismiss my words instead of saying "hey sorry we fell short this time, we'll see what we can do to improve". But as I said, I used to love the place. After yesterday, I'm not surprised you just don't care what anyone says unless it validates you. Plenty of places are on the river or the beach and still manage to do the basics for cleanliness. It's not a pass.
Worth it

I have to admit, when I first arrived and saw that parking was a little difficult, I assumed the place would be overcrowded. As the saying goes, don’t judge a book by its cover! From the moment we sat down, everything was outstanding. The food was simply amazing. The skirt steak was absolutely incredible—cooked to perfection and packed with flavor. The paella was equally impressive, authentic, and delicious. What amazed me most was how this little corner of Florida delivers such a rich cultural influence through its food. The clientele was friendly, diverse, and created a wonderful atmosphere. The live country music was right on point. Great sound system, talented musicians, and just the right vibe to enjoy a relaxing meal and evening. Honestly, I’d rather make the drive here than go to Conchy Joe’s in Jensen Beach. Yes, I said it—Riverside Cafe is 100% better in my opinion. If you’re looking for great food, great music, and a fantastic overall experience, come see for yourself. You won’t be disappointed. Thank you, Riverside Cafe, for a wonderful experience! — Dr. Guillermo Collazo
Great service really good food and next to the water what more could you want..really good place to have dinner great selection on menu ..

We did sit outside and it did uncomfortable because of outside temperature. I had a mahi sandwich which was good and my wife had a Reuben. It did not agree with her and about 30 minutes later she threw it up. Yes graphic but why did it happen. This does not happen every time we eat out, so yes unusual.

Sarah is the friendliest & best waitress we have had this entire vacation. Really enjoyed the food and sitting on the deck. We had the crabby pig sandwich and the kickin chicken sandwich. Enjoyed both. Don’t miss the French fries

Can get loud inside on Friday and Saturday evenings. Sitting out side is a bit better. The food is good, your typical area seafood and sandwiches. My wife loves the Ahi Tuna and I usually get the Reuben sandwich. Sitting out side along the water is the best part of dinning here. The servers are attentive and helpful.

This is a hidden gem that sits right on the water on the barrier island. We sat outside and though it was quite warm, it felt comfortable. Our waitress, Angela, is a gem herself! We asked for recommendations and took her up on 2 of them. The first was clams in a white wine sauce with linguine added for an extra fee and the second was the rum runners. Absolutely delish! My husband ordered the Mahi Mahi blackened, as a sandwich. The food was delicious and the service, thanks to Angela was sublime! So if you find yourself near Vero stop at the Riverside Cafe, ask for Angela and enjoy the view, the food and a true gem of a waitress!

Had a great experience at Riverside. Something about an older bar on the water filled with great live music, cheerful employees, and friendly patrons that make me really enjoy the experience. Food was great and the drinks came out fast at a great price. Had the grilled flounder with a few beers. Listed to a great live band “Whippersnapper Mountain Boys” I believe who were fantastic!

My family and I ate here today for my aunt’s birthday with Taylor, who served us, and man, we had a phenomenal time. Taylor was so prompt and friendly and eager to serve us with only the best. The sunset was absolutely gorgeous. I’m thankful we chose Riverside Cafe.
We went here for lunch and drinks while watching the Blue Angels air show. Great location away from the pay to get in at the airport
Great find at Vero Beach. Food was amazing and our server Marianna was amazing also, great energy and always smiling. Highly recommend crab dip , bang bang shrimp and the skirt steak.
We didn’t get 5 steps into the door before the waitresses were dropping F bombs in front if my kids. Turned and left.

10/10 experience good service. The server was kind and warm she knows what you need. The food was amazing I ordered fish and chips makes me think it must be coming from the river right next to it because it was fresh melts in my mouth yet crispy outside the portion was big too. I was satisfied with my order the view was entertaining too the breeze, the pelican trying to swallow big catch and the waters, it was nice!

Visited this place and brought my wife and two of her coworkers because of the good reviews and recommendations on stupid AI and i completely regret my decision. Food is not good and neither is the service or atmosphere. We sat outside on the dock in the blazing hot sun where the tables were not spaced enough apart. All the food was bad nothing was good. Our drinks came out wrong, the water tasted like they scooped it out of the lagoon, and we never got our drinks refilled once (probably a good thing) and our plates were never cleared from our table. I couldn’t wait to leave. This is another establishment in a long list of Florida coast restaurants that don’t deserve the ratings they have.

I've only gone here for the bluegrass bands they've had, but it's a nice enough vibe that I don't mind visiting 🙃 I have yet to explore their food options much as they are a bit expensive for my budget, but their garlic wings were rather good 😋 Not too bad if you like bars 👌
First time, went on Mother's Day, everything was wonderful.
Who wouldn’t want to spend their afternoon looking out on the water with the best bartenders around? Charli & Morgan are amazing. Service was fast and food is great.
Great food and atmosphere
Like always, very attentive, respectful and on point. They will make your occasion worth it.

Great renovations at the Ruth Chris at Lake Mary. Reserved a table for my daughter 's 25th birthday and was decorated. Sophie took amazing care of us, able to gave suggestions for the wine and entrees. We ordered the 40 Oz porterhouse and was perfect!. David, the manage came twice to check on us. We will be back!
Always a great experience coming here!
Always exceptional

I had dinner at Ruth's Chris Steak House recently, and it was a great experience from the moment we arrived. My steak was cooked exactly as requested, and every bite was tender and full of flavor. The sides were just as enjoyable, and everything was served fresh and hot. The staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure we had a pleasant evening without making us feel rushed. I'd definitely come back for another special dinner.
Steak was seasoned perfectly, the calamari, lobster mac and cheese, and sweet potato casserole was absolutely delicious. Service was fast and responsive. Would definitely recommend
Great food and place

My boyfriend and I came here to celebrate our anniversary and everything was perfect. Our steaks were perfectly cooked and service was excellent. Our server Taylor took such great care of us and multiple managers came over to wish us a happy anniversary.

We came in late due to traffic but were welcomed by the hostess. Josh was our server and he was super accommodating, knowledgable, and friendly. Food was incredible-we ordered the ahi tuna, the 16 oz NY Strip, and the Ruth Chris salad. Highly recommend for food, service, and atmosphere. Thank you Josh and team for being so accommodating especially so last minute. We will be back again soon!

My husband and I had dinner there last night for date night and our server Morgyn was amazing! So personable and joked around with my husband about him eating a 40oz steak to himself 😂 We will be asking for her again the next time we come in! And the food was delicious as always.

Ruth's Chris never disappoints! The steak was absolutely incredible — perfectly cooked, juicy, and full of flavor. The takeout was great too, but I really wish I had stayed to eat inside. The atmosphere is so pleasant and relaxing. Can't resist coming back! so good had to post a review, was staying at hotel, shorts pool etc , should have stayed, take out did not disappoint
Over cooked food, got home was excited good dinner, so tough ( stuffed chicken) over cooked , $89.00 might as well lit a $100 bill
The food and service was outstanding !! Our server Morgan C was wonderful and truly made it a great experience for my BFs birthday
Steak was so bland. Servers didn't care. Restrooms were dirty. I went to texas roadhouse, two days ago and it was twenty times better.
What a great steak house. The service we recieved was top notch. They even brought out a complimentary desert at the end. I look forward to our next visit.

Great meal, bar seemed to be under construction did not feel special. Tables were not cleaned well for a nice place, had to re wash table still was a quick job. I think id like meals to be spaced out to enjoy apps 1st before pile table with salad, dinners apps all at once.
Wonderful, classic, elevated experience. Greatly enjoyed the shrimp cocktail as an appetizer.

Food has gone downhill sadly. My son’s porterhouse was awful. No flavor, tough. Same with my husband’s New York strip. They did not eat it, nor would they let me say something to the waiter. But the porterhouse & strip steaks apparently tasted like steaks bought from those door to door salesman’s with a cooler in the back of their vehicle.So bad. It was expensive for nothing.

I took my client out for dinner and suggested a steak house that I have always known to be a home run and it sure didn't disappoint. Talk about the best of everything. I have to tell you, I'm kind of glad we got those and not the Tomahawk. Talk about a great steak! Wow. The client was impressed, I was impressed it turned out to be great evening all around. Great job Faith and great job Ruth's Chris!

All staff kept bumping into our chairs! Filet was tough. Restaurant was overly loud. French onion soup was lousy. Kid who wrapped leftover food wrapped it in a tin foil ball and squeezed it round and hard. Lobster ok. Shrimp good. Waiter good.
Hosted a private event at Ruth's Chris in Lake Mary and beyond terrific food, we enjoyed excellent service! Thank you Lauren, Jake, and Megan for ensuring our group experienced a memorable evening.
Good. Flavored teas were on point. The nuggets and fries were low key bland during my visit but hopefully it’s not an ongoing thing.
Definitely my favorite boba shop in Orlando.
That’s my son and mine favorite place. The waffles and crab chips and Taro boba tea are very delicious. And the ladies at the front are very nice

Love the view to the airport, they have an excellent selection of options and one of the best flavors in Orlando. Their selection of ice creams was soo yummy too! Been here a couple times and their quality is always top notch

Was going to go to my gym and then I saw this adorable Boba Place Service is fantastic very airy and roomie environment The Mango Slushy & Peach Pearls: A great flavor profile; the two fruits complement each other well without one overpowering the other. Viral Treats: They are stocked up on the trending fruit ice cream crunch items and have a wide variety of ice cream sandwiches and assorted frozen desserts. Popcorn Chicken: This might be a "skip" for those who prefer a higher breading-to-meat ratio. The spicy version is very meat-heavy, which wasn't quite the expected texture compared to more traditional, heavily-battered versions. Parking: Plenty of free parking available. Location: Situated in a great, accessible area.

I’ve been wanting to come here for many years and I’ve never been and I finally came today! Food and drink is excellent, customer service? Terrible. I will definitely be back because food and prices are amazing I told the cashier it was my first time there, she didn’t at all bother to explain to me how the menu worked, the menu is overwhelming but the point of her is to assist customers, she stocked, chatted with other employees and pressed buttons on the computer as I ordered. And she answered “it’s not a lot, like 70 cents” and I said “it’s a percentage per dollar, I’m looking for a percent” The manager/owner was next to me and I asked “are you the owner?” And asked her. The answer is 3%. Just in case bring cash so you can pay less, and not support those corporations take charge more. I spent $35 for 2 drinks 2 baos and corn nuggets

I wish them luck and prosperity in there business..
The tea was made quickly and tasted great.

Cute place. I happened to notice it while looking for UPS next door and decided to pop in. They have those viral fruit icecream/sorbet things and I tried one. It was better than I expected (lemon) and my honeydew milk tea was perfect.

Place was pretty run down, and was blasting metal music. Went there to get some work done and it was impossible to focus. Workers seemed bored and uninterested, not nice at all. I got a poke bowl, and for $15, it was barley filled up and tasted like the ingredients were days old.

Sadly, we won't be back unless we happen to come to Orlando again. If so, we will make this a destination .

First time visiting and I was looking for a quick and small bite, I came in and ordered some hazelnut milk tea and pork bao buns.
