I actually had to cut it up to eat it, which I didn’t mind at all. Overall, it was a good experience, and I’d definitely consider coming back.

Amazing food and atmosphere! Large menu and great workers who were all very kind and helpful. Our server was awesome and so was the food. During service dancers go on stage to dance, play music, and perform. Super cool place and stands out!
Had a wonderful time here for dinner. Chips and salsa appetizer was great and the Avocado margarita was just phenomenal. Try it out before you go on the Three Caballeros ride.
HORRIBLE PLACE. Automatic 20% tip without ever telling you, added onto check. Very bad and slow service. Dont go here

Marco was a fantastic server. We sat down in a section that was empty, by the end of our dinner he had 5 tables and his service never faulted. He definitely deserves recognition and is manager material.

Worst service ever at a disney restaurant. Ordered drinks, appetizer and entrees. Kept a menu to order another drink. Over half finished with entrees had to go ask for more water. Wasn't asked about another beverage, until we were done. Service at disney is usually outstanding, but today's meal was not.
Incorrect orders, missing orders, had to go find silverware for those who's food did come out. Definitely go someplace else.
Great food. Our server Mauricio was awesome. Very attentive.

Nice looking restaurant but terrible service. Was not served until 5:40 despite a 5 pm reservation that we were early for. Did not eat until 6:20, cutting significantly into park time. One of our table members was served fried food after requesting grilled and waiting 40 minutes for food. Food is overpriced. A discount was then offered and not given on the final receipts. You are better off eating anywhere else.

Spacing in the restaurant is a little tight, so it was a bit difficult to navigate a wheelchair in. The staff was patient though, and made it work for us. They were kind and great to talk to. The food was unbelievably fresh, the elote appetizer stole the show. You can’t go wrong with anything you order though. Guacamole was also great, as well as the tacos. I left the restaurant already thinking “I can’t wait to come back!” Some people were waiting for a table near the water, but the atmosphere is nice anywhere in the restaurant.

Overall this place was pretty good. Not the best thing ever but better than outside. The wait staff was attentive, but failed to recognize a birthday until we were already leaving. We were sat right next to the kitchen so it was pretty loud. The food came out fast and was very good.

We dined at San Angel during our Epcot visit on May 21st. Danny was an amazing server, so polite and charismatic. The manager, didn’t get his name possibly Julio, was amazing!!! He not only gave our grandson corn because it was his favorite but he also noticed the birthday button on his backpack. He came back with stickers, a birthday card AND ice cream with a candle. He and Danny sang happy birthday! I would 2000 percent recommend this restaurant. This is what “Be our Guest” is all about! Julio should teach a course!

I mostly want to compliment the wait staff. The service here was outstanding. They were so kind, so helpful. They truly went above and beyond. The food was good. The venue was gorgeous and truly exceptional, but what really made the meal was the overall sense of kindness

Primera vez que como en ese restaurante de Disney, no esperamos mucho tiempo ,teníamos reserva . Nos comimos unas tostadas de pollo estaban ricas , el guacamole con chicharrón también muy bueno y unas costillas de maíz 🌽 super buenas, los ur no me gustó mucho fue el queso fundido, creo que le faltó derretirlo mucho mas pero no por eso le voy a quitar la buena labor del personal y la experiencia vivida volvería de nuevo .
Ricky was great

By far the best experience that me and my wife had between all 4 parks / resorts at our stay at Disney world, our server Wendy was amazing. Made sure we were taken care of and felt welcomed the entire time we were there. It was our last stop before we went home and we had a great time and it was a great way to end our trip

A nice restaurant, definitely overpriced which is expected, but a nice experience! I know some seats suck depending on where you’re sat, but the seats next to the ride are wonderful. Our service was wonderful and they celebrated a birthday well. The food could have been better, but we were happy.

Very unaccommodating. Made me wake my sleeping child to seat us, instead of letting us bring in her stroller. Wouldn't even push back our reservation to accommodate us, told us we'd have to come back and wait in the walk up line. (When they had posted that they weren't even accepting walk ups). Won't be coming back here again.

We got the chips and cheese dip for the appetizer, it was good. I got the Tacos, the tacos were good and my daughter got the chicken strips and she said she liked it. But the service wasn't good. We had to wait close to 15 min for just a drink refill.

Se pidió carne y pollo y todo los platos vinieron quemado se habló con el personal y decían que eso venía asi desde cuando la carne y el pollo se comen quemado no volveré a ir mas pues vivo en orlando lo único que le doy 5 estrella es a la persona que nos atendió ni comida ni local ni ambiente

We were really excited to dine at San Angel Inn during our family trip to Epcot, but unfortunately, this ended up being one of the most disappointing dining experiences we’ve had at Disney. From the beginning, the service was very poor. We waited about 20 minutes before our server even came to our table. When he finally did, his attitude made us feel like we were an inconvenience rather than welcomed guests. As a party of eight—celebrating time together as a family—and with my dad spending a significant amount on this dinner, we expected a much higher level of service. The experience only went downhill from there. Our food came out cold and was honestly not good at all, which was surprising given Disney’s usual standards. We chose not to complain at the time, hoping things might improve, but our server never returned to check on us. We had planned to order additional drinks, but never even had the chance because we couldn’t find him. Eventually, we paid our check and left feeling frustrated and disappointed. Our family loves Disney and has been visiting every other year for several years, which made this experience even more upsetting. Unfortunately, based on this visit, we will not be returning to San Angel Inn.

The only good thing about this restaurant was the service. We had the shrimp and steak tacos, chips with queso and salsa, 2 drinks and a diet coke. Everything was bland and the drinks were watered down. For 18.50 a drink, they should be fresh and the correct pours done. The shrimp tacos were tiny and tasteless with tiny bite sized tortillas to go with them. Husband said the steak was under seasoned. Even the plantains that came with the tacos were under seasoned. The queso was tasteless as well. The salsa was ok. For 140 dollars, I expected better. The only saving grace was the wait time. There hardly was any and now we know why. Won't return.

Absolutely the worst disney dining experience of my life. Even the water tasted like it was from the ride itself. The margarita flight was barely drinkable. I have had a better steak for breakfast at a waffle house. Disney should close this place asap. Do yourself a favor and avoid at all costs. $54 for a steak and enchiladas that were hard a a rock. DO BETTER DISNEY!

I’m rating the atmosphere one star because we were sat behind a huge cement wall that blocked all views of anything besides the bathroom. It’s the place they seat people who don’t have a reservation. (We waited 30 minutes on the waitlist) They told us that when I asked if I could move to one of the 20 open tables with a view of the cenote. I then asked if I could just move to the table next to ours (still in the no-reservation shame corner) and she said no because that was a table for six and there were only three of us. By the time we finished our horrible food (more on that below), all of the empty 20 tables with a view, plus the one next to ours, were still empty. As far as the food goes - just don’t. Ribeye tacos were served cold, in one solid lump of cold cheese, in a “skillet”. Husband got the fish tacos and immediately sent them back. Cold, overcooked fish sticks in a corn tortilla. Daughter got the chicken enchilada which came out hot and she said they were “fine”. Do not recommend at all.

I’ve lived in Orlando a very long time and have been to Epcot dozens of times. Yet I have never made a reservation for a restaurant. That was a mistake. San Angel Inn is peak Mexican cuisine. The service was second to none. We had the ribeye tacos and the slow roasted pork. Everything was delicious. I would definitely recommend this place if you are planning a visit to Epcot. Definitely make a reservation.
shrimp cocktail
The food was awesome! The drinks were very good and strong! The ambiance is really cool!

The food and drinks were not worth it. The kids meals were just meet on a soft shell with white rice. No sauce, no lettuce, no additions. My fish tacos the fish was way over cooked. And i ordered a traditional margarita which was way too sweet and undrinkable. So I ordered a Paloma thinking that couldn’t be bad and it was equally as awful. And I understand that it’s Disney but not even an option to order chips and salad as a starter was crazy. I guess these girls had better things to do. Other than that it was great.
Fun place with great food! Very kid friendly atmosphere. The staff is amazing and Sunday karaoke is so much fun!
great sports bar with excellent food. reasonable pricing and a fun locals vibe. Beth and the rest of the staff always friendly and welcoming.
If you go to eat, may I suggest that you ask for Christina. She’s very attentive and you never have to worry about waiting for a refill of your drink or anything else you might need.
Server was friendly and food was good.

Fantastic experience with my takeout order from Recovery Sports Grill. I ordered the fried fish sandwich on brioche, turkey club, crispy chicken sandwich on brioche, wings, onion rings, coleslaw, and sides. Everything was on point. The wings were cooked perfectly, the sandwiches were excellent, and the onion rings and coleslaw especially stood out. The atmosphere is exactly what a sports grill should be. Great setup, cool bar, inside and patio service, and sports memorabilia all over the place. I especially loved seeing local hometown athletes recognized on the walls. The team was friendly, and the lovely host who oversaw my takeout order did a great job making sure everything was handled properly. As a Port St. Lucie resident and someone who works in the hospitality industry, I really appreciate having a place like this locally. They have nightly specials and an extended happy hour, which is a big plus. My only suggestion would be staying open later on weekends. A 1 AM last call would give local hospitality professionals somewhere to unwind without having to drive to Stuart, and it would help spread the late-night business beyond Miller’s. Overall, fantastic food, great atmosphere, and a place I’ll definitely be back to.
Over rated all the way around.

I stayed for three nights in two rooms on the fourth floor of the 1000 building, where I experienced an early check-in with a friendly staff member. It seems that the 1000 and 2000 buildings might be older or less maintained. The property has 24-hour security, including a front gate and a nighttime patrol, which is reassuring. My room was quite basic, and I found the bed to be hard and uncomfortable. The staff used regular flat sheets instead of properly sized fitted sheets, which made for a poor sleeping experience. The pillows were flat and uninviting, and the air conditioning unit made a squealing noise that disrupted my sleep. Additionally, the door was difficult to open with the room key, and children running in the hallways added to the noise. The ice machine was inconveniently located far from my room, and while the pool was decent, the scattered chairs made it less enjoyable. The biggest issue was the elevators, which were out of order throughout my stay, making it a struggle to carry luggage up to the fourth floor. Overall, I had hoped to enjoy my time here, but I don't think I will return. Security staff were nice. Housekeeping staff were distant and unapproachable.

NO lo recomiendo para nada, estuvimos hace un par de semanas y dejaron salir al perro de mi hija, que es de apoyo emocional Dog Service y lo dejaron escapar, no nos quieren mostrar las cámaras, solo nos dieron una fotos donde se 6 personas alrededor del perro, que solo pesa 5 pounds, estamos devastadas, mi hija está en un estado depresivo, no tenemos respuesta de ellos para nada y eso que se hacen llamar Pet Friendly, las fotos solo demuestran la incapacidad del staff, no hablan ni inglés ni español, no tienen idea por lo que estamos pasando en estos momentos, nosotras lo único que queremos es transparencia y saber realmente que fue lo que pasó y se niegan a mostrar las cámaras, muy claramente dicen que abren las habitaciones al tercer o cuarto día para limpiar, pero el de nosotras lo abrieron y miren por la desgracia que estamos pasando, le preguntamos al staff quien abrió la habitación para saber lo que pasó y ni siquiera hablan inglés, me parece una gran irresponsabilidad de parte de todo el hotel, hasta de sus managers ya que hablamos con ellos y no responden por nada, solo nos dijeron que nos podían regalar 5 días gratis dentro de 2 años, la verdad que no tienen vergüenza, acaso 5 días gratis compensan con el dolor que estamos atravesando, esto es muy duro y me voy a encargar de desprestigiarlos si es posible a nivel nacional, porque lo que hicieron no tiene perdón, nunca vamos a olvidar su irresponsabilidad, así olviden a este hotel y mucho menos lleven a sus perritos…

I unfortunately had one of the most distressing experiences at this hotel. I traveled with my service/emotional support dog, and on Saturday morning, while I was away from the property for a short time, the hotel staff called to inform me that my dog had escaped from my room. It has now been over two weeks, and I am still desperately searching for him. Despite repeatedly reaching out to corporate for answers, they have refused to provide a full explanation or release the security footage surrounding the incident. If you are traveling with your beloved pet, I strongly encourage you to reconsider staying at this property. I would never want another family to go through the heartbreak that mine is experiencing.

I stayed from June 19th–21st and this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve had. The lobby looked nice at first, but once I got to my room everything changed. The room smelled bad, the bathtub was filthy, and they had a tub mat sitting in the shower which made me question how clean everything really was. There wasn’t even a fitted sheet properly on the bed. Saturday morning I woke up and found a roach on the shower curtain. On top of that, I almost hurt my toe walking into the bathroom because of how awkward and unsafe the bathroom door setup is. The shower itself was another issue—I almost slipped and fell twice because the tub sits higher than the bathroom floor, making it feel unsafe getting in and out. To make things worse, on my last day the elevator was broken and I was staying on the 3rd floor while carrying a lot of bags down. Garbage cans were overflowing, the entire hotel had an unpleasant smell, and breakfast wasn’t even included—you had to pay extra. They did offer to move our room, but by that point we already had everything unpacked and honestly, the room should have been clean and ready before guests check in. I’ve worked in hotels for years and I’ve never experienced conditions like this. For the price paid, this stay did not live up to expectations at all. I would not stay here again and would not recommend it

The hotel was nice, gated security gave the extra comfort. I never seen wooden keycard which was pretty cool. On the downside, the breakfast buffet food was cold, possibly due to my early arrival. If you're sensitive to noise, I’d recommend requesting a room away from the highway.

The rooms are fine. Not 3 or 3 1/2 stars fine but fine. The location is good and the in and out is convenient, but the undisclosed fees are unacceptable. I had two Amazon deliveries made during my stay. Unbeknownst to me for some unknown reason, the delivered them in 5 packages. And also unbeknownst to be the hotel CHARGES $5 per package delivered to guests. (They didn't even deliver you go to the front desk and get them). So, they charged me $30 for me to walk down to the front desk to pickup my packages. A charge that wasn't disclosed to me when I booked. As I travel a lot for work and for personal getaways, I have stayed at literally hundreds of hotels and NEVER been charged a few like this. And that it was undisclosed to me at the time of booking is NOT RIGHT. Although the staff was politite, when asked about it they offered to do nothing rather just repeating a talking point that management had clearly coached them to give. These sorts of fees undisclosed at the time of booking (or check check-in) are unacceptable and just another way to bilk guests out of their hard earned money. Heck, Amazon doesn't charge for shipping sometimes hundreds of miles and Rosen decides they can charge me an undisclosed fee for me having the privilege of me walking across the property myself to get packages? Tsk tsk.

I booked the hotel on Priceline and the reviews showed a decent value for this hotel located near Disney property and not far from Universal and SeaWorld. Check-in was fairly quick. Llegamos al hotel sobre las 23:00, el mismo día en que teníamos previsto hacer el check-in, después de un largo día en un parque de atracciones. Al entrar en la habitación que nos asignaron, nos encontramos con que no estaba correctamente limpia: había pelos en el baño, jabón usado, restos de pasta de dientes y la alfombra de la habitación tenía un olor extraño. Además, tras estar unos 20 minutos tumbado en la cama, empecé a notar picaduras por todo el cuerpo. Por el tipo de reacción y la situación de la habitación, parecía que en la cama podía haber chinches o pulgas. Por este motivo, no nos sentimos cómodos ni seguros quedándonos allí y tuvimos que marcharnos de madrugada para buscar otro alojamiento, con el inconveniente y el sobrecoste que supone reservar en el último momento en Orlando. Nos explicaron que la limpieza de habitaciones se realiza cada cuatro días y, en nuestro caso, no había personal responsable disponible por la noche para gestionar adecuadamente la incidencia. Solo había atención por parte del personal de seguridad, a quien sí quiero agradecer su ayuda, ya que intentó asistirnos y nos facilitó una crema con corticoides para las picaduras. También nos comentaron que, al tratarse de un alojamiento que admite mascotas, a veces pueden ocurrir este tipo de situaciones. En mi opinión, precisamente por admitir animales, la limpieza y la desinsectación deberían ser especialmente rigurosas, especialmente antes de entregar una habitación a nuevos huéspedes el día…

My server came back with another and said that she had tried the other and that it had been done incorrectly so she remade it so i could try it how it was suppose to be. This second attempt was SO GOOD. I appreciated her remaking it as I had friends who raved about this drink and I really wanted to try it. My husband and I got the sea bass over the seasonal risotto in a lobster sherry sauce. The risotto and the sauce were great, but the sea bass was very fishy. We ate it as we had tickets to see a play and I didnt have time for a redo, but It definitely killed the experience for me. Hence the 3 stars. I hear people love the chicken and the pork chop so maybe we will go back and try that, but the seafood route disappointed us.

My favorite pizza is their “Hot Honey Roni Pizza,” hands down the best one in Orlando. They’ve perfected it: cup-and-char pepperoni, the perfect ratio of mozzarella and fresh mozzarella, finished with a drizzle of hot honey. Some of my other go-to dishes are the Penne Vodka and the Parmigiana. Seriously, once you come to Proccolino’s, you’ll be coming back again and again.

Absolutely terrible experience at The Crackin Crab in Cocoa Beach. We were seated and never even got water. Instead of taking our order like a normal restaurant, we were told to order online while sitting inside the establishment. What’s the point of having servers if customers are expected to do everything themselves? The staff did virtually nothing, yet we’re still expected to pay restaurant prices and tip for service that wasn’t provided. To make matters worse, they didn’t have crab crackers. Apparently they had some type of substitute, but those were out too. How does a seafood restaurant run out of basic tools needed to eat crab? That’s like a pizza place running out of pizza cutters. They also didn’t have metal utensils and served our seafood boil in cardboard containers, which made the whole experience feel cheap and unorganized. As if that wasn’t enough, after we finished eating, we were told to clean up our own table. Seriously? At a restaurant? We already had to order our own food online, never received basic service, and now we’re expected to bus our own table too? At that point, it felt more like a cafeteria than a sit-down restaurant. The only positive thing I can say is that the mac and cheese was actually really good. Between the lack of service, missing essentials, being asked to clean up after ourselves, and the overall disorganization, this was one of the most frustrating restaurant experiences I’ve had. I won’t be coming back. 0/5 stars. The mac and cheese…

I have stayed here back in 2022 and was very impressed with the hotel. Now being back a few years later, they have definitely put in the work! The rooms look amazing and so does the lobby area. The person at the front desk was very nice and very helpful! Made our check in process simple and easy. The free breakfast had a nice variety and makes staying here worth it. My only complaints are that there some of the drawers were a bit wonky, and the bus service needs a bit of work. You have to take the hotel bus to one location (atm Hollywood Studios) then transfer to the park you want on disneys transportation (which doesn't start until about 10am). Then to get back, you have to go to their designated pickup spot (ATM EPCOT). Almost better off just driving to the parks at that point unless you plan to go to one of those parks or have park hopping. Other than that, this place is definitely worth the price and a great spot close enough to the parks without the hefty price tag!

The services were excellent; the room was very clean and cool. The service desk personal made my check in and out very pleasant. I will definitely stay with Quality INN by the Parks when I return to Orlando.

The service here is INCREDIBLE. Shout out Tezhana for making our stay. For real. We booked another location by accident and she worked her magic to get us a nice room for the same price. Not the ritz, but for something clean and simple near the parks can’t beat the price 👊
We loved our stay we stayed their due to a vacation getaway and we loved it we had access to the pool and our breakfast was included which food was good.

Overall good experience. Comfortable beds, good space, mostly clean. However, a key selling point was the free shuttle to the parks, and these were less than ideal. It arrived quite late, and the timings were very awkward. They only do one shuttle to Disney at 8:45 am and after that you have to take the monorail or skyliner to the other parks which can take quite a long time. The shuttle also stopped at other hotels and the driving was very rash and dangerous, which was not only unsafe, but added a lot of additional time to the trip. The only shuttle back was at 10:50 pm from Epcot but most parks close at 9:00 pm, so that was also very inconvenient. Overall good location, but the shuttle is not worth it if that is what you are staying for.

Wir können die positiven Bewertungen in keiner Weise nachvollziehen 1.) Zimmer Wir hatten während unseres Aufenthalts zwei Zimmer, da wir seitens des Hotels dazu aufgefordert wurden umzuziehen, da Renovierungs-/Bauarbeiten stattfinden (dazu unten mehr). In beiden Zimmern war so ein übler, beissender Geruch der meiner Meinung nach auch nicht gesundheitsfördernd ist. Es roch nach einer Mischung zwischen Holzpolitur und Schimmel. Die Klimaanlage bzw. die Betten sind so positioniert, sodass die Klimaanlage einen direkt ins Gesicht/auf den Körper bläst. Während die Klimaanlage in Zimmer 1 noch eine normale Betriebslautstärke hatte, war die Klimaanlage in Zimmer 2 verhältlnismäßig laut. In beiden Zimmern herrschte trotz Klimaanlage eine enorme Feuchtigkeit, sodass die ganze Kleidung klamm/feucht war. 2.) Die Bauarbeiten Wenn ein Hotel Bau- oder Renovierungsarbeiten vornimmt und man nur für 3 Tage das Hotel gebucht hat, dann sollte das Hotel in der Lage sein, die Zimmer so zu vergeben, dass den Gästen nicht spontan und ohne Ankündigung beim Einchecken ein Zimmer-Umzug zugemutet werden muss. Es gab keinerlei Entgegenkommen dafür, dass wir aufgrund dieser Fehlplanung unsere ganzen Sachen in das neue Zimmer verfrachten mussten - zudem: Ging das wirklich von unserer begrenzenten Zeit ab, die wir in Orlando verbrachten. Absoluter Abschuss waren dann die Bauarbeiter, die frühmorgens um 7:30 Uhr begonnen haben, einen Maschine über das Hotelgelände zu fahren, welches von einem lauten,…
Muito boa hospedagem, foram 11 noites. Tudo limpo, tratamento cordial e educado. Bom café da manhã.

After a 4-hour trip to get to Orlando, Tezhana made the check-in experience enjoyable. She was pleasant, professional, courteous and informative. After our positive check-in experience, we found the rooms to be nice, clean, recently updated with new furniture and a comfortable bed. My first time visiting The Porch Winter Park, which is an unassuming neighborhood restaurant with great food, good drinks, and alright service. There wasn't one thing on the menu that I didn't like. The drink selection is larger than some of the more upscale restaurants in the area. We had to ask another staff member our server's name, because Bailey didn't introduce herself as latecomers in our party arrived. She was cordial, did the bare minimum, and was a bit off putting as she took several orders, not all, from one table, went to the second table for our group and took everyone's order, and then came back to the first table and took the order of the two Black women in our party. The food arrived quickly, however everything was not hot, as if it was made in batches and sat under a warmer. Although there were no issues with the food, other than its temperature, our server didn't check to ensure everyone was ok when the entrées were served. If anything was needed, it was an ask: more water, another drink, additional napkins. Regardless of my experience, The Porch Winter Park is a place I would recommend. Along with the food and drinks, they have plenty TVs for the sports enthusiasts.

Highly disappointed in the lack of transparency and outright misinformation at this property. I booked a pre-confirmed "Park & Fly" package under a Government Rate for my child. To be absolutely certain, I called the hotel TWICE prior to arrival to confirm the logistics. Both times, agents explicitly assured me everything was set and parking was included. When my child arrived to drop off the car, the staff completely reneged. They claimed the Gov Rate excludes parking packages—a restriction never mentioned on my calls—and forced them to scan a QR code and pay an external third-party vendor $190 out-of-pocket on the spot just to avoid being towed before their flight. To resolve the mess created by their front desk, I had to burn 34,000 Bonvoy points for a last-minute replacement stay. As a Gold Elite member and Business cardholder, I expect a brand like Marriott to honor the verbal agreements made by their staff. Total service failure and at worst a bait-and-switch at best poorly trained staff. Avoid this property if you are trying to utilize a Park & Fly package.

On the positive side, check-in was quick, even at night. The 24-Hour airport shuttle is also very helpful- it got me to the airport promptly at 2:30 AM, and the staff were helpful. The hotel is well-located, and close to not only the airport, but also to a variety of shops, restaurants, and even a movie theater. Unfortunately, the upkeep within the room was not to the level I would’ve liked to see at a property within the Marriott portfolio. Upon opening the room door, you are greeted by a small fixture with a microwave. The microwave, however, was filthy, with dried food residue caked on the rotating plate portion. To the side of that is a sofa bed, which looked in solid shape, as well as a desk. I noticed that the desk surface was slightly chipped, and the lamp had spots that would’ve been remarkably easy to remove. The TV stand was also heavily chipped, and just not solid presentation overall. On the mattress- which was comfortable and (mostly) clean, was one weird black mark under the sheets. Lastly, the bathroom presented some discomfort as well, with walls partially stained red, a messy interior of the toilet, a very scuffed-up shower head, and more chipped paint on the edges of the wall. The bathtub also didn’t fill up particularly quickly.…

I rarely write reviews, but our experience with SpringHill Suites by Marriott Orlando Lake Buena Vista South was so frustrating and disappointing that I feel obligated to warn others. We booked a king suite with a sofa bed for our family of 5 (including two small children and baby) for April 10–11, reserving three days in advance. We also paid extra for parking and a late checkout (2 PM), totaling about $240. We specifically chose this hotel because of its amenities, hot breakfast, and a previous wonderful experience at SpringHill Suites by Marriott Fayetteville North Carolina. On the day of our reservation, while we were out enjoying our vacation, we received an email from the hotel stating they had overbooked and would be “accommodating” us elsewhere. No prior notice, no courtesy call just a same day email completely disrupting our plans. We immediately called, already stressed, only to find out we were being sent to Hampton Inn Orlando Lake Buena Vista South. This was not an equivalent accommodation; not even close. From the moment we walked into the Hampton Inn, there was a noticeable moldy smell, and the property felt outdated and poorly maintained. We were initially given the wrong room (two queen beds instead of the king suite we paid for), and getting this corrected required multiple back-and-forth trips. To make matters worse, there’s no direct walkway between the two properties, so we had to cut through bushes just to get back to the original hotel to sort things…

I give it back to them. The manager apologizes. She seemed to be very nice. I get home and I have a plane burger look up with a smasher burger has on it. This burger is just meat, cheese, bacon on the side in a pile of pickles, where is the lettuce tomato onion that makes the Burger if this was her first attempt OK I see but the third attempt and they still give me a plane cold nasty burger is beyond me and I’m not one to complain I k ow what having a bad day is or just a mistake but this is sad and ridiculous to be honest they should be ashamed 18 dollar meal how 3 orders later still wrong it’s just sad and honestly pathetic

We waited and waited in the drive through and no one took our order. After awhile we thought maybe the speaker was broken. We pulled up to the windows and saw 3 if the employees just standing inside, laughing and talking. One of them looked at us waiting and then turned away. We went just around the corner to Steak N Shake snd enjoyed an excellent shake with excellent service.
Some of the best service I've ever gotten at a fast food joint. Great team. Everything was fresh, and it was 30 min before close. Wish I could have tipped on card.

I ordered a sonic burger with chil tots. I paid extra for the chili and literally got maybe a half of teaspoon of chili and small order of tots instead of large. I called the store and the girl said that I would have to contact DoorDash for a refund. What they didn’t screw up my order sonic did. I hung up never will I order from there again
Everything great

Ordered watch 4 other people order and get their food. We waited for 30min. Asked a server where our order was, she checked and brought out cold food. We reordered, waited 10 more minutes, still no food. Asked for a manager, server came back and said they refunded the food. We were very disappointed.

Sat at one of the screens for several minutes and no one came out so i decided to go to the drive-through to pick up a DoorDash order which was just one vanilla shake. When I told the employee the name for the order, she directed me to go back to a stall and I told her I had already been waiting for 10 minutes. She then told me that it was probably broken and still wanted me to go back to a stall and push the button again because her handing us the shake was slowing down her drive-through time and her general manager would tell me the same thing I told her to go get the general manager who came to the window and asked what the order name was. I gave her the name and she proceeded to go grab the shake. Once she handed me the shake, the general manager told me "next time go back around like the person said to" and shut the Window in my face and walked off. Rude, no customer service skills. Unprofessional employees and management. Friday, March 6 around 9 PM, 2026. Trifling wanna be important, must be slow, no people skills having child. So I took my time accepting the order in the drive through. Do better.

We were in town to celebrate a special occasion! Our time at Squid Lips was enjoyed by all! Thank you Chef for our wonderful meal and of course our realtor Jake who introduced us to this local spot! #supportlocal @trutraveler
A great place on the beach! Kids played on the beach and pier while the food was made fresh. Food was excellent, prices were great, and overall it was a complete win.

A must for anyone who travels to the area. Crab burger is amazing. They also have a coconut encrusted fish sandwich that is to die for and out of this world. My family and I ate here twice in one week on our vacation. I can't wait to go back again.

My family ate here on Friday and the food wasn’t that great. My mom got the fried fish sandwich and got terrible food poisoning after. She called the following day to inform them, for the safety of others and the manager was not pleasant and argumentative on the phone and just said they would make a report.

I would start by saying JoJo, our server was very sweet. We were here a few weeks ago and had the same dish, which included shrimp. last time the shrimp was firm and very tasty. This visit and the shrimp was mushy and had no flavor. If this was my first visit, I would not be back.
I love their happy hour that starts at 3 o’clock and I always get a dozen raw oysters which are $.99 apiece and the peel and eat shrimp which is $.69 a piece incredibly delicious!!!

The price of food is highly disappointing. The scallops was $21. They didn’t even taste that great they should’ve at least use a full piece of bacon… I guess I’m a fatty expecting a little bit. More service was fine. Prices are what killing me but welcome to the New World.

It's always a great vibe at squidz (as I call it) it was trivia night and those guys & gals that run it are really good at their job! Dare I say, charismatic? 😆 It helped that I knew the answers to so many questions at first, and I was beginning to think had some hidden genius inside me all these years, alas it was not true lol. Very fun none the less, great service, smiles all around!
Amazing food and service!

Love this place. Have no problem making the 2 hour trip just for lunch with friends here. The drinks are strong the food is fresh and the portions are worth it on its own. The staff is super friendly. The muscles and peel and eats are to die for. Never had a bad experience. To spend less 100 for drinks and food for 3 people is almost unheard of nowadays and with this level of quality is a real gem.
Beautiful view and good eats. Worth taking some time to enjoy in a Sunday

Worst food ive ever had with at that price point!!!!! Ive had better fish at a Dennys. Mahi was over cooked and super tough, the mango salsa was barely salsa and the mango wasnt even ripe. It literally felt and tasted like a low end cheap restaurant, worse than Dennys.
Good 👍
Good seafood! We also went for prime rib night and it was great!
Always Have a Great Time .The Atmosphere is Very Tropical and Food is Good
Great local setting on the water. Oysters were knock your socks off and the peel and eat shrimp was very good as well. The setting outside stole the show.
My first time trying Ethiopian cuisine and I’m definitely coming back! I ordered the veggie combination and lentil samosa and every last bite exploded with amazing flavors!
Great food and atmosphere. Owner was extremely kind, courteous, and went the extra mile for his customers.
Absolutely delicious food, beautiful setting, welcoming atmosphere, and reasonably priced.
Amazing service and food. They realized they put a group tip and that I had tipped on top, they resolved it. Highly recommended

We love Ethipian food and have tried many places. Food here pretty good. Solid. Serving size is not great. Typically we’d leave full after a veggie platter in Ethiopian spots in DC, for less. $50 for 2, and extra for adequate injera, servings should have been a bit larger, in my opinion.
The service and food are immaculate! Love this place
Amazing atmosphere, and owner was fun and nice. The meat was also seasoned and roasted perfectly.

Never had Ethiopian food before. Our waiter, Abraham was the perfect host, and very helpful, and funny. We had Coffee with the appetizer (Samosa) and then the Selam veggie special. Hey, if you can eat ribs or chicken with your fingers, this was just as good, wrapping food up in really cool spongy bread. We capped it off with tea. The coffee and tea spices were outstanding. The food had tasty spices and was incredible. The mushroom dish was my favorite. If I am going back to Orlando, I will be making Selam a goto place.
Excellent quality dishes! If you are a fan of zesty flavors, you will love the lamb tibia. Chuni and Abraham are very friendly and family like. Thank you for a delicious dinner :)

My wife and I ate here for dinner. It was the first time we have eaten at an Ethiopian restaurant. The food was phenomenal and the service was excellent. Next time we return to Orlando we will be eating here again.
Great customer service. Amazing food 😋, great atmosphere 👌

This is a must stop while in Orlando! The service was spectacular and the food is to die for. The server took his time explaining every dish and was very happy to serve. We have been to several Ethiopian restaurants in Minnesota and Colorado and this one was the best! Will come back for sure!
Excellent in every way! So thankful and glad we tried this place. The service is great, the food is extremely tasty, and the ambiance is very authentic. I definitely recommend! 🌸
The food was absolutely delicious! If I was local I'd be there all the time!
I’ve had a lot of Ethiopian food, and this is really great stuff! I highly recommend! Everyone will find something they like. You feel healthy and nourished afterwards too!
Good Ethiopian food. Great service. Thank you Fekare.

We're tourists here and wanted to try a local spot. I stumbled across a recommendation for this one and I'm so glad that we went! Both the good and service were perfect. We were looking for a smaller lunch so we split the sampler appetizer and each got a mango drink. Everything was great but I strongly recommend the lentil samosas and mango drink to anyone. Some of the best food I've ever had. We were both full and happy as we left.

one of the best meals i've had recently. the owner and staff overall were super friendly and wonderful. we were sitting at the table and already planning our next visit. we got the meat and vegetable platter and it was amazing. when a restaurant has good vegetarian food, it's a good sign. and the vegetarian food on the platter was exceptional. the coffee service also amazing, it was one of the highlights.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I visited this restaurant by myself and had an amazing experience. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with genuine hospitality and made to feel comfortable. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. Every bite reflected the authenticity and care that goes into Ethiopian cuisine. The staff was friendly, attentive, and happy to explain the menu, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The atmosphere was warm, relaxing, and perfect for dining alone. I never felt rushed and was able to fully enjoy the meal. If you’re looking for authentic Ethiopian food and excellent service, I highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely be coming back the next time I’m in the area.
The food was excellent and so was the service!
Food was good quality and excellent in taste. Loved our first time and we will be back again soon!

We live in Tampa, but whenever we visit Orlando, Selam Cuisine is always on our list. It’s my wife’s all-time favorite! We had a wonderful family dinner there. The food was incredibly authentic — the best Ethiopian dishes we’ve tasted. The injera was perfect, and the stews were rich and flavorful. Naomi, our daughter, loved it too. Our favorite was the “Cornis” an amazing meat combo that’s a true meat lover’s dream. So tender, well-seasoned, and packed with flavor! The ambiance is warm and welcoming, like a cozy home. The staff were friendly, loving, and made us feel like family. Prices are very reasonable for the quality. Highly recommend!

The food was pretty good but stood out was the lackluster service. We waited at least 10 minutes before the waiter came to greet us. They initially tried to seat us at a table that was under a section of the ceiling that was leaking. They moved us two tables over but didn't do anything to address the leak. Sat someone later there, they just moved the table a few inches so it wasn't directly in the line of fire. Maybe because we didn't have reservations and we're seated in the bar, but we didn't see our waiter too often. Felt like we were an after thought. I'm in Orlando about once a month and my friend likes the food so we may go back again and give them another chance.

One of my most favorite sushi restaurants. I always go out of my way to come here when I’m in orlando. The food is exceptional and they also make wonderful cocktails! The staff is always super friendly.

We’ve been visiting Seito for years (!!) and somehow only now decided to leave a review 😁 The food is always phenomenal, but this time I especially wanted to mention our server, Marina K. She was so attentive - she remembered us and our order! She was also funny, easy to talk to, and made the whole experience better!! Hopefully next time Marina K. will be also there. This time, Marina recommended that we try the happy hour menu, and I’m so glad we did. The burger was delicious, and the potatoes were seriously the best. After that, we went back to our regular order 🤣 We also had the ube cheesecake again, and it is honestly the best. Such a tasty twist on a classic cheesecake, and the boba pearls are so on point. We were hesitant about trying dessert at first last time, but apparently we wasted a lot of time not ordering it sooner 🤣 To sum it up: everything was great as usual. Amazing food, great service, and always a wonderful experience!
The food is delicious!
The food was so good and our server was the best.

Went for our anniversary and had the tuna tower and miso soup. The sushi quality was excellent . This is one of my wife's top go to places for sushi in orlando. The service was appropriately attentive and considerate. I definitely recommend the restaurant however pricing can be a bit higher so plan to spend more if you plan to eat here.
Flavorful menu. Great Sushi! Best Ube Cheesecake, it’s a must have!

Seito Sand Lake did not disappoint! Food and service were both high quality. Griffin did an amazing job with our table and knew the menu front to back. No rushed service and great recommendations. Will definitely return!
Excellent service & the food was amazing. I had the tuna sashimi it was incredibly fresh , the lobster dumplings were amazing as well. Such a delightful place .

Seito Sushi on Sand Lake delivered an exceptional dining experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely outstanding—beautifully prepared, fresh, and full of flavor. What impressed me even more was how the staff went above and beyond to accommodate the dietary restrictions within our group. Their attention to detail and willingness to ensure everyone had an amazing meal did not go unnoticed. The service was impeccable—attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming without ever feeling rushed. Dining in the Cherry Blossom Room made the evening even more memorable. It was quiet, intimate, and created the perfect atmosphere for a special night out. Every detail came together to make this an unforgettable experience. My favorites were the jalapeno business roll the truffle miso soup and garlic fried rice.

A super satisfying experience with amazing quality in a modern yet intimate space. The ochazuke was a highlight - sea bass over fragrant mushroom dashi with a subtle mirin note and crispy onigiri for contrast. The chutoro crudo was rich and flavorful, and the salmon tower was a great shareable dish with salmon in different styles. Overall, a very satisfying meal that really blew me away with its quality and execution.

The place is pretty nice and the atmosphere is amazing. Service was great and the restaurant was very clean. Food was good but nothing super amazing… everything was well prepared and look very good… I really wanted to be impressed with the food because I have heard good things about this restaurant… I mean the food was tasty and good… but nothing crazy. Oh I forgot to mention that the green tea ice cream did not have a nice flavor… actually it was kind of lacking a flavor and my daughter did not even eat her strawberry ice cream… she did not like the taste of it.
An extraordinary restaurant—I think it's very reasonably priced. The menu is excellent; it's a top-notch restaurant, and the desserts are the best I've ever tasted... 5 stars.

Amazing food. They have an assortment of offerings and everything I tasted was delicious and the flavors were well balanced. The restaurant itself has beautifully appointed decor. There are different decors depending on the section you sit at. It is a bit difficult to speak due to the loud noise but quite enjoyable.

Freshest fish we've ever had and my wife lived off the bayou. The drinks are super tasty, so come for happy hour before 630. Neat take on edamame with lime garlic. Lounge feel,great food, great service. A little pricey but worth the experience.

The Ora Sake (salmon nigiri) was DIVINE, HEAVEN SENT, AMAZING, MOUTH WATERING, SPECTACULAR.... my only complain is that they don't have a NYC location.... my husband and i came here for vacay and im so glad he found this spot. the ora sake, man so GOOD, i can eat a whole plate if it was meant to be a party size. i can go on for DAYS on how amazing that salmon nigiri is, i wish i had more. PLS OPEN UP IN NYCCC
Delicious food, great vibes, amazing for date night ❤️

Love love love everything about seito. The garlic fried rice and jalapeño business roll are so delicious. I’m a little sad they shorted happy hour from 7 to now 6:30 but besides that, everything is always so good. The KFC bao buns are amazing, I wish they weren’t only on the happy hour menu because they are so good. They always come out steaming hot with the nice crunchy crisp on the chicken.
10/10 this is my favorite spot in Orlando to grab a bite, talk to my favorite mixologist while ordering the best food you can ask for. Definitely worth every penny!

What an outstanding dining experience this turned out to be! Our server Julianna absolutely went above and beyond to ensure that we had a great evening. She was very personable, and had great recommendations! We started with the pork belly buns with were incredible, just the perfect bite! We then shared the crispy tuna rice, which was also really good. We then shared the Hokkaido roll which was light and flavorful. Overall, this is one of our favorite sushi restaurants in Orlando. The atmosphere was very laid-back, the food was delicious, and the service was outstanding! We can't wait to be back again real soon!

The dishes are well thought through and intentional with flavors and presentation. Ambience was nice in private seating area. Regular seating is a little loud. Overall experience was very beneficial and definitely worth it for the prices trust me. There are dishes that I think can be the pinnacle of anyone’s experience at Seito. The Distinguished Gentleman 🥩(a signature roll), combining umami and savory in a refined and refreshing presentation. The Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice🍣, a savory yet fresh pairing that elegantly layers a pristine crunch and chew that melts in your mouth. Finally, The Fries and Caviar 🍟, I believe this dish was the perfect filler between meals that attribute a drop of elegance while still maintaining the addicting qualities of adored crispy fries.
food was so good and the manager Naomi was amazing! can’t wait to come back!
very good though the kitchen service was slow. The waiter incredible and the atmosphere enjoyable. A bit on the expensive side.
Sabores delicados y un ambiente maravilloso. Iría repetidas veces
Terrible service, got the order wrong. Never checked on us for drinks or more food. Hostess(guy) and the bartenders just cold no smile not welcoming. Never coming back here. What a waste of 200$

I took my wife here as part of our five year wedding anniversary celebrations. This place was exceptional! From the food and service to the ambiance and decor, everything was spectacular. Julia was our waitress. She was very knowledgeable of the menu and history of the location. She had great recommendations and her service was excellent! 5/5 experience Also, try the Spicy tuna crispy rice and Ube Cheesecake. Everything was great but those two were the star of the show for us. And If you like smoked whiskey cocktails, just order the Shogun old fashioned, you won’t regret it.
Beautiful sunsets over the Bannana River.
Have to nevermind the smelly restaurant before the restaurant, lol need to sort that out, make it a museum or something if it's not nice as a place to eat. Service was good.

Overall rating of three stars because the food, while good, overpriced for what you’re getting. I’ve paid the same price for quality seafood in other places on the east coast. This place is not where you want to go for great food. Sunset views are likely what’s keeping this place afloat.
Our first stop when going to Cocoa Beach. Seat outside on the patio with a great view. Can be a little warm. Food is good and staff is friendly. Been going here for years.
Great vibe, awesome view and food...

Our 2nd visit with my daughter, her husband and our 2 grandchildren. Excellent visit, friendly staff, fast service, the seafood selections were all good. No problems with Squi to Lips - we will be back again. Awesome - first time to Cocoa Beach and first time to Squid Lips - NOT disappointed. The Conch was good, the Coconut Shrimp was good and the Baked Stuffed Flounder was excellent. No host waiting and no server waiting. Overall, we recommend Squid Lips.
Nice place my favorite bar I been to in coco so far good vibes nice young and older crowd mix

It doesn't look like much from the outside, but the food is excellent. I had the seafood lasagna which was cooked to perfection and the right portion size. Also had coconut shrimp for an appetizer. Again, perfectly fried; sweet and crispy. No need for the dipping sauce.

Just off A1A on the Banana River is a worthy place for lunch and dinner, parking is free, and sure from the outside it is understated. Indoor and outdoor, terrace dining available with beautiful views of the River and setting sun. Dolphin pods and a school of well fed catfish to amuse the kids and adults, feed the fish from the dock. Service was efficient and friendly, place is capable of small to large groups and couple's. Menu is extensive, salads, burgers, seafood, poke bowls, steaks and more all prepared from scratch. Mahi Oak Grilled Fish sandwich was delicious, along with the New Orleans Sea Bass pan sautéed with sweet pecan praline was delicious. Mike’s Key Lime Pie tops off a delicious meal -recommend. Really worth a visit and enjoy good food at reasonable prices, with amazing views. It's going to be on my list of local places to eat for sure.
Kate was our bartender/server Definitely highly recommended She was very helpful & amazingly friendly My wife & I loved the atmosphere & service...will be back soon... Great food !!!
Liked it the crab cakes were an issue. 24$ for one but you get one on a burger for 19$ and the burger alone. 32$ for 2 I skipped it.
All great! Excellent parking, food, service and views for my wife and our 4 kids.

My husband and I tried this out and despite its name this place is amazing! They had some of the most interesting food we’d ever tried, the service was great and the wildlife you can see is so fun. We will 100% be coming back!
The service was great and the views are nice. I bit warm inside and too hot to sit outside. The food was good.
Great food and service. Views to die for!! We saw several groups of dolphins close to sunset!! We will come back.

Restaurant was dirty and smelled but we decided to give it the benefit of the doubt because they could accommodate a large party. First our pretzels came out rock hard. Like to the point they couldn’t even be ripped. The second batch was good. However, we ended up leaving because there were literal BES BUGS crawling out of one of our seats. Told management and they were flabbergasted. Will not return.

We enjoyed a great atmosphere, perfectly prepared meals and the best service and to top it off waterfront sunset views. Carlos, the manager has it dialed in on this establishment. I highly recommend everyone to check it out.

Awesome way to end our trip before heading back to SC. Beautiful river view and great service. Only thing I would add is an open sign out front. We had four cars pull up and ask if the establishment was open when we headed back to the lot. I feel business would benefit from it. We’ll be back.
This place is such a vibe ✨ the food was good, staff is friendly and even with a little rain, everything was perfect. Is a nice place to have a dinner. There’s also some fish food machines
Absolutely amazing food experience I wipe recommend coming here!! The host Petra was so very helpful and made my experience great very pretty girl
Great views. Great service. Food was ok. Better experience in Sebastien.
It was so hot where the bar was it was hard to eat. Won't be going there again. They lost 16 people.
Service was great, food was even better. We had fish n chips basket and the shrimp basket. Both were excellent! If you want seafood this is a must. Menu looks like they have anything though.

The drinks were terrible & the food was just ok. Our waitress couldn't help with any questions we had about food or drinks & was unconcerned when we said our drinks sucked. Beautiful view of the Banana River but everything else was....meh

Thought this would be a great place for dinner...fun atmosphere & water view. Unfortunately that's all it had going for it. Service was extremely slow; we even had to go up to the bar ourselves to get our drinks refilled after waiting a significant amount of time after food was brought out from kitchen. In addition food was not good...my medium rare burger was "soggy" & completely pink making me question if it was even warm. Attempted to eat it without the bottom bun (too wet)but couldn't stomach more than half. Husband's chicken livers were overcooked & completely dried out. He tried to eat them with ketchup, which he doesn't like, because it was the only "sauce" option on the table but couldn't finish his meal either. All guests in our party drinking alcohol (3 of 6) said their beers were warm and by the time our server finally came around again after almost an hour, it was also no longer Happy Hour so prices were no longer discounted. Final straw for us was the women's bathroom 🤢 Definitely would not recommend this SL location & personally will never be back.
It is more of a tourist party place food is average service slow

Soccer on Tvs blasting. Very crowded. Large groups. Service very slow but they were doing their best. Food was lukewarm when brought out but again, very crowded. Would not recommend when a major sporting event is happening. Long lines waiting to get in at 8 pm!
Our family arrived at 6pm and was sat quickly. No one came to take our order so we left after waiting for 15 minutes. Waitstaff seems to cater more to tables with large groups of girls.

I been here a couple times and had a great time and really good memories but it was the first time I went to watch a FIFA game and the first time I got treated so bad. I was with friends waiting for more of us to show up, the server was kicking us out after a 20min wait on the table, refusing to take our order as we waited for the rest of the party to show up. I understand it was a very hectic environment… but the server didn’t need to be so rude saying “ I don’t care what you want to order now it’s been 1hr you guys been waiting and haven’t order anything, leave I’m not serving you guys” clearly we were only there 20min since the Mexico game started… after the Brazilian server treated us so bad for a couple of minutes we decided to leave and avoid a bigger situation since he was getting very mad and yelling at us to leave. I have never receive this treatment at this location and I don’t really want to go back knowing the employees treat customers very disrespectful. I RECOMMEND IF YOU WANT TO WATCH YOUR FIFA GAME CHOOSE ANY OTHER RESTAURANT it’s not worth the way they treat you here!

We were waiting for the remainder of our party to arrive to order food and the server came and told us we had to order or get out. We said give us 5 minutes since we’ve only been there for 20 minutes and even offered to give him his cash tip early (we showed him the cash) and he said he didn’t care very disrespectfully and told us to leave. We tried to explain to him again and order three nachos and he (a Brazilian wearing a Mexico jersey didn’t catch his name) kept being rude and continued to tell us he didn’t care and to get out. I have never been kicked out of an establishment and everyone is fully sober. Never coming back.
Kick my girls out and wouldn’t let them order. So we went to millers instead. 5 star!

We have been to this location before with a large group but tonight’s service was terrible. Our server was Sara H. Everything took forever, took 30 minutes before anyone even received water yet mixed drinks came for some first. Food mediocre at best. Sara was rude, brought chips and queso that was ordered as an appetizer at the end of the meal after the table was already cleared and dinner was over and gave some in our party serious attitude. Awful experience, Chipotle would have been better. There are so many options in Orlando, don’t waste your time here.
Ambiente super rico, buena musica, comida, bebida y personal. Excelente sabado pasamos en familia🩷 Recomendado

Probably one of the craziest bar experiences I have ever had. We had an absolute BLAST here. So much fun. I saw that they're opening one in Daytona Beach, and cannot wait to go again! Definitely check this place out if you're a party person. You won't regret it!
They convince you to get the buy one get one free drink, but if you pay before getting the free drink they forget about it and pretend you are lying about it.
Be careful that they charge for extra service of the tip.. and many of the prices are different, when you get the receipt.....
Had excellent veggie burrito! Attentive service. Family friendly, festive atmosphere.
Last night, a staff member went out of their way to help me, even though they didn’t have to. I truly appreciated their kindness and willingness to help. Thank you!

No mention of happy hour til we left. Would have liked to have food but we had to sit at the bar.... Kids to step over and maneuver around and screeching music for 6pm. More children then adults present which was a surprise to me. Low quality drinks. Just a wash n rinse kinda place

Great energy and family fun, but watch out for the hidden costs! ​We had a nice overall experience here. The atmosphere is incredibly lively, happy, and loud—they had music playing and the soccer (football) game on the screens. It’s also very family-friendly; the service for the kids was great, and they loved getting custom balloon hats made by the staff. ​The service was quick and the food was good. We tried the birria tacos (one with cheese, one without) and the kids had hamburgers. ​Just keep in mind that it is a pricey spot, and you'll want to watch the bill: ​The Drinks: If you get the 2-for-1 drinks, definitely ask about the price upfront so your bill doesn't catch you off guard. We paid $40 for two yard cocktail drinks. They were very good, and you get to keep the yard cup as a souvenir, but it definitely made the total higher than expected. ​Service Charge: They automatically include a tip/service charge on the bill (I believe if your party is over 4 people), so keep that in mind before you pay. ​A great, fun environment, just be prepared for the final total!
Had a great time.

Absolutely ridiculous experience at Señor Frog’s in Orlando. My friends and I booked a table an entire week in advance specifically to watch the Brazil vs. Morocco game, and somehow this place still managed to be completely unprepared. We got there and our table wasn’t even ready. Then we waited forever just to get a waiter to acknowledge us. The TVs kept shutting off during the game, and we literally had to BEG staff multiple times to put the match back on. Imagine reserving a table a week ahead for a soccer game and the restaurant can’t even keep the game on the screens. Completely disorganized, chaotic, and beyond frustrating. The worst part is that nobody seemed to care. We spent the entire night chasing staff down for basic service instead of enjoying the game. If you’re planning to come here for a sports event, don’t bother. They clearly cannot handle it.

The customer service and food were great. However, we arrived a little after 7PM on a Friday evening and found that all nearby parking was either reserved for valet ($20) or paid parking lots ($10). I ended up parking farther away just to check this experience off my vacation list, but the parking situation left a negative impression. When you're already planning to spend money on dining and drinks, the additional parking costs can feel excessive and detract from the overall experience.
Muy bien todo excelente servicio the food was exelent too no complaints at all send blessings to the people that work their look like they really love what they do god bless you all ❤️
We love bringing our employees to the St. Lucie Draft House! The atmosphere is very welcoming and the food is fantastic.

Came in on a Friday evening with a couple friends and had a pretty nice time overall. The place had a relaxed vibe, not too loud, so it was easy to actually talk. We asked the employee, Adam, twice whether the burger was truly gluten-free, and both times he confidently assured us that it was. After we had already finished eating, Adam came back to our table and admitted that the gluten-free protocol had not been followed after all. He offered only a brief "sorry" and, in a very rude and dismissive manner, stated that he had nothing else to say and that he was ending the conversation before walking away. First time visiting Shake Shack on 6/28/26 around 12 PM with my friend, and overall we had a great experience! 🍔😄 I ordered a simple single-patty burger, while my friend went with one of the loaded burgers with all the toppings. 🍔🔥 Both were delicious. 🤤 I have to say the beef was probably some of the best I've had from a fast-casual burger place. 🥩👏 I also really appreciated that they offer the option to have your burger cooked well done, which is something most fast-food restaurants don't offer. ✅ We also ordered chicken nuggets, and they were crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. 🍗✨ Looking back, I wish I had ordered a larger serving because they were that good. 😋 My friend really enjoyed his burger and said all the toppings worked well together. 🌮🧀🥓🍅🥬 We also tried the spicy fries, but they weren't anything special. 🍟🌶️ They seemed like regular fries with spicy seasoning sprinkled on top, so they didn't really stand out. 🤷‍♂️ He ordered the pistachio milkshake as well. 🥤💚 At around $10, it's definitely expensive 💸, but he said it was worth it because it tasted great. 😍 My biggest complaint was the bottled water—$3.50 is just too much for a bottle of water. 💧💲😅 The other downside was the parking. 🚗🅿️ Finding a spot was frustrating, and a lot of people seemed irritated while driving around looking for parking. 😵‍💫 Overall, the food was excellent and definitely worth trying. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We'll be back, but probably at a less busy time to avoid the parking headache. 👍🍔🚗

Barely taste peppermint a waste of 10.00 we ended up throwing it away by no means worth the money or calories!!! Customer service and food was great!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ If you’re looking for the perfect blend of laid-back coastal charm and upscale comfort, look no further than Lowe’s Surf Side Hotel in Orlando. From the moment we pulled up, the vibrant beachside atmosphere and warm welcome from the staff set the tone for what turned out to be an unforgettable stay. The rooms are spacious, beautifully appointed, and spotlessly clean — with stunning views that make waking up an absolute pleasure. We stayed in an ocean-view suite and honestly had a hard time leaving the balcony each morning. The bedding was luxurious, the AC was perfectly maintained, and the attention to detail throughout the room showed real pride in the property. The pool area is a true highlight — well-maintained, never overcrowded, and surrounded by comfortable loungers with attentive poolside service. Whether you want a cocktail delivered to your chair or a quiet spot to read, it delivers on both fronts. Breakfast at the on-site restaurant was exceptional. Fresh ingredients, generous portions, and a staff that genuinely seemed happy to be there. We also enjoyed dinner one evening and were equally impressed — the seafood was fresh and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting. What really sets Lowe’s Surf Side apart is the staff. Every single person we encountered — from the front desk to housekeeping to the restaurant team — was friendly, professional, and went out of their way to make us feel at home. Special shoutout to the concierge team who helped us arrange a…

Extremely clean, very open, and you can tell just how new the resort is. Amenities were on point point. The pool area is excellent. There are plenty of chairs, even if the pool seems a bit crowded. You never had to worry about "chair hogs". The bar area at the pool is very inviting, and the staff is very friendly. I did not partake in the pizza, but those that did said it was very good and surprisingly affordable. There is an open seating area around the grab-and-go food section. There were plenty of food options at breakfast and lunch. You're also a short walk away from a Waffle House. The room itself is very inviting, and the "beach vibe" is done very well without seeming cheesy. The bathrooms in the two-bedroom suites are very typical, with a combo tub and shower. I can see why they did this, as they should have plenty of kids staying in there. The one big surprise that I had was how quiet the resort is. In some of these, you can literally hear your neighbor's conversation. I never had to worry about that. It was a nice change. I would definitely stay here again, and look forward to bringing a large blended family here to enjoy while taking in all of the Universal parks.

O Wi-Fi não funciona na maior parte do parque e a sinalização é horrível, fazendo com que você se perca constantemente. Se chover, o Tram que leva ao estacionamento para de funcionar e você é obrigado a andar a pé. Para completar, o estacionamento só abre depois que o parque já está aberto. Falta de Funcionários e Caos nas Filas: Quase não se vê funcionários nas atrações. A organização das filas fica por conta dos visitantes, o que torna o comportamento de furar fila um padrão no parque. Como ninguém organiza os fluxos, as atrações vão quase vazias várias vezes enquanto as filas estão cheias. Quando você tenta questionar os funcionários sobre qualquer problema, eles batem de frente e nunca assumem o erro. Dos poucos que vimos, o treinamento parece nulo: apenas dois foram cordiais. Negligência Médica: Presenciamos um homem desmaiar na fila. O socorro do parque demorou 20 minutos para chegar. Ele só não ficou sem assistência porque uma enfermeira que estava na fila o socorreu. Problemas com Ingressos e Aplicativos: O sistema digital é péssimo; cada parque do grupo exige um aplicativo diferente e os ingressos não integram direito. Um dos nossos ingressos com data marcada constou…

I am deaf, and my experience at this Regal location on Tuesday was a complete failure of basic accessibility. I purchased tickets online to see Toy Story 5. When I arrived and politely requested a Closed Captioning (CC) device, the staff informed me they couldn't provide one because the tablets had no battery. How am I expected to enjoy a movie without captions? When I asked for a complimentary ticket to return another day when the equipment was actually charged, management refused, claiming "the price is different." While they eventually refunded my ticket, they refused to refund my online booking fee. I am penalized financially because this theater failed to maintain their equipment. Under the ADA, movie theaters must provide functioning auxiliary aids. Denying me access because you forgot to charge your equipment is a violation of my rights. This is America—disabled patrons deserve equal access and fair treatment, not to be turned away and shortchanged. I will be escalating this to corporate. Fix your equipment management immediately.

Misleading label as "allergen friendly". We made a dinner reservation for Sharks Underwater Grill on Saturday, June 13th, because it was highlighted as SeaWorld Orlando's "Designated Allergen Friendly Location." Because of this designation, we thought it would be a safer option than leaving the park early to find food nearby. When we checked in, we asked to speak to the supervisor to discuss my daughter's allergies. We were told to mention this to the waiter. When we met our waiter, he said speaking with the supervisor was not necessary, that he would speak to the chef. We are vegetarian, and nothing on the menu had any sort of labels for allergens or meat, like I would expect in an "allergen-friendly" facility. Once we placed our orders, it took over 30 minutes for the waiter to even clarify if our choices contained the allergens, and ultimately, between avoiding meat, sesame, and tree nuts, the only options available to us and our daughter were salad and french fries. None of the other dishes were customizable to exclude the allergens, and the majority of the food was not prepared in house, as again, I would expect for an "allergen-friendly" facility. It took over an hour to receive our food. We then tried to order dessert, but the chef could not even clarify what dessert might be safe (aside from a bowel of fruit), because things were not made in house. Any true allergen-friendly facility would maintain ingredient lists for all menu items. We will not be dining at this…

The hush puppies were also nearly perfect spheres, making us believe that both the scallops and hush puppies (and probably more) was simply frozen food that was purchased from a distributor. The hush puppies were also a very dark brown with the occasional black -- but once through the outer shell, they tasted OK. The 3rd member of our group tried the linguine with white clam sauce (his favorite) and he gave up after eating about 1/4 of it because it wasn't very good (he loves it at Amici's and Brooklyn Pizza, both in Viera.) Strangely, the french fries were a light, golden brown, so I guess it was POSSIBLE to not over cook fried food. Overall, our visit showed a very sad reflection of what was once one of our favorite places for seafood. Maybe they are better when they are busy, but that's no excuse for the food we received.

Space 220 was easily one of the most memorable dining experiences from our trip to EPCOT. The experience starts before you even sit down with the immersive pre-show and elevator ride that transports you up to the space station, setting the tone for what’s to come. Once inside, the ambiance is incredible. The massive space-themed screens surrounding the restaurant make it genuinely feel like you’re dining somewhere in a galaxy far away, with views of Earth below and spacecraft floating by throughout the meal. The attention to detail really adds to the overall experience and makes it feel much more than just a restaurant. The food lived up to the atmosphere as well. The Wagyu carpaccio was a great way to start the meal, packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The beef rib was tender and hearty, while the kids steak and fries were a hit with the little ones and cooked perfectly. To make the evening even more special, we were celebrating our anniversary and the staff surprised us with complimentary desserts and a candle to celebrate the occasion. It was a thoughtful touch that made an already memorable experience even better. If you’re visiting EPCOT and looking for a dining experience that’s as much about the atmosphere as it is the food, Space 220 is absolutely worth the reservation.

Steakhouse 71 was easily one of the highlights of our Walt Disney World vacation. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere perfectly blended classic Disney nostalgia with an upscale yet comfortable steakhouse experience. The décor pays tribute to the opening era of Walt Disney World while still feeling modern and inviting. The food was exceptional. Every dish was prepared perfectly, from the expertly cooked steak to the incredible side dishes. The flavors were rich without being overwhelming, and the quality of the ingredients was evident in every bite. The famous au gratin potatoes absolutely lived up to the hype, and the desserts were the perfect way to end the meal. What impressed me most was the value. For a Disney signature dining experience, the pricing felt surprisingly reasonable while still delivering high quality food and service. The staff was friendly, attentive, and genuinely focused on making our meal memorable. Service was prompt without feeling rushed, allowing us to relax and enjoy the entire experience. If you're visiting Walt Disney World and looking for an excellent steakhouse with great food, fantastic service, and a unique Disney atmosphere, Steakhouse 71 is a must visit. I would absolutely dine here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for one of the best dining experiences on Disney property.

Dinner at Steakhouse 71 was phenomenal from start to finish. A huge standout was our amazing waiter, Kaylee. She brought such a beautiful energy to the table, knew the menu inside and out, and effortlessly answered all of our questions! We started with the appetizers from the menu, and they were spectacular. The French Onion Soup was deeply savory with a perfect, bubbly layer of gooey gratinée cheese, the Lump Crab Cakes were packed with sweet crab meat over a smoky corn hash, and the loaded Iceberg Wedge Salad offered a wonderful, crisp contrast. ​For our entrees, both the 10-oz New York Strip (paired with ultra smooth mashed potatoes and rich macaroni and cheese) and the 6-oz Top Sirloin Steak (served with tender, parmesan-shaved charred asparagus) were cooked to absolute perfection. Pro-tip: Upgrade to the Sauce Flight! Sampling all five house-made sauces makes every bite an adventure. ​We finished the night with their spectacular Crème Brûlée, featuring a perfectly glassy torched crust, fresh berries, and adorable chocolate-dipped shortbread cookies with Mickey sprinkles. ​Between Kaylee's fantastic service and the top-tier food, it was a flawless meal. We will definitely be back!

The miso soup was hot, clean, and comforting, exactly what you want before getting into the main course. The sashimi was incredibly fresh, with great variety and quality across the board. You can tell they take care in their sourcing and presentation. The Negihama roll was simple, but executed perfectly, clean flavors, balanced, and a great complement to the sashimi. What stood out most was how consistent everything was. No shortcuts, no filler, just well-prepared, high-quality food. If you are local, this is absolutely worth adding to your regular rotation. My girlfriend and I stopped by Steve’s Diner for breakfast after watching the SpaceX Starfall demo launch, and I have to say, the space-themed mural dedicated to the Space Shuttle program outside is awesome. It’s a great touch for a diner on the Space Coast and definitely caught our attention before we even walked inside. The atmosphere was what you’d expect from a classic hometown diner, but the dining area could use a little TLC. Several of the booths and seats were torn with stuffing coming out, the tables felt a bit sticky, and it was noticeably warm inside. Service started off a little slow, but it looked like our waitress may have been the only one working during a busy breakfast rush, so it’s hard to fault her too much. I ordered Steve’s Delight, which came with a pancake, a slice of French toast, eggs, a sausage link, two pieces of bacon, and hashbrowns. The food was good, but it never really reached orbit. The eggs and bacon were cooked well, but I was surprised by how small the pancake was—I was expecting something a little more substantial. The single sausage link also felt a little skimpy, and unfortunately the hashbrowns were cold just a couple of minutes after they hit the table. My girlfriend ordered the croissant sandwich with home fries. She said the sandwich was good, but not particularly memorable, and the home fries were a little bland and could have been served hotter. Overall, the food wasn’t bad by any means, but it also wasn’t the kind of breakfast…
